```cpp
constexpr uint32_t ITEM_TABLE = 0x7ddd98;  // 11 records of 40 bytes: kind, label, help, flag, count, 5 option labels
constexpr uint32_t HELP_OBJ = 0x9efb50;    // **: the camp help line (0x319d54)
constexpr uint32_t MSG_FILE = 0x9efb60;    // **: Camp.msbt (msg file object; +4 = its data)
constexpr uint32_t BTN_L = 1 << 6, BTN_R = 1 << 7;
const char k_hint_game[] = "  (L / R: PC settings)";
const char* const k_hint_pc[4] = {"PC 1/4 (L / R: pages)", "PC 2/4 (L / R: pages)", "PC 3/4 (L / R: pages)", "PC 4/4 (L / R: pages)"};  // put first (long texts get cut)

uint32_t g_screen = 0;
int g_page = -1;  // -1 the game's page, 0 / 1 ours
bool g_in_update = false;
int g_pending = -1;       // our page under the game's A dialog (rows hold the game's values meanwhile)
uint32_t g_saved[11][4];  // game rows: value, arrows, min, max
int g_cur[11], g_count[11];
uint64_t g_prev_buttons = 0;
uint32_t g_txt_data = 0;              // msg data whose TXT2 we rebuilt
std::vector<std::string> g_txt_orig;  // its original texts (each with its terminator)
uint32_t g_txt_arena = 0, g_txt_cap = 0;  // our TXT2 block
std::map<std::string, uint32_t> g_strs;  // guest copies of our strings (operator new, kept)

const PageRow& prow(int i) { return k_pages[g_page][i]; }
uint32_t row(uint32_t s, int i) { return s + 0x1c + i * 0x18; }
int slider_value(int i) { return g_count[i] > 1 ? (g_cur[i] * 10 + (g_count[i] - 1) / 2) / (g_count[i] - 1) : 0; }
uint32_t guest_str(Cpu* c, const std::string& s) {
    uint32_t& p = g_strs[s];
    if (!p) p = gcall(c, 0x5a8720, {(uint32_t)s.size() + 1}), memcpy(GPTR(p), s.c_str(), s.size() + 1);
    return p;
}

// Camp.msbt TXT2: msg data +0xc = section table (16 bytes each), +0x14 = TXT2's index; table entry {+0 block, +8
// block size}; block = {count, offsets[count] (from the block), texts (UTF-8 + 0)}, a text runs to the next offset
// (the last to the size). We build a whole new block (same layout) and point the table entry at it, so every
// reader sees a consistent block; the file's own block stays as it was.
uint32_t txt2_entry(uint32_t data) { return ld32(data + 0xc) + ld32(data + 0x14) * 0x10; }
// msbt texts may hold tags with 0 bytes inside (button icons): only the trailing terminator goes
std::string without_terminator(std::string s) {
    while (!s.empty() && s.back() == 0) s.pop_back();
    return s;
}
// Help texts: every CAMP_SETTING_HELP_* gets the page hint; help_row >= 0: that row's help is our text.
void rebuild_help(Cpu* c, int help_row, const std::string& text) {
    const uint32_t file = ld32(ld32(MSG_FILE)), data = file ? ld32(file + 4) : 0;
    if (!data || (int32_t)ld32(data + 0x14) < 0) return;
    const uint32_t ent = txt2_entry(data), sec = ld32(ent), n = ld32(sec);
    if (!n || n > 5000) return;
    // first time for this file (or it was loaded again: the entry does not point at our block): keep the originals
    if (data != g_txt_data || sec != g_txt_arena) {
        g_txt_data = data, g_txt_orig.assign(n, {}), g_txt_arena = 0, g_txt_cap = 0;
        const uint32_t size = ld32(ent + 8);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const uint32_t a = sec + ld32(sec + 4 + 4 * i), e = sec + (i + 1 < n ? ld32(sec + 8 + 4 * i) : size);
            g_txt_orig[i].assign((const char*)GPTR(a), e - a);
        }
    }
    std::vector<std::string> t = g_txt_orig;
    for (int r = 0; r < 11; r++) {
        const uint32_t idx = gcall(c, 0x5c22e8, {data, ld32(ITEM_TABLE + r * 40 + 8)});  // label -> index
        if (idx >= n) continue;
        const std::string base = r == help_row ? std::string(k_hint_pc[g_page]) + "  " + text : without_terminator(t[idx]) + k_hint_game;
        t[idx] = base + '\0';
    }
    uint32_t total = 4 + 4 * n;
    for (auto& s : t) total += (uint32_t)s.size();
    if (!g_txt_arena || total > g_txt_cap) g_txt_cap = total + 4096, g_txt_arena = gcall(c, 0x5a8720, {g_txt_cap});
    if (!g_txt_arena) return;
    const uint32_t b = g_txt_arena;
    st32(b, n);
    uint32_t off = 4 + 4 * n;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        memcpy(GPTR(b + off), t[i].data(), t[i].size());
        st32(b + 4 + 4 * i, off);
        off += (uint32_t)t[i].size();
    }
    st32(ent + 8, off), st32(ent, b);
}
void show_game_help(Cpu* c, uint32_t s) {
    const int i = (int)ld32(s + 0x124);
    if (i < 0 || i > 10) return;
    const uint32_t obj = ld32(ld32(HELP_OBJ)), file = ld32(ld32(MSG_FILE));
    c->r[13] -= 8;  // 0x319d54(help, 7, 0, label, file): the 5th argument goes on the stack
    st32(c->r[13], file);
    gcall(c, 0x319d54, {obj, 7, 0, ld32(ITEM_TABLE + i * 40 + 8)});
    c->r[13] += 8;
}
void show_help(Cpu* c, uint32_t s) {
    const int i = (int)ld32(s + 0x124);
    if (i < 0 || i > 10) return;
    std::string h = prow(i).help;
    SettingItem it;
    if (prow(i).name && prow(i).slider && overlay_setting(prow(i).name, it) && g_cur[i] < (int)it.choices.size())
        h = it.name + ": " + it.choices[g_cur[i]] + ". " + h;
    rebuild_help(c, i, h);
    show_game_help(c, s);
}
void show_option(Cpu* c, uint32_t s, int i) {
    SettingItem it;
    const uint32_t opt = ld32(row(s, i) + 4);
    if (!opt) return;
    if (!prow(i).name) { gcall(c, 0x586488, {opt, guest_str(c, "")}); return; }
    if (!overlay_setting(prow(i).name, it) || g_cur[i] >= (int)it.choices.size()) return;
    gcall(c, 0x586488, {opt, guest_str(c, it.choices[g_cur[i]])});
}

// On/Off items on rows 0-2: the option text object of an empty row (9, 8, 7; row 10 has another font) moves there while
// our page is up. The draw 0x33cb14 draws a row's option text whenever +4 is set; a text object's position is +0x50 x /
// +0x54 y (option x 850, rows 50 apart at 720p; same y as the row's label), used when its text is set.
struct Lent { int from = -1; float y = 0; };
Lent g_lent[3];
void return_options(Cpu* c, uint32_t s) {  // back home blank (our text would show there under the A dialog)
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        Lent& l = g_lent[i];
        if (l.from < 0) continue;
        const uint32_t o = ld32(row(s, i) + 4);
        if (o) memcpy(GPTR(o + 0x54), &l.y, 4), gcall(c, 0x586488, {o, guest_str(c, "")});
        st32(row(s, l.from) + 4, o), st32(row(s, i) + 4, 0);
        l = {};
    }
}
void lend_options(uint32_t s) {
    int donor = 9;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (!prow(i).name || prow(i).slider || ld32(row(s, i) + 4) || !ld32(row(s, i))) continue;
        while (donor > 2 && (prow(donor).name || !ld32(row(s, donor) + 4))) donor--;
        if (donor <= 2) return;
        const uint32_t o = ld32(row(s, donor) + 4);
        g_lent[i].from = donor;
        memcpy(&g_lent[i].y, GPTR(o + 0x54), 4);
        memcpy(GPTR(o + 0x54), GPTR(ld32(row(s, i)) + 0x54), 4);  // the label's y
        st32(row(s, i) + 4, o), st32(row(s, donor) + 4, 0);
        donor--;
    }
}

// show PC page `page` in the rows (from the game's page: keep its rows first)
void enter_pc(Cpu* c, uint32_t s, int page) {
    return_options(c, s);
    for (int i = 0; i < 11 && g_page < 0; i++) {
        const uint32_t r = row(s, i);
        g_saved[i][0] = ld32(r + 8), g_saved[i][1] = ld32(r + 0xc), g_saved[i][2] = ld32(r + 0x10), g_saved[i][3] = ld32(r + 0x14);
    }
    g_page = page;
    lend_options(s);
    for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
        const uint32_t r = row(s, i);
        SettingItem it;
        if (!prow(i).name) it.name = "", it.choices = {""};
        else if (!overlay_setting(prow(i).name, it)) it.name = "?", it.choices = {"-"};
        g_count[i] = (int)it.choices.size(), g_cur[i] = std::max(0, std::min(it.cur, g_count[i] - 1));
        st32(r + 0xc, prow(i).name ? 1 : 0), st32(r + 0x10, 0);
        if (prow(i).slider) st32(r + 8, slider_value(i)), st32(r + 0x14, 10);
        else st32(r + 8, g_cur[i]), st32(r + 0x14, std::min(4, g_count[i] - 1));  // the game's option table has 5 slots
        if (ld32(r)) gcall(c, 0x586488, {ld32(r), guest_str(c, it.name)});
        if (!prow(i).slider) show_option(c, s, i);
    }
    show_help(c, s);
    log("camp settings: PC page %d", page + 1);
}
void leave_pc(Cpu* c, uint32_t s, bool help) {
    return_options(c, s);
    const uint32_t file = ld32(ld32(MSG_FILE));
    for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
        const uint32_t r = row(s, i), rec = ITEM_TABLE + i * 40;
        st32(r + 8, g_saved[i][0]), st32(r + 0xc, g_saved[i][1]), st32(r + 0x10, g_saved[i][2]), st32(r + 0x14, g_saved[i][3]);
        // row 10 (difficulty) takes its options from another message file
        const uint32_t ofile = i == 10 ? ld32(ld32(0x9ef380) + 8) : file;
        if (ld32(r)) gcall(c, 0x586818, {ld32(r), file, ld32(rec + 4)});
        const uint32_t opt = ld32(r + 4), v = g_saved[i][0];
        if (opt && v < 5) gcall(c, 0x586818, {opt, ofile, ld32(rec + 0x14 + 4 * v)});
    }
    g_page = -1;
    rebuild_help(c, -1, {});
    if (help) show_game_help(c, s);
    log("camp settings: game page");
}
}  // namespace

// Settings screen update (S = r0): state S+4 (2 = browsing), cursor row S+0x124.
HLE_FN(camp_settings_update, "camp_settings_update") {
    const uint32_t s = c->r[0];
    const uint64_t b = g_pad_game_buttons, pressed = b & ~g_prev_buttons;
    g_prev_buttons = b;
    const Cpu keep = *c;
    if (s != g_screen) {  // a new screen: game page, help lines with the hint
        g_screen = s, g_page = -1, g_pending = -1;
        for (Lent& l : g_lent) l = {};
        rebuild_help(c, -1, {});
        if (ld32(s + 4) == 2) show_game_help(c, s);
        *c = keep;
    }
    // the A dialog is gone; No / B pass 7 (closing) first: wait for 2, or the "not browsing" branch below would leave
    // our page again in the same update (s94: B on the dialog showed the game page)
    if (g_pending >= 0 && ld32(s + 4) != 4 && ld32(s + 4) != 5 && ld32(s + 4) != 7) {
        if (ld32(s + 4) == 2) enter_pc(c, s, g_pending);  // No / B: our page again
        else rebuild_help(c, -1, {});  // Yes: applied, the screen closes
        g_pending = -1;
        *c = keep;
    }
    if (ld32(s + 4) == 2 && (pressed & (BTN_L | BTN_R))) {
        const int next = (g_page + 1 + ((pressed & BTN_R) ? 1 : 4)) % 5 - 1;  // -1 game, 0 .. 3
        if (next < 0) leave_pc(c, s, true);
        else enter_pc(c, s, next);
        *c = keep;
    }
    const int cur_before = (int)ld32(s + 0x124);
    uint32_t before[11];
    for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) before[i] = ld32(row(s, i) + 8);
    g_in_update = true;
    const uint32_t ret = call_unhooked(c, "camp_settings_update", {s});
    g_in_update = false;
    if (g_page < 0) { c->r[0] = ret; return; }
    const Cpu after = *c;
    if (ld32(s + 4) == 4 && ld32(s + 0x134) == 1) {  // A: the game's apply dialog sees its own values
        return_options(c, s);
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++)
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) st32(row(s, i) + 8 + 4 * k, g_saved[i][k]);
        g_pending = g_page, g_page = -1;
        log("camp settings: apply dialog from PC page %d", g_pending + 1);
    } else if (ld32(s + 4) != 2) {
        leave_pc(c, s, false);  // B / Y defaults: the game's own rows from here on
    } else {
        bool changed = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
            const uint32_t v = ld32(row(s, i) + 8);
            if (v == before[i] || !prow(i).name) continue;
            if (prow(i).slider) {  // one choice per press, the bar shows where it is
                g_cur[i] = std::max(0, std::min(g_count[i] - 1, g_cur[i] + ((int)v > (int)before[i] ? 1 : -1)));
                st32(row(s, i) + 8, slider_value(i));
            } else {
                g_cur[i] = (int)v;
                show_option(c, s, i);
            }
            overlay_apply_setting(prow(i).name, g_cur[i]);
            log("camp settings: %ls -> %d", prow(i).name, g_cur[i]);
            changed = true;
        }
        if (changed || (int)ld32(s + 0x124) != cur_before) show_help(c, s);
    }
    *c = after;
    c->r[0] = ret;
}

// The Settings screen's voice preview (row 2 = voice volume) plays an Itsuki line: not for our rows (user report 10-30).
HLE_FN(sound_play_cue, "sound_play_cue") {
    if (g_in_update && g_page >= 0) { c->r[0] = 0; return; }
    c->r[0] = call_unhooked(c, "sound_play_cue", {c->r[0], c->r[1]});
}

// The Settings screen's volume preview: not for our slider rows.
HLE_FN(sound_volume_set, "sound_volume_set") {
    if (g_in_update && g_page >= 0) return;
    c->r[0] = call_unhooked(c, "sound_volume_set", {c->r[0], c->r[1], c->r[2], c->r[3]});
}

// Empty slider rows (PC 4/4 rows 0-2; USER 11-21: "3 blank volume sliders, ugly"): the draw 0x33cb14 always draws rows 0-2 as
// sliders (row < 3: background 0x4e6c / table kind 0x4e6a, bar ui_draw_gauge, knob ui_draw_part; row index in r9 at those
// calls). On our pages an unnamed or On/Off row gets the choice-row background and no bar or knob, like rows 3-10.
static bool empty_slider_row(const Cpu* c) {
    return g_page >= 0 && c->r[9] < 3 && (!k_pages[g_page][c->r[9]].name || !k_pages[g_page][c->r[9]].slider);
}
HLE_FN(ui_draw_sprite, "ui_draw_sprite") {
    if (c->r[14] == 0x33cccc && empty_slider_row(c)) c->r[0] = c->r[0] == 0x4e6c ? 0x4e6d : 0x4e6b;
    c->r[0] = call_unhooked(c, "ui_draw_sprite", {c->r[0], c->r[1], c->r[2], c->r[3]});
}
HLE_FN(ui_draw_gauge, "ui_draw_gauge") {
    if (c->r[14] == 0x33cd80 && empty_slider_row(c)) return;
    c->r[0] = call_unhooked(c, "ui_draw_gauge", {c->r[0], c->r[1], c->r[2], c->r[3]});
}
HLE_FN(ui_draw_part, "ui_draw_part") {
    if (c->r[14] == 0x33cda0 && empty_slider_row(c)) return;
    c->r[0] = call_unhooked(c, "ui_draw_part", {c->r[0], c->r[1], c->r[2], c->r[3]});
}

```

`runtime/src/dispatch.cpp`:

```cpp
// Guest address -> recompiled function, HLE hooks bound by symbol name, traps raised by generated code.
#include "plat.h"
#ifndef _WIN32
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <shared_mutex>
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <filesystem>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
#include <set>

#include "rt.h"

extern "C" uint32_t* g_cover = nullptr;

namespace rt {
// the recompiled code and its tables live in game.dll (tools/setup/build_game.py, also run by the CMake build), found
// next to tms.exe: the program download carries no game code, setup builds game.dll from the player's own copy
static const GuestFunc* g_guest_funcs;
static uint32_t g_guest_func_count;
static const GuestHookName* g_hook_names;
static uint32_t g_hook_count;
static const GuestHookName* g_hook_aliases;
static uint32_t g_hook_alias_count;
static const GuestHookName* g_thunks;
static uint32_t g_thunk_count;
static GuestFn* g_hooks;
static GuestFn* g_probes;
const GuestModule* g_modules;
uint32_t g_module_count, g_image_size;

void game_load(const std::filesystem::path& dir) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    auto p = dir / "game.dll";
    HMODULE m = LoadLibraryW(p.c_str());
    if (!m) fatal("cannot load %s (error %lu): run Setup in launcher.exe to build it from your game files",
                  p.string().c_str(), GetLastError());
    auto sym = [&](const char* n) {
        void* a = (void*)GetProcAddress(m, n);
        if (!a) fatal("game.dll has no %s: rebuild it (Setup in launcher.exe)", n);
        return a;
    };
#else
    // game.so: next to tms, or NX_GAME_SO (a build kept outside a read-only install, e.g. an AppImage)
    std::filesystem::path p = getenv("NX_GAME_SO") ? std::filesystem::path(getenv("NX_GAME_SO")) : dir / "game.so";
    void* m = dlopen(p.c_str(), RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
    if (!m) fatal("cannot load %s (%s): run the setup (tools/setup/setup.py) to build it from your game files",
                  p.string().c_str(), dlerror());
    auto sym = [&](const char* n) {
        void* a = dlsym(m, n);
        if (!a) fatal("game.so has no %s: rebuild it (tools/setup/setup.py)", n);
        return a;
    };
#endif
    g_guest_funcs = (const GuestFunc*)sym("g_guest_funcs");
    g_guest_func_count = *(const uint32_t*)sym("g_guest_func_count");
    g_hook_names = (const GuestHookName*)sym("g_hook_names");
    g_hook_count = *(const uint32_t*)sym("g_hook_count");
    g_hook_aliases = (const GuestHookName*)sym("g_hook_aliases");
    g_hook_alias_count = *(const uint32_t*)sym("g_hook_alias_count");
    g_thunks = (const GuestHookName*)sym("g_thunks");
    g_thunk_count = *(const uint32_t*)sym("g_thunk_count");
    g_hooks = (GuestFn*)sym("g_hooks");
    g_probes = (GuestFn*)sym("g_probes");
    g_modules = (const GuestModule*)sym("g_modules");
    g_module_count = *(const uint32_t*)sym("g_module_count");
    g_image_size = *(const uint32_t*)sym("g_image_size");
    log("game.dll: %s, %u functions", p.string().c_str(), g_guest_func_count);
}

// probed functions called since the last report, with counts (NX_COVER)
void cover_report() {
    static std::vector<uint32_t> last;
    if (!g_cover) return;
    last.resize(g_hook_count);
    std::string s;
    char b[64];
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < g_hook_count; k++) {
        uint32_t n = g_cover[k] - last[k];
        last[k] = g_cover[k];
        if (n) { snprintf(b, sizeof b, " %s:%u", g_hook_names[k].name, n); s += b; }
        if (s.size() > 3000) { log("cover:%s", s.c_str()); s.clear(); }  // log lines are cut at 4 KB
    }
    log("cover-end:%s", s.c_str());
}

struct Reg { const char* name; HleFn fn; bool probe; };
static std::vector<Reg>& registry() {
    static std::vector<Reg> r;
    return r;
}
HleReg::HleReg(const char* mangled, HleFn fn, bool probe) { registry().push_back({mangled, fn, probe}); }

// NX_PROBE=name,name,...: log every call of those names-file functions (arguments and caller), up to 64 names
static const char* g_probe_names[64];
template <int K> static void probe_log(Cpu* c) {
    log("probe %s(%08x %08x %08x %08x) lr %s", g_probe_names[K], c->r[0], c->r[1], c->r[2], c->r[3], symbol_at(c->r[14]));
}
template <int... K> static constexpr std::array<HleFn, sizeof...(K)> probe_table(std::integer_sequence<int, K...>) {
    return {probe_log<K>...};
}
static constexpr auto g_probe_loggers = probe_table(std::make_integer_sequence<int, 64>{});

struct TextRange { uint32_t lo, hi; std::vector<GuestFn> fns; };
static std::vector<TextRange> g_text;
static uint32_t g_thunk_lo = 0xFFFFFFFF, g_thunk_hi = 0;
static std::vector<HleFn> g_thunk_fn;
static std::vector<const char*> g_thunk_name;
static std::map<uint32_t, const char*> g_syms;
static std::unordered_map<std::string, uint32_t> g_sym_addr;
constexpr uint32_t THUNK_SIZE = 16;
static std::unordered_map<std::string, uint32_t> g_hook_index;

void dispatch_init() {
    // contiguous runs of functions -> dense tables, split where the gap is large (between modules)
    uint32_t i = 0;
    while (i < g_guest_func_count) {
        uint32_t lo = g_guest_funcs[i].addr, j = i;
        while (j + 1 < g_guest_func_count && g_guest_funcs[j + 1].addr - g_guest_funcs[j].addr < 0x100000) j++;
        TextRange t{lo, g_guest_funcs[j].addr + 4, {}};
        t.fns.assign((t.hi - lo) / 4, nullptr);
        for (uint32_t k = i; k <= j; k++) t.fns[(g_guest_funcs[k].addr - lo) / 4] = g_guest_funcs[k].fn;
        g_text.push_back(std::move(t));
        i = j + 1;
    }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < g_hook_count; k++) {
        g_syms[g_hook_names[k].addr] = g_hook_names[k].name;
        g_sym_addr[g_hook_names[k].name] = g_hook_names[k].addr;
    }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < g_thunk_count; k++) {
        g_thunk_lo = std::min(g_thunk_lo, g_thunks[k].addr);
        g_thunk_hi = std::max(g_thunk_hi, g_thunks[k].addr + THUNK_SIZE);
    }
    if (g_thunk_count) {
        g_thunk_fn.assign((g_thunk_hi - g_thunk_lo) / THUNK_SIZE, nullptr);
        g_thunk_name.assign(g_thunk_fn.size(), nullptr);
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < g_thunk_count; k++) g_thunk_name[(g_thunks[k].addr - g_thunk_lo) / THUNK_SIZE] = g_thunks[k].name;
    }
    // bind HLE implementations: exported functions get their hook slot, unresolved imports their thunk
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> idx_of_addr;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < g_hook_count; k++) idx_of_addr.emplace(g_hook_names[k].addr, k);
    std::unordered_map<std::string, uint32_t> hook_idx;  // every alias -> hook slot of its address
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < g_hook_alias_count; k++) {
        hook_idx.emplace(g_hook_aliases[k].name, idx_of_addr[g_hook_aliases[k].addr]);
        g_sym_addr.emplace(g_hook_aliases[k].name, g_hook_aliases[k].addr);
    }
    g_hook_index = hook_idx;
    int bound = 0, unused = 0;
    for (auto& [name, fn, probe] : registry()) {
        bool ok = false;
        auto h = hook_idx.find(name);
        if (h != hook_idx.end()) { (probe ? g_probes : g_hooks)[h->second] = fn; ok = true; }
        for (size_t k = 0; k < g_thunk_name.size() && !probe; k++)
            if (g_thunk_name[k] && !strcmp(g_thunk_name[k], name)) { g_thunk_fn[k] = fn; ok = true; }
        if (ok) bound++;
        else { unused++; LOGV("HLE %s: no such symbol", name); }
    }
    if (const char* cov = getenv("NX_COVER")) {  // every 10 s (NX_COVER=manual: only on the control line "cover")
        static std::vector<uint32_t> counts(g_hook_count);
        g_cover = counts.data();
        if (strcmp(cov, "manual"))
            std::thread([] { for (;;) { Sleep(10000); cover_report(); } }).detach();
    }
    if (const char* env = getenv("NX_PROBE")) {
        static std::vector<std::string> keep;
        keep.reserve(128);  // g_probe_names points into it
        std::string s = env;
        for (size_t p = 0, n = 0; p <= s.size() && n < 64;) {
            size_t q = s.find(',', p);
            if (q == std::string::npos) q = s.size();
            keep.push_back(s.substr(p, q - p));
            p = q + 1;
            auto h = hook_idx.find(keep.back());
            if (h == hook_idx.end()) { log("NX_PROBE: no hookable function %s", keep.back().c_str()); continue; }
            g_probe_names[n] = keep.back().c_str();
            g_probes[h->second] = g_probe_loggers[n++];
        }
    }
    log("dispatch: %u functions in %zu ranges, %d HLE bound, %d unmatched", g_guest_func_count, g_text.size(), bound, unused);
}

// call an exported guest function with its HLE hook disabled (to reach the real SDK implementation)
uint32_t call_unhooked(Cpu* c, const char* name, std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args) {
    auto it = g_hook_index.find(name);
    if (it == g_hook_index.end()) fatal("call_unhooked: %s is not hookable", name);
    c->hook_bypass = it->second + 1;  // per thread: HOOK at the function's entry clears it and runs the guest code
    return gcall(c, name, args);
}

GuestFn lookup(uint32_t a) {
    for (auto& t : g_text)
        if (a >= t.lo && a < t.hi) return (a & 3) ? nullptr : t.fns[(a - t.lo) / 4];
    return nullptr;
}

const char* symbol_at(uint32_t a) {
    static thread_local char buf[256];
    auto it = g_syms.upper_bound(a);
    if (it == g_syms.begin()) { snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%08x", a); return buf; }
    --it;
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%08x %s+%#x", a, it->second, a - it->first);
    return buf;
}

uint32_t export_addr(const char* name) {
    auto it = g_sym_addr.find(name);
    return it == g_sym_addr.end() ? 0 : it->second;
}

}  // namespace rt

using namespace rt;

extern "C" void dispatch(Cpu* c, uint32_t t) {
    if (GuestFn f = lookup(t)) { f(c); return; }
    if (t >= g_thunk_lo && t < g_thunk_hi) {
        size_t k = (t - g_thunk_lo) / THUNK_SIZE;
        if (g_thunk_fn[k]) { g_thunk_fn[k](c); return; }
        static std::mutex m;
        static std::set<size_t> seen;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m);
            if (seen.insert(k).second) log("unimplemented import %s (lr %s)", g_thunk_name[k], symbol_at(c->r[14]));
        }
        c->r[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (HleFn f = host_callback_at(t)) { f(c); return; }
    guest_bad_branch(c, c->r[14], t);
}

extern "C" void guest_trap(Cpu* c, uint32_t a, const char* why) {
    fatal("guest trap at %s: %s (lr %s)", symbol_at(a), why, symbol_at(c->r[14]));
}

extern "C" void guest_unimpl(Cpu* c, uint32_t a, uint32_t w) {
    fatal("unimplemented instruction %08x at %s (lr %s)", w, symbol_at(a), symbol_at(c->r[14]));
}

extern "C" void guest_bad_branch(Cpu* c, uint32_t from, uint32_t to) {
    fatal("branch to unknown code %08x from %s (sp %08x)", to, symbol_at(from), c->r[13]);
}

extern "C" void guest_noreturn(Cpu* c, uint32_t a) {
    fatal("noreturn call returned at %s", symbol_at(a));
}

extern "C" void guest_svc(Cpu* c, uint32_t imm, uint32_t a) {
    (void)a;
    rt::svc(c, imm);
}

extern "C" void guest_yield(Cpu* c) {
    (void)c;
    SwitchToThread();
}

extern "C" uint32_t cp15_read(Cpu* c, int opc1, int crn, int crm, int opc2) {
    log("cp15 read %d c%d c%d %d at lr %s", opc1, crn, crm, opc2, symbol_at(c->r[14]));
    return 0;
}

extern "C" void cp15_write(Cpu* c, int opc1, int crn, int crm, int opc2, uint32_t v) {
    log("cp15 write %d c%d c%d %d = %08x at lr %s", opc1, crn, crm, opc2, v, symbol_at(c->r[14]));
}

static uint64_t real_counter() {
#ifdef _WIN32
    static LARGE_INTEGER freq = [] { LARGE_INTEGER f; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f); return f; }();
    LARGE_INTEGER now;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    uint64_t q = (uint64_t)now.QuadPart, f = (uint64_t)freq.QuadPart;
#else
    timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    uint64_t q = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec, f = 1000000000ull;
#endif
    return q / f * 19200000 + q % f * 19200000 / f;
}

// guest time = base_guest + (real - base_real) * speed; rebased on every speed change so it never jumps back
#ifdef _WIN32
static SRWLOCK g_speed_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
#else
static std::shared_mutex g_speed_lock;
static void AcquireSRWLockExclusive(std::shared_mutex* m) { m->lock(); }
static void ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(std::shared_mutex* m) { m->unlock(); }
static void AcquireSRWLockShared(std::shared_mutex* m) { m->lock_shared(); }
static void ReleaseSRWLockShared(std::shared_mutex* m) { m->unlock_shared(); }
#endif
static uint64_t g_base_real = 0, g_base_guest = 0;
std::atomic<int> rt::g_speed{[] { const char* s = getenv("NX_SPEED"); return s && atoi(s) > 1 ? atoi(s) : 1; }()};

void rt::set_speed(int n) {
    if (n < 1) n = 1;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_speed_lock);
    uint64_t real = real_counter();
    g_base_guest += (real - g_base_real) * (uint64_t)g_speed.load();
    g_base_real = real;
    g_speed = n;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_speed_lock);
    log("speed: x%d", n);
}

extern "C" uint64_t guest_counter(void) {
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_speed_lock);
    uint64_t t = g_base_guest + (real_counter() - g_base_real) * (uint64_t)g_speed.load();
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_speed_lock);
    return t;
}

// setjmp/longjmp: see lift.py (setjmp is lifted inline at its call sites)
extern "C" GuestJmp* guest_setjmp_slot(Cpu* c, uint32_t buf) {
    (void)c;
    return &cur()->jmps[buf];
}
extern "C" void guest_setjmp_save(Cpu* c, GuestJmp* j) {
    memcpy(j->r, c->r, sizeof j->r);
    memcpy(j->d, &c->vr.x[8], sizeof j->d);
    c->r[0] = 0;
}
extern "C" void guest_setjmp_resume(Cpu* c, GuestJmp* j) {
    memcpy(&c->r[4], &j->r[4], 11 * 4);  // r4-r14
    memcpy(&c->vr.x[8], j->d, sizeof j->d);
    c->r[0] = j->val;
}
HLE_FN(hle_longjmp, "longjmp") {
    auto& m = cur()->jmps;
    auto it = m.find(c->r[0]);
    if (it == m.end()) fatal("longjmp to unknown jmp_buf %08x", c->r[0]);
    it->second.val = c->r[1] ? c->r[1] : 1;
    longjmp(it->second.host, 1);
}
```

```h
#pragma once
// Linux 2D drawing for the menu (overlay.cpp), voice subtitles (subs.cpp) and button icons (pad_icons.cpp): cairo for
// shapes, pango for text, both standard on Linux desktops. Windows draws the same things with Direct2D / DirectWrite.
// Surfaces are CAIRO_FORMAT_ARGB32: premultiplied B, G, R, A bytes, top-down, like the Direct2D PBGRA targets.
#ifndef _WIN32
#include <cairo.h>
#include <pango/pangocairo.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

namespace draw {

// wchar_t is UTF-32 on Linux
inline std::string utf8(const wchar_t* w) {
    std::string s;
    for (; w && *w; w++) {
        uint32_t c = (uint32_t)*w;
        if (c < 0x80) s += (char)c;
        else if (c < 0x800) s += (char)(0xC0 | c >> 6), s += (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        else if (c < 0x10000) s += (char)(0xE0 | c >> 12), s += (char)(0x80 | (c >> 6 & 0x3F)), s += (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        else s += (char)(0xF0 | c >> 18), s += (char)(0x80 | (c >> 12 & 0x3F)), s += (char)(0x80 | (c >> 6 & 0x3F)), s += (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
    }
    return s;
}
inline std::string utf8(const std::wstring& w) { return utf8(w.c_str()); }
inline std::wstring wide(const std::string& s) {
    std::wstring w;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size();) {
        const uint8_t b = (uint8_t)s[i];
        const int n = b < 0x80 ? 1 : b >> 5 == 6 ? 2 : b >> 4 == 14 ? 3 : b >> 3 == 30 ? 4 : 1;
        uint32_t c = n == 1 ? b : n == 2 ? b & 0x1F : n == 3 ? b & 0x0F : b & 0x07;
        for (int k = 1; k < n && i + k < s.size(); k++) c = c << 6 | ((uint8_t)s[i + k] & 0x3F);
        w += (wchar_t)c;
        i += n;
    }
    return w;
}

struct Color { double r, g, b, a; };
inline Color rgb(uint32_t c, double a = 1) { return {(c >> 16 & 255) / 255.0, (c >> 8 & 255) / 255.0, (c & 255) / 255.0, a}; }
inline void set(cairo_t* cr, Color c) { cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a); }

inline void round_rect(cairo_t* cr, double x, double y, double w, double h, double r) {
    r = std::min(r, std::min(w, h) / 2);
    cairo_new_sub_path(cr);
    cairo_arc(cr, x + w - r, y + r, r, -M_PI / 2, 0);
    cairo_arc(cr, x + w - r, y + h - r, r, 0, M_PI / 2);
    cairo_arc(cr, x + r, y + h - r, r, M_PI / 2, M_PI);
    cairo_arc(cr, x + r, y + r, r, M_PI, 3 * M_PI / 2);
    cairo_close_path(cr);
}
inline void ellipse(cairo_t* cr, double cx, double cy, double rx, double ry) {
    cairo_save(cr);
    cairo_translate(cr, cx, cy);
    cairo_scale(cr, rx, ry);
    cairo_new_sub_path(cr);
    cairo_arc(cr, 0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * M_PI);
    cairo_restore(cr);
}

enum Align { LEADING, TRAILING, CENTER };
// the DirectWrite families the Windows code asks for, as fontconfig fallbacks
constexpr const char* k_ui_font = "Segoe UI, Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, Sans";
constexpr const char* k_icon_font = "Arial, Liberation Sans, Arimo, DejaVu Sans, Sans";

// a pango layout for utf-8 text, size in pixels (the em size, as DirectWrite's font size), weight 400 / 600 / 700
inline PangoLayout* layout(cairo_t* cr, const std::string& s, double size, int weight, const char* family = k_ui_font) {
    PangoLayout* l = pango_cairo_create_layout(cr);
    PangoFontDescription* fd = pango_font_description_from_string(family);
    pango_font_description_set_absolute_size(fd, size * PANGO_SCALE);
    pango_font_description_set_weight(fd, (PangoWeight)weight);
    pango_layout_set_font_description(l, fd);
    pango_font_description_free(fd);
    pango_layout_set_text(l, s.c_str(), -1);
    return l;
}
// text in the box (x, y, w, h): wrapped at w, aligned, centred vertically (DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER)
inline void text(cairo_t* cr, const std::string& s, double x, double y, double w, double h, double size, Color c,
                 int weight = 600, Align align = LEADING, const char* family = k_ui_font) {
    if (s.empty() || w <= 0) return;
    PangoLayout* l = layout(cr, s, size, weight, family);
    pango_layout_set_width(l, (int)(w * PANGO_SCALE));
    pango_layout_set_wrap(l, PANGO_WRAP_WORD_CHAR);
    pango_layout_set_alignment(l, align == CENTER ? PANGO_ALIGN_CENTER : align == TRAILING ? PANGO_ALIGN_RIGHT : PANGO_ALIGN_LEFT);
    int lw, lh;
    pango_layout_get_pixel_size(l, &lw, &lh);
    set(cr, c);
    cairo_move_to(cr, x, y + (h - lh) / 2);
    pango_cairo_show_layout(cr, l);
    g_object_unref(l);
}

// A drawing surface of w x h; data() is premultiplied BGRA, w * 4 bytes a row (cairo_image_surface_get_stride may pad:
// stride() says it)
struct Canvas {
    cairo_surface_t* surf = nullptr;
    cairo_t* cr = nullptr;
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    Canvas(int w_, int h_) : w(w_), h(h_) {
        surf = cairo_image_surface_create(CAIRO_FORMAT_ARGB32, w, h);
        cr = cairo_create(surf);
        cairo_set_antialias(cr, CAIRO_ANTIALIAS_GOOD);
    }
    ~Canvas() { cairo_destroy(cr); cairo_surface_destroy(surf); }
    Canvas(const Canvas&) = delete;
    Canvas& operator=(const Canvas&) = delete;
    bool ok() const { return cairo_surface_status(surf) == CAIRO_STATUS_SUCCESS; }
    void clear() {
        cairo_save(cr);
        cairo_set_operator(cr, CAIRO_OPERATOR_CLEAR);
        cairo_paint(cr);
        cairo_restore(cr);
    }
    const uint8_t* data() { cairo_surface_flush(surf); return cairo_image_surface_get_data(surf); }
    int stride() const { return cairo_image_surface_get_stride(surf); }
};

}  // namespace draw
#endif
```

`runtime/src/ext_bgm.cpp`:

```cpp
// Custom battle music (setting random_battle_bgm = 2 custom / 3 mixed; user request 10-30): CRI ADX files from a
// folder (setting custom_bgm_dir, default <data>\music) play instead of the game's battle track, and the victory theme
// that matches the battle track's series plays at the victory. Made for the P5R "random battle music" mod's loose
// files: "<id>_<series>_<title>.adx", e.g. "1_P5R_Last Surprise Battle.adx" -> "300_P5R_Victory.adx".
// - pairing: a title with "Victory" is a victory theme, everything else a battle track. The victory for a battle
//   series: the same series; else the one with the longest common start if one series starts the other or 9+
//   characters are the same ("Persona 2 InnocentSin" -> "Persona 2 EternalPunishment"); "P4" = "Persona 4"; else a
//   random victory theme.
// - decoder (our own): ADX v4, 4-bit ADPCM, 18-byte frames x channels (32 samples), 2-tap predictor from the header's
//   highpass frequency, scale = (16-bit BE & 0x1fff) + 1; encryption type 9 (flag 0x13 = 9): the scale is XORed with an
//   LCG stepped once per frame in file order (keycode from setting custom_bgm_key, none built in: encrypted files without
//   it are skipped with a log line); loop points from the v4 header
//   (+0x18 + 4 ch: align, 1, loop flag, start sample, start byte, end sample, end byte). At the loop start the decoder
//   state (history + XOR) is saved and restored at the loop end.
// - output: mixed into the game's own audio buffers (hle_audio.cpp feeder, 48 kHz stereo s16); 1 s fade out when the
//   game's music takes over again. Other rates are resampled linearly. Loudness: each track is scaled to the RMS
//   level of the game's own battle music in its output (BGM_RMS), times setting custom_bgm_volume / 7 (0..10, default
//   7 = the game's level). Measured 11-01: the game's BGM files (Common.awb, plain ADX) have RMS 3400..6400 (quartiles)
//   and come out ~0.175 x (field music ~750 in the audio log); battle tracks are the loud ones -> ~1100. The P5R files
//   are 4800..12300, so the old fixed 0.7 gain was 10..18 dB louder than the game (user 11-01: far too loud).
#include "plat.h"

#include <filesystem>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "rt.h"

using namespace rt;

namespace {
struct Track { std::string path, series; bool victory; };
std::vector<Track> g_tracks;
std::once_flag g_scan_once;

uint32_t rnd() {
    static uint32_t s = (uint32_t)GetTickCount() * 2654435761u | 1;
    s ^= s << 13, s ^= s >> 17, s ^= s << 5;
    return s;
}
std::string lower(std::string s) {
    for (char& ch : s) ch = (char)tolower((unsigned char)ch);
    return s;
}
std::string folder() {
    const char* d = getenv("NX_CUSTOM_BGM_DIR");
#ifdef _WIN32
    return d && *d ? std::string(d) : g_data_dir + "\\music";
#else
    return d && *d ? std::string(d) : g_data_dir + "/music";
#endif
}
#ifndef _WIN32
void scan() {  // Linux: every *.adx (any case) in the folder, sorted
    const std::string dir = folder();
    std::vector<std::string> names;
    std::error_code ec;
    for (auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir, ec)) {
        const std::string n = e.path().filename().string();
        if (n.size() > 4 && lower(n.substr(n.size() - 4)) == ".adx") names.push_back(n);
    }
    if (names.empty()) { log("custom music: no .adx files in %s", dir.c_str()); return; }
    std::sort(names.begin(), names.end());
    for (const std::string& name : names) {
        const std::string stem = name.substr(0, name.size() - 4);
        const size_t a = stem.find('_'), b = a == std::string::npos ? a : stem.find('_', a + 1);
        Track t{dir + "/" + name, b == std::string::npos ? "" : stem.substr(a + 1, b - a - 1),
                lower(stem).find("victory") != std::string::npos};
        if (t.series == "P4") t.series = "Persona 4";
        g_tracks.push_back(t);
    }
    int v = 0;
    for (auto& t : g_tracks) v += t.victory;
    log("custom music: %zu battle tracks, %d victory themes in %s", g_tracks.size() - v, v, dir.c_str());
}
#else
void scan() {
    const std::string dir = folder();
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA((dir + "\\*.adx").c_str(), &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) { log("custom music: no .adx files in %s", dir.c_str()); return; }
    do {
        const std::string name = fd.cFileName, stem = name.substr(0, name.size() - 4);
        const size_t a = stem.find('_'), b = a == std::string::npos ? a : stem.find('_', a + 1);
        Track t{dir + "\\" + name, b == std::string::npos ? "" : stem.substr(a + 1, b - a - 1),
                lower(stem).find("victory") != std::string::npos};
        if (t.series == "P4") t.series = "Persona 4";
        g_tracks.push_back(t);
    } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
    int v = 0;
    for (auto& t : g_tracks) v += t.victory;
    log("custom music: %zu battle tracks, %d victory themes in %s", g_tracks.size() - v, v, dir.c_str());
}
#endif
const Track* pick_battle() {
    std::vector<const Track*> v;
    for (auto& t : g_tracks) if (!t.victory) v.push_back(&t);
    return v.empty() ? nullptr : v[rnd() % v.size()];
}
const Track* pick_victory(const std::string& series) {
    const Track* best = nullptr;
    size_t best_n = 0;
    std::vector<const Track*> all;
    for (auto& t : g_tracks) {
        if (!t.victory) continue;
        all.push_back(&t);
        if (t.series == series) return &t;
        size_t n = 0;
        while (n < series.size() && n < t.series.size() && series[n] == t.series[n]) n++;
        const bool ok = n >= 9 || (n && n == std::min(series.size(), t.series.size()));
        if (ok && n > best_n) best = &t, best_n = n;
    }
    return best ? best : all.empty() ? nullptr : all[rnd() % all.size()];
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ADX decoder
struct Adx {
    std::vector<uint8_t> f;
    uint32_t ch = 0, rate = 0, frame = 0, data = 0, total = 0;
    bool enc = false, loop = false;
    uint32_t loop_start = 0, loop_end = 0;  // samples
    int c1 = 0, c2 = 0;
    uint16_t mul = 0, add = 0;
    // decoder state
    struct State { uint32_t pos; uint16_t xr; int h[2][2]; } st{}, at_loop{};
    int16_t buf[2][32];
    uint32_t buf_frame = ~0u;  // frame index in buf
    bool open(const std::string& path) {
        FILE* fp = fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
        if (!fp) return false;
        fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_END);
        f.resize((size_t)ftell(fp));
        fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_SET);
        const bool rd = fread(f.data(), 1, f.size(), fp) == f.size();
        fclose(fp);
        auto be16 = [&](size_t o) { return (uint32_t)f[o] << 8 | f[o + 1]; };
        auto be32 = [&](size_t o) { return be16(o) << 16 | be16(o + 2); };
        if (!rd || f.size() < 0x40 || be16(0) != 0x8000 || f[4] != 3 || f[6] != 4 || f[7] < 1 || f[7] > 2) return false;
        frame = f[5], ch = f[7], rate = be32(8), total = be32(12), data = be16(2) + 4;
        if (frame != 18 || !rate || data >= f.size()) return false;
        enc = f[0x13] == 9;
        if (f[0x12] == 4) {
            const size_t p = 0x18 + 4 * ch + (ch == 1 ? 4 : 0);
            if (p + 24 <= data && be32(p + 4)) loop = true, loop_start = be32(p + 8), loop_end = be32(p + 16);
        }
        if (loop_end > total || loop_start >= loop_end) loop = false;
        const double hp = be16(0x10), a = std::sqrt(2.0) - std::cos(2 * 3.14159265358979 * hp / rate), b = std::sqrt(2.0) - 1;
        const double c = (a - std::sqrt((a + b) * (a - b))) / b;
        c1 = (int)(c * 8192), c2 = (int)(c * c * -4096);
        static const uint64_t keycode = [] { const char* e = getenv("NX_CUSTOM_BGM_KEY"); return e ? strtoull(e, nullptr, 10) : 0ull; }();
        if (enc && !keycode) { log("custom music: %s is encrypted: set custom_bgm_key in settings.ini (or use decrypted files)", path.c_str()); return false; }
        const uint64_t k = keycode - 1;
        st = {};
        st.xr = (uint16_t)((k >> 27) & 0x7fff), mul = (uint16_t)(((k >> 12) & 0x7ffc) | 1), add = (uint16_t)(((k << 1) & 0x7fff) | 1);
        if (!enc && keycode) {  // some repacked files have flag 0 but P5R-keyed frames (40_SMT3_Fiend Battle): keyed scales come out far smaller
            uint64_t plain = 0, keyed = 0;
            uint16_t xr = st.xr;
            for (size_t i = 0, o = data; i < 64 && o + 2 <= f.size(); i++, o += frame)
                plain += be16(o) & 0x1fff, keyed += (be16(o) ^ xr) & 0x1fff, xr = (uint16_t)((xr * mul + add) & 0x7fff);
            enc = keyed * 4 < plain;
        }
        return true;
    }
    // decode frame index fi (sequential: st.pos is the next frame)
    void decode_next() {
        const uint32_t fi = st.pos;
        if (loop && fi == loop_start / 32) at_loop = st;
        for (uint32_t c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            const size_t o = data + ((size_t)fi * ch + c) * frame;
            if (o + frame > f.size()) { memset(buf[c], 0, sizeof buf[c]); continue; }
            uint32_t raw = (uint32_t)f[o] << 8 | f[o + 1];
            if (enc) raw ^= st.xr, st.xr = (uint16_t)((st.xr * mul + add) & 0x7fff);
            const int scale = (int)(raw & 0x1fff) + 1;
            int h1 = st.h[c][0], h2 = st.h[c][1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
                int n = (f[o + 2 + i / 2] >> (i & 1 ? 0 : 4)) & 15;
                if (n >= 8) n -= 16;
                int s = n * scale + ((c1 * h1 + c2 * h2) >> 12);
                s = std::clamp(s, -32768, 32767);
                h2 = h1, h1 = s;
                buf[c][i] = (int16_t)s;
            }
            st.h[c][0] = h1, st.h[c][1] = h2;
        }
        buf_frame = fi;
        st.pos++;
    }
    // sample n, both channels, called with n = 0, 1, 2, ... (n jumps back to the loop start at the loop end);
    // false at the end (no loop)
    bool sample(uint64_t& n, int& l, int& r) {
        if (loop && n >= loop_end) n = loop_start, st = at_loop, buf_frame = ~0u;
        if (n >= total) return false;
        const uint32_t fi = (uint32_t)(n / 32);
        while (fi != buf_frame) decode_next();  // sequential: the next frame (or the loop start frame again)
        l = buf[0][n % 32], r = buf[ch - 1][n % 32];
        return true;
    }
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ player
std::mutex g_lock;
constexpr double BGM_RMS = 1100;  // the game's music in its audio output (s16 RMS; see the header)
struct Voice {
    Adx adx;
    uint64_t pos = 0;  // next sample to read
    int cur[2] = {}, next[2] = {};  // samples pos - 2 and pos - 1: the output lies between them at frac
    bool primed = false, done = false;
    double frac = 0;
    float fade = 1, fade_step = 0, norm = 0;  // norm: gain to the game's music level
    std::string series;
    bool read(int* s) {
        if (!adx.sample(pos, s[0], s[1])) return false;
        pos++;
        return true;
    }
};
std::shared_ptr<Voice> g_voice;  // playing (g_lock)
std::string g_battle_series;     // series of the battle track playing (victory pairing)
bool g_active = false;           // a custom battle or victory track owns the music (g_lock)

void start(const Track* t, bool battle) {
    if (!t) return;
    auto v = std::make_shared<Voice>();
    const std::string path = t->path, series = t->series;
    std::thread([v, path, series, battle] {  // file load off the game thread
        if (!v->adx.open(path)) { log("custom music: cannot read %s", path.c_str()); return; }
        double sum = 0;  // RMS of the first 60 s, on a copy (the decoder is sequential)
        uint64_t n = 0;
        {
            Adx probe = v->adx;
            int a, b;
            for (uint64_t k = 0; n < 60ull * probe.rate && probe.sample(k, a, b); k++, n++) sum += (double)a * a + (double)b * b;
        }
        const double rms = n ? std::sqrt(sum / (2.0 * n)) : 0;
        v->norm = rms > 1 ? (float)std::min(1.0, BGM_RMS / rms) : 1.0f;
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_lock);
        if (!g_active) return;  // the game took the music back meanwhile
        v->series = series;
        g_voice = v;
        log("custom music: %s %s (%u Hz, %u ch, loop %s, rms %.0f, gain %.3f)", battle ? "battle" : "victory", path.c_str(),
            v->adx.rate, v->adx.ch, v->adx.loop ? "yes" : "no", rms, v->norm);
    }).detach();
}
}  // namespace

int rt::custom_bgm_mode() {
    const char* e = getenv("NX_RANDOM_BATTLE_BGM");
    return e ? std::clamp(atoi(e), 0, 3) : 0;
}
// bgm_play hook (hle_sys.cpp): a battle track starts. True = custom music plays (the game's track is to be stopped).
bool rt::custom_bgm_battle() {
    const int mode = custom_bgm_mode();
    if (mode < 2) return false;
    std::call_once(g_scan_once, scan);
    if (mode == 3 && rnd() % 2) return false;  // mixed: half the battles keep a game track
    const Track* t = pick_battle();
    if (!t) return false;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_lock);
    g_active = true, g_battle_series = t->series;
    if (g_voice) g_voice->fade_step = 1.0f / 4800;  // a battle track still fading: 0.1 s
    start(t, true);
    return true;
}
// the victory jingle (bgm 65) while custom battle music plays: the matching victory theme. True = handled.
bool rt::custom_bgm_victory() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_lock);
    if (!g_active) return false;
    if (g_voice) g_voice->fade_step = 1.0f / 4800;
    start(pick_victory(g_battle_series), false);
    return true;
}
// the game's music takes over (another track on the slot, the field music restored): fade out over 1 s
void rt::custom_bgm_stop(const char* why) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_lock);
    if (!g_active) return;
    g_active = false;
    if (g_voice && !g_voice->fade_step) g_voice->fade_step = 1.0f / 48000;
    log("custom music: stop (%s)", why);
}
bool rt::custom_bgm_active() { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_lock); return g_active; }

// hle_audio.cpp feeder: add the custom music to n stereo s16 frames at 48 kHz
void rt::custom_bgm_mix(int16_t* out, uint32_t n) {
    std::shared_ptr<Voice> v;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_lock);
        v = g_voice;
    }
    if (!v) return;
    const char* ve = getenv("NX_CUSTOM_BGM_VOLUME");
    const float gain = (ve ? std::clamp(atoi(ve), 0, 10) : 7) / 7.0f * v->norm;
    const double step = (double)v->adx.rate / 48000;
    if (!v->primed) {
        v->primed = true;
        if (!v->read(v->cur) || !v->read(v->next)) v->done = true;
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && !v->done; i++) {
        const float t = (float)v->frac, g = gain * v->fade;
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            const float x = (v->cur[c] + (v->next[c] - v->cur[c]) * t) * g;
            out[2 * i + c] = (int16_t)std::clamp((int)(out[2 * i + c] + x), -32768, 32767);
        }
        for (v->frac += step; v->frac >= 1 && !v->done; v->frac -= 1) {
            v->cur[0] = v->next[0], v->cur[1] = v->next[1];
            if (!v->read(v->next)) v->done = true;
        }
        if (v->fade_step && (v->fade -= v->fade_step) <= 0) v->done = true;
    }
    if (v->done) v->fade = 0;
    if (v->fade <= 0) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_lock);
        if (g_voice == v) g_voice = nullptr;
    }
}
```

`runtime/src/hle_audio.cpp`:

```cpp
// nn::audio AudioOut on an SDL3 audio stream. Buffers are released (and the game's event signalled) once SDL has
// consumed them, so the game's audio thread is paced by real playback like on the console.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include "plat.h"

#include <cmath>
#include <deque>
#include <thread>

#include "rt.h"

using namespace rt;

namespace rt { SDL_Window* ui_window(); void guest_backtrace(const Cpu& c); }

static std::mutex g_au_lock;
static std::deque<uint32_t> g_queued, g_released;  // guest AudioOutBuffer addresses
static uint32_t g_au_event = 0;                    // writable handle of the game's buffer event
static SDL_AudioStream* g_stream;
static bool g_playing = false;
static std::once_flag g_au_once;

// AudioOutBuffer (from the SDK's own setters): data pointer @8, buffer size @0x10, data size @0x18
static void feeder() {
    for (;;) {
        uint32_t b = 0;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_au_lock);
            if (g_playing && !g_queued.empty()) b = g_queued.front();
        }
        if (!b) { Sleep(2); continue; }
        uint32_t data = ld32(b + 8), size = ld32(b + 0x18);
        // every 10 s of audio: buffers, peak and RMS level (the game's and the custom music's), so silence shows
        static uint64_t a_bytes = 0, a_bufs = 0;
        static int a_peak = 0;
        static double a_game2 = 0, a_cust2 = 0;
        {
            const int16_t* s = (const int16_t*)GPTR(data);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < size / 2; i++) a_peak = std::max(a_peak, std::abs((int)s[i])), a_game2 += (double)s[i] * s[i];
            a_bufs++;
        }
        static const bool mute = getenv("NX_MUTE") != nullptr;
        const bool silent = !g_stream || mute || g_speed > 1;  // sped up: drop the audio, keep its pace
        if (!silent && size) {  // the custom battle music (ext_bgm.cpp) is mixed into a copy of the game's buffer
            static std::vector<int16_t> mix;
            mix.assign((const int16_t*)GPTR(data), (const int16_t*)GPTR(data) + size / 2);
            custom_bgm_mix(mix.data(), size / 4);
            const int16_t* s = (const int16_t*)GPTR(data);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < size / 2; i++) a_cust2 += (double)(mix[i] - s[i]) * (mix[i] - s[i]);
            SDL_PutAudioStreamData(g_stream, mix.data(), (int)size);
        }
        if ((a_bytes += size) >= 48000 * 4 * 10) {
            const double n = a_bytes / 2.0;
            log("audio: %llu buffers in 10 s, peak %d/32767, rms game %.0f custom %.0f", (unsigned long long)a_bufs, a_peak,
                sqrt(a_game2 / n), sqrt(a_cust2 / n));
            a_bytes = a_bufs = 0, a_peak = 0, a_game2 = a_cust2 = 0;
        }
        // keep ~2 buffers queued in SDL: wait until what is left drops below one buffer's worth
        while (g_stream && SDL_GetAudioStreamQueued(g_stream) > (int)size) Sleep(1);
        if (silent) Sleep(size / 192 / g_speed ? size / 192 / g_speed : 1);  // 48 kHz stereo s16 = 192 B/ms
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_au_lock);
            g_queued.pop_front();
            g_released.push_back(b);
        }
        if (g_au_event) kevent_signal(g_au_event);
    }
}

// CRI middleware errors: the criErr_Notify family (names.txt) gets (level, message or format, args...); CRI's own
// callback is silent in retail. Formatted with the game's vsnprintf; the Cpu is restored so the probe stays invisible.
static void cri_report(Cpu* c, uint32_t fmt, std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args) {
    static std::atomic<int> n{0};
    if (n++ >= 300) return;
    static thread_local uint32_t buf = hle_alloc(0x200, 4), va = hle_alloc(0x20, 4);
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (uint32_t a : args) st32(va + 4 * k++, a);
    Cpu saved = *c;
    gcall(c, "game_vsnprintf", {buf, 0x200, fmt, va});
    *c = saved;
    log("[cri] level %u: %s", c->r[0], gstr(buf, 0x200).c_str());
}
PROBE_FN(cri_err0, "criErr_Notify") { cri_report(c, c->r[1], {}); }
PROBE_FN(cri_err_code, "criErr_NotifyCode") { cri_report(c, c->r[1], {}); log("  (code %d)", (int)c->r[2]); }
PROBE_FN(cri_err1, "criErr_Notify1") { cri_report(c, c->r[1], {c->r[2]}); }
PROBE_FN(cri_err2, "criErr_Notify2") { cri_report(c, c->r[1], {c->r[2], c->r[3]}); }
PROBE_FN(cri_err3, "criErr_Notify3") { cri_report(c, c->r[1], {c->r[2], c->r[3], ld32(c->r[13])}); }


HLE_FN(au_Open, "_ZN2nn5audio19OpenDefaultAudioOutEPNS0_8AudioOutEPNS_2os11SystemEventERKNS0_17AudioOutParameterE") {
    uint32_t ev = c->r[1], readable;
    g_au_event = kevent_create(&readable);
    attach_system_event(c, ev, readable, true);
    std::call_once(g_au_once, [] {
        ui_window();  // SDL is initialised on the UI thread
        SDL_AudioSpec spec{SDL_AUDIO_S16LE, 2, 48000};
        g_stream = SDL_OpenAudioDeviceStream(SDL_AUDIO_DEVICE_DEFAULT_PLAYBACK, &spec, nullptr, nullptr);
        if (!g_stream) log("audio: SDL_OpenAudioDeviceStream failed: %s (continuing silent)", SDL_GetError());
        else SDL_ResumeAudioStreamDevice(g_stream);
        std::thread(feeder).detach();
    });
    log("audio: AudioOut opened (48 kHz, 2 ch, s16)");
    c->r[0] = 0;
}
HLE_FN(au_Start, "_ZN2nn5audio13StartAudioOutEPNS0_8AudioOutE") { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_au_lock); g_playing = true; c->r[0] = 0; }
HLE_FN(au_Stop, "_ZN2nn5audio12StopAudioOutEPNS0_8AudioOutE") { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_au_lock); g_playing = false; }
HLE_FN(au_Close, "_ZN2nn5audio13CloseAudioOutEPNS0_8AudioOutE") {}
HLE_FN(au_Append, "_ZN2nn5audio20AppendAudioOutBufferEPNS0_8AudioOutEPNS0_14AudioOutBufferE") {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_au_lock);
    g_queued.push_back(c->r[1]);
    c->r[0] = 1;
}
HLE_FN(au_Released, "_ZN2nn5audio25GetReleasedAudioOutBufferEPNS0_8AudioOutE") {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_au_lock);
    uint32_t b = 0;
    if (!g_released.empty()) { b = g_released.front(); g_released.pop_front(); }
    c->r[0] = b;
}
HLE_FN(au_Rate, "_ZN2nn5audio21GetAudioOutSampleRateEPKNS0_8AudioOutE") { c->r[0] = 48000; }
HLE_FN(au_Channels, "_ZN2nn5audio23GetAudioOutChannelCountEPKNS0_8AudioOutE") { c->r[0] = 2; }
HLE_FN(au_Format, "_ZN2nn5audio23GetAudioOutSampleFormatEPKNS0_8AudioOutE") { c->r[0] = 2; }  // PcmInt16
HLE_FN(au_Name, "_ZN2nn5audio15GetAudioOutNameEPKNS0_8AudioOutE") {
    static uint32_t name = [] { uint32_t a = hle_alloc(16); memcpy(GPTR(a), "DeviceOut", 10); return a; }();
    c->r[0] = name;
}
HLE_FN(au_DeviceNotif, "_ZN2nn5audio39AcquireAudioDeviceNotificationForOutputEPNS_2os11SystemEventE") {
    uint32_t readable;
    kevent_create(&readable);  // never signalled: the output device does not change
    attach_system_event(c, c->r[0], readable, true);
    c->r[0] = 0;
}
```

`runtime/src/hle_fs.cpp`:

```cpp
// nn::fs on host files: "rom:" -> <data>/romfs, save mounts -> <data>/save. Positional Win32 reads (thread-safe).
// Mods (LayeredFS style): a file at <data>/mods/<name>/romfs/<path> replaces romfs/<path>. Every mod folder is on
// unless named in NX_MODS_DISABLED (ini mods_disabled, comma separated); earlier names (sorted) win.
#include "plat.h"
#ifndef _WIN32
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <filesystem>

#include "rt.h"

using namespace rt;
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

constexpr uint32_t RES_PATH_NOT_FOUND = 0x202, RES_PATH_EXISTS = 0x402, RES_FAIL = 0x2802;

static std::mutex g_fs_lock;
static std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<fs::path>> g_mounts;  // roots, first existing file wins
#ifdef _WIN32
using FileH = HANDLE;
static const FileH k_bad_file = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
#else

using FileH = int;
static const FileH k_bad_file = -1;
using DWORD = uint32_t;
static constexpr DWORD GENERIC_READ = 1, GENERIC_WRITE = 2;
static FileH f_open(const fs::path& p, DWORD access) {
    return open(p.c_str(), (access & GENERIC_WRITE ? (access & GENERIC_READ ? O_RDWR : O_WRONLY) : O_RDONLY) | O_CLOEXEC);
}
// Windows paths ignore case, the game's own paths may not match the dumped names letter for letter: a component that
// does not exist is looked up case-insensitively in its folder (only on a miss, so normal opens cost nothing extra).
static fs::path ci_path(const fs::path& root, const fs::path& rel) {
    fs::path cur = root;
    std::error_code ec;
    for (auto it = rel.begin(); it != rel.end(); ++it) {
        fs::path next = cur / *it;
        if (!fs::exists(next, ec)) {
            const std::string want = it->string();
            for (auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(cur, ec))
                if (!strcasecmp(e.path().filename().c_str(), want.c_str())) { next = e.path(); break; }
        }
        cur = next;
    }
    return cur;
}
#endif
static std::unordered_map<uint32_t, FileH> g_files;
struct Dir { std::vector<fs::directory_entry> ents; size_t pos = 0; };
static std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Dir> g_dirs;
static uint32_t g_next = 1;

static bool host_path(uint32_t gpath, fs::path& out) {
    std::string p = gstr(gpath);
    size_t colon = p.find(':');
    if (colon == std::string::npos) return false;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_fs_lock);
    auto it = g_mounts.find(p.substr(0, colon));
    if (it == g_mounts.end()) { log("fs: no mount for %s", p.c_str()); return false; }
    std::string rest = p.substr(colon + 1);
    while (!rest.empty() && rest[0] == '/') rest.erase(0, 1);
    fs::path rel = fs::u8path(rest);
    std::error_code ec;
#ifdef _WIN32
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < it->second.size(); i++)
        if (fs::is_regular_file(it->second[i] / rel, ec)) { out = it->second[i] / rel; return true; }
    out = it->second.back() / rel;
#else
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < it->second.size(); i++)
        if (fs::path q = ci_path(it->second[i], rel); fs::is_regular_file(q, ec)) { out = q; return true; }
    out = ci_path(it->second.back(), rel);
#endif
    return true;
}

static std::vector<fs::path> rom_roots() {
    std::vector<fs::path> roots;
    std::string off = getenv("NX_MODS_DISABLED") ? std::string(",") + getenv("NX_MODS_DISABLED") + "," : ",";
    std::error_code ec;
    for (auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(fs::path(g_data_dir) / "mods", ec)) {
        auto u8 = e.path().filename().u8string();
        std::string name((const char*)u8.data(), u8.size());
        if (!fs::is_directory(e.path() / "romfs", ec)) continue;
        if (off.find("," + name + ",") != std::string::npos) { log("fs: mod %s off", name.c_str()); continue; }
        roots.push_back(e.path() / "romfs");
    }
    std::sort(roots.begin(), roots.end());
    for (auto& r : roots) log("fs: mod %s on", r.parent_path().filename().string().c_str());
    roots.push_back(fs::path(g_data_dir) / "romfs");
    return roots;
}

static FileH file(uint32_t id) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_fs_lock);
    auto it = g_files.find(id);
    return it == g_files.end() ? k_bad_file : it->second;
}
static uint32_t do_read(uint32_t id, uint64_t off, uint32_t buf, uint32_t size, uint32_t* got) {
    FileH h = file(id);
    if (h == k_bad_file) return RES_FAIL;
#ifndef _WIN32
    // straight into guest memory; a write-watched page (memory.cpp) makes the kernel return EFAULT instead of
    // faulting, so the rest then goes through a bounce buffer (written by the CPU: the watch sees it)
    uint32_t n = 0;
    while (n < size) {
        ssize_t r = pread(h, GPTR(buf + n), size - n, (off_t)(off + n));
        if (r > 0) { n += (uint32_t)r; continue; }
        if (r == 0) break;
        if (errno == EINTR) continue;
        if (errno != EFAULT) return RES_FAIL;
        std::vector<uint8_t> tmp(std::min<uint32_t>(size - n, 4u << 20));
        r = pread(h, tmp.data(), tmp.size(), (off_t)(off + n));
        if (r < 0) return RES_FAIL;
        if (r == 0) break;
        memcpy(GPTR(buf + n), tmp.data(), (size_t)r);
        n += (uint32_t)r;
    }
    *got = n;
    LOGV("fs: read %u off %llx size %x -> %x", id, (unsigned long long)off, size, n);
    return 0;
#else
    OVERLAPPED o{};
    o.Offset = (DWORD)off;
    o.OffsetHigh = (DWORD)(off >> 32);
    DWORD n = 0;
    if (!ReadFile(h, GPTR(buf), size, &n, &o) && GetLastError() != ERROR_HANDLE_EOF) return RES_FAIL;
    *got = n;
    LOGV("fs: read %u off %llx size %x -> %lx", id, (unsigned long long)off, size, n);
    return 0;
#endif
}
```
