        if (dump) {
            uint32_t n = std::min<uint32_t>(ld32(o + 0x124), 256), fr = (uint32_t)g_frame_no.load();
            fwrite(&fr, 4, 1, dump); fwrite(&n, 4, 1, dump);
            fwrite(GPTR(ld32(o + 0x134)), 0x150, n, dump);
            fflush(dump);
        }
    }
}
// Resolved update function of a scheduler task (member-function tasks: wrapper 0x3134f4 and identical copies).
static uint32_t task_update_fn(uint32_t t) {
    uint32_t fn = ld32(ld32(t) + 0x14);
    bool wrapper = true;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8 && wrapper; i++) wrapper = ld32(fn + 4 * i) == ld32(0x3134f4 + 4 * i);
    if (wrapper) {
        uint32_t adj = ld32(t + 0x18);
        fn = adj & 1 ? ld32(ld32(ld32(t + 0x10) + ((int32_t)adj >> 1)) + ld32(t + 0x14)) : ld32(t + 0x14);
    }
    return fn;
}
// Debug NX_TASK30=<update fn hex,...> (or control "task30 <fn>", 0 = clear): those tasks update only on 30 Hz ticks (vtable
// swapped to a copy whose update is "return 1" for the phase). To find which task drives a frame-counted effect.
static std::vector<uint32_t> g_task30;
static std::mutex g_task30_lock;
void rt::task30_command(const char* a) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_task30_lock);
    uint32_t fn = (uint32_t)strtoul(a, nullptr, 16);
    if (!fn) g_task30.clear(); else g_task30.push_back(fn);
    log("task30: %zu functions", g_task30.size());
}
HLE_FN(task_run_phase_gate, "task_run_phase") {
    static bool init = [] {
        if (const char* e = getenv("NX_TASK30")) for (const char* q = e; *q;) { g_task30.push_back((uint32_t)strtoul(q, (char**)&q, 16)); while (*q == ',' || *q == ' ') q++; }
        return true;
    }();
    (void)init;
    std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> swapped;  // task, vtable
    static std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> fake_of, ticks;
    if (!g_task30.empty() && fps_setting() != 30) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_task30_lock);
        uint32_t list = ld32(c->r[0] + 4) + c->r[1] * 0xc;
        int n = 0;
        for (uint32_t t = ld32(list); t && n < 400; t = ld32(t + 8), n++) {
            const uint32_t fn = task_update_fn(t);
            if (std::find(g_task30.begin(), g_task30.end(), fn) == g_task30.end() || tick_on(ticks, g_tick_ui30, t)) continue;
            const uint32_t vt = ld32(t);
            uint32_t& fake = fake_of[vt];
            if (!fake) {
                const Cpu keep = *c;
                fake = gcall(c, 0x5a8720, {0x40});
                *c = keep;
                if (!fake) continue;
                memcpy(GPTR(fake), GPTR(vt), 0x40);
                st32(fake + 0x14, 0x201d24);
            }
            st32(t, fake), swapped.push_back({t, vt});
        }
    }
    const uint32_t sched = c->r[0], phase = c->r[1];
    call_unhooked(c, "task_run_phase", {sched, phase});
    for (auto& [t, vt] : swapped) if (ld32(t) == fake_of[vt]) st32(t, vt);
}
PROBE_FN(task_run_phase, "task_run_phase") {  // NX_ANIM_PROBE: which tasks run in each phase (debug)
    static const bool on = getenv("NX_ANIM_PROBE") != nullptr;
    if (!on) return;
    static std::set<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> seen;  // (phase, vtable or bound member function)
    uint32_t list = ld32(c->r[0] + 4) + c->r[1] * 0xc;
    int n = 0;
    for (uint32_t t = ld32(list); t && n < 200; t = ld32(t + 8), n++) {
        const uint32_t fn = task_update_fn(t);  // member-function task: object +0x10, function +0x14, adjust +0x18 (bit 0: virtual)
        if (seen.insert({c->r[1], fn}).second)
            log("[task] phase %u sched %08x task %08x vt %08x update %s", c->r[1], c->r[0], t, ld32(t), symbol_at(fn));
    }
}

HLE_FN(gfx_set_present_interval, "gfx_set_present_interval") {
    const int fps = fps_setting();
    uint32_t n = fps == 30 ? c->r[1] : 1;
    static uint32_t last = ~0u;
    if (n != last) {
        log("frame step: game asks for interval %u, using %u (NX_FPS %d)", c->r[1], n, fps);
        if (fps == 60) set_game_dt(1 / 60.0f);  // at 30 the game's own interval changes keep its 1/30 dt (loading)
        else if (fps == 30 && walk_speed() != 1) set_game_dt(1 / 30.0f);  // only for the walk literals
        last = n;
    }
    st32(c->r[0] + 0x58c0, n);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Lua script log
// Game scripts (Lua 5.2) print through AtPrintf/print/AtConsoleOut/AtTraceOut, all empty in retail; script errors go
// to script_error, which also drops its text. We log them as [lua] / [lua error]. NX_LUA_LOG=0 turns the prints off.
// Lua C API inside main (found from the binding wrappers at 0x5adc48 / 0x5addc8):
static const uint32_t LUA_GETTOP = 0x529964, LUA_TYPE = 0x529f88, LUA_TOLSTRING = 0x52aa6c;

static std::string lua_args(Cpu* c, uint32_t L) {
    std::string s;
    uint32_t n = gcall(c, LUA_GETTOP, {L});
    for (uint32_t i = 1; i <= n && i <= 16; i++) {
        uint32_t t = gcall(c, LUA_TYPE, {L, i});
        if (i > 1) s += ' ';
        if (t == 3 || t == 4) {  // number, string
            uint32_t p = gcall(c, LUA_TOLSTRING, {L, i, 0});
            s += p ? gstr(p, 512) : "?";
        } else {
            s += t == 0 ? "nil" : t == 1 ? "<bool>" : "<" + std::to_string(t) + ">";
        }
    }
    return s;
}
static void lua_print(Cpu* c, const char* tag) {
    static const bool off = getenv("NX_LUA_LOG") && !strcmp(getenv("NX_LUA_LOG"), "0");
    if (!off) log("[lua%s] %s", tag, lua_args(c, c->r[0]).c_str());
    c->r[0] = 0;
}
HLE_FN(lua_AtPrintf, "lua_AtPrintf") { lua_print(c, ""); }
HLE_FN(lua_AtConsoleOut, "lua_AtConsoleOut") { lua_print(c, " console"); }
HLE_FN(lua_AtTraceOut, "lua_AtTraceOut") { lua_print(c, " trace"); }
PROBE_FN(script_error, "script_error") {
    log("[lua error] %s %s: %s", c->r[1] ? gstr(c->r[1], 64).c_str() : "", c->r[2] ? gstr(c->r[2], 128).c_str() : "",
        c->r[3] ? gstr(c->r[3], 512).c_str() : "");
}
PROBE_FN(luaG_errormsg, "luaG_errormsg") {
    Cpu save = *c;  // probes must leave the Cpu as they found it
    uint32_t p = gcall(c, LUA_TOLSTRING, {save.r[0], 0xffffffffu, 0});
    log("[lua error] raised: %s", p ? gstr(p, 512).c_str() : "(not a string)");
    *c = save;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ game flags
// Story/system flags are bits at flags+0xa4 (flag_on 0x351c94 / flag_off 0x354674 / is_flag_on 0x353568, behind the
// Lua bindings FlagOn/FlagOff/IsFlagOn); the flags object pointer lives at FLAGS_PTR. Names come from <data>/flags.txt
// ("0x412 FLG_EVM_0009_01" lines, made by tools/lua/flagnames.py from ScriptCommon/Flag/*.lua). Every change is
// logged as "[flag] on/off". NX_CONTROL "flag n" logs a flag, "flag n 0|1" sets it (debug).
static const uint32_t FLAGS_PTR = 0x9ef37c;
static std::string flag_name(uint32_t id) {
    static const std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::string> names = [] {
        std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::string> m;
        if (FILE* f = fopen((g_data_dir + "/flags.txt").c_str(), "r")) {
            char line[256], name[200];
            unsigned v;
            while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f))
                if (sscanf(line, "%x %199s", &v, name) == 2) m.emplace(v, name);
            fclose(f);
        }
        return m;
    }();
    auto it = names.find(id);
    char buf[16];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%#x", id);
    return it == names.end() ? std::string(buf) : std::string(buf) + " " + it->second;
}
static uint32_t flag_byte(uint32_t id) {
    uint32_t obj = ld32(ld32(FLAGS_PTR));
    return obj ? obj + 0xa4 + (id >> 3) : 0;
}
static int flag_get(uint32_t id) {
    uint32_t a = flag_byte(id);
    return a ? (*(uint8_t*)GPTR(a) >> (id & 7)) & 1 : -1;
}
PROBE_FN(flag_on, "flag_on") { if (flag_get(c->r[0]) == 0) log("[flag] on %s", flag_name(c->r[0]).c_str()); }
PROBE_FN(flag_off, "flag_off") { if (flag_get(c->r[0]) == 1) log("[flag] off %s", flag_name(c->r[0]).c_str()); }
void rt::flag_command(const char* args) {
    unsigned id = 0;
    int v = -1;
    if (sscanf(args, "%i %d", (int*)&id, &v) < 1) return;
    uint32_t a = flag_byte(id);
    if (!a) { log("[flag] flags not loaded yet"); return; }
    if (v == 0 || v == 1) {
        uint8_t* p = (uint8_t*)GPTR(a);
        *p = v ? *p | (1u << (id & 7)) : *p & ~(1u << (id & 7));
        log("[flag] set %s = %d (control)", flag_name(id).c_str(), v);
    } else {
        log("[flag] %s = %d", flag_name(id).c_str(), flag_get(id));
    }
}

// NX_CONTROL "pos": log the player's position (map coordinates, as in the layout records; -z = north). Same lookup as
// the Lua binding chrGetPlayer (0x417c1c): handle at field+0x1f4, actor from the actor list (0x3cad88: nodes at
// list+4, next +4, actor +8, actor id +4); chrGetActorPos reads x y z at actor+0xc after checking the tag at +8.
void rt::pos_command(const char* set) {  // set: "x y z" moves the player there (debug teleport)
    auto mapped = [](uint32_t a) { return a && mem_query(a).state != MS_FREE && mem_query(a + 0x200).state != MS_FREE; };
    const uint32_t list = 0x9f4510;  // the actor list object itself (static data)
    uint32_t field = ld32(0x9f47f4);
    if (!mapped(field)) { log("[pos] no field"); return; }
    uint32_t handle = ld32(field + 0x1f4);
    if (set && !strcmp(set, "all")) {  // control "actors": every actor's handle, tag and position (finding symbols)
        for (uint32_t node = ld32(list + 4), n = 0; mapped(node) && n < 10000; node = ld32(node + 4), n++) {
            uint32_t actor = ld32(node + 8);
            if (!mapped(actor)) continue;
            float p[3];
            memcpy(p, GPTR(actor + 0xc), 12);
            log("[actor] %08x handle %08x tag %08x vt %08x pos %.1f %.1f %.1f", actor, ld32(actor + 4), ld32(actor + 8), ld32(actor), p[0], p[1], p[2]);
        }
        return;
    }
    for (uint32_t node = ld32(list + 4), n = 0; mapped(node) && n < 10000; node = ld32(node + 4), n++) {
        uint32_t actor = ld32(node + 8);
        if (!mapped(actor) || ld32(actor + 4) != handle) continue;
        if (ld32(actor + 8) != 0x514c4742) break;
        float p[3];
        if (set && sscanf(set, "%f %f %f", &p[0], &p[1], &p[2]) == 3) memcpy(GPTR(actor + 0xc), p, 12);
        memcpy(p, GPTR(actor + 0xc), 12);
        log("[pos] player %.1f %.1f %.1f", p[0], p[1], p[2]);
        return;
    }
    log("[pos] player actor %#x not found", handle);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ nn::time
HLE_FN(time_Initialize, "_ZN2nn4time10InitializeEv") { c->r[0] = 0; }
HLE_FN(time_Now, "_ZN2nn4time23StandardUserSystemClock14GetCurrentTimeEPNS0_9PosixTimeE") {
    st64(c->r[0], (uint64_t)time(nullptr));
    c->r[0] = 0;
}
HLE_FN(time_ToCal, "_ZN2nn4time14ToCalendarTimeEPNS0_12CalendarTimeEPNS0_22CalendarAdditionalInfoERKNS0_9PosixTimeE") {
    time_t t = (time_t)ld64(c->r[2]);
    struct tm lt;
#ifdef _WIN32
    localtime_s(&lt, &t);
#else
    localtime_r(&t, &lt);
#endif
    uint32_t cal = c->r[0], info = c->r[1];
    st16(cal, lt.tm_year + 1900);
    st8(cal + 2, lt.tm_mon + 1);
    st8(cal + 3, lt.tm_mday);
    st8(cal + 4, lt.tm_hour);
    st8(cal + 5, lt.tm_min);
    st8(cal + 6, lt.tm_sec);
    if (info) {  // CalendarAdditionalInfo: dayOfWeek, dayOfYear, timeZone name[8], isDst, utc offset
        st32(info, lt.tm_wday);
        st32(info + 4, lt.tm_yday);
        memset(GPTR(info + 8), 0, 8);
        memcpy(GPTR(info + 8), "UTC", 3);
        st32(info + 16, lt.tm_isdst > 0);
        st32(info + 20, 0);
    }
    c->r[0] = 0;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ nv:: (graphics firmware)
HLE_FN(nv_SetAlloc, "_ZN2nv20SetGraphicsAllocatorEPFPvjjS0_EPFvS0_S0_EPFS0_S0_jS0_ES0_") {}
HLE_FN(nv_Init, "_ZN2nv18InitializeGraphicsEPvj") {}
HLE_FN(nv_Fini, "_ZN2nv16FinalizeGraphicsEv") {}



// Hide field enemies (setting hide_field_enemies, user request 10-30): every field symbol is spawned by
// field_enemy_spawn (area load, respawn timer); with the setting on it spawns none (-1 = "no symbol", as when the
// group table has no entry). Symbols already in the area stay until the next area load.
HLE_FN(field_enemy_spawn, "field_enemy_spawn") {
    const char* e = getenv("NX_HIDE_FIELD_ENEMIES");
    if (e && atoi(e)) {
        static int n = 0;
        if (n++ < 5) log("field: enemy spawn skipped (hide field enemies)");
        c->r[0] = 0xffffffff;
        return;
    }
    c->r[0] = call_unhooked(c, "field_enemy_spawn", {c->r[0], c->r[1]});
}

`runtime/src/ipc.cpp`:

```cpp
// HIPC/CMIF sessions for the services the SDK still talks to directly. Message layout from Switchbrew (IPC_Marshalling).
// Unknown commands answer success with zeroed output and are logged once, so the log lists what is worth implementing.
#include <set>

#include "rt.h"

namespace rt {

uint32_t kernel_add_object(std::shared_ptr<KObject> o);

struct KSession : KObject {
    std::string svc;
    bool domain = false;
    uint32_t next_obj = 1;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::string> objs;  // domain object id -> interface name
};

struct Request {
    uint32_t buf, type, cmd, token, data;  // data = guest address of the CMIF payload (after the SFCI header)
    uint32_t domain_obj = 0, domain_cmd = 0;
    std::vector<uint32_t> copy, move;
    std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> x, a, b;  // (addr, size)
    bool pid = false;
};

struct Reply {
    uint32_t result = 0;
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    std::vector<uint32_t> move, copy, objs;
    template <class T> void push(T v) { auto p = (uint8_t*)&v; out.insert(out.end(), p, p + sizeof v); }
};

static std::mutex g_ipc_lock;
static std::set<std::string> g_seen;

uint32_t ipc_new_session(const std::string& name) {
    auto s = std::make_shared<KSession>();
    s->svc = name;
    return kernel_add_object(s);
}
uint32_t ipc_connect(const char* port) {
    log("ConnectToNamedPort(\"%s\")", port);
    return ipc_new_session(port);
}

KObject* kernel_get_object(uint32_t h);

static bool parse(uint32_t buf, KSession* s, Request& q) {
    q.buf = buf;
    uint32_t w0 = ld32(buf), w1 = ld32(buf + 4);
    q.type = w0 & 0xFFFF;
    uint32_t nx = (w0 >> 16) & 0xF, na = (w0 >> 20) & 0xF, nb = (w0 >> 24) & 0xF, nw = (w0 >> 28) & 0xF;
    uint32_t p = buf + 8;
    if (w1 >> 31) {
        uint32_t sh = ld32(p);
        p += 4;
        q.pid = sh & 1;
        if (q.pid) p += 8;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ((sh >> 1) & 0xF); i++, p += 4) q.copy.push_back(ld32(p));
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ((sh >> 5) & 0xF); i++, p += 4) q.move.push_back(ld32(p));
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nx; i++, p += 8) q.x.emplace_back(ld32(p + 4), ld32(p) >> 16);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < na; i++, p += 12) q.a.emplace_back(ld32(p + 4), ld32(p));
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nb; i++, p += 12) q.b.emplace_back(ld32(p + 4), ld32(p));
    p += 12 * nw;
    p = buf + ((p - buf + 15) & ~15u);
    if (s->domain && q.type == 4) {  // domain header: u8 cmd, u8 nobj, u16 size, u32 object, u32 pad, u32 token
        q.domain_cmd = ld8(p);
        q.domain_obj = ld32(p + 4);
        p += 16;
    }
    if (ld32(p) != 0x49434653 && q.type != 2 && q.domain_cmd != 2) {  // "SFCI"
        log("ipc %s: no SFCI magic (type %u)", s->svc.c_str(), q.type);
        return false;
    }
    q.cmd = ld32(p + 8);
    q.token = ld32(p + 12);
    q.data = p + 16;
    return true;
}

static void write_reply(KSession* s, const Request& q, const Reply& r) {
    uint32_t buf = q.buf;
    bool special = !r.move.empty() || !r.copy.empty();
    uint32_t hdr_words = 2 + (special ? 1 + (uint32_t)(r.copy.size() + r.move.size()) : 0);
    uint32_t payload = (s->domain ? 16 : 0) + 16 + (uint32_t)((r.out.size() + 3) & ~3u) + 4 * (uint32_t)r.objs.size();
    uint32_t data_words = 4 + payload / 4;  // 16 bytes of alignment padding are always reserved
    st32(buf, 0);
    st32(buf + 4, data_words | (special ? 0x80000000u : 0));
    uint32_t p = buf + 8;
    if (special) {
        st32(p, (uint32_t)(r.copy.size() << 1 | r.move.size() << 5));
        p += 4;
        for (uint32_t h : r.copy) { st32(p, h); p += 4; }
        for (uint32_t h : r.move) { st32(p, h); p += 4; }
    }
    (void)hdr_words;
    p = buf + ((p - buf + 15) & ~15u);
    if (s->domain) {
        memset(GPTR(p), 0, 16);
        st32(p, (uint32_t)r.objs.size());
        p += 16;
    }
    st32(p, 0x4F434653);  // "SFCO"
    st32(p + 4, 0);
    st32(p + 8, r.result);
    st32(p + 12, 0);
    p += 16;
    memcpy(GPTR(p), r.out.data(), r.out.size());
    p += (uint32_t)((r.out.size() + 3) & ~3u);
    for (uint32_t o : r.objs) { st32(p, o); p += 4; }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ services
static void sm(KSession* s, Request& q, Reply& r) {
    if (q.cmd == 0) return;  // RegisterClient
    if (q.cmd == 1) {        // GetService(name u64)
        char name[9] = {};
        memcpy(name, GPTR(q.data), 8);
        log("sm GetService(\"%s\")", name);
        r.move.push_back(ipc_new_session(name));
        return;
    }
    log("sm cmd %u", q.cmd);
}

static void control(KSession* s, Request& q, Reply& r) {
    switch (q.cmd) {
        case 0: s->domain = true; r.push<uint32_t>(s->next_obj++); return;  // ConvertCurrentObjectToDomain
        case 2: case 4: r.move.push_back(ipc_new_session(s->svc)); return;  // CloneCurrentObject(Ex)
        case 3: r.push<uint16_t>(0x8000); return;                             // QueryPointerBufferSize
        default: log("ipc control cmd %u", q.cmd);
    }
}

uint32_t ipc_request(uint32_t handle, uint32_t buf, uint32_t size) {
    (void)size;
    KSession* s = dynamic_cast<KSession*>(kernel_get_object(handle));
    if (!s) { log("ipc to bad handle %08x", handle); return 0xE401; }
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_ipc_lock);
    Request q;
    if (!parse(buf, s, q)) return 0xF601;
    if (q.type == 2) return 0;  // close
    Reply r;
    if (q.type == 5 || q.type == 7) control(s, q, r);
    else if (s->svc == "sm:") sm(s, q, r);
    else {
        std::string key = s->svc + "#" + std::to_string(q.cmd);
        if (g_seen.insert(key).second) log("ipc %s cmd %u: unimplemented, returning success", s->svc.c_str(), q.cmd);
        r.out.assign(0x40, 0);
    }
    write_reply(s, q, r);
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace rt

```

`runtime/src/kernel.cpp`:

```cpp
// Horizon kernel, high level: the SVCs the SDK's own nn::os code issues (32-bit register ABI, read from the
// SDK's svc wrappers: inputs r0-r4, result r0, outputs r1-r3). Semantics from Switchbrew.
// ponytail: one big kernel lock + per-thread condition variables; split it if contention ever shows in a profile.
#include "plat.h"
#ifndef _WIN32
#include <pthread.h>
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <map>
#include <random>
#include <thread>

#include "rt.h"
#ifndef _WIN32
#undef R_OK  // <unistd.h> access() mode; here the Horizon result code below
#endif

namespace rt {

constexpr uint32_t R_OK = 0, R_TIMEOUT = 0xEA01, R_CANCELLED = 0xEC01, R_BAD_HANDLE = 0xE401,
                   R_INVALID_STATE = 0xFA01, R_NOT_FOUND = 0xF201;
constexpr uint32_t WAITERS = 0x40000000;
constexpr uint32_t PSEUDO_PROCESS = 0xFFFF8000, PSEUDO_THREAD = 0xFFFF8001;

static std::mutex K;                    // kernel lock
static std::condition_variable KCV;     // any waitable object changed (WaitSynchronization)
static std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::shared_ptr<KObject>> g_handles;
static uint32_t g_next_handle = 0x10001;
static uint64_t g_next_tid = 0x60;
static thread_local KThread* t_cur;

static std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<KThread*>> g_mutex_waiters, g_cv_waiters, g_addr_waiters;

struct ThreadExit {};

struct KEvent : KObject {
    bool sig = false;
    bool signaled() const override { return sig; }
};
struct KSessionStub : KObject {};

KThread* cur() { return t_cur; }

// SDK threads: the argument is the nn::os::ThreadType, its name pointer at +0xe4 (GetThreadNamePointer)
static std::string thread_name(const KThread* t) {
    return !t->name.empty() || !t->arg ? t->name : gstr(ld32(t->arg + 0xe4), 64);
}
static const bool g_trace_cv = getenv("NX_TRACE_CV") != nullptr;  // log condition-variable waits and signals

static uint32_t add_handle(std::shared_ptr<KObject> o) {
    uint32_t h = g_next_handle++;
    g_handles[h] = std::move(o);
    return h;
}
static KObject* get(uint32_t h) {
    if (h == PSEUDO_THREAD) return t_cur;
    auto it = g_handles.find(h);
    return it == g_handles.end() ? nullptr : it->second.get();
}
static KThread* get_thread(uint32_t h) { return dynamic_cast<KThread*>(get(h)); }

static std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point deadline(int64_t ns) {
    return std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::nanoseconds(ns / g_speed);
}

// wait on t->cv (K held) until pred or timeout (ns < 0 = forever). Returns pred().
template <class P>
static bool kwait(std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& l, KThread* t, int64_t ns, P pred) {
    if (ns < 0) { t->cv.wait(l, pred); return true; }
    return t->cv.wait_until(l, deadline(ns), pred);
}

static void pop_waiter(std::vector<KThread*>& v, KThread* t) { v.erase(std::remove(v.begin(), v.end(), t), v.end()); }
static KThread* best_waiter(std::vector<KThread*>& v) {  // highest priority (lowest number), FIFO among equals
    auto it = std::min_element(v.begin(), v.end(), [](KThread* a, KThread* b) { return a->prio < b->prio; });
    KThread* t = *it;
    v.erase(it);
    return t;
}
static std::atomic<uint32_t>& gword(uint32_t a) { return *reinterpret_cast<std::atomic<uint32_t>*>(GPTR(a)); }

// hand a mutex tag at addr to its next waiter, or clear it (K held)
static void release_mutex(uint32_t addr) {
    auto it = g_mutex_waiters.find(addr);
    if (it == g_mutex_waiters.end() || it->second.empty()) { gword(addr).store(0); return; }
    KThread* w = best_waiter(it->second);
    uint32_t tag = w->self_tag | (it->second.empty() ? 0 : WAITERS);
    if (it->second.empty()) g_mutex_waiters.erase(it);
    gword(addr).store(tag);
    w->granted = true;
    w->cv.notify_one();
}

// a thread signaled from a condition variable wants the mutex back (K held)
static void reacquire(KThread* w) {
    auto& word = gword(w->cv_mutex);
    uint32_t cur = word.load();
    for (;;) {
        if (cur == 0) {
            if (word.compare_exchange_weak(cur, w->self_tag)) { w->granted = true; w->cv.notify_one(); return; }
            continue;
        }
        if (word.compare_exchange_weak(cur, cur | WAITERS)) break;
    }
    g_mutex_waiters[w->cv_mutex].push_back(w);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ threads
#ifdef _WIN32
static DWORD WINAPI thread_proc(void* p) {
#else
static void* thread_proc(void* p) {
#endif
    KThread* t = static_cast<KThread*>(p);
    t_cur = t;
    try {
        dispatch(&t->cpu, t->entry);
    } catch (ThreadExit&) {
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
        t->exited = true;
    }
    KCV.notify_all();
    return 0;
}

static std::shared_ptr<KThread> new_thread(uint32_t entry, uint32_t arg, uint32_t sp, int prio, int core) {
    auto t = std::make_shared<KThread>();
    t->entry = entry;
    t->arg = arg;
    t->stack_top = sp;
    t->prio = prio;
    t->core = core;
    t->id = g_next_tid++;
    t->tlr = kernel_alloc(0x1000);
    t->cpu.r[0] = arg;
    t->cpu.r[13] = sp;
    t->cpu.r[14] = 0;
    t->cpu.tpidruro = t->tlr;
    t->cpu.fpscr = 0;  // TODO: Horizon's AArch32 default FPSCR (flush-to-zero?) unverified
    t->cpu.host = t.get();
    return t;
}

uint32_t create_main_thread(uint32_t stack_size, int prio) {
    uint32_t stack = kernel_alloc(stack_size);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
    auto t = new_thread(0, 0, stack + stack_size, prio, 0);
    t->name = "main";
    t->handle = add_handle(t);
    t_cur = t.get();
    t->started = true;
    return t->handle;
}

void run_main_thread(uint32_t entry, const uint32_t args[4]) {
    KThread* t = t_cur;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) t->cpu.r[i] = args[i];
    try {
        dispatch(&t->cpu, entry);
    } catch (ThreadExit&) {
    }
    log("main thread returned");
}

static constexpr size_t HOST_STACK = 64u << 20;  // recompiled guest calls nest on the host stack

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ svc
static void exit_thread() { throw ThreadExit{}; }

static uint32_t wait_sync(Cpu* c, uint32_t handles, int32_t count, int64_t timeout, uint32_t* index) {
    KThread* t = t_cur;
    std::vector<KObject*> objs;
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> l(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        KObject* o = get(ld32(handles + 4 * i));
        if (!o) {  // the SDK's WaitSystemEvent aborts on this (seen at boot: NOTES "Boot abort")
            log("kernel: wait on bad handle %08x (%d of %d) in '%s'", ld32(handles + 4 * i), i, count, thread_name(t).c_str());
            return R_BAD_HANDLE;
        }
        objs.push_back(o);
    }
    auto ready = [&]() -> int {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            if (objs[i]->signaled()) return i;
        return -1;
    };
    auto end = deadline(timeout < 0 ? 0 : timeout);
    for (;;) {
        int i = ready();
        if (i >= 0) { *index = (uint32_t)i; return R_OK; }
        if (t->cancel) { t->cancel = false; return R_CANCELLED; }
        if (timeout == 0) return R_TIMEOUT;
        if (timeout < 0) KCV.wait(l);
        else if (KCV.wait_until(l, end) == std::cv_status::timeout && ready() < 0) return R_TIMEOUT;
    }
}

static uint64_t get_info(uint32_t id, uint32_t handle, uint64_t sub, uint32_t* res) {
    *res = R_OK;
    switch (id) {
        case 0: return 0xF;                      // allowed core mask
        case 1: return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;    // allowed priorities
        case 2: return ALIAS_BASE;
        case 3: return ALIAS_SIZE;
        case 4: return HEAP_BASE;
        case 5: return HEAP_REGION_SIZE;
        case 6: case 21: return HEAP_REGION_SIZE + 0x10000000ull;  // total memory: the SDK sizes the heap as total - used
        case 7: case 22: return 0x10000000ull;
        case 8: return 0;                        // debugger attached
        case 9: return 0;                        // resource limit handle
        case 10: return 0;
        case 11: { static std::mt19937_64 rng(0x7a5); return rng(); }
        case 12: return ASLR_BASE;
        case 13: return ASLR_SIZE;
        case 14: return STACK_BASE;
        case 15: return STACK_SIZE;
        case 16: case 17: return 0;
        case 18: return 0x0100A9400C9C2000ull;   // program id
        case 20: return 0;                       // user exception context
        case 0xF0000002: return guest_counter(); // thread tick count
        default:
            log("svcGetInfo id %u handle %08x sub %llx: unknown", id, handle, (unsigned long long)sub);
            *res = 0xF001;
            return 0;
    }
}

static void svc_impl(Cpu* c, uint32_t imm);

void svc(Cpu* c, uint32_t imm) {
    if (t_cur) t_cur->ran = true;
    uint32_t in[5];
    memcpy(in, c->r, sizeof in);
    svc_impl(c, imm);
    LOGV("svc %02x(%08x %08x %08x %08x %08x) -> %x %08x %08x  lr %s", imm, in[0], in[1], in[2], in[3], in[4], c->r[0],
         c->r[1], c->r[2], symbol_at(c->r[14]));
}

static void svc_impl(Cpu* c, uint32_t imm) {
    uint32_t* r = c->r;
    KThread* t = t_cur;
    switch (imm) {
        case 0x01: {  // SetHeapSize(size r1) -> r1 addr
            uint32_t a = heap_set_size(r[1]);
            r[0] = a ? R_OK : 0xD401;
            r[1] = a;
            return;
        }
        case 0x02: case 0x03: r[0] = R_OK; return;  // SetMemoryPermission / SetMemoryAttribute
        case 0x04: {  // MapMemory(dst, src, size): copy semantics (src is inaccessible while mapped)
            mem_map(r[0], r[2], MS_STACK, 3);
            memcpy(GPTR(r[0]), GPTR(r[1]), r[2]);
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x05: {  // UnmapMemory(dst, src, size)
            memcpy(GPTR(r[1]), GPTR(r[0]), r[2]);
            mem_unmap(r[0], r[2]);
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x06: {  // QueryMemory(MemoryInfo* r0, addr r2) -> r1 page info
            Region g = mem_query(r[2]);
            uint32_t mi = r[0];
            st64(mi + 0, g.addr);
            st64(mi + 8, g.size);
            st32(mi + 16, g.state);
            st32(mi + 20, g.attr);
            st32(mi + 24, g.perm);
            st32(mi + 28, 0);
            st32(mi + 32, 0);
            st32(mi + 36, 0);
            r[0] = R_OK;
            r[1] = 0;
            return;
        }
        case 0x07: log("svcExitProcess"); fflush(nullptr); ExitProcess(0);
        case 0x08: {  // CreateThread(entry r1, arg r2, stack_top r3, prio r0, core r4) -> r1 handle
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            auto nt = new_thread(r[1], r[2], r[3], (int)r[0], (int)r[4] == -2 ? 0 : (int)r[4]);  // -2: process default core
            nt->handle = add_handle(nt);
            LOGV("CreateThread entry %s arg %08x sp %08x prio %d -> %x", symbol_at(r[1]), r[2], r[3], (int)r[0], nt->handle);
            r[0] = R_OK;
            r[1] = nt->handle;
            return;
        }
        case 0x09: {  // StartThread(handle)
            KThread* nt;
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
                nt = get_thread(r[0]);
            }
            if (!nt) { r[0] = R_BAD_HANDLE; return; }
            nt->started = true;
#ifdef _WIN32
            HANDLE h = CreateThread(nullptr, HOST_STACK, thread_proc, nt, STACK_SIZE_PARAM_IS_A_RESERVATION, nullptr);
            if (!h) fatal("host CreateThread failed");
            CloseHandle(h);
#else
            pthread_attr_t at;
            pthread_attr_init(&at);
            pthread_attr_setstacksize(&at, HOST_STACK);  // reserved, touched on demand (as the Windows reservation)
            pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&at, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
            pthread_t th;
            const int e = pthread_create(&th, &at, thread_proc, nt);
            pthread_attr_destroy(&at);
            if (e) fatal("host pthread_create failed (%s)", strerror(e));
#endif
            // On the console a higher-priority thread preempts its creator at once; games rely on it (e.g. reading
            // arguments from the creator's stack). Let it run until its first svc (or 100 ms) before returning.
            if (t && nt->prio < t->prio) {
                auto until = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(100);
                while (!nt->ran && !nt->exited && std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < until) SwitchToThread();
            }
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x0A: exit_thread(); return;
        case 0x0B: {  // SleepThread(ns r0:r1)
            int64_t ns = (int64_t)((uint64_t)r[1] << 32 | r[0]);
            static const bool sleep_log = getenv("NX_SLEEP_LOG") != nullptr;  // debug: who sleeps how long
            if (sleep_log && t_cur) {
                static std::mutex m;
                static std::map<std::pair<std::string, int64_t>, uint32_t> n;
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m);
                uint32_t k = ++n[{thread_name(t_cur), ns}];
                if (k == 1 || k == 1000 || k == 10000) log("sleep: '%s' %lld ns x%u (lr %08x)", thread_name(t_cur).c_str(), (long long)ns, k, r[14]);
            }
            if (ns <= 0) SwitchToThread();
            else if (ns < 1000000) {
                // sub-millisecond sleeps (main and AtJob workers poll the job system every 50 us): an OS sleep lasts
                // >= 1 ms on Windows, so the main thread lost up to 30% of each frame waiting. Yield until the deadline.
                auto until = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::nanoseconds(ns / g_speed);
                while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < until) SwitchToThread();
            } else std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::nanoseconds(ns / g_speed));
            return;
        }
        case 0x0C: {  // GetThreadPriority(handle r1) -> r1
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            KThread* x = get_thread(r[1]);
            r[0] = x ? R_OK : R_BAD_HANDLE;
            r[1] = x ? (uint32_t)x->prio : 0;
            return;
        }
        case 0x0D: {  // SetThreadPriority(handle, prio)
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            if (KThread* x = get_thread(r[0])) { x->prio = (int)r[1]; r[0] = R_OK; } else r[0] = R_BAD_HANDLE;
            return;
        }
        case 0x0E: {  // GetThreadCoreMask(handle r2) -> r1 core, r2:r3 mask
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            KThread* x = get_thread(r[2]);
            r[0] = x ? R_OK : R_BAD_HANDLE;
            r[1] = x ? (uint32_t)x->core : 0;
            r[2] = 0xF;
            r[3] = 0;
            return;
        }
        case 0x0F: {  // SetThreadCoreMask(handle r0, ideal core r1, mask r2:r3): the host schedules, but games read the
                      // core back (GetCurrentProcessorNumber) to pick per-core work queues
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            KThread* x = get_thread(r[0]);
            if (!x) { r[0] = R_BAD_HANDLE; return; }
            int ideal = (int)r[1];
            uint32_t mask = r[2];
            if (ideal == -2) ideal = 0;                                          // process default core (main.npdm)
            if (ideal == -3) ideal = (x->core >= 0 && (mask >> x->core & 1)) ? x->core : -1;  // keep if still allowed
            if (ideal >= 0) x->core = ideal;
            else if (x->core < 0 || !(mask >> x->core & 1))
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) if (mask >> k & 1) { x->core = k; break; }  // first allowed core
            LOGV("SetThreadCoreMask %x ideal %d mask %x -> core %d", r[0], (int)r[1], mask, x->core);
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x10: r[0] = t && t->core >= 0 && t->core <= 2 ? (uint32_t)t->core : 0; return;  // games index per-core data (cores 0-2)
        case 0x11: case 0x12: case 0x17: {  // SignalEvent / ClearEvent / ResetSignal
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
                KEvent* e = dynamic_cast<KEvent*>(get(r[0]));
                if (!e) { r[0] = R_BAD_HANDLE; return; }
                if (imm == 0x17 && !e->sig) { r[0] = R_INVALID_STATE; return; }
                e->sig = imm == 0x11;
            }
            if (imm == 0x11) KCV.notify_all();
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x16: {  // CloseHandle
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            g_handles.erase(r[0]);
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x18: {  // WaitSynchronization(handles r1, count r2, timeout r0:r3) -> r1 index
            int64_t to = (int64_t)((uint64_t)r[3] << 32 | r[0]);
            uint32_t idx = 0;
            r[0] = wait_sync(c, r[1], (int32_t)r[2], to, &idx);
            r[1] = idx;
            return;
        }
        case 0x19: {  // CancelSynchronization(thread handle)
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
                if (KThread* x = get_thread(r[0])) x->cancel = true;
            }
            KCV.notify_all();
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x1A: {  // ArbitrateLock(owner r0, addr r1, self tag r2)
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> l(K);
            if (gword(r[1]).load() != (r[0] | WAITERS)) { r[0] = R_OK; return; }
            t->self_tag = r[2];
            t->granted = false;
            g_mutex_waiters[r[1]].push_back(t);
            kwait(l, t, -1, [&] { return t->granted; });
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x1B: {  // ArbitrateUnlock(addr)
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            release_mutex(r[0]);
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x1C: {  // WaitProcessWideKeyAtomic(mutex r0, key r1, tag r2, timeout r3:r4)
            int64_t to = (int64_t)((uint64_t)r[4] << 32 | r[3]);
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> l(K);
            uint32_t mtx = r[0], key = r[1];
            release_mutex(mtx);
            t->self_tag = r[2];
            t->cv_key = key;
            t->cv_mutex = mtx;
            t->granted = false;
            t->cv_signaled = false;
            g_cv_waiters[key].push_back(t);
            gword(key).store(1);
            if (g_trace_cv) log("cv wait %08x '%s' timeout %lld", key, thread_name(t).c_str(), (long long)to);
            bool ok = kwait(l, t, to, [&] { return t->granted || t->cv_signaled; });
            if (!ok) {  // timed out while still on the condition variable
                auto& v = g_cv_waiters[key];
                pop_waiter(v, t);
                if (v.empty()) { g_cv_waiters.erase(key); gword(key).store(0); }
                r[0] = R_TIMEOUT;
                return;
            }
            kwait(l, t, -1, [&] { return t->granted; });  // signaled: now wait for the mutex hand-off
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x1D: {  // SignalProcessWideKey(key r0, count r1)
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            auto it = g_cv_waiters.find(r[0]);
            if (g_trace_cv) log("cv signal %08x n %d by '%s': %zu waiting", r[0], (int32_t)r[1], thread_name(t).c_str(),
                                it == g_cv_waiters.end() ? (size_t)0 : it->second.size());
            if (it != g_cv_waiters.end()) {
                int32_t n = (int32_t)r[1];
                bool all = n <= 0;  // -1: every waiter
                while (!it->second.empty() && (all || n-- > 0)) {
                    KThread* w = best_waiter(it->second);
                    w->cv_signaled = true;
                    reacquire(w);
                }
                if (it->second.empty()) { g_cv_waiters.erase(it); gword(r[0]).store(0); }
            }
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x1F: {  // ConnectToNamedPort(name r1) -> r1 handle
            r[1] = ipc_connect(gstr(r[1], 16).c_str());
            r[0] = r[1] ? R_OK : R_NOT_FOUND;
            return;
        }
        case 0x21: r[0] = ipc_request(r[0], t->tlr, 0x100); return;           // SendSyncRequest(handle)
        case 0x22: r[0] = ipc_request(r[2], r[0], r[1]); return;              // ...WithUserBuffer(buf, size, handle)
        case 0x25: {  // GetThreadId(handle r1) -> r1:r2
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            KThread* x = get_thread(r[1]);
            r[0] = x ? R_OK : R_BAD_HANDLE;
            r[1] = x ? (uint32_t)x->id : 0;
            r[2] = x ? (uint32_t)(x->id >> 32) : 0;
            return;
        }
        case 0x26: fatal("svcBreak(%x, %08x, %x) lr %s", r[0], r[1], r[2], symbol_at(c->r[14]));
        case 0x27: log("[guest] %.*s", (int)r[1], (const char*)GPTR(r[0])); r[0] = R_OK; return;
        case 0x29: {  // GetInfo(id r1, handle r2, sub r0:r3) -> r1:r2
            uint32_t res;
            uint64_t v = get_info(r[1], r[2], (uint64_t)r[3] << 32 | r[0], &res);
            r[0] = res;
            r[1] = (uint32_t)v;
            r[2] = (uint32_t)(v >> 32);
            return;
        }
        case 0x2A: case 0x2B: case 0x2C: case 0x5F: r[0] = R_OK; return;  // cache maintenance
        case 0x34: {  // WaitForAddress(addr r0, type r1, value r2, timeout r3:r4)
            int64_t to = (int64_t)((uint64_t)r[4] << 32 | r[3]);
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> l(K);
            uint32_t addr = r[0], type = r[1];
            int32_t v = (int32_t)gword(addr).load(), want = (int32_t)r[2];
            bool wait = type == 2 ? v == want : v < want;
            if (!wait) { r[0] = R_INVALID_STATE; return; }
            if (type == 1) gword(addr).store((uint32_t)(v - 1));
            if (to == 0) { r[0] = R_TIMEOUT; return; }
            t->addr_woken = false;
            g_addr_waiters[addr].push_back(t);
            if (!kwait(l, t, to, [&] { return t->addr_woken; })) {
                pop_waiter(g_addr_waiters[addr], t);
                r[0] = R_TIMEOUT;
                return;
            }
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x35: {  // SignalToAddress(addr r0, type r1, value r2, count r3)
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            uint32_t addr = r[0], type = r[1];
            int32_t count = (int32_t)r[3];
            auto& v = g_addr_waiters[addr];
            if (type == 1 || type == 2) {
                if ((int32_t)gword(addr).load() != (int32_t)r[2]) { r[0] = R_INVALID_STATE; return; }
                int32_t value = (int32_t)r[2], waiters = (int32_t)v.size(), nv = value + 1;
                if (type == 2 && waiters) {  // modify by waiting count (Horizon's KAddressArbiter rule)
                    if (count <= 0) nv = value - 2;                   // all woken
                    else nv = waiters <= count ? value - 1 : value;   // every waiter woken / some stay asleep
                }
                gword(addr).store((uint32_t)nv);
            }
            bool all = count <= 0;
            while (!v.empty() && (all || count-- > 0)) {
                KThread* w = best_waiter(v);
                w->addr_woken = true;
                w->cv.notify_one();
            }
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        case 0x45: {  // CreateEvent -> r1 writable, r2 readable
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            auto e = std::make_shared<KEvent>();
            r[1] = add_handle(e);
            r[2] = add_handle(e);
            r[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        default:
            fatal("unimplemented svc %#x (r0 %08x r1 %08x r2 %08x) lr %s", imm, r[0], r[1], r[2], symbol_at(c->r[14]));
    }
}

void guest_backtrace(const Cpu& c);

// NX_THREAD_DUMP=<seconds>: after that long, log where every guest thread is (debugging hangs)
void kernel_init() {
    const char* s = getenv("NX_THREAD_DUMP");
    if (!s) return;
    int secs = atoi(s);
    std::thread([secs] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(secs));
        std::vector<KThread*> ts;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
            for (auto& [h, o] : g_handles)
                if (auto* t = dynamic_cast<KThread*>(o.get())) ts.push_back(t);
        }
        for (KThread* t : ts) {
            std::string name = thread_name(t);
            log("thread %x '%s' prio %d core %d entry %s%s", t->handle, name.c_str(), t->prio, t->core, symbol_at(t->entry),
                t->exited ? " (exited)" : "");
            guest_backtrace(t->cpu);
        }
    }).detach();
}

uint32_t kernel_add_object(std::shared_ptr<KObject> o) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
    return add_handle(std::move(o));
}
uint32_t kevent_create(uint32_t* readable) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
    auto e = std::make_shared<KEvent>();
    uint32_t w = add_handle(e);
    *readable = add_handle(e);
    return w;
}
void kevent_signal(uint32_t h) {
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
        if (KEvent* e = dynamic_cast<KEvent*>(get(h))) e->sig = true;
    }
    KCV.notify_all();
}
KObject* kernel_get_object(uint32_t h) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(K);
    return get(h);
}

}  // namespace rt

```

`runtime/src/main.cpp`:

// Boot: map the prelinked image, then do what rtld does and enter nn::init::Start on the main thread.

namespace rt {

int g_verbose = 0;
static FILE* g_log;
static FILE* g_issues;  // <data>/issues.log: only problem lines, timestamped (play.bat shows it live)
static bool g_own_console;  // started without a console (double-click): fatal errors also show a message box
static std::mutex g_log_lock;
std::filesystem::path g_data;  // private/tms (image, romfs)

// A log line that reports a problem: crashes, stubs, unimplemented calls, failed translations, skipped work, CRI
// errors. "vk: skipped:" counters only when one of them is non-zero.
static bool is_issue(const char* s) {
    if (strstr(s, "#CRIATOM")) return false;  // CRI's API trace through the game log, not errors
    if (!strncmp(s, "vk: skipped: ", 13)) {
        for (const char* p = s + 13; *p; p++)
            if (*p >= '1' && *p <= '9' && (p[-1] == ' ')) return true;
        return false;
    }
    static const char* words[] = {"FATAL", "CRASH", "stub", "unimplemented", "unknown", "failed", "error", "[cri]",
                                  "skipped", "bad handle", "cannot", "not found"};
    for (const char* w : words)
        if (strstr(s, w)) return true;
    return false;
}

// Same message with other numbers counts as a repeat: written 3 times, then at 10, 100, 1000... repeats.
static void issue(const char* s) {
    static std::unordered_map<std::string, uint64_t> seen;
    static int tail = 0;  // lines after FATAL/CRASH (backtrace) are copied as they are
    static const unsigned long long t0 = GetTickCount64();
    if (!g_issues) return;
    bool cont = tail > 0 && s[0] == ' ';
    if (!cont && !is_issue(s)) { tail = 0; return; }
    uint64_t n = 0;
    if (cont) tail--;
    else {
        if (!strncmp(s, "FATAL", 5) || !strncmp(s, "CRASH", 5)) tail = 64;
        std::string key(s);
        for (char& ch : key)
            if (isxdigit((unsigned char)ch)) ch = '#';
        n = ++seen[key];
        if (n > 3 && n != 10 && n != 100 && n != 1000 && n != 10000 && n != 100000) return;
    }
    // seen on every boot since milestone 1, with no visible effect
    static const char* known[] = {"unimplemented import nnosGetDefaultUserExceptionStackForApplication",
                                  "unimplemented import glslcSetAllocator", "ipc lm cmd 0:", "ipc set cmd 2:",
                                  "ipc set cmd 5:", "nvn stub nvnProgramFinalize"};
    const char* tag = "";
    for (const char* k : known)
        if (!strncmp(s, k, strlen(k))) tag = "(known, harmless) ";
#ifdef _WIN32
    SYSTEMTIME st;
    GetLocalTime(&st);
#else
    struct { unsigned wHour, wMinute, wSecond; } st;
    { time_t now = time(nullptr); tm lt{}; localtime_r(&now, &lt); st = {(unsigned)lt.tm_hour, (unsigned)lt.tm_min, (unsigned)lt.tm_sec}; }
#endif
    unsigned long long ms = GetTickCount64() - t0;
    fprintf(g_issues, "[%02u:%02u:%02u run %llu:%02llu] %s%s", st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond, ms / 60000, ms / 1000 % 60,
            tag, s);
    if (n > 3) fprintf(g_issues, "   (seen %llu times)", (unsigned long long)n);
    fputc('\n', g_issues);
    fflush(g_issues);
}

void log(const char* fmt, ...) {
    char buf[4096];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(buf, sizeof buf, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_log_lock);
    fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", buf);
    // NX_LOG_TIME=1: prefix log-file lines with seconds since start (timing comparisons, e.g. 30 vs 60 fps)
    static const bool stamp = getenv("NX_LOG_TIME") != nullptr;
    static const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    if (g_log && stamp) fprintf(g_log, "%9.3f ", std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count());
    if (g_log) { fprintf(g_log, "%s\n", buf); fflush(g_log); }
    issue(buf);
}

// Keep the previous run's logs: <file> -> <data>/logs/<stem>_<its last write time><ext>.
static void archive_log(const std::filesystem::path& p) {
    std::error_code ec;
    if (!std::filesystem::exists(p, ec) || std::filesystem::file_size(p, ec) == 0) return;
    auto t = std::chrono::clock_cast<std::chrono::system_clock>(std::filesystem::last_write_time(p, ec));
    std::time_t tt = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(t);
    char stamp[32];
    std::strftime(stamp, sizeof stamp, "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", std::localtime(&tt));
    auto dir = g_data / "logs";
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir, ec);
    std::filesystem::rename(p, dir / (p.stem().string() + "_" + stamp + p.extension().string()), ec);
}

// guest call stack from the frame-pointer chain (clang's `push {.., fp, lr}; add fp, sp, #n`: [fp] = caller fp, [fp+4] = lr)
void guest_backtrace(const Cpu& c) {
    log("  pc~lr %s", symbol_at(c.r[14]));
    uint32_t fp = c.r[11];
    for (int i = 0; i < 24 && fp >= 0x00200000 && fp < 0xFFFF0000u && (fp & 3) == 0; i++) {
        Region r = mem_query(fp);
        if (r.state == MS_FREE) break;
        uint32_t lr = ld32(fp + 4), up = ld32(fp);
        log("  #%-2d %s", i, symbol_at(lr));
        if (up <= fp) break;
        fp = up;
    }
}

void fatal(const char* fmt, ...) {
    char buf[4096];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(buf, sizeof buf, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    log("FATAL: %s", buf);
    if (KThread* t = cur()) { log("  thread %s", t->name.c_str()); guest_backtrace(t->cpu); }
    fflush(nullptr);
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (g_own_console) MessageBoxA(nullptr, buf, "TMSRecomp: fatal error", MB_ICONERROR);
    TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 3);
#else
    if (g_own_console) SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR, "TMSRecomp: fatal error", buf, nullptr);
    _exit(3);
#endif
    for (;;) {}
}

std::string g_data_dir;

// guest-callable host functions (rtld's callbacks, NVN procs). The tag tells a shared function which entry ran.
static std::mutex g_cb_lock;
static std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::pair<HleFn, uintptr_t>> g_host_cb;
static thread_local uintptr_t t_cb_tag;
uint32_t host_callback(HleFn fn, uintptr_t tag) {
    uint32_t a = hle_alloc(4, 4);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_cb_lock);
    g_host_cb[a] = {fn, tag};
    return a;
}
uint32_t host_callback(HleFn fn) { return host_callback(fn, 0); }
HleFn host_callback_at(uint32_t a) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_cb_lock);
    auto it = g_host_cb.find(a);
    if (it == g_host_cb.end()) return nullptr;
    t_cb_tag = it->second.second;
    return it->second.first;
}
uintptr_t host_callback_tag() { return t_cb_tag; }

uint32_t gcall(Cpu* c, uint32_t fn, std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args) {
    int i = 0;
    for (uint32_t a : args) c->r[i++] = a;
    call_guest(c, fn);
    return c->r[0];
}
uint32_t gcall(Cpu* c, const char* sym, std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args) {
    uint32_t a = export_addr(sym);
    if (!a) fatal("gcall: no symbol %s", sym);
    return gcall(c, a, args);
}
void attach_system_event(Cpu* c, uint32_t sysevent, uint32_t readable, bool autoclear) {
    gcall(c, "_ZN2nn2os33AttachReadableHandleToSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeEjbNS0_14EventClearModeE",
          {sysevent, readable, 1, autoclear ? 1u : 0u});
}
void set_r64(Cpu* c, uint64_t v) { c->r[0] = (uint32_t)v; c->r[1] = (uint32_t)(v >> 32); }

void call_guest(Cpu* c, uint32_t addr) {
    uint32_t lr = c->r[14];
    c->r[14] = 0xFFFFFFF0u;
    dispatch(c, addr);
    c->r[14] = lr;
}

static void load_image() {
    auto p = g_data / "link" / "image.bin";
    std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) fatal("cannot open %s (run the import step first)", p.string().c_str());
    std::vector<char> img((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), {});
    if (img.size() != g_image_size) fatal("image.bin is %zu bytes, the build expects %u: rebuild after re-import", img.size(), g_image_size);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_module_count; i++) {
        const GuestModule& m = g_modules[i];
        mem_map(m.text_lo, m.text_hi - m.text_lo + 0xFFF & ~0xFFFu, MS_CODE, 5);
        mem_map(m.ro_lo, (m.ro_hi - m.ro_lo + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFu, MS_CODE, 1);
        mem_map(m.data_lo, m.data_hi - m.data_lo, MS_CODEDATA, 3);
    }
    uint32_t end = g_modules[g_module_count - 1].base + g_modules[g_module_count - 1].size;
    uint32_t thunks = (end + 0xFFFFF) & ~0xFFFFFu;
    if (img.size() > thunks - IMAGE_BASE) mem_map(thunks, (uint32_t)img.size() - (thunks - IMAGE_BASE) + 0xFFF & ~0xFFFu, MS_CODE, 5);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_module_count; i++)  // modules are 1 MiB aligned with uncommitted gaps between
        memcpy(GPTR(g_modules[i].base), img.data() + (g_modules[i].base - IMAGE_BASE), g_modules[i].size);
    if (img.size() > thunks - IMAGE_BASE)
        memcpy(GPTR(thunks), img.data() + (thunks - IMAGE_BASE), img.size() - (thunks - IMAGE_BASE));
    log("image: %zu bytes, %u modules", img.size(), g_module_count);
}

}  // namespace rt

using namespace rt;

// NX_CONTROL "watch addr len [r]" (hex guest address, byte length; "watch off" stops): log the code that writes (r: reads
// or writes) guest memory [addr, addr+len), to find frame-counted game code. The host page is guarded; a hit logs the
// generated function (F_<guest address> from tms.pdb) once per host instruction, then runs that instruction
// single-stepped with the page open and guards it again. Other threads touching the page in that window are missed.
#ifdef _WIN32
static struct { uint32_t lo = 0, hi = 0; bool reads = false; uint8_t* page = nullptr; } g_watch;
static thread_local bool t_watch_step;
static std::mutex g_watch_lock;
static DWORD watch_protect() { return g_watch.reads ? PAGE_NOACCESS : PAGE_READONLY; }

static bool sym_init() {  // dbghelp symbols (tms.pdb) for watch, guest_chain and the profiler: initialised once
    static const bool ok = SymInitialize(GetCurrentProcess(), nullptr, TRUE);
    return ok;
}

// NX_PROFILE=1: sampling profiler of the calling thread (the game thread, from pace_present). A sampler thread stops it
// every millisecond, records the host instruction and the innermost generated function (F_<guest addr>) on its stack,
// and every 10 s logs the top entries of both (where frame time goes: guest code, runtime, waits).
void rt::profile_start() {
    static bool on = getenv("NX_PROFILE") != nullptr, started = false;
    if (!on || started) return;
    started = true;
    HANDLE target;
    DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentProcess(), GetCurrentThread(), GetCurrentProcess(), &target,
                    THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME | THREAD_GET_CONTEXT | THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, 0);
    std::thread([target] {
        HANDLE proc = GetCurrentProcess();
        sym_init();
        timeBeginPeriod(1);
        MODULEINFO mi{}, gi{};
        GetModuleInformation(proc, GetModuleHandleA(nullptr), &mi, sizeof mi);
        GetModuleInformation(proc, GetModuleHandleA("game.dll"), &gi, sizeof gi);
        uint64_t lo = (uint64_t)mi.lpBaseOfDll, hi = lo + mi.SizeOfImage;      // runtime
        uint64_t glo = (uint64_t)gi.lpBaseOfDll, ghi = glo + gi.SizeOfImage;  // generated code
        auto ours = [&](DWORD64 a) { return (a >= lo && a < hi) || (a >= glo && a < ghi); };
        // address -> (function start, is generated guest code); filled after the target runs again (no locks held)
        std::unordered_map<DWORD64, std::pair<DWORD64, bool>> syms;
        alignas(SYMBOL_INFO) char buf[sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO) + 256] = {};
        auto* si = (SYMBOL_INFO*)buf;
        auto lookup = [&](DWORD64 a) -> std::pair<DWORD64, bool>& {
            auto [it, added] = syms.try_emplace(a, std::pair<DWORD64, bool>{a, false});
            if (added) {
                si->SizeOfStruct = sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO), si->MaxNameLen = 255;
                DWORD64 disp;
                if (SymFromAddr(proc, a, &disp, si)) it->second = {si->Address, !strncmp(si->Name, "F_", 2)};
            }
            return it->second;
        };
        std::unordered_map<DWORD64, uint32_t> leaf, guest;
        static uint64_t stack[1024];
        uint32_t n = 0;
        auto last = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        // spikes: a game frame (pace_present to pace_present) over NX_PROFILE_SPIKE ms (default 20) logs its own samples
        const double spike_ms = getenv("NX_PROFILE_SPIKE") ? atof(getenv("NX_PROFILE_SPIKE")) : 20.0;
        std::vector<std::array<DWORD64, 3>> frame;  // (leaf, guest, runtime caller of a non-tms.exe leaf) samples of the current game frame
        uint64_t frame_no = g_frame_no;
        auto frame_t0 = last;
        auto spike = [&](double ms) {
            std::unordered_map<std::string, uint32_t> agg;
            for (auto& [lf, g, h] : frame) {
                std::string k;
                DWORD64 disp;
                for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                    DWORD64 a = j == 0 ? g : j == 1 ? h : lf;
                    if (j == 1 && !a) continue;
                    si->SizeOfStruct = sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO), si->MaxNameLen = 255;
                    std::string nm = !a ? "(no guest frame)" : SymFromAddr(proc, a, &disp, si) ? si->Name : "?";
                    k += (j ? " / " : "") + nm.substr(0, 60);
                }
                agg[k]++;
            }
            std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, std::string>> v;
            for (auto& [k, c] : agg) v.push_back({c, k});
            std::sort(v.rbegin(), v.rend());
            std::string s;
            char b[600];
            for (size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < 8; i++) { snprintf(b, sizeof b, "\n    %3u %s", v[i].first, v[i].second.c_str()); s += b; }
            log("[profile] spike frame %.1f ms, %zu samples (guest / runtime caller / leaf):%s", ms, frame.size(), s.c_str());
        };
        for (;;) {
            Sleep(1);
            if (SuspendThread(target) == (DWORD)-1) return;
            CONTEXT ctx{};
            ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_CONTROL;
            bool ok = GetThreadContext(target, &ctx);
            SIZE_T got = 0;
            if (ok) ReadProcessMemory(proc, (void*)ctx.Rsp, stack, sizeof stack, &got);  // no lock taken
            ResumeThread(target);
            if (!ok) continue;
            leaf[lookup(ctx.Rip).first]++;
            DWORD64 g = lookup(ctx.Rip).second ? lookup(ctx.Rip).first : 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; !g && i < got / 8; i++)  // return addresses into game.dll: first generated function
                if (stack[i] >= glo && stack[i] < ghi && lookup(stack[i]).second) g = lookup(stack[i]).first;
            guest[g]++;
            n++;
            auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            if (uint64_t f = g_frame_no; f != frame_no) {
                double ms = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(now - frame_t0).count();
                if (f == frame_no + 1 && ms > spike_ms) spike(ms);
                frame.clear(), frame_no = f, frame_t0 = now;
            }
            DWORD64 h = 0;  // leaf outside our modules (driver, ntdll waits): the runtime function that called into it
            for (size_t i = 0; !h && !ours(ctx.Rip) && i < got / 8; i++)
                if (stack[i] >= lo && stack[i] < hi && !lookup(stack[i]).second) h = lookup(stack[i]).first;
            frame.push_back({lookup(ctx.Rip).first, g, h});
            if (now - last < std::chrono::seconds(10)) continue;
            last = now;
            auto top = [&](std::unordered_map<DWORD64, uint32_t>& m, const char* what) {
                std::unordered_map<std::string, uint32_t> agg;
                for (auto& [a, c] : m) {
                    si->SizeOfStruct = sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO), si->MaxNameLen = 255;
                    DWORD64 disp;
                    agg[!a ? "(no guest frame)" : SymFromAddr(proc, a, &disp, si) ? si->Name : "?"] += c;
                }
                std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, std::string>> v;
                for (auto& [k, c] : agg) v.push_back({c, k});
                std::sort(v.rbegin(), v.rend());
                std::string s;
                char b[320];
                for (size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < 25; i++) { snprintf(b, sizeof b, "\n    %5.1f%% %s", 100.0 * v[i].first / n, v[i].second.c_str()); s += b; }
                log("[profile] %s, %u samples:%s", what, n, s.c_str());
            };
            top(leaf, "host functions (leaf)");
            top(guest, "innermost guest function");
            leaf.clear(), guest.clear(), n = 0;
        }
    }).detach();
}

// NX_CONTROL "spr bank sheet n" (debug): the game's 2D sprite records (id = bank * 10^7 + sheet * 10^4 + index; lookup
// 0x59c1a0, manager pointer at 0x9f3320): index, then the 0x70-byte record's first 16 words (rect floats / ints)
void rt::sprite_command(const char* args) {
    int bank = 0, sheet = 0, n = 0;
    if (sscanf(args, "%d %d %d", &bank, &sheet, &n) != 3) return;
    const uint32_t m = ld32(0x9f3320);
    if (!m) { log("spr: no sprite manager"); return; }
    const uint32_t t = ld32(m + 8), b0 = t ? ld32(t + bank * 0xc) : 0, bk = b0 >= 0x10000000 ? ld32(b0 + 0x10) : 0,
                   recs = bk >= 0x10000000 ? ld32(bk + sheet * 0x30 + 0x10) : 0;
    log("spr: manager %08x table %08x b0 %08x bank %08x records %08x", m, t, b0, bk, recs);
    if (!recs) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const uint32_t r = recs + i * 0x70;
        std::string s;
        char b[32];
        for (int k = 0; k < 28; k++) {
            const uint32_t w = ld32(r + 4 * k);
            float f;
            memcpy(&f, &w, 4);
            if (w > 0x3000000 && w < 0x50000000) snprintf(b, sizeof b, " %g", f);
            else snprintf(b, sizeof b, " %x", w);
            s += b;
        }
        log("spr %d: %s", i, s.c_str());
    }
}
void rt::dump_command(const char* args) {  // pages that are not committed are written as zeros (snap4.sh, framecount.py)
    unsigned lo = 0, hi = 0;
    char path[260] = "";
    if (sscanf(args, " %x %x %259s", &lo, &hi, path) < 3 || hi <= lo) { log("[dump] usage: dump lo hi file"); return; }
    uint64_t frame = g_frame_no;
    std::vector<uint8_t> snap(hi - (lo & ~0xfffu));  // copy first (fast), write after: one point in game time
    for (uint32_t a = lo & ~0xfffu; a < hi; a += 0x1000) {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi{};
        bool ok = VirtualQuery(GPTR(a), &mi, sizeof mi) && mi.State == MEM_COMMIT && !(mi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD));
        if (ok) memcpy(&snap[a - (lo & ~0xfffu)], GPTR(a), std::min<size_t>(0x1000, hi - a));
    }
    uint64_t frame2 = g_frame_no;
    FILE* f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) { log("[dump] cannot write %s", path); return; }
    fwrite(snap.data(), 1, snap.size(), f);
    fclose(f);
    log("[dump] frames %llu-%llu: %08x-%08x -> %s", (unsigned long long)frame, (unsigned long long)frame2, lo & ~0xfffu, hi, path);
}

void rt::watch_command(const char* args) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_watch_lock);
    DWORD old;
    if (g_watch.page) VirtualProtect(g_watch.page, 0x1000, PAGE_READWRITE, &old);
    g_watch.page = nullptr;
    unsigned a = 0, n = 4;
    char r[4] = "";
    unsigned off = 0;  // "*ptr+off len": watch at the pointer stored at ptr, plus off
    if (sscanf(args, " *%x+%x %x %3s", &a, &off, &n, r) >= 2) a = ld32(a) + off;
    else if (sscanf(args, " %x %x %3s", &a, &n, r) < 1) a = 0;
    if (!a) { log("[watch] off"); return; }
    static bool sym = sym_init();
    if (!sym) log("[watch] no symbols (SymInitialize failed)");
    g_watch.lo = a;
    g_watch.hi = a + std::max(1u, n);
    g_watch.reads = r[0] == 'r';
    g_watch.page = (uint8_t*)((uintptr_t)GPTR(a) & ~(uintptr_t)0xFFF);
    if ((g_watch.hi - 1) >> 12 != a >> 12) log("[watch] range crosses a page: only %08x.. is watched", a);
    if (!VirtualProtect(g_watch.page, 0x1000, watch_protect(), &old)) { log("[watch] VirtualProtect failed"); g_watch.page = nullptr; }
    else log("[watch] %08x-%08x %s", g_watch.lo, g_watch.hi, g_watch.reads ? "reads + writes" : "writes");
}

// Guest call chain for logs: the generated functions (F_<guest addr>) on the host stack, innermost first.
std::string rt::guest_chain() {
    static bool sym = sym_init();
    if (!sym) return "";
    alignas(SYMBOL_INFO) char buf[sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO) + 256] = {};
    auto* si = (SYMBOL_INFO*)buf;
    si->SizeOfStruct = sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO);
    si->MaxNameLen = 255;
    DWORD64 disp = 0;
    void* frames[48];
    std::string chain;
    for (USHORT i = 0, n = RtlCaptureStackBackTrace(0, 48, frames, nullptr); i < n; i++)
        if (SymFromAddr(GetCurrentProcess(), (DWORD64)frames[i], &disp, si) && !strncmp(si->Name, "F_", 2))
            chain += std::string(" ") + (si->Name + 2);
    return chain;
}

static LONG WINAPI on_watch(EXCEPTION_POINTERS* e) {
    auto* r = e->ExceptionRecord;
    if (r->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP && t_watch_step) {
        t_watch_step = false;
        DWORD old;
        if (g_watch.page) VirtualProtect(g_watch.page, 0x1000, watch_protect(), &old);
        e->ContextRecord->EFlags &= ~0x100u;
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    }
    if (r->ExceptionCode != EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION || !g_watch.page || r->NumberParameters < 2) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    uint8_t* fa = (uint8_t*)r->ExceptionInformation[1];
    if (fa < g_watch.page || fa >= g_watch.page + 0x1000) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    uint32_t ga = (uint32_t)(fa - (uint8_t*)GUEST_BASE);
    bool write = r->ExceptionInformation[0] == 1;
    if (ga >= g_watch.lo && ga < g_watch.hi && (write || g_watch.reads)) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_watch_lock);
        static std::unordered_map<uintptr_t, uint32_t> seen;  // hits per host instruction
        uint32_t k = ++seen[(uintptr_t)r->ExceptionAddress];
        if (k == 1 || k == 100 || k == 10000) {
            alignas(SYMBOL_INFO) char buf[sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO) + 256] = {};
            auto* si = (SYMBOL_INFO*)buf;
            si->SizeOfStruct = sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO);
            si->MaxNameLen = 255;
            DWORD64 disp = 0;
            const char* name = SymFromAddr(GetCurrentProcess(), (DWORD64)r->ExceptionAddress, &disp, si) ? si->Name : "?";
            KThread* t = cur();
            log("[watch] %s %08x by %s+%#llx x%u (guest lr %s)", write ? "write" : "read", ga, name,
                (unsigned long long)disp, k, t ? symbol_at(t->cpu.r[14]) : "-");
            std::string chain = guest_chain();
            if (!chain.empty()) log("[watch]   chain%s", chain.c_str());
        }
    }
    DWORD old;
    VirtualProtect(g_watch.page, 0x1000, PAGE_READWRITE, &old);
    t_watch_step = true;
    e->ContextRecord->EFlags |= 0x100u;  // trap after this instruction
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
}

static LONG WINAPI on_crash(EXCEPTION_POINTERS* e) {
    auto* r = e->ExceptionRecord;
    if (r->ExceptionCode == 0xE06D7363 || r->ExceptionCode < 0x80000000) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;  // C++ throw, debug prints
    uint64_t fa = r->NumberParameters >= 2 ? r->ExceptionInformation[1] : 0;
    char extra[128] = "";
    if (fa >= GUEST_BASE && fa < GUEST_BASE + 0x100010000ull)
        snprintf(extra, sizeof extra, " (guest address %08llx)", fa - GUEST_BASE);
    // "tms.exe+off" / "game.dll+off" (llvm-symbolizer --obj=<module> <off + 0x140000000 exe | 0x180000000 dll>)
    auto where = [](const void* a, char* out, size_t n) {
        static const uintptr_t exe = (uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleA(nullptr), dll = (uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleA("game.dll");
        HMODULE m = nullptr;
        GetModuleHandleExA(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, (LPCSTR)a, &m);
        if (!m || ((uintptr_t)m != exe && (uintptr_t)m != dll)) return false;
        snprintf(out, n, "%s+%#llx", (uintptr_t)m == exe ? "tms.exe" : "game.dll", (unsigned long long)((uintptr_t)a - (uintptr_t)m));
        return true;
    };
    char at[64] = "?";
    where(r->ExceptionAddress, at, sizeof at);
    log("CRASH: code %08lx at host %p (%s), access %llx%s", r->ExceptionCode, r->ExceptionAddress, at, fa, extra);
    void* frames[24];
    USHORT nf = RtlCaptureStackBackTrace(0, 24, frames, nullptr);
    std::string bt;
    char b[64];
    for (USHORT i = 0; i < nf; i++)
        if (where(frames[i], b, sizeof b)) bt += std::string(" ") + b;
    log("  host stack:%s", bt.c_str());
    if (KThread* t = cur()) {
        Cpu& c = t->cpu;
        log("  guest thread %s: lr %s", t->name.c_str(), symbol_at(c.r[14]));
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i += 4) log("  r%-2d %08x %08x %08x %08x", i, c.r[i], c.r[i + 1], c.r[i + 2], c.r[i + 3]);
        guest_backtrace(c);
    }
    fflush(nullptr);
    if (g_own_console) MessageBoxA(nullptr, "The game crashed. Details are in the log (nx.log in the data folder).", "TMSRecomp", MB_ICONERROR);
    TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 4);
    return EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER;
}
#else  // Linux
// The Windows debugging aids (NX_PROFILE sampling profiler, NX_CONTROL "watch", guest call chains from tms.pdb) use
// dbghelp; on Linux they report that they are not available. Crashes are reported by a SIGSEGV / SIGBUS / SIGILL /
// SIGFPE handler, which first gives memory.cpp's write watch its faults.
void rt::profile_start() {
    static bool said = false;
    if (getenv("NX_PROFILE") && !said) said = true, log("[profile] not available on Linux (use perf)");
}

void rt::dump_command(const char* args) {  // pages that are not committed are written as zeros
    unsigned lo = 0, hi = 0;
    char path[260] = "";
    if (sscanf(args, " %x %x %259s", &lo, &hi, path) < 3 || hi <= lo) { log("[dump] usage: dump lo hi file"); return; }
    uint64_t frame = g_frame_no;
    std::vector<uint8_t> snap(hi - (lo & ~0xfffu));
    for (uint32_t a = lo & ~0xfffu; a < hi; a += 0x1000)
        if (mem_query(a).state != MS_FREE) memcpy(&snap[a - (lo & ~0xfffu)], GPTR(a), std::min<size_t>(0x1000, hi - a));
    uint64_t frame2 = g_frame_no;
    FILE* f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) { log("[dump] cannot write %s", path); return; }
    fwrite(snap.data(), 1, snap.size(), f);
    fclose(f);
    log("[dump] frames %llu-%llu: %08x-%08x -> %s", (unsigned long long)frame, (unsigned long long)frame2, lo & ~0xfffu, hi, path);
}

void rt::watch_command(const char*) { log("[watch] not available on Linux"); }
std::string rt::guest_chain() { return ""; }

static void on_crash(int sig, siginfo_t* si, void* uc) {
    if ((sig == SIGSEGV || sig == SIGBUS) && mem_fault(si->si_addr)) return;  // a write-watched page: run it again
    static std::atomic<bool> once{false};
    if (once.exchange(true)) _exit(4);  // a crash inside the report
    const uint64_t fa = (uint64_t)si->si_addr;
    const void* pc = (const void*)((ucontext_t*)uc)->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RIP];
    char extra[128] = "";
    if (fa >= GUEST_BASE && fa < GUEST_BASE + 0x100010000ull)
        snprintf(extra, sizeof extra, " (guest address %08llx)", (unsigned long long)(fa - GUEST_BASE));
    // "tms+off" / "game.so+off" (llvm-symbolizer --obj=<file> <off>)
    auto where = [](const void* a, char* out, size_t n) {
        Dl_info di{};
        if (!dladdr(a, &di) || !di.dli_fname) return false;
        const char* base = strrchr(di.dli_fname, '/');
        snprintf(out, n, "%s+%#llx", base ? base + 1 : di.dli_fname, (unsigned long long)((uintptr_t)a - (uintptr_t)di.dli_fbase));
        return true;
    };
    char at[96] = "?";
    where(pc, at, sizeof at);
    log("CRASH: signal %d at host %p (%s), access %llx%s", sig, pc, at, (unsigned long long)fa, extra);
    void* frames[24];
    int nf = backtrace(frames, 24);
    std::string bt;
    char b[96];
    for (int i = 0; i < nf; i++)
        if (where(frames[i], b, sizeof b)) bt += std::string(" ") + b;
    log("  host stack:%s", bt.c_str());
    if (KThread* t = cur()) {
        Cpu& c = t->cpu;
        log("  guest thread %s: lr %s", t->name.c_str(), symbol_at(c.r[14]));
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i += 4) log("  r%-2d %08x %08x %08x %08x", i, c.r[i], c.r[i + 1], c.r[i + 2], c.r[i + 3]);
        guest_backtrace(c);
    }
    fflush(nullptr);
    if (g_own_console) SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR, "TMSRecomp", "The game crashed. Details are in the log (nx.log in the data folder).", nullptr);
    _exit(4);
}
static void install_crash_handler() {
    struct sigaction sa{};
    sa.sa_sigaction = on_crash;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_NODEFER;  // NODEFER: a watched-page fault inside a handler of ours still works
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    for (int s : {SIGSEGV, SIGBUS, SIGILL, SIGFPE}) sigaction(s, &sa, nullptr);
    signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);  // a helper that died (shader translator): write() fails with an error, as on Windows
}
#endif


// settings.ini next to tms.exe: "key = value" lines become NX_KEY unless that environment variable is already set.
// ponytail: ANSI paths only (getenv / _putenv_s); a non-ASCII data folder needs the wide-char API.
static void load_settings(const std::filesystem::path& ini) {
    if (!std::filesystem::exists(ini)) std::ofstream(ini) << k_default_settings;
    std::ifstream f(ini);
    for (std::string line; std::getline(f, line);) {
        line = line.substr(0, line.find_first_of(";#"));
        size_t eq = line.find('=');
        if (eq == std::string::npos) continue;
        auto trim = [](std::string s) {
            s.erase(0, s.find_first_not_of(" \t\r"));
            s.erase(s.find_last_not_of(" \t\r") + 1);
            return s;
        };
        std::string k = trim(line.substr(0, eq)), v = trim(line.substr(eq + 1));
        if (k.empty() || v.empty()) continue;
        std::transform(k.begin(), k.end(), k.begin(), ::toupper);
        k = "NX_" + k;
        if (!getenv(k.c_str())) _putenv_s(k.c_str(), v.c_str());
    }
}

static bool is_data(const std::filesystem::path& p) {
    std::error_code ec;
    return std::filesystem::exists(p / "link" / "image.bin", ec) && std::filesystem::exists(p / "romfs", ec);
}

static std::filesystem::path pick_data_folder() {
#ifndef _WIN32
    return {};  // Linux: no folder dialog; --data, NX_DATA, settings.ini "data =" or <data>/build/tms
#else
    CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED);
    BROWSEINFOW bi{};
    bi.lpszTitle = L"TMSRecomp: select the game data folder (the one with link\\image.bin and romfs)";
    bi.ulFlags = BIF_RETURNONLYFSDIRS | BIF_NEWDIALOGSTYLE;
    std::filesystem::path p;
    if (PIDLIST_ABSOLUTE id = SHBrowseForFolderW(&bi)) {
        wchar_t b[MAX_PATH];
        if (SHGetPathFromIDListW(id, b)) p = b;
        CoTaskMemFree(id);
    }
    return p;
#endif
}

#ifdef _WIN32
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, on_crash);
    AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, on_watch);  // first: watch faults are not crashes
    DWORD cons[2];
    if (GetConsoleProcessList(cons, 2) == 1) {  // started on its own (double-click): no console window, errors in a box
        FreeConsole();
        g_own_console = true;
    }
    wchar_t exe[MAX_PATH];
    GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH);
    const std::filesystem::path exe_dir = std::filesystem::path(exe).parent_path(), ini = exe_dir / "settings.ini";
#else
static int tms_main(int argc, char** argv);
// The guest main thread runs on the calling thread and its recompiled calls nest deeply: Windows links tms.exe with a
// 64 MiB stack. Linux gives the main thread 8 MiB, so the game runs on a thread of its own with 64 MiB.
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    struct Args { int argc; char** argv; int ret; } a{argc, argv, 0};
    pthread_attr_t at;
    pthread_attr_init(&at);
    pthread_attr_setstacksize(&at, 64u << 20);
    pthread_t th;
    if (pthread_create(&th, &at, [](void* p) -> void* { auto* a = (Args*)p; a->ret = tms_main(a->argc, a->argv); return nullptr; }, &a)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "TMSRecomp: cannot start the game thread\n");
        return 1;
    }
    pthread_join(th, nullptr);
    return a.ret;
}
static int tms_main(int argc, char** argv) {
    install_crash_handler();
    g_own_console = !isatty(2);  // started from a desktop entry / AppImage: errors also in a message box
    const std::filesystem::path exe_dir = plat::exe_path().parent_path(), ini = plat::settings_ini();
#endif
    for (int i = 1; i + 1 < argc; i++)  // --set key=value: a settings.ini line for this run only (not saved)
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--set")) {
            std::string kv = argv[++i];
            const size_t eq = kv.find('=');
            if (eq == std::string::npos || !eq) continue;
            std::string k = kv.substr(0, eq);
            std::transform(k.begin(), k.end(), k.begin(), ::toupper);
            _putenv_s(("NX_" + k).c_str(), kv.substr(eq + 1).c_str());
        }
    load_settings(ini);
    if (const char* t = getenv("NX_PAD_ICONS_TEST")) return rt::pad_icons_selftest(t);
    const char* d = getenv("NX_DATA");
    g_data = d ? d : "private/tms";
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--data") && i + 1 < argc) g_data = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-v")) g_verbose = 1;
    }
    if (!is_data(g_data)) {  // the default layout: <data>\build\tms.exe
        if (is_data(exe_dir.parent_path())) g_data = exe_dir.parent_path();
        else if (auto p = pick_data_folder(); is_data(p)) {
            g_data = p;
            std::ofstream(ini, std::ios::app) << "data = " << p.string() << "\n";
        } else {
#ifdef _WIN32
            MessageBoxA(nullptr, "Game data not found: the folder needs link\\image.bin and romfs (see README).",
                        "TMSRecomp", MB_ICONERROR);
#else
            log("Game data not found: give the folder with link/image.bin and romfs (--data <folder>, NX_DATA or data = in %s)",
                ini.string().c_str());
            SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR, "TMSRecomp",
                                     "Game data not found: the folder needs link/image.bin and romfs (see README).", nullptr);
#endif
            return 1;
        }
    }
    if (getenv("NX_VERBOSE")) g_verbose = 1;
    g_data_dir = g_data.string();
    const char* lp = getenv("NX_LOG");
    std::filesystem::path log_path = lp ? std::filesystem::path(lp) : g_data / "nx.log";
    archive_log(log_path);
    archive_log(g_data / "issues.log");
    if (const char* r = getenv("NX_RECORD")) archive_log(r);  // keep every run's input recording too
    g_log = fopen(log_path.string().c_str(), "w");
    g_issues = fopen((g_data / "issues.log").string().c_str(), "w");
    if (g_issues) {
#ifdef _WIN32
        SYSTEMTIME st;
        GetLocalTime(&st);
#else
        struct { unsigned wYear, wMonth, wDay, wHour, wMinute, wSecond; } st;
        { time_t now = time(nullptr); tm lt{}; localtime_r(&now, &lt);
          st = {(unsigned)lt.tm_year + 1900, (unsigned)lt.tm_mon + 1, (unsigned)lt.tm_mday, (unsigned)lt.tm_hour, (unsigned)lt.tm_min, (unsigned)lt.tm_sec}; }
#endif
        fprintf(g_issues, "TMSRecomp issues log, run started %04u-%02u-%02u %02u:%02u:%02u (build %s %s). Full log: %s\n",
                st.wYear, st.wMonth, st.wDay, st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond, __DATE__, __TIME__,
                log_path.string().c_str());
        fflush(g_issues);
    }
    log("TMSRecomp: data %s", g_data.string().c_str());
    log("system: %s", sysinfo_line().c_str());  // bug reports: version, Windows, CPU, RAM (GPU: the "vk:" line)
    mem_init();
    game_load(exe_dir);  // after mem_init: the guest window is reserved before any DLL can land near it
    load_image();
    dispatch_init();
    kernel_init();
    uint32_t handle = create_main_thread(0x100000, 44);  // main.npdm: stack 1 MiB, priority 44
    uint32_t start = export_addr("_ZN2nn4init5StartEjjPFvvES2_");
    if (!start) fatal("nn::init::Start not found");
    // rtld callback 1: marks rtld as initialised, nothing for us. Callback 2: each module's DT_INIT (static
    // constructors, musl registration), dependencies first.
    uint32_t cb1 = host_callback([](Cpu*) {});
    uint32_t cb2 = host_callback([](Cpu* c) {
        for (int i = (int)g_module_count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            if (g_modules[i].init) {
                log("DT_INIT %s", g_modules[i].name);
                call_guest(c, g_modules[i].init);
            }
    });
    uint32_t args[4] = {handle, 0, cb1, cb2};
    log("entering nn::init::Start");
    run_main_thread(start, args);
    return 0;
}
