`runtime/src/overlay.cpp`:

```cpp
// In-game settings menu and the title screen's exit, drawn over the game window in a layered popup (per-pixel alpha
// through UpdateLayeredWindow, Direct2D + DirectWrite into a DIB; the swapchain is not touched). The UI thread calls
// overlay_update with the host pad state every loop; while a menu is open the game gets no buttons.
// Open / close: F1, or L3 + R3 together (both sticks pressed in). Title screen: (-) opens "Exit the game?"; camp menu
// (Y in the field): (-) opens Return to Title / Quit Game / Cancel.
#include "plat.h"
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <d2d1.h>
#include <dwrite.h>
#else
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include "draw_linux.h"
#include <climits>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rt.h"

namespace vk { float wide_factor(); }

namespace rt {

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ settings
static std::filesystem::path ini_path() {
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t exe[MAX_PATH];
    GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH);
    return std::filesystem::path(exe).parent_path() / "settings.ini";
#else
    return plat::settings_ini();
#endif
}

// Rewrites "key = value" in settings.ini (the first uncommented line with that key, else appended) and NX_KEY.
void save_setting(const char* key, const std::string& value) {
    std::filesystem::path ini = ini_path();
    std::vector<std::string> lines;
    {
        std::ifstream f(ini);
        for (std::string l; std::getline(f, l);) lines.push_back(l);
    }
    bool done = false;
    for (std::string& l : lines) {
        std::string k = l.substr(0, l.find_first_of(";#="));
        k.erase(0, k.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
        k.erase(k.find_last_not_of(" \t\r") + 1);
        if (!done && l.find('=') != std::string::npos && l.find_first_of(";#") > l.find('=') && _stricmp(k.c_str(), key) == 0) {
            l = std::string(key) + " = " + value;
            done = true;
        }
    }
    if (!done) lines.push_back(std::string(key) + " = " + value);
    // replays (agent test runs) change the setting for this run only: a desynced replay that wandered into the
    // settings menu rewrote the user's settings.ini (11-01)
    if (!getenv("NX_REPLAY") || !*getenv("NX_REPLAY")) {
        std::ofstream f(ini, std::ios::trunc);
        for (const std::string& l : lines) f << l << "\n";
    }
    std::string env = "NX_" + std::string(key);
    for (char& ch : env) ch = (char)toupper((unsigned char)ch);
    _putenv_s(env.c_str(), value.c_str());
    log("settings: %s = %s", key, value.c_str());
}

static int env_int(const char* name, int def, int lo, int hi) {
    const char* v = getenv(name);
    return v && *v ? std::clamp(atoi(v), lo, hi) : def;
}
static bool env_on(const char* name, bool def) {
    const char* v = getenv(name);
    return v ? atoi(v) != 0 : def;
}

// Post effects the menu can turn off (hle_sys.cpp skips their render step): bit = FX_* index.
static std::atomic<uint32_t> g_fx_off{~0u};
static const char* const k_fx_keys[FX_COUNT] = {"fx_bloom", "fx_glow", "fx_dof", "fx_vignette", "fx_fog", "fx_outline", "fx_fxaa", "fx_char_rim"};
bool fx_enabled(int fx) {
    if (g_fx_off == ~0u) {
        uint32_t off = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < FX_COUNT; i++) {
            std::string env = "NX_" + std::string(k_fx_keys[i]);
            for (char& ch : env) ch = (char)toupper((unsigned char)ch);
            if (!env_on(env.c_str(), true)) off |= 1u << i;
        }
        g_fx_off = off;
    }
    return !(g_fx_off >> fx & 1);
}

static std::atomic<int> g_sharpen{-1};
static const int k_sharpen[] = {0, 35, 65, 100};
int sharpen_setting() {
    if (g_sharpen < 0) g_sharpen = getenv("NX_SHARPEN") ? std::clamp(atoi(getenv("NX_SHARPEN")), 0, 100) : 0;
    return g_sharpen;
}
static std::atomic<int> g_upscaler{-1};
int upscaler_setting() {
    if (g_upscaler < 0) {
        const char* e = getenv("NX_UPSCALER");
        // unset / auto = FSR 1 (weak-PC default: res auto renders below the screen there; ~0.3 ms, every GPU)
        g_upscaler = !e || !_stricmp(e, "auto") || !_stricmp(e, "fsr1") || !_stricmp(e, "fsr") || !strcmp(e, "1") ? 1 : 0;
    }
    return g_upscaler;
}
// Anti-aliasing: setting fx_fxaa = 0 off, 1 the game's FXAA, 2 SMAA (vk_replay.cpp runs our SMAA passes where the
// game's FXAA would run and turns FXAA into a pass-through). NX_SMAA=1 also selects SMAA.
static std::atomic<int> g_smaa{-1};
int smaa_setting() {
    if (g_smaa < 0) {
        const char* e = getenv("NX_FX_FXAA");
        g_smaa = env_on("NX_SMAA", false) || (e && atoi(e) == 2) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    return g_smaa;
}
// fx_fxaa = 3: AMD FSR 3 temporal anti-aliasing (native size) at the same place; SMAA when the FSR DLLs are missing
static std::atomic<int> g_fsr3{-1};
int fsr3_setting() {
    if (g_fsr3 < 0) {
        const char* e = getenv("NX_FX_FXAA");
        g_fsr3 = e && atoi(e) == 3 ? 1 : e && atoi(e) == 4 ? 2 : 0;  // 4: NVIDIA DLSS / DLAA (vk_dlss.cpp), FSR 3 when unavailable
    }
    return g_fsr3;
}
// fsr3_quality = FSR 3 / DLSS upscaling: the 3D scene renders below the output size (Anti-aliasing = FSR 3 / DLSS);
// applies at the next frame end (vk.cpp upscale_apply_setting)
static std::atomic<int> g_fsr3q{-1};
int fsr3_quality() {
    if (g_fsr3q < 0) { const char* e = getenv("NX_FSR3_QUALITY"); g_fsr3q = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
    return g_fsr3q;
}
void apply_fsr3_quality(int i) { save_setting("fsr3_quality", std::to_string(i)); g_fsr3q = i; }
void apply_aa(int i) {
    save_setting("fx_fxaa", std::to_string(i));
    fx_enabled(0);  // loaded
    if (i) g_fx_off &= ~(1u << FX_FXAA);
    else g_fx_off |= 1u << FX_FXAA;
    g_smaa = i == 2;
    g_fsr3 = i == 3 ? 1 : i == 4 ? 2 : 0;
}
// MSAA (setting msaa 0 / 2 / 4 / 8): vk_replay.cpp MsTwin, applies at once
static std::atomic<int> g_msaa{-1};
static const int k_msaa[] = {0, 2, 4, 8};
int msaa_setting() {
    if (g_msaa < 0) g_msaa = env_int("NX_MSAA", 0, 0, 8);
    return g_msaa;
}
void apply_msaa(int i) {
    save_setting("msaa", std::to_string(k_msaa[i]));
    g_msaa = k_msaa[i];
}
static void apply_upscaler(int i) {
    save_setting("upscaler", i ? "fsr1" : "bilinear");
    g_upscaler = i;
}
static void apply_sharpen(int i) {
    save_setting("sharpen", std::to_string(k_sharpen[i]));
    g_sharpen = k_sharpen[i];
}

static std::atomic<int64_t> g_title_ms{0};
static int64_t now_ms() {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}
void overlay_title_seen() { g_title_ms = now_ms(); }
static std::atomic<int64_t> g_camp_ms{0};
void overlay_camp_seen() { g_camp_ms = now_ms(); }

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ menu model
enum : uint64_t { P_A = 1 << 0, P_B = 1 << 1, P_LS = 1 << 4, P_RS = 1 << 5, P_L = 1 << 6, P_MINUS = 1 << 11, P_LEFT = 1 << 12,
                  P_UP = 1 << 13, P_RIGHT = 1 << 14, P_DOWN = 1 << 15 };

struct Item {
    const wchar_t* name;
    std::vector<const wchar_t*> choices;  // empty: an action
    int cur;
    const wchar_t* help;
    void (*apply)(int choice);
};

static const int k_fps[] = {30, 60, 120, 144, 165, 240, 0};
static const char* const k_res[] = {"720p", "1080p", "1440p", "4k", "8k"};
static bool g_restart_note = false;
static void* g_game_hwnd = nullptr;

static void apply_fps(int i) {
    int n = k_fps[i];
    save_setting("fps", std::to_string(n));
    if (n == 30 || fps_setting() == 30) g_restart_note = true;  // 30 <-> other rates need a restart (frame step setup)
    else set_fps(n);
}
static void apply_res(int i) { save_setting("res", k_res[i]); g_restart_note = true; }
static const char* const k_aspect[4] = {"16:9", "auto", "21:9", "32:9"};
static void apply_aspect(int i) { save_setting("aspect", k_aspect[i]); g_restart_note = true; }
static int aspect_index() {
    const char* a = getenv("NX_ASPECT");
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (a && !_stricmp(a, k_aspect[i])) return i;
    return 0;
}
static void apply_window(int i) {
    save_setting("window", i ? "window" : "borderless");
    ui_set_fullscreen(i == 0);
}
static void apply_fx(int fx, int on) {
    save_setting(k_fx_keys[fx], on ? "1" : "0");
    fx_enabled(0);  // loaded
    if (on) g_fx_off &= ~(1u << fx);
    else g_fx_off |= 1u << fx;
}
static void apply_first_strike(int on) { save_setting("first_strike", on ? "1" : "0"); }
static void apply_guard_regen(int on) { save_setting("guard_regen", on ? "1" : "0"); }
static void apply_skill_details(int on) { save_setting("skill_details", on ? "1" : "0"); g_restart_note = true; }
static void apply_random_bgm(int i) { save_setting("random_battle_bgm", std::to_string(i)); }
static void apply_custom_bgm_volume(int i) { save_setting("custom_bgm_volume", std::to_string(i)); }
static void apply_levelup_refill(int on) { save_setting("levelup_refill", on ? "1" : "0"); }
static void apply_autosave(int on) { save_setting("autosave", on ? "1" : "0"); }
static void apply_hide_enemies(int on) { save_setting("hide_field_enemies", on ? "1" : "0"); }
static const float k_walk[] = {1, 1.25f, 1.5f, 1.75f, 2, 2.5f, 3};
static void apply_walk(int i) {
    char v[16];
    snprintf(v, sizeof v, "%g", k_walk[i]);
    save_setting("walk_speed", v);
    set_walk_speed(k_walk[i]);
}
static void apply_exit(int) {
    log("overlay: exit chosen");
    fflush(nullptr);
#ifdef _WIN32
    ExitProcess(0);
#else
    _exit(0);
#endif
}
// Return to Title: first close the camp menu with B presses (the game's own back path, from any submenu), then the field
// leaves to the title scene from its free-roam state (hle_sys.cpp field_roam_update), like the game after an event calls
// Lua ChangeTitle. Tested 10-30: leaving from the camp's own field state, with the menu open or just closed, left the
// menu or the "now loading" screen drawn over the title.
static std::atomic<bool> g_title_request{false};
static std::atomic<int64_t> g_title_ms_chosen{0};  // when Return to Title was chosen, 0 = none
bool overlay_take_title_request() { return g_title_request.exchange(false); }
static void request_title() {
    log("overlay: return to title");
    g_title_ms_chosen = now_ms();
}
// Open Tokyo Map (QoL fast travel): the game's own map, as at a town exit (hle_sys.cpp field_roam_update). Offered only
// while the field is in free roam in a town area; the map's points keep the game's own unlock flags.
static std::atomic<int64_t> g_roam_ms{0};
static std::atomic<bool> g_roam_town{false};
static std::atomic<int64_t> g_map_request_ms{0};  // when chosen, 0 = none
void overlay_roam_seen(bool town) { g_roam_ms = now_ms(), g_roam_town = town; }
void overlay_request_map() { log("overlay: open Tokyo Map"); g_map_request_ms = now_ms(); }
// a request not taken within 2 s (an event or battle started meanwhile) is dropped: the map never opens out of the blue
bool overlay_take_map_request() {
    const int64_t p = g_map_request_ms.exchange(0);
    if (p && now_ms() - p > 2000) log("overlay: Tokyo Map request dropped (field was not in free roam)");
    return p && now_ms() - p <= 2000;
}
static bool map_offered() { return g_roam_town && now_ms() - g_roam_ms < 300; }
// L1 fast travel (USER 11-14): L in town free roam opens a list of visited shops (hle_sys.cpp travel_mask) + Tokyo Map
static std::atomic<int64_t> g_travel_ms{0};
static std::atomic<int> g_travel_shop{-1};
void overlay_request_travel(int i) { log("overlay: fast travel %d", i); g_travel_shop = i, g_travel_ms = now_ms(); }
int overlay_take_travel_request() {
    const int64_t p = g_travel_ms.exchange(0);
    if (!p) return -1;
    if (now_ms() - p > 2000) { log("overlay: fast travel request dropped (field was not in free roam)"); return -1; }
    return g_travel_shop;
}
static std::vector<Item> build_travel_items() {
    std::vector<Item> v;
    const uint32_t m = travel_shops_offered();
    for (int i = 0; i < travel_shop_count() && i < 32; i++) {
        if (!(m >> i & 1)) continue;
        // shortcut: Item.apply has no context, so the row's shop index travels through a per-row lambda table
        static void (*const go[8])(int) = {[](int) { overlay_request_travel(0); }, [](int) { overlay_request_travel(1); },
                                            [](int) { overlay_request_travel(2); }, [](int) { overlay_request_travel(3); },
                                            [](int) { overlay_request_travel(4); }, [](int) { overlay_request_travel(5); },
                                            [](int) { overlay_request_travel(6); }, [](int) { overlay_request_travel(7); }};
        if (i < 8) v.push_back({travel_shop_name(i), {}, 0, travel_shop_help(i), go[i]});
    }
    if (v.empty())
        v.push_back({L"No shops yet", {}, 0, L"Shops appear here after your first visit (Café Seiren once Shibuya is open on the Tokyo Map).", [](int) {}});
    v.push_back({L"Tokyo Map", {}, 0, L"The game's own Tokyo Map, as at a town exit. Only places you have unlocked can be picked; B on the map returns here.",
                 [](int) { overlay_request_map(); }});
    return v;
}
// buttons to add to the game's pad this poll (B pulses until the camp menu is closed)
uint64_t overlay_buttons() {
    const int64_t p = g_title_ms_chosen, t = now_ms();
    if (!p) return 0;
    if (t - p > 10000) { log("overlay: return to title: camp menu did not close"); g_title_ms_chosen = 0; return 0; }
    if (t - g_camp_ms > 300) { g_title_request = true, g_title_ms_chosen = 0; return 0; }  // closed
    return (t - p) % 300 >= 150 ? P_B : 0;  // 150 ms released (the A press ends), 150 ms pressed
}

static std::vector<Item> build_items() {
    int fps = fps_setting(), fi = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) if (k_fps[i] == fps) fi = i;
    const char* res = getenv("NX_RES");
    int ri = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) if (res && !_stricmp(res, k_res[i])) ri = i;
    const char* win = getenv("NX_WINDOW");
    int wi = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) if (fabsf(k_walk[i] - walk_speed()) < 0.01f) wi = i;
    std::vector<const wchar_t*> onoff = {L"Off", L"On"};
    std::vector<Item> v = {
        {L"Frame rate", {L"30", L"60", L"120", L"144", L"165", L"240", L"Uncapped"}, fi,
         L"Game speed stays the same at every rate; higher is smoother. 30 is the Switch rate (switching to or from 30 needs a restart).", apply_fps},
        {L"UI animation speed", {L"Switch", L"60 Hz"}, ui_speed() == 60 ? 1 : 0,
         L"Menus, dialogue, HUD and battle UI. 60 Hz (default): the 60 fps speed at every frame rate above 30. Switch: half that speed, the original 30 fps pace.",
         [](int c) { set_ui_speed(c ? 60 : 30); save_setting("ui_speed", c ? "60" : "30"); }},
        {L"Attack Session", onoff, !getenv("NX_ATTACK_SESSION") || atoi(getenv("NX_ATTACK_SESSION")) != 0,
         L"A regular Attack that hits a weakness can start a Session. Off: the original rule. Applies after a restart.",
         [](int c) { save_setting("attack_session", c ? "1" : "0"); }},

static std::string utf8(const wchar_t* w) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    std::string s(n > 0 ? n - 1 : 0, '␀');
    if (n > 1) WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, s.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
    return s;
#else
    return draw::utf8(w);
#endif
}
bool overlay_setting(const wchar_t* name, SettingItem& out) {
    for (const Item& it : build_items()) {
        if (wcscmp(it.name, name)) continue;
        out.name = utf8(it.name), out.help = utf8(it.help), out.cur = it.cur, out.choices.clear();
        for (const wchar_t* c : it.choices) out.choices.push_back(utf8(c));
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
void overlay_apply_setting(const wchar_t* name, int choice) {
    for (const Item& it : build_items())
        if (!wcscmp(it.name, name) && choice >= 0 && choice < (int)it.choices.size()) it.apply(choice);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ drawing
#ifdef _WIN32
struct Layer {
    HWND hwnd = nullptr;
    HDC mem = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bmp = nullptr;
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    bool shown = false;
};
static ID2D1Factory* g_d2d;
static IDWriteFactory* g_dw;
static ID2D1DCRenderTarget* g_rt;

static bool init_d2d() {
    if (g_rt) return true;
    if (FAILED(D2D1CreateFactory(D2D1_FACTORY_TYPE_SINGLE_THREADED, &g_d2d))) return false;
    if (FAILED(DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, __uuidof(IDWriteFactory), (IUnknown**)&g_dw))) return false;
    D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES p = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
        D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_DEFAULT, D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED));
    return SUCCEEDED(g_d2d->CreateDCRenderTarget(&p, &g_rt));
}

static void layer_hide(Layer& l) {
    if (l.hwnd && l.shown) ShowWindow(l.hwnd, SW_HIDE);
    l.shown = false;
}

// Draws with fn into a w x h layer at screen (x, y) over the game window.
template <class F>
static void layer_show(Layer& l, int x, int y, int w, int h, F fn) {
    if (!l.hwnd) {
        WNDCLASSW wc{};
        wc.lpfnWndProc = DefWindowProcW;
        wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
        wc.lpszClassName = L"TMSRecompOverlay";
        RegisterClassW(&wc);  // fails harmlessly the second time
        l.hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TRANSPARENT | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, wc.lpszClassName,
                                 L"", WS_POPUP, 0, 0, 1, 1, (HWND)g_game_hwnd, nullptr, wc.hInstance, nullptr);
    }
    if (l.w != w || l.h != h) {
        if (l.bmp) DeleteObject(l.bmp);
        if (!l.mem) l.mem = CreateCompatibleDC(nullptr);
        BITMAPINFO bi{};
        bi.bmiHeader = {sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER), w, -h, 1, 32, BI_RGB};
        void* bits;
        l.bmp = CreateDIBSection(l.mem, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
        SelectObject(l.mem, l.bmp);
        l.w = w, l.h = h;
    }
    RECT r{0, 0, w, h};
    g_rt->BindDC(l.mem, &r);
    g_rt->BeginDraw();
    g_rt->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0, 0, 0, 0));
    fn();
    g_rt->EndDraw();
    POINT pos{x, y}, zero{0, 0};
    SIZE size{w, h};
    BLENDFUNCTION bf{AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA};
    UpdateLayeredWindow(l.hwnd, nullptr, &pos, &size, l.mem, &zero, 0, &bf, ULW_ALPHA);
    if (!l.shown) SetWindowPos(l.hwnd, HWND_TOP, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW);
    l.shown = true;
}

static void text(const wchar_t* s, float x, float y, float w, float h, float size, D2D1::ColorF color,
                 DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT weight = DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD,
                 DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT align = DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING) {
    IDWriteTextFormat* f;
    if (FAILED(g_dw->CreateTextFormat(L"Segoe UI", nullptr, weight, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
                                      size, L"en-us", &f)))
        return;
    f->SetTextAlignment(align);
    f->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
    f->SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_WRAP);
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* b;
    g_rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(color, &b);
    g_rt->DrawText(s, (UINT32)wcslen(s), f, D2D1::RectF(x, y, x + w, y + h), b);
    b->Release();
    f->Release();
}

static void fill(float x, float y, float w, float h, float radius, D2D1::ColorF color) {
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* b;
    g_rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(color, &b);
    g_rt->FillRoundedRectangle(D2D1::RoundedRect(D2D1::RectF(x, y, x + w, y + h), radius, radius), b);
    b->Release();
}

#else  // Linux: each layer is a bitmap blended into the frame by the present path (frame_overlay below)
namespace D2D1 {
struct ColorF {
    float r, g, b, a;
    ColorF(float r_, float g_, float b_, float a_ = 1) : r(r_), g(g_), b(b_), a(a_) {}
};
}  // namespace D2D1
using DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT = int;
constexpr int DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL = 400, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD = 600, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD = 700;
enum DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT { DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING = draw::LEADING, DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_TRAILING = draw::TRAILING,
                             DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER = draw::CENTER };
struct RECT { int left, top, right, bottom; };
struct POINT { int x, y; };

struct Layer {
    std::unique_ptr<draw::Canvas> cv;
    int x = 0, y = 0, w = 0, h = 0;  // in window pixels
    bool shown = false;
    std::shared_ptr<const SubsBitmap> bmp;  // what frame_overlay blends (g_layer_lock)
};
static std::mutex g_layer_lock;
static int g_layer_win_w = 0, g_layer_win_h = 0;  // the window size the layers were laid out for (g_layer_lock)
static cairo_t* g_cr;

static bool init_d2d() { return true; }

static void layer_hide(Layer& l) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_layer_lock);
    l.shown = false;
    l.bmp = nullptr;
}

template <class F>
static void layer_show(Layer& l, int x, int y, int w, int h, F fn) {
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
    if (!l.cv || l.cv->w != w || l.cv->h != h) l.cv = std::make_unique<draw::Canvas>(w, h);
    l.cv->clear();
    g_cr = l.cv->cr;
    fn();
    g_cr = nullptr;
    auto b = std::make_shared<SubsBitmap>();
    b->w = (uint32_t)w, b->h = (uint32_t)h;
    b->rgba.resize((size_t)w * h);
    const uint8_t* src = l.cv->data();
    for (int yy = 0; yy < h; yy++) {
        const uint32_t* s = (const uint32_t*)(src + (size_t)yy * l.cv->stride());
        uint32_t* d = b->rgba.data() + (size_t)yy * w;
        for (int xx = 0; xx < w; xx++) d[xx] = (s[xx] & 0xff00ff00) | ((s[xx] >> 16) & 0xff) | ((s[xx] & 0xff) << 16);  // BGRA -> RGBA
    }
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_layer_lock);
    l.x = x, l.y = y, l.w = w, l.h = h, l.shown = true;
    l.bmp = b;
}

static void text(const wchar_t* s, float x, float y, float w, float h, float size, D2D1::ColorF color,
                 DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT weight = DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD,
                 DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT align = DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING) {
    draw::text(g_cr, draw::utf8(s), x, y, w, h, size, {color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a}, weight, (draw::Align)align);
}

static void fill(float x, float y, float w, float h, float radius, D2D1::ColorF color) {
    draw::round_rect(g_cr, x, y, w, h, radius);
    draw::set(g_cr, {color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a});
    cairo_fill(g_cr);
}
#endif

static const D2D1::ColorF k_bg(0.05f, 0.06f, 0.08f, 0.88f), k_lime(0.62f, 0.95f, 0.16f, 1), k_white(1, 1, 1, 1),
    k_grey(0.75f, 0.78f, 0.82f, 1), k_row(1, 1, 1, 0.06f);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ update
static Layer g_menu_layer, g_hint_layer;

bool overlay_update(void* hwnd, uint64_t buttons, int ly, bool f1) {
    g_game_hwnd = hwnd;
    static bool menu = false, confirm = false, swallow = false, travel = false;
    static int sel = 0, confirm_sel = 1, confirm_kind = 0;  // kind 0: title "Exit the game?" (Yes / No); 1: camp menu (Title / Quit / Cancel)
    static std::vector<Item> items;
    static uint64_t prev = 0;
    static int64_t next_repeat = 0;
    if (!init_d2d()) return false;
    // stick up/down as d-pad in the menus
    if (ly > 20000) buttons |= P_UP;
    if (ly < -20000) buttons |= P_DOWN;
    uint64_t pressed = buttons & ~prev;
    prev = buttons;
    int64_t t = now_ms();
    if (buttons & (P_UP | P_DOWN | P_LEFT | P_RIGHT)) {  // hold to repeat: 350 ms, then every 90 ms
        if (pressed & (P_UP | P_DOWN | P_LEFT | P_RIGHT)) next_repeat = t + 350;
        else if (t >= next_repeat) pressed |= buttons & (P_UP | P_DOWN | P_LEFT | P_RIGHT), next_repeat = t + 90;
    }
    const bool title = t - g_title_ms < 300, camp = t - g_camp_ms < 300;
    const int n_opt = confirm_kind ? 3 : 2;
    bool dirty = false;
    if (!menu && !confirm) {
        if (f1 || ((buttons & (P_LS | P_RS)) == (P_LS | P_RS) && (pressed & (P_LS | P_RS)))) {
            menu = true, travel = false, items = build_items(), sel = 0, dirty = true, g_restart_note = false;
        } else if (map_offered() && (pressed & P_L) && !(buttons & ~P_L)) {  // L alone: unused by the game in free roam
            menu = true, travel = true, items = build_travel_items(), sel = 0, dirty = true;
            log("overlay: fast travel menu (shops %#x)", travel_shops_offered());
        } else if ((title || camp) && (pressed & P_MINUS)) {
            confirm_kind = title ? 0 : 1;
            confirm = true, confirm_sel = confirm_kind ? 2 : 1, dirty = true;
        }
    } else if (confirm) {
        const int k = confirm_kind ? 3 : 2;
        if (pressed & (P_LEFT | P_UP)) confirm_sel = (confirm_sel + k - 1) % k, dirty = true;
        if (pressed & (P_RIGHT | P_DOWN)) confirm_sel = (confirm_sel + 1) % k, dirty = true;
        if (pressed & P_A) {
            if (confirm_kind == 0 && confirm_sel == 0) apply_exit(0);
            if (confirm_kind == 1 && confirm_sel == 0) request_title();
            if (confirm_kind == 1 && confirm_sel == 1) apply_exit(0);
            confirm = false, swallow = true;
        }
        if (pressed & P_B) confirm = false, swallow = true;
    } else {
        int n = (int)items.size();
        if (pressed & P_UP) sel = (sel + n - 1) % n, dirty = true;
        if (pressed & P_DOWN) sel = (sel + 1) % n, dirty = true;
        Item& it = items[sel];
        int k = (int)it.choices.size();
        if (k && (pressed & (P_LEFT | P_RIGHT | P_A))) {
            it.cur = (it.cur + ((pressed & P_LEFT) ? k - 1 : 1)) % k;
            it.apply(it.cur);
            dirty = true;
        } else if (!k && (pressed & P_A)) {
            it.apply(0);
            menu = false, swallow = true;  // actions close the menu (Open Tokyo Map runs once the game has the input back)
        }
        const bool sticks = (buttons & (P_LS | P_RS)) == (P_LS | P_RS) && (pressed & (P_LS | P_RS));
        if ((pressed & P_B) || f1 || sticks || (travel && (pressed & P_L))) menu = false, swallow = true;
        if (travel && menu && !map_offered()) menu = false;  // an event / battle took the field meanwhile
    }

    // layout in the game window's client area, scaled to its height (1080 = 1.0)
#ifdef _WIN32
    RECT cr;
    GetClientRect((HWND)hwnd, &cr);
    POINT org{0, 0};
    ClientToScreen((HWND)hwnd, &org);
    const float s = std::max(0.5f, (cr.bottom - cr.top) / 1080.0f);
    // the game's 16:9 area in the window: the picture (16:9 x aspect factor) fitted with bars by vk fit_blit, its 16:9
    // middle (ultrawide); the pill sits there, not in a black bar (user 21:9 test s104)
    const float pa = 16.0f / 9 * vk::wide_factor(), cw_ = (float)cr.right, ch_ = (float)cr.bottom;
    const float ph = std::fabs(cw_ / ch_ - pa) < pa * 0.01f ? ch_ : std::min(ch_, cw_ / pa);
    const int ui_left = (int)((cw_ - std::min(cw_, ph * 16 / 9)) / 2), ui_bottom = (int)((ch_ + ph) / 2);
    const bool visible = IsWindowVisible((HWND)hwnd) && !IsIconic((HWND)hwnd);
#else
    // layers in window pixels from the window's corner: frame_overlay maps them onto the frame
    int ww = 0, wh = 0;
    SDL_GetWindowSizeInPixels((SDL_Window*)hwnd, &ww, &wh);
    RECT cr{0, 0, ww, wh};
    POINT org{0, 0};
    const float s = std::max(0.5f, (cr.bottom - cr.top) / 1080.0f);
    const bool visible = ww > 0 && wh > 0 && !(SDL_GetWindowFlags((SDL_Window*)hwnd) & (SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN | SDL_WINDOW_MINIMIZED));
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_layer_lock);
        if (g_layer_win_w != ww || g_layer_win_h != wh) dirty = true;  // a new size: lay out again
        g_layer_win_w = ww, g_layer_win_h = wh;
    }
#endif

    static bool menu_drawn = false;
    if (menu && visible) {
        if (dirty || !menu_drawn) {
            // more items than fit the window: show a window of rows that follows the selection (arrows mark hidden rows)
            static int top = 0;
            int w = (int)(980 * s), row = (int)(54 * s), n = (int)items.size();
            int vis = std::min(n, std::max(3, (int)((cr.bottom - cr.top - 40 * s - 290 * s) / row)));
            top = std::clamp(top, std::max(0, sel - vis + 1), std::min(sel, n - vis));
            int h = (int)(170 * s) + row * vis + (int)(120 * s);
            int x = org.x + (cr.right - w) / 2, y = org.y + std::max(0, (int)(cr.bottom - h) / 2);
            layer_show(g_menu_layer, x, y, w, h, [&] {
                fill(0, 0, (float)w, (float)h, 18 * s, k_bg);
                fill(0, 0, 10 * s, (float)h, 4 * s, k_lime);
                text(travel ? L"FAST TRAVEL" : L"SETTINGS", 48 * s, 28 * s, 600 * s, 60 * s, 40 * s, k_white, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD);
                text(L"TMSRecomp", 48 * s, 82 * s, 600 * s, 34 * s, 20 * s, k_lime);
                float y0 = 140 * s;
                if (top > 0) text(L"▲", w - 80 * s, 100 * s, 40 * s, 36 * s, 22 * s, k_lime);
                if (top + vis < n) text(L"▼", w - 80 * s, y0 + row * (float)vis - 4 * s, 40 * s, 36 * s, 22 * s, k_lime);
                for (size_t i = top; i < (size_t)(top + vis); i++) {
                    float ry = y0 + row * (float)(i - top);
                    if ((int)i == sel) fill(32 * s, ry, w - 64 * s, row - 6 * s, 10 * s, D2D1::ColorF(0.62f, 0.95f, 0.16f, 0.22f));
                    else if (i % 2 == 0) fill(32 * s, ry, w - 64 * s, row - 6 * s, 10 * s, k_row);
                    text(items[i].name, 56 * s, ry, 520 * s, row - 6 * s, 24 * s, (int)i == sel ? k_white : k_grey);
                    if (!items[i].choices.empty()) {
                        std::wstring v = items[i].choices[items[i].cur];
                        if ((int)i == sel) v = L"◀  " + v + L"  ▶";
                        text(v.c_str(), w - 420 * s, ry, 360 * s, row - 6 * s, 24 * s, (int)i == sel ? k_lime : k_white,
                             DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD, DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_TRAILING);
                    }
                }
                float hy = y0 + row * (float)vis + 10 * s;
                std::wstring help = items[sel].help;
                if (g_restart_note) help += L"  (Saved: restart the game to apply.)";
                text(help.c_str(), 56 * s, hy, w - 112 * s, 64 * s, 19 * s, k_grey, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL);
                text(travel ? L"↑↓ select    A go    B / L close    (open: L in town)"
                            : L"↑↓ select    ←→ / A change    B / F1 / L3+R3 close    (open: F1, or press both sticks in)", 56 * s, (float)h - 48 * s, w - 112 * s, 36 * s, 18 * s,
                     k_grey, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL);
            });
        }
        menu_drawn = true;
    } else {
        layer_hide(g_menu_layer);
        menu_drawn = false;
    }

    if (confirm && visible) {
        const int cw = (int)((n_opt == 3 ? 820 : 620) * s);
        if (dirty || !g_hint_layer.shown || g_hint_layer.w != cw) {
            int w = cw, h = (int)((n_opt == 3 ? 270 : 230) * s);
            layer_show(g_hint_layer, org.x + (cr.right - w) / 2, org.y + (cr.bottom - h) / 2, w, h, [&] {
                fill(0, 0, (float)w, (float)h, 18 * s, k_bg);
                fill(0, 0, (float)w, 8 * s, 4 * s, k_lime);
                text(n_opt == 3 ? L"Leave the game?" : L"Exit the game?", 0, 34 * s, (float)w, 60 * s, 34 * s, k_white,
                     DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
                if (n_opt == 3)
                    text(L"Progress since your last save will be lost.", 0, 86 * s, (float)w, 36 * s, 20 * s, k_grey,
                         DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL, DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
                const wchar_t* opt2[2] = {L"Yes", L"No"};
                const wchar_t* opt3[3] = {L"Return to Title", L"Quit Game", L"Cancel"};
                const float bw = (n_opt == 3 ? 240 : 180) * s, gap = 20 * s, by = (n_opt == 3 ? 160 : 130) * s;
                for (int i = 0; i < n_opt; i++) {
                    float bx = (w - n_opt * bw - (n_opt - 1) * gap) / 2 + i * (bw + gap);
                    fill(bx, by, bw, 60 * s, 12 * s, i == confirm_sel ? k_lime : D2D1::ColorF(1, 1, 1, 0.1f));
                    text(n_opt == 3 ? opt3[i] : opt2[i], bx, by, bw, 60 * s, 24 * s,
                         i == confirm_sel ? D2D1::ColorF(0, 0, 0, 1) : k_white, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
                }
            });
        }
    } else if ((title || camp) && !menu && visible) {
        static bool pill_camp = false;
        int w = (int)((camp ? 330 : 300) * s), h = (int)(56 * s);
        static int pill_x = 0, pill_y = 0;
        const int px = org.x + ui_left + (int)(40 * s), py = org.y + ui_bottom - (int)((camp ? 120 : 150) * s);
        const bool redraw = !g_hint_layer.shown || g_hint_layer.w != w || pill_camp != camp || px != pill_x || py != pill_y;
        pill_camp = camp, pill_x = px, pill_y = py;
        if (redraw)
            layer_show(g_hint_layer, px, py, w, h, [&] {
                fill(0, 0, (float)w, (float)h, h / 2.0f, D2D1::ColorF(0, 0, 0, 0.55f));
                fill(10 * s, 10 * s, 36 * s, 36 * s, 18 * s, k_white);
                text(L"−", 10 * s, 8 * s, 36 * s, 36 * s, 30 * s, D2D1::ColorF(0, 0, 0, 1), DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
                text(camp ? L"Title / Quit Game" : L"Exit Game", 60 * s, 0, w - 70 * s, (float)h, 24 * s, k_white, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD);
            });
    } else {
        layer_hide(g_hint_layer);
    }

    // the game sees no buttons while a menu is open, nor the button that closed it until everything is released
    if (swallow && !buttons) swallow = false;
    return menu || confirm || swallow;
}

#ifdef _WIN32
std::shared_ptr<const SubsBitmap> frame_overlay(uint32_t fw, uint32_t fh) { return subs_frame(fw, fh); }
#else
// The present path's overlay for a fw x fh frame: the subtitles plus the menu layers (laid out in window pixels, scaled
// to the frame when it has another size), as one bitmap. Rebuilt only when one of them changed.
std::shared_ptr<const SubsBitmap> frame_overlay(uint32_t fw, uint32_t fh) {
    auto subs = subs_frame(fw, fh);
    int ww, wh;
    struct Placed { std::shared_ptr<const SubsBitmap> b; int x, y; };
    std::vector<Placed> parts;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_layer_lock);
        for (Layer* l : {&g_menu_layer, &g_hint_layer})
            if (l->shown && l->bmp) parts.push_back({l->bmp, l->x, l->y});
        ww = g_layer_win_w, wh = g_layer_win_h;
    }
    if (parts.empty()) return subs;
    static std::mutex m;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(m);  // two present paths (staging slots, screenshots) may ask at once
    static std::shared_ptr<const SubsBitmap> cached, cached_subs;
    static std::vector<const SubsBitmap*> cached_parts;
    static uint32_t cached_w = 0, cached_h = 0;
    std::vector<const SubsBitmap*> keys;
    for (auto& p : parts) keys.push_back(p.b.get());
    if (cached && cached_subs == subs && cached_parts == keys && cached_w == fw && cached_h == fh) return cached;
    const float sx = ww > 0 ? (float)fw / ww : 1.f, sy = wh > 0 ? (float)fh / wh : 1.f;
    struct R { int x0, y0, x1, y1; };
    std::vector<R> rs;
    R u{INT_MAX, INT_MAX, INT_MIN, INT_MIN};
    auto add = [&](R r) {
        r.x0 = std::clamp(r.x0, 0, (int)fw), r.x1 = std::clamp(r.x1, 0, (int)fw);
        r.y0 = std::clamp(r.y0, 0, (int)fh), r.y1 = std::clamp(r.y1, 0, (int)fh);
        rs.push_back(r);
        if (r.x1 > r.x0 && r.y1 > r.y0) u = {std::min(u.x0, r.x0), std::min(u.y0, r.y0), std::max(u.x1, r.x1), std::max(u.y1, r.y1)};
    };
    if (subs) add({(int)subs->x, (int)subs->y, (int)(subs->x + subs->w), (int)(subs->y + subs->h)});
    for (auto& p : parts) add({(int)(p.x * sx), (int)(p.y * sy), (int)((p.x + p.b->w) * sx), (int)((p.y + p.b->h) * sy)});
    if (u.x1 <= u.x0 || u.y1 <= u.y0) return subs;
    auto out = std::make_shared<SubsBitmap>();
    out->x = (uint32_t)u.x0, out->y = (uint32_t)u.y0, out->w = (uint32_t)(u.x1 - u.x0), out->h = (uint32_t)(u.y1 - u.y0);
    out->rgba.assign((size_t)out->w * out->h, 0);
    // the unscaled rectangle of each part (the source size): scale back into it with nearest samples
    std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> src_size;
    if (subs) src_size.push_back({subs->w, subs->h});
    for (auto& p : parts) src_size.push_back({p.b->w, p.b->h});
    auto blend = [&](const SubsBitmap& b, const R& r, const R& full) {  // premultiplied "over"
        const int fwid = full.x1 - full.x0, fhgt = full.y1 - full.y0;
        if (fwid <= 0 || fhgt <= 0) return;
        for (int y = r.y0; y < r.y1; y++) {
            const uint32_t sy_ = std::min<uint32_t>(b.h - 1, (uint32_t)((uint64_t)(y - full.y0) * b.h / fhgt));
            uint32_t* d = out->rgba.data() + (size_t)(y - u.y0) * out->w;
            for (int x = r.x0; x < r.x1; x++) {
                const uint32_t sx_ = std::min<uint32_t>(b.w - 1, (uint32_t)((uint64_t)(x - full.x0) * b.w / fwid));
                const uint32_t s = b.rgba[(size_t)sy_ * b.w + sx_], a = s >> 24;
                uint32_t& o = d[x - u.x0];
                if (!a) continue;
                if (a == 255) { o = s; continue; }
                uint32_t v = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 32; k += 8)
                    v |= std::min<uint32_t>(255, ((s >> k) & 255) + (((o >> k) & 255) * (255 - a) + 127) / 255) << k;
                o = v;
            }
        }
    };
    size_t i = 0;
    if (subs) {
        const R full{(int)subs->x, (int)subs->y, (int)(subs->x + subs->w), (int)(subs->y + subs->h)};
        blend(*subs, rs[i++], full);
    }
    for (auto& p : parts) {
        const R full{(int)(p.x * sx), (int)(p.y * sy), (int)((p.x + p.b->w) * sx), (int)((p.y + p.b->h) * sy)};
        blend(*p.b, rs[i++], full);
    }
    cached = out, cached_subs = subs, cached_parts = keys, cached_w = fw, cached_h = fh;
    return out;
}
#endif

}  // namespace rt
```

`runtime/src/pad_icons.cpp`:

```cpp
// Button icons by controller. Switch button faces are baked into a few UI atlases (RGBA8, straight alpha): the
// common button atlas (Interface/_US/common/icon/button_icon.gtx, black-ringed discs) and the prompt sprites of the
// HUD/menu atlases (plain white discs with grey letters: "(+) Stats", "(B) Close"...). With a PlayStation or Xbox pad
// in use (setting pad_icons: auto, switch, playstation, xbox) the face buttons, shoulder buttons and +/- are drawn
// again here with Direct2D over a copy of the atlas before it is uploaded (vk_texture.cpp). No art files: shapes and
// text only. Atlases are found by the hash of their level 0 (vk_texture.cpp tex_hash); cells were measured on the
// dumps (tools/padicons: find_discs.py, sheet.py, crop.py).
// Faces follow ui.cpp's positional mapping: Switch A = east (PS circle, Xbox B), B = south (cross, A), X = north
// (triangle, Y), Y = west (square, X).
#include "plat.h"
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <d2d1.h>
#include <dwrite.h>
#include <wincodec.h>
#else
#include "draw_linux.h"
#include <cmath>
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rt.h"

namespace rt {

std::atomic<int> g_pad_kind{0};         // ui.cpp: the open pad (0 Switch / other, 1 PlayStation, 2 Xbox)
static std::atomic<int> g_pad_icons{-1};  // setting: -1 not read, 0 auto, 1 switch, 2 playstation, 3 xbox
static const char* const k_icon_names[] = {"auto", "switch", "playstation", "xbox"};

int pad_icons_setting() {
    if (g_pad_icons < 0) {
        const char* v = getenv("NX_PAD_ICONS");
        int s = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (v && !_stricmp(v, k_icon_names[i])) s = i;
        g_pad_icons = s;
    }
    return g_pad_icons;
}
void set_pad_icons(int s) {
    save_setting("pad_icons", k_icon_names[s]);
    g_pad_icons = s;
}
bool button_layout_xbox() {
    static const bool on = [] { const char* v = getenv("NX_BUTTON_LAYOUT"); return v && !_stricmp(v, "xbox"); }();
    return on;
}
int pad_icon_style() {
    int s = pad_icons_setting();
    return s == 0 ? g_pad_kind.load() : s - 1;
}

namespace {
enum Kind { FACE_A, FACE_B, FACE_X, FACE_Y, PLUS, MINUS, SH_L, SH_R, SH_ZL, SH_ZR };
struct Cell { int x, y, w, h; Kind k; int look = 0; uint32_t fill = 0; };  // look: 0 the atlas's, 1 plain, 2 ringed, 3 bubble, 4 cut-out (white disc, glyph transparent); fill: disc colour (0 white; glyphs then black)

// div 2: the same layout at half size. The English (uncensor) mod's _US Interface atlases are 2x the game's own:
// without the mod (or for other languages) the game loads the half-size originals, with other hashes.

#define ATLAS_HALF(h, w, ht, plain, c) {h, w, ht, plain, c, sizeof(c) / sizeof(c[0]), 2}

#ifdef _WIN32
template <class T> void release(T*& p) { if (p) p->Release(), p = nullptr; }

struct Painter {
    ID2D1Factory* f = nullptr;
    IDWriteFactory* dw = nullptr;
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* rt = nullptr;
    ID2D1StrokeStyle* round = nullptr;
    bool plain = false;  // prompt look: white disc without the black ring, grey glyphs
    bool bubble = false;  // look 3: grey disc, white glyph (the game tints both)
    bool cut = false;  // look 4: white disc, black glyph that the copy back turns into transparency
    uint32_t fill = 0xFFFFFF;  // disc colour; not white: every glyph in black
    uint32_t tint(uint32_t rgb) const { return cut ? 0x000000 : bubble ? 0xFFFFFF : fill == 0xFFFFFF ? rgb : 0x000000; }
    uint32_t ink() const { return cut ? 0x000000 : bubble ? 0xFFFFFF : plain ? 0x5A5A5A : 0x000000; }
    ~Painter() { release(round), release(rt), release(dw), release(f); }

    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* brush(uint32_t rgb) {
        ID2D1SolidColorBrush* b = nullptr;
        rt->CreateSolidColorBrush(D2D1::ColorF(rgb), &b);
        return b;
    }
    void text(const wchar_t* s, D2D1_RECT_F r, float size, uint32_t rgb) {
        IDWriteTextFormat* tf = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(dw->CreateTextFormat(L"Arial", nullptr, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
                                        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, size, L"en-us", &tf)))
            return;
        tf->SetTextAlignment(DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
        tf->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
        ID2D1SolidColorBrush* b = brush(rgb);
        rt->DrawText(s, (UINT32)wcslen(s), tf, r, b);
        release(b), release(tf);
    }
    void line(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float w, uint32_t rgb) {
        ID2D1SolidColorBrush* b = brush(rgb);
        rt->DrawLine({x0, y0}, {x1, y1}, b, w, round);
        release(b);
    }
    // white disc with the game's black ring (2 px at 26 px)
    void disc(float cx, float cy, float r) {
        ID2D1SolidColorBrush *w = brush(fill), *k = brush(0x000000);
        float sw = r * 0.16f;
        D2D1_ELLIPSE e{{cx, cy}, r - sw / 2, r - sw / 2};
        if (plain) e = {{cx, cy}, r, r};
        rt->FillEllipse(e, w);
        if (!plain) rt->DrawEllipse(e, k, sw);
        release(w), release(k);
    }
    // the physical button a game button sits on, as a positional kind (FACE_A = east ... FACE_Y = west):
    // button_layout and the pad_<button> remaps (ui.cpp)
    static int pos(int k) { return k <= FACE_Y ? pad_face_pos(k) : k; }
    void face(const Cell& c, int style) {
        float cx = c.x + c.w / 2.0f, cy = c.y + c.h / 2.0f, r = c.w / 2.0f;
        disc(cx, cy, r);
        if (style == 2) {  // Xbox letters in their colours
            static const wchar_t* const letter[] = {L"B", L"A", L"Y", L"X"};
            static const uint32_t col[] = {0xD8262B, 0x3E9B2F, 0xE0A800, 0x2B6CD6};
            const int k = pos(c.k);
            text(letter[k], D2D1::RectF(c.x, c.y + r * 0.04f, c.x + c.w, c.y + c.h), r * 1.25f, tint(col[k]));
            return;
        }
        float sw = r * 0.2f, g = r * 0.42f;  // PlayStation symbols, stroked
        ID2D1SolidColorBrush* b = nullptr;
        switch (pos(c.k)) {
            case FACE_A:  // circle
                b = brush(tint(0xE0464B));
                rt->DrawEllipse({{cx, cy}, g, g}, b, sw);
                break;
            case FACE_B:  // cross
                line(cx - g, cy - g, cx + g, cy + g, sw, tint(0x4A7FD8));
                line(cx - g, cy + g, cx + g, cy - g, sw, tint(0x4A7FD8));
                break;
            case FACE_X: {  // triangle
                b = brush(tint(0x2FA67E));
                ID2D1PathGeometry* p = nullptr;
                ID2D1GeometrySink* s = nullptr;
                f->CreatePathGeometry(&p);
                p->Open(&s);
                float t = g * 1.15f, oy = cy + g * 0.15f;
                s->BeginFigure({cx, oy - t}, D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_HOLLOW);
                s->AddLine({cx + t * 0.866f, oy + t * 0.5f});
                s->AddLine({cx - t * 0.866f, oy + t * 0.5f});
                s->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_CLOSED);
                s->Close();
                rt->DrawGeometry(p, b, sw, round);
                release(s), release(p);
                break;
            }
            default:  // square
                b = brush(tint(0xD266AE));
                rt->DrawRectangle(D2D1::RectF(cx - g * 0.85f, cy - g * 0.85f, cx + g * 0.85f, cy + g * 0.85f), b, sw);
                break;
        }
        release(b);
    }
    void plus_minus(const Cell& c, int style) {
        float cx = c.x + c.w / 2.0f, cy = c.y + c.h / 2.0f, r = c.w / 2.0f, sw = r * 0.16f;
        disc(cx, cy, r);
        if (c.k == PLUS) {  // Options / Menu: three lines
            for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++) line(cx - r * 0.38f, cy + i * r * 0.3f, cx + r * 0.38f, cy + i * r * 0.3f, sw, ink());
        } else if (style == 2) {  // View: two overlapping squares
            ID2D1SolidColorBrush *k = brush(ink()), *w = brush(0xFFFFFF);
            float s = r * 0.42f, o = r * 0.16f;
            D2D1_RECT_F back = D2D1::RectF(cx - s + o, cy - s - o + o * 0.2f, cx + s * 0.6f + o, cy + s * 0.6f - o);
            D2D1_RECT_F front = D2D1::RectF(cx - s * 0.6f - o, cy - s * 0.6f + o, cx + s - o, cy + s + o - o * 0.2f);
            rt->DrawRectangle(back, k, sw * 0.8f);
            rt->FillRectangle(front, w);
            rt->DrawRectangle(front, k, sw * 0.8f);
            release(k), release(w);
        } else {  // Share / Create: arrow up out of a tray
            line(cx, cy + r * 0.1f, cx, cy - r * 0.45f, sw, ink());
            line(cx - r * 0.22f, cy - r * 0.23f, cx, cy - r * 0.45f, sw, ink());
            line(cx + r * 0.22f, cy - r * 0.23f, cx, cy - r * 0.45f, sw, ink());
            line(cx - r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.05f, cx - r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.4f, sw, ink());
            line(cx - r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.4f, cx + r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.4f, sw, ink());
            line(cx + r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.4f, cx + r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.05f, sw, ink());
        }
    }
    void shoulder(const Cell& c, int style) {
        static const wchar_t* const ps[] = {L"L1", L"R1", L"L2", L"R2"};
        static const wchar_t* const xb[] = {L"LB", L"RB", L"LT", L"RT"};
        float sw = c.h * 0.085f;
        D2D1_ROUNDED_RECT rr{D2D1::RectF(c.x + sw / 2, c.y + sw / 2, c.x + c.w - sw / 2, c.y + c.h - sw / 2), c.h * 0.28f, c.h * 0.28f};
        if (plain) rr.rect = D2D1::RectF(c.x, c.y, c.x + c.w, c.y + c.h);
        ID2D1SolidColorBrush *w = brush(0xFFFFFF), *k = brush(0);
        rt->FillRoundedRectangle(rr, w);
        if (!plain) rt->DrawRoundedRectangle(rr, k, sw);
        release(w), release(k);
        int i = c.k - SH_L;
        text(style == 2 ? xb[i] : ps[i], D2D1::RectF(c.x, c.y + c.h * 0.03f, c.x + c.w, c.y + c.h), c.h * 0.58f, ink());
    }
};
#else
// Linux: the same shapes with cairo / pango (draw_linux.h)
struct RectF { float left, top, right, bottom; };
struct Painter {
    cairo_t* cr = nullptr;
    bool plain = false, bubble = false, cut = false;
    uint32_t fill = 0xFFFFFF;
    uint32_t tint(uint32_t rgb) const { return cut ? 0x000000 : bubble ? 0xFFFFFF : fill == 0xFFFFFF ? rgb : 0x000000; }
    uint32_t ink() const { return cut ? 0x000000 : bubble ? 0xFFFFFF : plain ? 0x5A5A5A : 0x000000; }

    void text(const wchar_t* s, RectF r, float size, uint32_t rgb) {
        draw::text(cr, draw::utf8(s), r.left, r.top, r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top, size, draw::rgb(rgb), 700,
                   draw::CENTER, draw::k_icon_font);
    }
    void stroke(float w, uint32_t rgb) {
        draw::set(cr, draw::rgb(rgb));
        cairo_set_line_width(cr, w);
        cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND);
        cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND);
        cairo_stroke(cr);
    }
    void line(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float w, uint32_t rgb) {
        cairo_move_to(cr, x0, y0);
        cairo_line_to(cr, x1, y1);
        stroke(w, rgb);
    }
    void disc(float cx, float cy, float r) {
        float sw = r * 0.16f, er = plain ? r : r - sw / 2;
        draw::ellipse(cr, cx, cy, er, er);
        draw::set(cr, draw::rgb(fill));
        if (plain) { cairo_fill(cr); return; }
        cairo_fill_preserve(cr);
        cairo_set_line_width(cr, sw);
        draw::set(cr, draw::rgb(0));
        cairo_stroke(cr);
    }
    void rect(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1) { cairo_rectangle(cr, x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0); }
    void face(const Cell& c, int style) {
        float cx = c.x + c.w / 2.0f, cy = c.y + c.h / 2.0f, r = c.w / 2.0f;
        disc(cx, cy, r);
        if (style == 2) {  // Xbox letters in their colours
            static const wchar_t* const letter[] = {L"B", L"A", L"Y", L"X"};
            static const uint32_t col[] = {0xD8262B, 0x3E9B2F, 0xE0A800, 0x2B6CD6};
            const int k = c.k <= FACE_Y ? pad_face_pos(c.k) : c.k;
            text(letter[k], RectF{(float)c.x, c.y + r * 0.04f, (float)(c.x + c.w), (float)(c.y + c.h)}, r * 1.25f, tint(col[k]));
            return;
        }
        float sw = r * 0.2f, g = r * 0.42f;  // PlayStation symbols, stroked
        switch (c.k <= FACE_Y ? pad_face_pos(c.k) : c.k) {
            case FACE_A:  // circle
                draw::ellipse(cr, cx, cy, g, g);
                stroke(sw, tint(0xE0464B));
                break;
            case FACE_B:  // cross
                line(cx - g, cy - g, cx + g, cy + g, sw, tint(0x4A7FD8));
                line(cx - g, cy + g, cx + g, cy - g, sw, tint(0x4A7FD8));
                break;
            case FACE_X: {  // triangle
                float t = g * 1.15f, oy = cy + g * 0.15f;
                cairo_move_to(cr, cx, oy - t);
                cairo_line_to(cr, cx + t * 0.866f, oy + t * 0.5f);
                cairo_line_to(cr, cx - t * 0.866f, oy + t * 0.5f);
                cairo_close_path(cr);
                stroke(sw, tint(0x2FA67E));
                break;
            }
            default:  // square
                rect(cx - g * 0.85f, cy - g * 0.85f, cx + g * 0.85f, cy + g * 0.85f);
                cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_BUTT);
                draw::set(cr, draw::rgb(tint(0xD266AE)));
                cairo_set_line_width(cr, sw);
                cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_MITER);
                cairo_stroke(cr);
                break;
        }
    }
    void plus_minus(const Cell& c, int style) {
        float cx = c.x + c.w / 2.0f, cy = c.y + c.h / 2.0f, r = c.w / 2.0f, sw = r * 0.16f;
        disc(cx, cy, r);
        if (c.k == PLUS) {  // Options / Menu: three lines
            for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++) line(cx - r * 0.38f, cy + i * r * 0.3f, cx + r * 0.38f, cy + i * r * 0.3f, sw, ink());
        } else if (style == 2) {  // View: two overlapping squares
            float s = r * 0.42f, o = r * 0.16f;
            auto box = [&](float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, bool filled) {
                if (filled) { rect(x0, y0, x1, y1); draw::set(cr, draw::rgb(0xFFFFFF)); cairo_fill(cr); }
                rect(x0, y0, x1, y1);
                draw::set(cr, draw::rgb(ink()));
                cairo_set_line_width(cr, sw * 0.8f);
                cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_MITER);
                cairo_stroke(cr);
            };
            box(cx - s + o, cy - s - o + o * 0.2f, cx + s * 0.6f + o, cy + s * 0.6f - o, false);
            box(cx - s * 0.6f - o, cy - s * 0.6f + o, cx + s - o, cy + s + o - o * 0.2f, true);
        } else {  // Share / Create: arrow up out of a tray
            line(cx, cy + r * 0.1f, cx, cy - r * 0.45f, sw, ink());
            line(cx - r * 0.22f, cy - r * 0.23f, cx, cy - r * 0.45f, sw, ink());
            line(cx + r * 0.22f, cy - r * 0.23f, cx, cy - r * 0.45f, sw, ink());
            line(cx - r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.05f, cx - r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.4f, sw, ink());
            line(cx - r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.4f, cx + r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.4f, sw, ink());
            line(cx + r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.4f, cx + r * 0.4f, cy + r * 0.05f, sw, ink());
        }
    }
    void shoulder(const Cell& c, int style) {
        static const wchar_t* const ps[] = {L"L1", L"R1", L"L2", L"R2"};
        static const wchar_t* const xb[] = {L"LB", L"RB", L"LT", L"RT"};
        float sw = c.h * 0.085f;
        RectF rr{c.x + sw / 2, c.y + sw / 2, c.x + c.w - sw / 2, c.y + c.h - sw / 2};
        if (plain) rr = RectF{(float)c.x, (float)c.y, (float)(c.x + c.w), (float)(c.y + c.h)};
        draw::round_rect(cr, rr.left, rr.top, rr.right - rr.left, rr.bottom - rr.top, c.h * 0.28f);
        draw::set(cr, draw::rgb(0xFFFFFF));
        if (plain) cairo_fill(cr);
        else {
            cairo_fill_preserve(cr);
            draw::set(cr, draw::rgb(0));
            cairo_set_line_width(cr, sw);
            cairo_stroke(cr);
        }
        int i = c.k - SH_L;
        text(style == 2 ? xb[i] : ps[i], RectF{(float)c.x, c.y + c.h * 0.03f, (float)(c.x + c.w), (float)(c.y + c.h)}, c.h * 0.58f, ink());
    }
};
#endif
}  // namespace

bool is_pad_icon_atlas(uint64_t hash) {
    for (const Atlas& a : k_atlases) if (a.hash == hash) return true;
    return false;
}
bool pad_icon_atlas_size(uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    for (const Atlas& a : k_atlases) if ((uint32_t)a.w == w && (uint32_t)a.h == h) return true;
    return false;
}

// Draws the cells' buttons over rgba (RGBA8, straight alpha, n x nh) in place. style 1 PlayStation, 2 Xbox.
#ifdef _WIN32
static bool paint_cells(int style, const std::vector<Cell>& cells, bool atlas_plain, int n, int nh, uint8_t* rgba) {
    Painter p;
    p.plain = atlas_plain;
    if (FAILED(D2D1CreateFactory(D2D1_FACTORY_TYPE_SINGLE_THREADED, &p.f)) ||
        FAILED(DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, __uuidof(IDWriteFactory), (IUnknown**)&p.dw)))
        return false;
    D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES rp = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
        D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE, D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED));
    if (FAILED(p.f->CreateDCRenderTarget(&rp, &p.rt))) return false;
    D2D1_STROKE_STYLE_PROPERTIES sp = D2D1::StrokeStyleProperties(D2D1_CAP_STYLE_ROUND, D2D1_CAP_STYLE_ROUND, D2D1_CAP_STYLE_ROUND,
                                                                  D2D1_LINE_JOIN_ROUND);
    p.f->CreateStrokeStyle(sp, nullptr, 0, &p.round);
    HDC dc = CreateCompatibleDC(nullptr);
    BITMAPINFO bi{};
    bi.bmiHeader = {sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER), n, -nh, 1, 32, BI_RGB};
    void* bits = nullptr;
    HBITMAP bmp = CreateDIBSection(dc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (!bmp) { DeleteDC(dc); return false; }
    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(dc, bmp);
    RECT r{0, 0, n, nh};
    p.rt->BindDC(dc, &r);
    p.rt->BeginDraw();
    p.rt->Clear(D2D1::ColorF(0, 0, 0, 0));
    for (const Cell& c : cells) {
        p.bubble = c.look == 3, p.cut = c.look == 4;
        p.plain = c.look ? c.look == 1 || c.look >= 3 : atlas_plain;
        p.fill = c.fill ? c.fill : 0xFFFFFF;
        if (c.k <= FACE_Y) p.face(c, style);
        else if (c.k <= MINUS) p.plus_minus(c, style);
        else p.shoulder(c, style);
    }
    bool ok = SUCCEEDED(p.rt->EndDraw());
    if (ok) {
        const uint8_t* src = (const uint8_t*)bits;  // BGRA premultiplied, top-down
        for (const Cell& c : cells)
            for (int y = std::max(0, c.y - 1); y < std::min(nh, c.y + c.h + 1); y++)
                for (int x = std::max(0, c.x - 1); x < std::min(n, c.x + c.w + 1); x++) {
                    const uint8_t* s = src + (y * n + x) * 4;
                    uint8_t* d = rgba + (y * n + x) * 4;
                    if (c.look == 4) {  // replace: white where the disc is, alpha falls with the glyph's darkness
                        d[0] = d[1] = d[2] = 255;
                        d[3] = (uint8_t)std::min(255, (s[0] + s[1] + s[2]) / 3);  // premultiplied grey = alpha x white
                        continue;
                    }
                    // over the original: our disc covers its glyph, panels and shadows around it stay
                    float sa = s[3] / 255.0f, da = d[3] / 255.0f, oa = sa + da * (1 - sa);
                    if (oa <= 0) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                        d[k] = (uint8_t)std::min(255.0f, (s[2 - k] + d[k] * da * (1 - sa)) / oa + 0.5f);
                    d[3] = (uint8_t)(oa * 255 + 0.5f);
                }
    }
    SelectObject(dc, old);
    DeleteObject(bmp);
    DeleteDC(dc);
    return ok;
}
#else
static bool paint_cells(int style, const std::vector<Cell>& cells, bool atlas_plain, int n, int nh, uint8_t* rgba) {
    draw::Canvas cv(n, nh);
    if (!cv.ok()) return false;
    cv.clear();
    Painter p;
    p.cr = cv.cr;
    p.plain = atlas_plain;
    for (const Cell& c : cells) {
        p.bubble = c.look == 3, p.cut = c.look == 4;
        p.plain = c.look ? c.look == 1 || c.look >= 3 : atlas_plain;
        p.fill = c.fill ? c.fill : 0xFFFFFF;
        if (c.k <= FACE_Y) p.face(c, style);
        else if (c.k <= MINUS) p.plus_minus(c, style);
        else p.shoulder(c, style);
    }
    const uint8_t* base = cv.data();  // BGRA premultiplied, top-down
    const int stride = cv.stride();
    for (const Cell& c : cells)
        for (int y = std::max(0, c.y - 1); y < std::min(nh, c.y + c.h + 1); y++)
            for (int x = std::max(0, c.x - 1); x < std::min(n, c.x + c.w + 1); x++) {
                const uint8_t* s = base + (size_t)y * stride + x * 4;
                uint8_t* d = rgba + (y * n + x) * 4;
                if (c.look == 4) {
                    d[0] = d[1] = d[2] = 255;
                    d[3] = (uint8_t)std::min(255, (s[0] + s[1] + s[2]) / 3);
                    continue;
                }
                float sa = s[3] / 255.0f, da = d[3] / 255.0f, oa = sa + da * (1 - sa);
                if (oa <= 0) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                    d[k] = (uint8_t)std::min(255.0f, (s[2 - k] + d[k] * da * (1 - sa)) / oa + 0.5f);
                d[3] = (uint8_t)(oa * 255 + 0.5f);
            }
    return true;
}
#endif

// rgba: an atlas of k_atlases (RGBA8, straight alpha, w x h), changed in place. style 1 PlayStation, 2 Xbox.
bool pad_icon_atlas(int style, uint64_t hash, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint8_t* rgba) {
    const Atlas* at = nullptr;
    for (const Atlas& a : k_atlases) if (a.hash == hash && (uint32_t)a.w == w && (uint32_t)a.h == h) at = &a;
    if (!at) return false;
    // Only the cells' bounding box is painted (a full 4096 x 4096 software target + its copies cost ~86 ms per load of
    // the battle atlas), and the result is cached per atlas + style: the same hash = the same original pixels.
    std::vector<Cell> cells(at->cells, at->cells + at->n);
    int x0 = at->w, y0 = at->h, x1 = 0, y1 = 0;
    for (Cell& c : cells) {
        c.x /= at->div, c.y /= at->div, c.w /= at->div, c.h /= at->div;
        x0 = std::min(x0, c.x - 1), y0 = std::min(y0, c.y - 1), x1 = std::max(x1, c.x + c.w + 1), y1 = std::max(y1, c.y + c.h + 1);
    }
    x0 = std::max(0, x0), y0 = std::max(0, y0), x1 = std::min(at->w, x1), y1 = std::min(at->h, y1);
    if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) return false;
    const int bw = x1 - x0, bh = y1 - y0;
    const size_t row = (size_t)bw * 4, stride = (size_t)at->w * 4;
    auto put = [&](const uint8_t* sub) {
        for (int y = 0; y < bh; y++) memcpy(rgba + (y0 + y) * stride + x0 * 4, sub + y * row, row);
    };
    static std::mutex m;
    static std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint8_t>> cache;
    const uint64_t key = hash ^ (uint64_t)style << 62;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(m);
    if (auto it = cache.find(key); it != cache.end()) return put(it->second.data()), true;
    std::vector<uint8_t> sub(row * bh);
    for (int y = 0; y < bh; y++) memcpy(sub.data() + y * row, rgba + (y0 + y) * stride + x0 * 4, row);
    for (Cell& c : cells) c.x -= x0, c.y -= y0;
    if (!paint_cells(style, cells, at->plain, bw, bh, sub.data())) return false;
    put(sub.data());
    cache[key] = std::move(sub);
    return true;
}

// Field interaction prompts ("(A) Talk", "(A) Exit", "(A) Check"... in 5 languages): whole pills pre-rendered in the
// effects Effect/map_0086..0095.ptcl, 512 x 128 BC3 (vk_texture.cpp decodes them). The green (A) disc sits at a
// different x per text, so it is found here: the leftmost round blob of opaque green (the pill's green border is wide).
static const uint64_t k_prompt_hashes[] = {
    0x0a1121d1123819dcull, 0x0d958b8b7e1852f5ull, 0x1388f62b0404aca6ull, 0x17cad5c99d823874ull, 0x1b23f7e7e2810cadull,
    0x1e4fb959bbc86e2dull, 0x1ef1081941e223d9ull, 0x232a2715e2737e93ull, 0x2d829d75a162f5c5ull, 0x2e019500c97f345eull,
    0x31b87b13d644650bull, 0x378d6a5e12791370ull, 0x3904e9419c035457ull, 0x3953990c54b24bf4ull, 0x3a3043403fefd112ull,
    0x443f62a2c9967a86ull, 0x49fe07ea64ab2751ull, 0x4da182f9c7e5a03full, 0x5048c18c8da31e5dull, 0x550a3aa178794266ull,
    0x55f721afdb19ec0full, 0x5761dab8dcd4fcf4ull, 0x665a0ce7165c86baull, 0x73571ed2b4f20705ull, 0x7bdcee88ce3ea21eull,
    0x820852f5d9647dc4ull, 0x829bf5dfba334167ull, 0x8aafac20d2f018d0ull, 0x8c5330694cae3b43ull, 0xa18fbfb6fe45a949ull,
    0xa5e3338d7887f62dull, 0xacda13f1dcbaa9c1ull, 0xae9ea682858c618aull, 0xaf22f738c6983ef7ull, 0xb5a3880cc5a5e69dull,
    0xbb200a4fd25dfe12ull, 0xbd585b68a49976c2ull, 0xbe2b9f8f51f27490ull, 0xbf9431f4c3de73e1ull, 0xc2e29b32cb58bac8ull,
    0xc8042cb35a6097b2ull, 0xccbf9b1d6119733eull, 0xcff32a454dd4b2d6ull, 0xdb722b95180a5ae9ull, 0xe0467adce73f48bbull,
    0xe2b912af1668225eull, 0xe66a7b3cb27bdb92ull, 0xe885537fa3e477a5ull, 0xee1ae98ed77c8a58ull, 0xf6ebe594efecb62eull,
};
bool is_pad_prompt(uint64_t hash) {
    for (uint64_t h : k_prompt_hashes) if (h == hash) return true;
    return false;
}
bool pad_icon_prompt(int style, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint8_t* rgba) {
    auto green = [&](uint32_t i) {
        const uint8_t* q = rgba + i * 4;
        return q[3] > 200 && q[1] > 140 && q[1] > q[0] + 40 && q[1] > q[2] + 80;
    };
    std::vector<uint8_t> seen(w * h);
    std::vector<uint32_t> stack;
    int best_x = 1 << 30;
    Cell best{};
    for (uint32_t i0 = 0; i0 < w * h; i0++) {
        if (seen[i0] || !green(i0)) continue;
        uint32_t x0 = w, y0 = h, x1 = 0, y1 = 0, n = 0;
        uint64_t sum[3] = {};
        stack.assign(1, i0), seen[i0] = 1;
        while (!stack.empty()) {
            const uint32_t i = stack.back(), x = i % w, y = i / w;
            stack.pop_back(), n++;
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) sum[k] += rgba[i * 4 + k];
            x0 = std::min(x0, x), x1 = std::max(x1, x), y0 = std::min(y0, y), y1 = std::max(y1, y);
            const uint32_t nb[4] = {x > 0 ? i - 1 : i, x + 1 < w ? i + 1 : i, y > 0 ? i - w : i, y + 1 < h ? i + w : i};
            for (uint32_t j : nb) if (!seen[j] && green(j)) seen[j] = 1, stack.push_back(j);
        }
        const int bw = (int)(x1 - x0 + 1), bh = (int)(y1 - y0 + 1);
        const float fill = (float)n / (bw * bh);  // a disc with the letter cut out: ~0.5..0.8
        if (bw < 14 || bw > 90 || abs(bw - bh) > std::max(2, bw / 8) || fill < 0.4f || fill > 0.85f || (int)x0 >= best_x) continue;
        const float r = bw / 2.0f * 1.16f;  // out to the middle of the disc's black ring
        const float cx = x0 + bw / 2.0f, cy = y0 + bh / 2.0f;
        best = {(int)(cx - r + 0.5f), (int)(cy - r + 0.5f), (int)(2 * r + 0.5f), (int)(2 * r + 0.5f), FACE_A, 2,
                (uint32_t)(sum[0] / n << 16 | sum[1] / n << 8 | sum[2] / n)};
        best_x = (int)x0;
    }
    if (best_x == 1 << 30) return false;
    return paint_cells(style, {best}, false, (int)w, (int)h, rgba);
}

// Cell table check without playing: every k_atlases texture found in <dir> as a dump (<w>x<h>_<fmt>_<hash>.dds,
// RGBA8, from NX_TEX_DUMP or tools/texextract) gets both styles drawn into <dir>/padicons_<style>_<hash>.dds.
int pad_icons_selftest(const char* dir) {
    int done = 0;
    std::error_code ec;
    for (auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir, ec)) {
        std::string n = e.path().filename().string();
        size_t u = n.rfind('_');
        if (n.rfind("padicons", 0) == 0 || u == std::string::npos || e.path().extension() != ".dds") continue;
        uint64_t hash = strtoull(n.c_str() + u + 1, nullptr, 16);
        if (!is_pad_icon_atlas(hash)) continue;
        std::ifstream f(e.path(), std::ios::binary);
        std::vector<uint8_t> b((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), {});
        if (b.size() < 148) continue;
        uint32_t h, w;
        memcpy(&h, &b[12], 4), memcpy(&w, &b[16], 4);
        if (b.size() < 148 + (size_t)w * h * 4) continue;
        for (int style = 1; style <= 2; style++) {
            std::vector<uint8_t> px(b.begin(), b.end());
            if (!pad_icon_atlas(style, hash, w, h, px.data() + 148)) continue;
            char out[64];
            snprintf(out, sizeof out, "padicons_%d_%016llx.dds", style, (unsigned long long)hash);
            std::ofstream(std::filesystem::path(dir) / out, std::ios::binary).write((const char*)px.data(), (std::streamsize)px.size());
            done++;
        }
    }
    printf("pad icons self-test: %d atlases drawn into %s\n", done, dir);
    return done ? 0 : 1;
}

// Resistance badges as icons (setting resist_icons, default 1; user request 11-02, like SMT V). The badges are white
// letters ("Wk", "Rs", "Nu", "Dr", "Rp") that the game draws over a grey disc (a separate sprite): the status screen
// atlases (camp/status001.gtx, status_drc/status_drc001.gtx = the Stats screen) and the battle atlas (battle_02/battle_002.gtx: analysis badges and the larger Rp / Nu /
// Dr). Each letter cell is cleared and gets an icon: <data>\resist_icons\{weak,resist,null,absorb,repel}.png when
// present, else resist_icons\ next to tms.exe (the user's own art, shipped from data/), else a plain disc in the type's colour. Cells = a square around the letters'
// centre, measured on the dumps (2048 scale; the game's own _US atlases without the English mod are the same layout at
// half size). Both atlas sizes are in k_atlases too, so pad_icon_atlas_size keeps their level 0 for hashing.
namespace {
enum Res { R_WK, R_RS, R_NU, R_DR, R_RP, R_POPUP, R_COUNT };
const char* const k_res_files[R_COUNT] = {"weak", "resist", "null", "absorb", "repel", "resist_popup"};
const uint32_t k_res_colour[R_COUNT] = {0xE02020, 0x9A9A9A, 0xB060E0, 0x50C050, 0x30A0F0, 0};
struct RCell { int cx, cy, size; Res r; int h = 0; };  // h: height when not square
// 48 = the whole sprite (Skill Inheritance drawlog 11-02: 24 px quads at 720p, Wk uv from (452,34), Rs from (402,184))
const RCell k_status_res[] = {{428, 58, 48, R_DR}, {476, 58, 48, R_WK}, {428, 108, 48, R_RP}, {427, 158, 48, R_NU},
                              {426, 208, 48, R_RS}};
// battle badges: 48 = the whole sprite (target panel drawlog 11-02: 24 px quads at 720p, uv from (2,174) for Wk)
const RCell k_battle_res[] = {{26, 150, 48, R_DR}, {74, 150, 48, R_RP}, {122, 150, 48, R_NU}, {170, 150, 48, R_RS},
                              {26, 198, 48, R_WK}, {128, 982, 60, R_RP}, {213, 982, 60, R_NU}, {301, 982, 60, R_DR},
                              {240, 152, 84, R_RS},  // our own, in empty space: the resist marker over foes (s106, hle_sys resist_mark)
                              {480, 300, 204, R_POPUP, 92}};  // our own: the RESIST hit popup (same size as WEAK, hle_sys btl_dmg_popup_draw)
struct RAtlas { uint64_t hash; uint32_t w, h; const RCell* cells; size_t n; int div; };
#define RATLAS(h, w, ht, c, d) {h, w, ht, c, sizeof(c) / sizeof(c[0]), d}
const RAtlas k_res_atlases[] = {
    RATLAS(0x266e32dcca881b44ull, 2048, 1024, k_status_res, 1),  // _US camp/status001 (English mod)
    RATLAS(0x6e6254f0ac17ee63ull, 1024, 512, k_status_res, 2),   // the game's own
    RATLAS(0x16f810b5373bff80ull, 2048, 1024, k_status_res, 1),  // _US status_drc/status_drc001 (Stats screen; English mod)
    RATLAS(0x57febd3b87911115ull, 1024, 512, k_status_res, 2),   // the game's own
    // same cells (pixel-matched to status001, 11-02): result/result_001 = Skill Inheritance screen, fusion/fusion001 = Carnage fusion
    RATLAS(0x3c5e643864ee95dfull, 2048, 2048, k_status_res, 1),  // _US result/result_001 (English mod)
    RATLAS(0x7fd8beb4e7f14b1aull, 1024, 1024, k_status_res, 2),  // the game's own
    RATLAS(0x688fc06ddecf3eb3ull, 2048, 2048, k_status_res, 1),  // _US fusion/fusion001 (English mod)
    RATLAS(0x133f164b20932f02ull, 1024, 1024, k_status_res, 2),  // the game's own
    RATLAS(0x7ada3bc97c0dd991ull, 2048, 2048, k_battle_res, 1),  // _US battle_02/battle_002 (English mod)
    RATLAS(0xf7914dfb3c6f343dull, 1024, 1024, k_battle_res, 2),  // the game's own
};
std::atomic<int> g_resist_icons{-1};

// icon k at size x size (w x h: the whole picture, not cropped), BGRA premultiplied; empty when there is no file
#ifndef _WIN32
// Linux: PNG through cairo, cropped to a square around its alpha bounds, scaled with a good filter
std::vector<uint8_t> load_icon(int k, int size, int h) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    const std::string name = std::string(k_res_files[k]) + ".png";
    std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::path(g_data_dir) / "resist_icons" / name;
    std::error_code ec;
    if (!std::filesystem::exists(path, ec)) {
        path = plat::exe_path().parent_path() / "resist_icons" / name;
        if (!std::filesystem::exists(path, ec)) return out;
    }
    cairo_surface_t* img = cairo_image_surface_create_from_png(path.c_str());
    if (cairo_surface_status(img) != CAIRO_STATUS_SUCCESS) {
        cairo_surface_destroy(img);
        log("resist icons: could not read %s", path.string().c_str());
        return out;
    }
    const int iw = cairo_image_surface_get_width(img), ih = cairo_image_surface_get_height(img), st = cairo_image_surface_get_stride(img);
    const uint8_t* px = cairo_image_surface_get_data(img);
    int x0 = iw, y0 = ih, x1 = -1, y1 = -1;
    for (int y = 0; y < ih; y++)
        for (int x = 0; x < iw; x++)
            if (px[(size_t)y * st + x * 4 + 3] > 24) x0 = std::min(x0, x), x1 = std::max(x1, x), y0 = std::min(y0, y), y1 = std::max(y1, y);
    int cx = 0, cy = 0, side = std::min(iw, ih);
    if (h) {  // the whole picture at size x h (RESIST popup)
        draw::Canvas cv(size, h);
        cv.clear();
        cairo_scale(cv.cr, (double)size / iw, (double)h / ih);
        cairo_set_source_surface(cv.cr, img, 0, 0);
        cairo_pattern_set_filter(cairo_get_source(cv.cr), CAIRO_FILTER_BEST);
        cairo_paint(cv.cr);
        cairo_surface_destroy(img);
        out.resize((size_t)size * h * 4);
        for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) memcpy(out.data() + (size_t)y * size * 4, cv.data() + (size_t)y * cv.stride(), (size_t)size * 4);
        return out;
    }
    if (x1 >= x0) {
        side = std::min({std::max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) + 1, iw, ih});
        cx = std::clamp((x0 + x1 + 1 - side) / 2, 0, iw - side), cy = std::clamp((y0 + y1 + 1 - side) / 2, 0, ih - side);
    }
    draw::Canvas cv(size, size);
    cv.clear();
    cairo_scale(cv.cr, (double)size / side, (double)size / side);
    cairo_set_source_surface(cv.cr, img, -cx, -cy);
    cairo_pattern_set_filter(cairo_get_source(cv.cr), CAIRO_FILTER_BEST);
    cairo_paint(cv.cr);
    cairo_surface_destroy(img);
    out.resize((size_t)size * size * 4);
    const uint8_t* src = cv.data();
    for (int y = 0; y < size; y++) memcpy(out.data() + (size_t)y * size * 4, src + (size_t)y * cv.stride(), (size_t)size * 4);
    return out;
}
#else
std::vector<uint8_t> load_icon(int k, int size, int h) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    // <data>\resist_icons wins (player override), else the set shipped next to tms.exe (user's own art, repo data/)
    const std::string name = std::string(k_res_files[k]) + ".png";
    std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::path(g_data_dir) / "resist_icons" / name;
    std::error_code ec;
    if (!std::filesystem::exists(path, ec)) {
        wchar_t exe[MAX_PATH];
        GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH);
        path = std::filesystem::path(exe).parent_path() / "resist_icons" / name;
        if (!std::filesystem::exists(path, ec)) return out;
    }
    CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    IWICImagingFactory* f = nullptr;
    IWICBitmapDecoder* d = nullptr;
    IWICBitmapFrameDecode* fr = nullptr;
    IWICFormatConverter* cv = nullptr;
    IWICBitmapClipper* cl = nullptr;
    IWICBitmapScaler* sc = nullptr;
    if (SUCCEEDED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&f))) &&
        SUCCEEDED(f->CreateDecoderFromFilename(path.c_str(), nullptr, GENERIC_READ, WICDecodeMetadataCacheOnDemand, &d)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(d->GetFrame(0, &fr)) && SUCCEEDED(f->CreateFormatConverter(&cv)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(cv->Initialize(fr, GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppPBGRA, WICBitmapDitherTypeNone, nullptr, 0, WICBitmapPaletteTypeCustom))) {
        // the art sits in a larger transparent canvas (192 px, top-left): crop to a square around its alpha bounds so it
        // fills the cell (= the badge's white disc)
        UINT iw = 0, ih = 0;
        cv->GetSize(&iw, &ih);
        std::vector<uint8_t> full((size_t)iw * ih * 4);
        WICRect rc{0, 0, (INT)iw, (INT)ih};
        if (!h && iw && ih && SUCCEEDED(cv->CopyPixels(nullptr, iw * 4, (UINT)full.size(), full.data()))) {
            int x0 = (int)iw, y0 = (int)ih, x1 = -1, y1 = -1;
            for (int y = 0; y < (int)ih; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < (int)iw; x++)
                    if (full[((size_t)y * iw + x) * 4 + 3] > 24) x0 = std::min(x0, x), x1 = std::max(x1, x), y0 = std::min(y0, y), y1 = std::max(y1, y);
            if (x1 >= x0) {
                const int side = std::min({std::max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) + 1, (int)iw, (int)ih});
                rc.X = std::clamp((x0 + x1 + 1 - side) / 2, 0, (int)iw - side), rc.Y = std::clamp((y0 + y1 + 1 - side) / 2, 0, (int)ih - side);
                rc.Width = rc.Height = side;
            }
        }
        if (SUCCEEDED(f->CreateBitmapClipper(&cl)) && SUCCEEDED(cl->Initialize(cv, &rc)) && SUCCEEDED(f->CreateBitmapScaler(&sc)) &&
            SUCCEEDED(sc->Initialize(cl, size, h ? h : size, WICBitmapInterpolationModeFant))) {
            out.resize((size_t)size * (h ? h : size) * 4);
            if (FAILED(sc->CopyPixels(nullptr, size * 4, (UINT)out.size(), out.data()))) out.clear();
        }
    }
    release(sc), release(cl), release(cv), release(fr), release(d), release(f);
    if (out.empty()) log("resist icons: could not read %s", path.string().c_str());
    return out;
}
#endif
}  // namespace

bool resist_icons_on() {
    if (g_resist_icons < 0) g_resist_icons = !getenv("NX_RESIST_ICONS") || atoi(getenv("NX_RESIST_ICONS")) != 0;
    return g_resist_icons != 0;
}
void set_resist_icons(bool on) {
    save_setting("resist_icons", on ? "1" : "0");
    g_resist_icons = on;  // the atlases upload again (vk_texture.cpp check_pool_texture)
}
bool is_resist_atlas(uint64_t hash) {
    for (const RAtlas& a : k_res_atlases) if (a.hash == hash) return true;
    return false;
}
bool resist_icon_cell(uint64_t hash, float u, float v) {
    for (const RAtlas& a : k_res_atlases) {
        if (a.hash != hash) continue;
        const float x = u * a.w * a.div, y = v * a.h * a.div;  // in the cells' 2048-scale units
        for (size_t i = 0; i < a.n; i++)
            if (a.cells[i].r != R_POPUP && fabsf(x - a.cells[i].cx) < a.cells[i].size / 2.0f && fabsf(y - a.cells[i].cy) < a.cells[i].size / 2.0f) return true;
    }
    return false;
}
// rgba: RGBA8, straight alpha, changed in place. icons: the badge icons too (else only the RESIST popup, which is
// drawn whatever the setting). Returns whether anything was drawn.
bool resist_icon_atlas(uint64_t hash, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint8_t* rgba, bool icons) {
    bool drawn = false;
    for (const RAtlas& a : k_res_atlases) {
        if (a.hash != hash || a.w != w || a.h != h) continue;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < a.n; i++) {
            const RCell& c = a.cells[i];
            if (!icons && c.r != R_POPUP) continue;
            const int size = c.size / a.div, ch = c.h ? c.h / a.div : size, x0 = c.cx / a.div - size / 2, y0 = c.cy / a.div - ch / 2;
            if (x0 < 0 || y0 < 0 || x0 + size > (int)w || y0 + ch > (int)h) continue;
            const std::vector<uint8_t> icon = load_icon(c.r, size, c.h ? ch : 0);
            if (icon.empty() && c.r == R_POPUP) continue;  // no file: leave the empty space
            drawn = true;
            for (int y = 0; y < ch; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < size; x++) {
                    uint8_t* d = rgba + ((size_t)(y0 + y) * w + x0 + x) * 4;
                    if (!icon.empty()) {  // BGRA premultiplied -> RGBA straight
                        const uint8_t* s = &icon[((size_t)y * size + x) * 4];
                        const float al = s[3] / 255.0f;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) d[k] = al > 0 ? (uint8_t)std::min(255.0f, s[2 - k] / al + 0.5f) : 0;
                        d[3] = s[3];
                        continue;
                    }
                    // no file: a disc of the type's colour with a dark ring, soft 1 px edge
                    const float dx = x + 0.5f - size / 2.0f, dy = y + 0.5f - size / 2.0f, r = sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy), R = size / 2.0f - 1;
                    const uint32_t col = r > R * 0.82f ? 0x202020 : k_res_colour[c.r];
                    d[0] = (uint8_t)(col >> 16), d[1] = (uint8_t)(col >> 8), d[2] = (uint8_t)col;
                    d[3] = (uint8_t)(255 * std::clamp(R - r + 0.5f, 0.0f, 1.0f));
                }
        }
    }
    return drawn;
}

}  // namespace rt
```

```h
// Portability. Windows: <windows.h>. Linux: POSIX versions of the few small Win32 helpers the runtime calls in many

// platform-specific parts (memory, threads, files, crash handler, drawing) have their own #ifdef _WIN32 blocks.

#else
```
