`runtime/src/vk_texture.cpp`:

```cpp
// Textures whose data the game put straight into a memory pool: untile (Tegra block-linear) or copy (pitch-linear)
// from guest memory into a staging ring, then copy into the Vulkan image. Block-linear layout: GOB = 64 bytes x 8
// rows; blocks are 1 GOB wide and 2^n GOBs tall (n chosen per level from its height, at most 16 GOBs), row-major.
// The block-height rule is the common Tegra one and is an assumption for this driver: check textures on screen.
#include "plat.h"
#include "vk.h"

#include <chrono>
#include <filesystem>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <fstream>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

using namespace rt;

namespace nvn { struct FormatInfo { uint32_t bw, bh, bytes, flags; }; FormatInfo format_info(uint32_t f); uint32_t block_height_max(uint32_t layout); }

namespace vk {

// one upload ring per submit slot (vk.cpp): a slot's ring is reused only after its submit finished on the GPU
static VkBuffer g_stages[3], g_stage;
static uint8_t* g_stage_maps[3], *g_stage_map;
static VkDeviceSize g_stage_cap = 256ull << 20, g_stage_used = 0;
static int g_stage_slot = 0;

void staging_reset(int slot) {
    g_stages[g_stage_slot] = g_stage, g_stage_maps[g_stage_slot] = g_stage_map;
    g_stage_slot = slot;
    g_stage = g_stages[slot], g_stage_map = g_stage_maps[slot];
    g_stage_used = 0;
}

static uint8_t* staging(VkDeviceSize n, VkDeviceSize* off) {
    if (!g_stage) {
        VkBufferCreateInfo bci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO};
        bci.size = g_stage_cap;
        bci.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
        VKC(vkCreateBuffer(dev, &bci, nullptr, &g_stage));
        VkMemoryRequirements req;
        vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(dev, g_stage, &req);
        VkDeviceSize o;
        VkDeviceMemory m = alloc(req, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT, &o);
        VKC(vkBindBufferMemory(dev, g_stage, m, o));
        void* p;
        VKC(vkMapMemory(dev, m, o, g_stage_cap, 0, &p));
        g_stage_map = (uint8_t*)p;
    }
    VkDeviceSize a = (g_stage_used + 15) & ~15ull;
    if (a + n > g_stage_cap) return nullptr;  // ponytail: ring full -> skip this upload; grow when it happens
    g_stage_used = a + n;
    *off = a;
    return g_stage_map + a;
}

static uint32_t gob_block_height(uint32_t rows, uint32_t bh) {  // GOBs per block for a level with `rows` rows of blocks
    uint32_t gobs = (rows + 7) / 8;
    while (bh > 1 && gobs <= bh / 2) bh /= 2;
    return bh;
}

// copy one level out of block-linear memory into `dst` (tightly packed rows of `row_bytes`)
static void untile(const uint8_t* src, uint8_t* dst, uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, uint32_t bh) {
    uint32_t blocks_x = (row_bytes + 63) / 64, block_bytes = 512 * bh;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
        uint32_t by = y / (8 * bh), gob_in_block = (y % (8 * bh)) / 8, yy = y % 8;
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < row_bytes; x += 16) {
            uint32_t bx = x / 64, xx = x % 64;
            uint32_t off = (by * blocks_x + bx) * block_bytes + gob_in_block * 512 +
                           (xx / 32) * 256 + (yy / 2) * 64 + ((xx % 32) / 16) * 32 + (yy % 2) * 16;
            uint32_t n = std::min(16u, row_bytes - x);
            memcpy(dst + (size_t)y * row_bytes + x, src + off, n);
        }
    }
}

// size of one block-linear level (same rule as nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageSize in nvn_hle.cpp)
static uint32_t level_size(uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, uint32_t bh) {
    uint32_t blocks_x = (row_bytes + 63) / 64, blocks_y = (rows + 8 * bh - 1) / (8 * bh);
    return blocks_x * blocks_y * 512 * bh;
}

uint64_t g_submit_serial = 0, g_reuploads = 0;

// nvnTextureWriteTexels: CPU texel writes are kept linear and copied into the image at the texture's next use (any
// target; level 0). The pool storage is not touched, so these textures skip the pool upload.
struct PendingTexels { int32_t rg[6]; std::vector<uint8_t> data; };
static std::mutex g_texels_lock;
static std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<PendingTexels>> g_texels;  // by guest texture object
static std::atomic<uint32_t> g_texels_count{0};

bool has_texels(nvn::Texture* t) {
    if (!g_texels_count) return false;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_texels_lock);
    return g_texels.count(t->guest) != 0;
}

void apply_texels(VkCommandBuffer cb, nvn::Texture* t, Image* im) {
    std::vector<PendingTexels> v;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_texels_lock);
        auto it = g_texels.find(t->guest);
        if (it == g_texels.end()) return;
        v = std::move(it->second);
        g_texels.erase(it);
        g_texels_count -= (uint32_t)v.size();
    }
    transition(cb, im, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    bool is3d = t->target == 2;
    for (auto& p : v) {
        VkDeviceSize so;
        uint8_t* dst = staging(p.data.size(), &so);
        if (!dst) { log("vk: staging ring full, texels for %08x dropped", t->guest); continue; }
        memcpy(dst, p.data.data(), p.data.size());
        VkBufferImageCopy c{};
        c.bufferOffset = so;
        uint32_t d = (uint32_t)std::max(1, p.rg[5]);
        c.imageSubresource = {(im->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT) ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT : im->aspect, 0,
                              is3d ? 0u : (uint32_t)p.rg[2], is3d ? 1u : d};
        c.imageOffset = {p.rg[0], p.rg[1], is3d ? p.rg[2] : 0};
        c.imageExtent = {(uint32_t)std::max(1, p.rg[3]), (uint32_t)std::max(1, p.rg[4]), is3d ? d : 1u};
        vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, g_stage, im->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &c);
    }
    VkMemoryBarrier mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, nullptr, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    im->written = true;
    im->from_pool = false;
    static int n = 0;
    if (n++ < 3) log("vk: WriteTexels data copied into %08x (%ux%u, %zu writes)", t->guest, im->w, im->h, v.size());
}

extern std::atomic<uint8_t> g_pack_gen;  // texture packs (below)
// once per submit per texture: GPU writes do not trip the watch, so only CPU-side changes cause a new upload
void check_pool_texture(nvn::Texture* t, Image* im) {
    if (!t || !im->from_pool || im->checked == g_submit_serial) return;
    im->checked = g_submit_serial;
    if (im->pad_style >= 0 && im->pad_style != rt::pad_icon_style()) im->written = false;  // other controller / setting
    if (im->resist >= 0 && im->resist != (int8_t)rt::resist_icons_on()) im->written = false;  // badge icons on / off
    if (im->pack_file && im->pack_gen != g_pack_gen) im->written = false;  // UHD pack switched on / off
    HitchTimer ht{HITCH_CHECK};
    if (mem_written((uint32_t)t->gpu, im->pool_bytes)) { im->written = false; g_reuploads++; }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ texture packs
// NX_TEX_DUMP=1: every new 2D texture from guest memory (level 0, layer 0) -> <data>/textures/dump/<w>x<h>_<nvn fmt>_
// <hash>.dds, once per hash. Files <data>/textures/pack/*_<hash>.dds (any size, own mip chain, BCn or RGBA8 DDS)
// replace the texture whose level 0 has that hash: the UHD pack (tools/uhd_pack.py upscales the dumps). NX_TEX_PACK=0
// starts with the pack off; the menus switch it live (rt::set_tex_pack: textures with a pack file upload again).
struct DxgiFmt { VkFormat unorm, srgb; uint32_t dxgi, dxgi_srgb, block; };  // block: bytes per 4x4, 0 = 4 B/pixel
static const DxgiFmt k_dxgi[] = {
    {VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGBA_UNORM_BLOCK, VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGBA_SRGB_BLOCK, 71, 72, 8},
    {VK_FORMAT_BC2_UNORM_BLOCK, VK_FORMAT_BC2_SRGB_BLOCK, 74, 75, 16},
    {VK_FORMAT_BC3_UNORM_BLOCK, VK_FORMAT_BC3_SRGB_BLOCK, 77, 78, 16},
    {VK_FORMAT_BC4_UNORM_BLOCK, VK_FORMAT_BC4_UNORM_BLOCK, 80, 80, 8},
    {VK_FORMAT_BC5_UNORM_BLOCK, VK_FORMAT_BC5_UNORM_BLOCK, 83, 83, 16},
    {VK_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM_BLOCK, VK_FORMAT_BC7_SRGB_BLOCK, 98, 99, 16},
    {VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB, 28, 29, 0},
    {VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB, 87, 91, 0},
};
static const DxgiFmt* dxgi_of(VkFormat f, bool* srgb) {
    if (f == VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGB_UNORM_BLOCK) f = VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGBA_UNORM_BLOCK;
    if (f == VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGB_SRGB_BLOCK) f = VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGBA_SRGB_BLOCK;
    for (auto& d : k_dxgi)
        if (f == d.unorm || f == d.srgb) { *srgb = f == d.srgb && d.srgb != d.unorm; return &d; }
    return nullptr;
}
static VkDeviceSize dds_level_size(const DxgiFmt* d, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    return d->block ? (VkDeviceSize)std::max(1u, (w + 3) / 4) * std::max(1u, (h + 3) / 4) * d->block
                    : (VkDeviceSize)w * h * 4;
}
// FNV-1a in 4 interleaved lanes over 32-byte steps (one multiply chain was ~1 GB/s: 300 ms per map load), then the
// tail bytes. Pack and dump file names carry this hash.
static uint64_t tex_hash(const uint8_t* p, size_t n) {
    const uint64_t prime = 0x100000001b3ull;
    uint64_t h[4] = {0xcbf29ce484222325ull, 0x84222325cbf29ce4ull, 0xcbf29ce4ull, 0x84222325ull};
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + 32 <= n; i += 32) {
        uint64_t w[4];
        memcpy(w, p + i, 32);
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) h[k] = (h[k] ^ w[k]) * prime;
    }
    for (; i < n; i++) h[0] = (h[0] ^ p[i]) * prime;
    return (h[0] ^ (h[1] * 3) ^ (h[2] * 5) ^ (h[3] * 7)) ^ n;
}
static void dump_dds(const fs::path& file, const DxgiFmt* d, bool srgb, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, const uint8_t* data) {
    uint32_t hdr[32] = {0x20534444, 124, 0x1 | 0x2 | 0x4 | 0x1000 | 0x80000, h, w, (uint32_t)dds_level_size(d, w, h), 0, 1};
    hdr[19] = 32, hdr[20] = 0x4, hdr[21] = 0x30315844;  // pixel format: FOURCC "DX10"
    hdr[27] = 0x1000;                                   // caps: texture
    uint32_t dx10[5] = {srgb ? d->dxgi_srgb : d->dxgi, 3, 0, 1, 0};
    std::ofstream f(file, std::ios::binary);
    f.write((const char*)hdr, sizeof hdr);
    f.write((const char*)dx10, sizeof dx10);
    f.write((const char*)data, (std::streamsize)dds_level_size(d, w, h));
}

// One per pack file. A worker thread reads the file (a 2048^2 BC7 file with mips is 5.6 MB; reading them on the game
// thread at map loads was the 100-800 ms stutter of 2026-10-27); the texture shows its original data until then. The
// uploaded image is kept per hash and shared by every texture with that hash, so a texture used again (map reloads,
// pool reuse) swaps it in with no read or upload, and no image is made twice.
struct PackTex {
    fs::path file;
    std::atomic<int> state{0};  // 0 not asked, 1 reading, 2 read (data), 3 uploaded (img), 4 unusable
    std::vector<uint8_t> data;
    Image::Own img{};
    int refs = 0;            // images showing it now
    bool in_unused = false;  // in g_pack_unused (no references, image kept for a reuse)
};
static std::unordered_map<uint64_t, PackTex>& pack_index() {
    static std::unordered_map<uint64_t, PackTex> idx = [] {
        std::unordered_map<uint64_t, PackTex> m;
        std::error_code ec;
        // The UHD pack first, then texture mods <data>/mods/<name>/textures (NX_MODS_DISABLED skips them as for romfs):
        // a mod's file wins over the pack for the same hash; between mods the first name wins, as for romfs files.
        // ponytail: mod textures follow the UHD pack switch; a separate switch if people want mods with the pack off.
        std::vector<fs::path> dirs{fs::path(g_data_dir) / "textures" / "pack"};
        std::string off = getenv("NX_MODS_DISABLED") ? std::string(",") + getenv("NX_MODS_DISABLED") + "," : ",";
        std::vector<fs::path> mods;
        for (auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(fs::path(g_data_dir) / "mods", ec))
            if (fs::is_directory(e.path() / "textures", ec) && off.find("," + e.path().filename().string() + ",") == std::string::npos)
                mods.push_back(e.path() / "textures");
        std::sort(mods.rbegin(), mods.rend());  // later dirs overwrite: reverse name order
        dirs.insert(dirs.end(), mods.begin(), mods.end());
        for (const fs::path& dir : dirs) {
            size_t before = m.size(), n_files = 0;
            for (auto& e : fs::recursive_directory_iterator(dir, ec)) {
                std::string n = e.path().filename().string();
                size_t u = n.rfind('_');
                if (u == std::string::npos || e.path().extension() != ".dds") continue;
                // debug: NX_PACK_SKIP=<hex hash>,... leaves those textures original (finding a bad pack texture)
                if (getenv("NX_PACK_SKIP") && strstr(getenv("NX_PACK_SKIP"), n.substr(u + 1, 16).c_str())) continue;
                m[strtoull(n.c_str() + u + 1, nullptr, 16)].file = e.path();
                n_files++;
            }
            if (n_files && dir != dirs[0]) log("textures: mod %s: %zu textures (%zu new)", dir.parent_path().filename().string().c_str(), n_files, m.size() - before);
        }
        if (!m.empty()) log("textures: pack with %zu replacement textures", m.size());
        return m;
    }();
    return idx;
}

static void pack_read_async(PackTex* p) {
    static std::mutex lock;
    static std::condition_variable cv;
    static std::deque<PackTex*> queue;
    static bool started = [] {
        std::thread([] {
            for (;;) {
                PackTex* p;
                {
                    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> l(lock);
                    cv.wait(l, [] { return !queue.empty(); });
                    p = queue.front();
                    queue.pop_front();
                }
                std::ifstream f(p->file, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
                std::vector<uint8_t> b(f ? (size_t)f.tellg() : 0);
                f.seekg(0);
                f.read((char*)b.data(), (std::streamsize)b.size());
                p->data = std::move(b);
                p->state = 2;
            }
        }).detach();
        return true;
    }();
    (void)started;
    p->state = 1;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(lock);
        queue.push_back(p);
    }
    cv.notify_one();
}

std::atomic<int> g_pack_on{-1};  // -1: not read from NX_TEX_PACK yet
std::atomic<uint8_t> g_pack_gen{0};  // +1 per switch: images uploaded under another value check again
bool pack_on() {
    if (g_pack_on < 0) {
        // tex_pack = auto (or unset, weak-PC default): off on integrated GPUs and under 4 GB of VRAM (4x textures; the
        // spill to system RAM keeps it running but stutters); F1 / the launcher can still turn it on
        const char* e = getenv("NX_TEX_PACK");
        if (e && _stricmp(e, "auto")) g_pack_on = atoi(e) != 0;
        else {
            g_pack_on = !weak_gpu();
            if (!pack_index().empty()) log("textures: UHD pack auto -> %s (%llu MB VRAM)", g_pack_on ? "on" : "off (weak GPU)", (unsigned long long)(vram_bytes() >> 20));
        }
    }
    return g_pack_on != 0;
}

bool pack_arrived(Image* im) {
    auto it = pack_index().find(im->pack_wait);
    return it == pack_index().end() || it->second.state != 1;
}

// Pack images without references (their textures were finalized or got other data) stay for a reuse until they add
// up to NX_PACK_CACHE_MB (default VRAM / 8, 128 .. 1024); then the oldest go and their file is read again when needed. Before
// 2026-10-29 every pack image stayed for the whole run (a full-game pack would fill VRAM).
static std::deque<uint64_t> g_pack_unused;
static VkDeviceSize g_pack_unused_bytes = 0;
static void pack_ref(uint64_t hash, int d) {
    auto it = pack_index().find(hash);
    if (it == pack_index().end()) return;
    PackTex& p = it->second;
    p.refs += d;
    if (d > 0 && p.in_unused) p.in_unused = false, g_pack_unused_bytes -= p.img.mem_size;
    if (p.refs || p.state != 3 || p.in_unused) return;
    p.in_unused = true;
    g_pack_unused.push_back(hash);
    g_pack_unused_bytes += p.img.mem_size;
    // default: an eighth of the VRAM, 128 MB .. 1 GB (a 2 GB card kept 1 GB of unused pack images before)
    static const VkDeviceSize budget = getenv("NX_PACK_CACHE_MB") ? (VkDeviceSize)atoi(getenv("NX_PACK_CACHE_MB")) << 20
                                                                  : std::clamp<VkDeviceSize>(vram_bytes() / 8, 128ull << 20, 1024ull << 20);
    while (g_pack_unused_bytes > budget && !g_pack_unused.empty()) {
        PackTex& q = pack_index()[g_pack_unused.front()];
        g_pack_unused.pop_front();
        if (!q.in_unused) continue;  // in use again
        q.in_unused = false;
        g_pack_unused_bytes -= q.img.mem_size;
        static uint64_t freed = 0;
        if (freed++ % 100 == 0) log("textures: %llu unused pack images freed (cache over %llu MB)", (unsigned long long)freed, (unsigned long long)(budget >> 20));
        defer_destroy(q.img.image, q.img.view, {}, q.img.mem, q.img.mem_off, q.img.mem_size);
        q.img = {};
        q.state = 0;
    }
}
void pack_released(Image* im) { pack_ref(im->pack_hash, -1); }

// put the pack image in place of the texture's own (kept in im->own for when the game reuses the texture)
static void pack_swap_in(Image* im, uint64_t hash, const Image::Own& r) {
    if (!im->own) im->own = new Image::Own{im->image, im->view, im->format, im->w, im->h, im->levels, im->layout, std::move(im->views)};
    else im->own->views = std::move(im->views), im->own->layout = im->layout;  // swapped in again: its views stay its own
    im->image = r.image, im->view = r.view, im->format = r.format, im->w = r.w, im->h = r.h, im->levels = r.levels;
    im->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL;
    im->views.clear();
    im->view_type = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    im->replaced = true;
    im->pack_hash = hash;
    pack_ref(hash, 1);
}
static void pack_swap_out(Image* im) {
    Image::Own& o = *im->own;
    defer_destroy(VK_NULL_HANDLE, VK_NULL_HANDLE, std::move(im->views), VK_NULL_HANDLE, 0, 0);  // this image's views of the pack image
    im->image = o.image, im->view = o.view, im->format = o.format, im->w = o.w, im->h = o.h, im->levels = o.levels;
    im->layout = o.layout;
    im->views = std::move(o.views);
    im->view_type = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    im->replaced = false;
    pack_ref(im->pack_hash, -1);
}

static bool pack_upload(VkCommandBuffer cb, Image* im, PackTex& p, uint64_t hash, bool srgb);
// The pack's image for this hash in place of the texture's: true when done (false: original data this time)
static bool pack_replace(VkCommandBuffer cb, Image* im, uint64_t hash, bool srgb) {
    auto it = pack_index().find(hash);
    if (it == pack_index().end()) return false;
    im->pack_file = true, im->pack_gen = g_pack_gen;
    if (!pack_on()) return false;
    PackTex& p = it->second;
    if (p.state == 0) pack_read_async(&p);
    if (p.state == 1) { im->pack_wait = hash; return false; }
    if (p.state == 4) return false;
    if (p.state == 3) { pack_swap_in(im, hash, p.img); return true; }
    return pack_upload(cb, im, p, hash, srgb);
}
// p.data (a DDS file's bytes, state 2) -> its image, swapped in (state 3; 4 = unusable)
static bool pack_upload(VkCommandBuffer cb, Image* im, PackTex& p, uint64_t hash, bool srgb) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> b = std::move(p.data);
    p.state = 4;
    uint32_t hdr[32];
    if (b.size() < 128) return false;
    memcpy(hdr, b.data(), 128);
    if (hdr[0] != 0x20534444) return false;
    uint32_t h = hdr[3], w = hdr[4], levels = std::max(1u, hdr[7]), dxgi = 0;
    size_t pos = 128;
    if (hdr[21] == 0x30315844 && b.size() >= 148) memcpy(&dxgi, b.data() + 128, 4), pos = 148;
    else if (hdr[21] == 0x31545844) dxgi = 71;  // "DXT1"
    else if (hdr[21] == 0x35545844) dxgi = 77;  // "DXT5"
    const DxgiFmt* d = nullptr;
    for (auto& x : k_dxgi)
        if (dxgi == x.dxgi || dxgi == x.dxgi_srgb) d = &x;
    if (!d) {
        log("textures: %s: DXGI format %u not supported", p.file.string().c_str(), dxgi);
        return false;
    }
    std::vector<VkBufferImageCopy> regions;
    for (uint32_t l = 0; l < levels; l++) {
        uint32_t lw = std::max(1u, w >> l), lh = std::max(1u, h >> l);
        VkDeviceSize n = dds_level_size(d, lw, lh), so;
        if (pos + n > b.size()) { levels = l; break; }
        uint8_t* dst = staging(n, &so);
        if (!dst) { p.data = std::move(b), p.state = 2; return false; }  // staging ring full: next time
        memcpy(dst, b.data() + pos, n);
        pos += n;
        VkBufferImageCopy c{};
        c.bufferOffset = so;
        c.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, l, 0, 1};
        c.imageExtent = {lw, lh, 1};
        regions.push_back(c);
    }
    if (!levels) return false;
    p.img = new_image_2d(srgb ? d->srgb : d->unorm, w, h, levels);
    p.state = 3;  // before the swap: pack_ref counts only uploaded images
    pack_swap_in(im, hash, p.img);
    im->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    transition(cb, im, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, g_stage, im->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, (uint32_t)regions.size(), regions.data());
    VkMemoryBarrier mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, nullptr, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    p.state = 3;
    static int logged = 0;
    if (logged++ < 20 || getenv("NX_PACK_LOG"))  // NX_PACK_LOG=1: every one (debug)
        log("textures: %016llx -> %s (%ux%u, %u levels)", (unsigned long long)hash, p.file.filename().string().c_str(), w, h, levels);
    return true;
}

// BC3 (DXT5) -> RGBA8, for the field prompts
static std::vector<uint8_t> decode_bc3(const uint8_t* src, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out((size_t)w * h * 4);
    const uint32_t bw = (w + 3) / 4, bh = (h + 3) / 4;
    for (uint32_t by = 0; by < bh; by++)
        for (uint32_t bx = 0; bx < bw; bx++, src += 16) {
            uint8_t a[8] = {src[0], src[1]};
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++)
                a[2 + j] = a[0] > a[1] ? (uint8_t)(((6 - j) * a[0] + (1 + j) * a[1]) / 7) : (uint8_t)(((4 - j) * a[0] + (1 + j) * a[1]) / 5);
            if (a[0] <= a[1]) a[6] = 0, a[7] = 255;
            uint64_t ai = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) ai |= (uint64_t)src[2 + k] << (8 * k);
            const uint16_t c0 = (uint16_t)(src[8] | src[9] << 8), c1 = (uint16_t)(src[10] | src[11] << 8);
            uint8_t c[4][3];
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                const uint16_t v = k ? c1 : c0;
                c[k][0] = (uint8_t)((v >> 11) * 255 / 31), c[k][1] = (uint8_t)(((v >> 5) & 63) * 255 / 63), c[k][2] = (uint8_t)((v & 31) * 255 / 31);
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) c[2][k] = (uint8_t)((2 * c[0][k] + c[1][k]) / 3), c[3][k] = (uint8_t)((c[0][k] + 2 * c[1][k]) / 3);
            const uint32_t ci = (uint32_t)(src[12] | src[13] << 8 | src[14] << 16 | (uint32_t)src[15] << 24);
            for (int t = 0; t < 16; t++) {
                const uint32_t x = bx * 4 + t % 4, y = by * 4 + t / 4;
                if (x >= w || y >= h) continue;
                uint8_t* d = &out[((size_t)y * w + x) * 4];
                memcpy(d, c[(ci >> (2 * t)) & 3], 3);
                d[3] = a[(ai >> (3 * t)) & 7];
            }
        }
    return out;
}

// A field prompt with the controller's (A) drawn in: RGBA8 image with a box-filtered mip chain, made once per prompt
// and style and kept (50 prompts x 340 KB at most); swapped in like a pack image.
static std::unordered_map<uint64_t, PackTex> g_prompts;
static bool prompt_replace(VkCommandBuffer cb, Image* im, uint64_t hash, int style, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, const uint8_t* bc3, bool srgb) {
    const uint64_t key = hash + (uint64_t)style * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;  // never a pack hash (pack_ref ignores it)
    PackTex& p = g_prompts[key];
    if (p.state == 3) { pack_swap_in(im, key, p.img); return true; }
    if (p.state == 4) return false;
    std::vector<uint8_t> px = decode_bc3(bc3, w, h);
    if (!rt::pad_icon_prompt(style, w, h, px.data())) { p.state = 4; return false; }
    uint32_t hdr[32] = {0x20534444, 124, 0x1 | 0x2 | 0x4 | 0x1000 | 0x20000, h, w, w * 4, 0, 0};
    hdr[19] = 32, hdr[20] = 0x4, hdr[21] = 0x30315844, hdr[27] = 0x1000;
    uint32_t dx10[5] = {28, 3, 0, 1, 0};  // RGBA8 (pack_upload picks sRGB from the texture)
    std::vector<uint8_t> dds((uint8_t*)hdr, (uint8_t*)hdr + sizeof hdr);
    dds.insert(dds.end(), (uint8_t*)dx10, (uint8_t*)dx10 + sizeof dx10);
    uint32_t lw = w, lh = h, levels = 0;
    for (;;) {
        dds.insert(dds.end(), px.begin(), px.end());
        levels++;
        if (lw == 1 && lh == 1) break;
        const uint32_t nw = std::max(1u, lw / 2), nh = std::max(1u, lh / 2);
        std::vector<uint8_t> m((size_t)nw * nh * 4);
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < nh; y++)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < nw; x++) {
                const uint32_t x0 = std::min(2 * x, lw - 1), x1 = std::min(2 * x + 1, lw - 1), y0 = std::min(2 * y, lh - 1), y1 = std::min(2 * y + 1, lh - 1);
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
                    m[((size_t)y * nw + x) * 4 + k] = (uint8_t)((px[((size_t)y0 * lw + x0) * 4 + k] + px[((size_t)y0 * lw + x1) * 4 + k] +
                                                                 px[((size_t)y1 * lw + x0) * 4 + k] + px[((size_t)y1 * lw + x1) * 4 + k] + 2) / 4);
            }
        px = std::move(m), lw = nw, lh = nh;
    }
    memcpy(&dds[28], &levels, 4);
    p.data = std::move(dds), p.state = 2;
    static int logged = 0;
    if (logged++ < 8) log("textures: field prompt %016llx drawn with %s icons", (unsigned long long)hash, style == 1 ? "PlayStation" : "Xbox");
    return pack_upload(cb, im, p, key, srgb);
}

// A movie frame plane (linear 1280x720 Y / 640x360 UV) of a 4K replacement movie (hle_movie.cpp): the HD plane goes
// into this texture's own HD image (one per guest address, kept), swapped in like a pack image.
static bool movie_replace(VkCommandBuffer cb, nvn::Texture* t, Image* im, uint32_t row) {
    const uint32_t stride = t->stride ? t->stride : row;
    std::shared_ptr<std::vector<uint8_t>> nv12;
    size_t off;
    uint32_t w, h;
    if (!rt::movie_hd_plane(rt::movie_fp((const uint8_t*)GPTR((uint32_t)t->gpu), row, t->height, stride), &nv12, &off, &w, &h)) return false;
    const VkDeviceSize n = (VkDeviceSize)w * h * (row / t->width);
    if (off + n > nv12->size()) return false;
    struct MovieImg { Image::Own img; bool fresh = true; };
    static std::unordered_map<uint64_t, MovieImg> imgs;  // ponytail: never freed; 2-3 textures per movie player (~37 MB)
    const uint64_t key = 0x4d4f5649450000ull ^ t->gpu;   // never a pack hash (pack_ref ignores it)
    MovieImg& m = imgs[key];
    if (m.img.image && (m.img.w != w || m.img.h != h || m.img.format != im->format)) {
        // the address held another movie's plane of another size (title Y -> camp UV): that texture stayed 720p for good,
        // so every other camp frame had 720p colour (flowers flickered, user 11-22)
        log("textures: movie plane %08x: 4K image %ux%u -> %ux%u (address reused)", t->guest, m.img.w, m.img.h, w, h);
        defer_destroy(m.img.image, m.img.view, {}, m.img.mem, m.img.mem_off, m.img.mem_size);
        m = MovieImg{};
    }
    if (!m.img.image) m.img = new_image_2d(im->format, w, h, 1);
    VkDeviceSize so;
    uint8_t* dst = staging(n, &so);
    if (!dst) return false;
    memcpy(dst, nv12->data() + off, n);
    pack_swap_in(im, key, m.img);
    if (m.fresh) im->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, m.fresh = false;
    transition(cb, im, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    VkMemoryBarrier rb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, nullptr, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 1, &rb, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    VkBufferImageCopy c{};
    c.bufferOffset = so;
    c.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1};
    c.imageExtent = {w, h, 1};
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, g_stage, im->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &c);
    VkMemoryBarrier mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, nullptr, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    static int logged = 0;
    if (logged++ < 4) log("textures: movie plane %ux%u -> 4K %ux%u (%08x)", t->width, t->height, w, h, t->guest);
    return true;
}

bool upload_from_pool(VkCommandBuffer cb, nvn::Texture* t, Image* im) {
    if (!t->gpu || (im->written && !im->pack_wait)) return false;
    HitchTimer ht{HITCH_UPLOAD};
    im->pack_wait = 0;
    if (im->replaced) pack_swap_out(im);  // the texture's own image and level count for the new data
    if (im->scale != 1) { im->written = true; return false; }  // a render target sampled before any pass wrote it
    nvn::FormatInfo fi = nvn::format_info(t->format);
    bool linear = (t->flags & 0x50) != 0;
    std::vector<VkBufferImageCopy> regions;
    uint32_t levels = linear ? 1 : im->levels;  // linear textures have one level
    std::vector<uint8_t*> dsts(levels);
    for (uint32_t l = 0; l < levels; l++) {  // staging is level-major (one copy region per level, all layers)
        uint32_t w = std::max(1u, t->width >> l), h = std::max(1u, t->height >> l);
        uint32_t bx = (w + fi.bw - 1) / fi.bw, by = (h + fi.bh - 1) / fi.bh;
        VkDeviceSize so;
        dsts[l] = staging((VkDeviceSize)bx * fi.bytes * by * im->layers, &so);
        if (!dsts[l]) { log("vk: staging ring full, texture %08x not uploaded", t->guest); return false; }
        VkBufferImageCopy c{};
        c.bufferOffset = so;
        c.imageSubresource = {(im->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT) ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT : im->aspect, l, 0, im->layers};
        c.imageExtent = {w, h, 1};
        regions.push_back(c);
    }
    // guest memory is layer-major: every level of layer 0, then layer 1, ...; a block-linear layer starts on a
    // level-0 block boundary (Tegra rule, as in Ryujinx's SizeCalculator.AlignLayerSize)
    // level 0 of a texture the pack may replace goes through cached memory: hashing it in the staging ring
    // (write-combined, ~80 MB/s to read) cost 100-400 ms per map load
    static const bool dumping = getenv("NX_TEX_DUMP") && atoi(getenv("NX_TEX_DUMP"));
    static thread_local std::vector<uint8_t> level0;
    const bool keep0 = !linear && t->target == 1 && im->layers == 1 &&
                       (dumping || !pack_index().empty() || rt::pad_icon_atlas_size(t->width, t->height) ||
                        (t->width == 512 && t->height == 128));  // field prompt size
    uint64_t src_off = 0;
    uint32_t bh_max = nvn::block_height_max(t->layout);
    uint32_t block0 = 512 * gob_block_height((std::max(1u, t->height) + fi.bh - 1) / fi.bh, bh_max);
    for (uint32_t layer = 0; layer < im->layers; layer++) {
        for (uint32_t l = 0; l < levels; l++) {
            uint32_t w = std::max(1u, t->width >> l), h = std::max(1u, t->height >> l);
            uint32_t bx = (w + fi.bw - 1) / fi.bw, by = (h + fi.bh - 1) / fi.bh;
            uint32_t row = bx * fi.bytes;
            uint8_t* dst = dsts[l] + (size_t)layer * row * by;
            if (keep0 && l == 0 && layer == 0) level0.resize((size_t)row * by), dst = level0.data();
            const uint8_t* src = (const uint8_t*)GPTR((uint32_t)(t->gpu + src_off));
            if (linear) {
                uint32_t stride = t->stride ? t->stride : row;
                for (uint32_t y = 0; y < by; y++) memcpy(dst + (size_t)y * row, src + (size_t)y * stride, row);
                src_off += (uint64_t)stride * by;
            } else {
                uint32_t bh = gob_block_height(by, bh_max);
                untile(src, dst, row, by, bh);
                src_off += level_size(row, by, bh);
            }
        }
        if (!linear && im->layers > 1) src_off = (src_off + block0 - 1) / block0 * block0;
    }
    if (keep0) memcpy(dsts[0], level0.data(), level0.size());
    im->pool_bytes = (uint32_t)src_off;
    mem_written((uint32_t)t->gpu, im->pool_bytes);  // start watching from this upload
    bool srgb = false;
    const DxgiFmt* dx = !linear && t->target == 1 && im->layers == 1 ? dxgi_of(im->format, &srgb) : nullptr;
    if (dx) {
        if (!keep0) goto upload;
        uint64_t hash = tex_hash(level0.data(), (size_t)dds_level_size(dx, t->width, t->height));
        if (dumping) {
            static std::unordered_set<uint64_t> seen;
            if (seen.insert(hash).second) {
                fs::path dir = fs::path(g_data_dir) / "textures" / "dump";
                char name[64];
                snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%ux%u_%02x_%016llx.dds", t->width, t->height, t->format, (unsigned long long)hash);
                std::error_code ec;
                fs::create_directories(dir, ec);
                if (!fs::exists(dir / name, ec)) dump_dds(dir / name, dx, srgb, t->width, t->height, level0.data());
            }
        }
        if (!dx->block && rt::is_resist_atlas(hash)) {  // resistance badges as icons (pad_icons.cpp)
            im->resist = (int8_t)rt::resist_icons_on();
            im->resist_hash = hash;
            // drawn into level0 itself: the Stats screen atlas also gets button icons (below), over these
            if (rt::resist_icon_atlas(hash, t->width, t->height, level0.data(), im->resist)) {
                memcpy(dsts[0], level0.data(), level0.size());
                log("textures: resistance atlas %016llx (%08x) drawn with icons", (unsigned long long)hash, t->guest);
                if (dumping) {
                    char name[64];
                    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "resist_%016llx.dds", (unsigned long long)hash);
                    dump_dds(fs::path(g_data_dir) / "textures" / "dump" / name, dx, srgb, t->width, t->height, level0.data());
                }
            }
            if (!rt::is_pad_icon_atlas(hash)) goto upload;  // a UHD pack file of the atlas would show the letters
        }
        if (!dx->block && rt::is_pad_icon_atlas(hash)) {  // controller icons (pad_icons.cpp)
            im->pad_style = (int8_t)rt::pad_icon_style();
            if (im->pad_style) {
                std::vector<uint8_t>& a = level0;  // painted in place (scratch; dsts[0] already has the original)
                const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
                if (rt::pad_icon_atlas(im->pad_style, hash, t->width, t->height, a.data())) {
                    memcpy(dsts[0], a.data(), a.size());
                    static int logged = 0;
                    if (logged++ < 16) log("textures: button atlas %016llx (%08x) drawn with %s icons (%.1f ms)", (unsigned long long)hash, t->guest, im->pad_style == 1 ? "PlayStation" : "Xbox",
                                           std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count());
                    if (dumping) {
                        char name[64];
                        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "padicons_%d_%016llx.dds", im->pad_style, (unsigned long long)hash);
                        dump_dds(fs::path(g_data_dir) / "textures" / "dump" / name, dx, srgb, t->width, t->height, a.data());
                    }
                }
            }
            goto upload;  // a UHD pack file of the atlas would show Switch icons
        }
        if (dx->unorm == VK_FORMAT_BC3_UNORM_BLOCK && rt::is_pad_prompt(hash)) {  // field prompts "(A) Talk" (pad_icons.cpp)
            im->pad_style = (int8_t)rt::pad_icon_style();
            if (im->pad_style && prompt_replace(cb, im, hash, im->pad_style, t->width, t->height, level0.data(), srgb)) {
                im->written = im->from_pool = true;
                return true;
            }
            goto upload;  // a UHD pack file of the prompt would show the Switch (A)
        }
        if (pack_replace(cb, im, hash, srgb)) { im->written = im->from_pool = true; return true; }
    }
    if (linear && rt::movie_hd_any() && im->layers == 1 && ((t->width == 1280 && t->height == 720) || (t->width == 640 && t->height == 360)) &&
        movie_replace(cb, t, im, ((t->width + fi.bw - 1) / fi.bw) * fi.bytes)) {
        im->written = im->from_pool = true;
        return true;
    }
upload:
    transition(cb, im, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, g_stage, im->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, (uint32_t)regions.size(), regions.data());
    VkMemoryBarrier mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, nullptr, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    im->written = true;
    im->from_pool = true;
    return true;
}

}  // namespace vk

void nvn::write_texels(nvn::Texture* t, const int32_t rg[6], const uint8_t* data) {
    nvn::FormatInfo fi = nvn::format_info(t->format);
    size_t n = (size_t)((std::max(1, rg[3]) + fi.bw - 1) / fi.bw) * fi.bytes * ((std::max(1, rg[4]) + fi.bh - 1) / fi.bh) *
               std::max(1, rg[5]);
    vk::PendingTexels p;
    memcpy(p.rg, rg, sizeof p.rg);
    p.data.assign(data, data + n);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(vk::g_texels_lock);
    vk::g_texels[t->guest].push_back(std::move(p));
    vk::g_texels_count++;
}
```

`tools/bmp2png.py`:

```py
"""Convert the runtime's 32-bit BMP frame dumps to PNG (stdlib only).

    python tools/bmp2png.py in.bmp [out.png] [--scale 2] [--r11g11b10] [--crop x0,y0,x1,y1 [--zoom 2]]

--r11g11b10: the dump is a raw B10G11R11 float target (NX_DUMP_RT of an HDR target); clamped to 0..1.
"""
import struct
import sys
import zlib


def uf(v, mbits):  # unsigned small float: 5-bit exponent, mbits mantissa
    e, m = v >> mbits, v & ((1 << mbits) - 1)
    if e == 0:
        return m / (1 << mbits) * 2.0 ** -14
    return 65504.0 if e == 31 else (1 + m / (1 << mbits)) * 2.0 ** (e - 15)


def main():
    src = sys.argv[1]
    dst = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 and not sys.argv[2].startswith("--") else src[:-4] + ".png"
    scale = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--scale") + 1]) if "--scale" in sys.argv else 1
    packed = "--r11g11b10" in sys.argv
    d = open(src, "rb").read()
    off, w, h = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, 10)[0], struct.unpack_from("<i", d, 18)[0], struct.unpack_from("<i", d, 22)[0]
    top_down = h < 0
    h = abs(h)
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = (int(v) for v in sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--crop") + 1].split(",")) if "--crop" in sys.argv else (0, 0, w, h)
    zoom = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--zoom") + 1]) if "--zoom" in sys.argv else 1
    rows = []
    for y in range(y0, y1, scale):
        sy = y if top_down else h - 1 - y
        row = d[off + sy * w * 4: off + (sy + 1) * w * 4]
        px = bytearray()
        for x in range(x0, x1, scale):
            if packed:
                v = struct.unpack_from("<I", row, 4 * x)[0]
                r, g, b = (min(255, int(uf(c, mb) ** (1 / 2.2) * 255)) for c, mb in
                           ((v & 0x7FF, 6), (v >> 11 & 0x7FF, 6), (v >> 22, 5)))
            else:
                b, g, r = row[4 * x], row[4 * x + 1], row[4 * x + 2]
            px += bytes((r, g, b)) * zoom
        rows += [b"\0" + bytes(px)] * zoom
    ow, oh = (x1 - x0 + scale - 1) // scale * zoom, (y1 - y0 + scale - 1) // scale * zoom

    def chunk(t, data):
        return struct.pack(">I", len(data)) + t + data + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(t + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    png = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", ow, oh, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)) + \
        chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(b"".join(rows), 6)) + chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    open(dst, "wb").write(png)
    print(dst, ow, oh)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/camphd/camphd.py`:

```py
"""Camp menu background movies in 4K (user decision 11-02: AI re-encode offline).
Per Movie/camp/*.usm in <data>/romfs/Pack/pack_049_movie_camp.cpk: USM -> IVF (usm2ivf), ffmpeg decodes the 1280x720
frames, Real-ESRGAN realesr-animevideov3 x3 makes them 3840x2160, ffmpeg libvpx-vp9 encodes them to
<data>/movie_hd/camp/<name>.ivf, which the runtime plays instead (hle_movie.cpp). Skips movies already done; frames are
deleted after each movie. Story movies: camphd.py <data> <esrgan dir> <data>/story_hd pack_050_movie.cpk story
Sofdec.Prime (MPEG-1) movies (the uncensored mod's m06 / m07 / m12): <name>_prime.ivf + <name>_prime.thm (16x9 Y block
means per frame, 144 bytes; the runtime matches the game's decoded frames by it, hle_movie.cpp mana_frame_copy):
camphd.py <data> <esrgan dir> <data>/prime_hd mods/uncensored/romfs/Pack/pack_050_movie.cpk story_mod
Usage: camphd.py <data> <esrgan dir> [work dir] [pack] [subdir]  (pack: a name in romfs/Pack or a path from <data>)"""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, here)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(here, ".."))
import usm2ivf  # noqa: E402


def first_packet_hash(ivf, packets=2):
    """FNV-1a 64 of the first 4096 bytes of frame 0, continued over frame 1's (hle_movie.cpp movie_packet_hash; story
    movies share black first packets, packet 1 differs; packets=1 = the old single-packet key of the camp files)"""
    b = open(ivf, "rb").read()
    h, o = 1469598103934665603, 32
    for _ in range(packets):
        n = int.from_bytes(b[o:o + 4], "little")
        for c in b[o + 12:o + 12 + min(n, 4096)]:
            h = ((h ^ c) * 1099511628211) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        o += 12 + n
    return h


def main(data, esrgan_dir, work=None, pack="pack_049_movie_camp.cpk", sub="camp"):
    work = work or os.path.join(data, "camp_hd")
    out_dir = os.path.join(data, "movie_hd", sub)
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    usm_dir = os.path.join(work, "usm")
    if not os.path.isdir(usm_dir):
        src = os.path.join(data, pack) if os.sep in pack or "/" in pack else os.path.join(data, "romfs", "Pack", pack)
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(here, "..", "cpk.py"), "extract", src, usm_dir], check=True)
    usms = sorted(os.path.join(r, f) for r, _, fs in os.walk(usm_dir) for f in fs if f.endswith(".usm"))
    for path in usms:
        name = os.path.basename(path)[:-4]
        ivf, lo, hi = (os.path.join(work, x) for x in (name + ".ivf", "lo", "hi"))
        chunks = list(usm2ivf.frames(open(path, "rb").read()))
        prime = chunks[0][:4] == b"\0\0\1\xb3"  # MPEG-1 sequence header (Sofdec.Prime), not IVF
        if prime:
            dst = os.path.join(out_dir, name + "_prime.ivf")  # runtime matches it by the thumbnails
            if os.path.exists(dst):
                continue
            ivf = os.path.join(work, name + ".m1v")
            open(ivf, "wb").write(b"".join(chunks))
            subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", ivf, "-fps_mode", "passthrough", "-vf",
                            "extractplanes=y,scale=16:9:flags=area", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "gray",
                            dst[:-4] + ".thm.tmp"], check=True)
        else:
            usm2ivf.main(path, ivf)
            dst = os.path.join(out_dir, "%s_%016x.ivf" % (name, first_packet_hash(ivf)))  # runtime finds it by the hash
            if os.path.exists(dst):
                continue
        n = len(chunks)
        if len(os.listdir(hi) if os.path.isdir(hi) else []) != n:  # an interrupted run's frames are kept
            for d in (lo, hi):
                shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
                os.makedirs(d)
            subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", ivf, "-fps_mode", "passthrough",
                            os.path.join(lo, "%04d.png")], check=True)
            subprocess.run([os.path.join(esrgan_dir, "realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan.exe"), "-i", lo, "-o", hi,
                           "-n", "realesr-animevideov3", "-s", "3", "-f", "png"], check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-framerate", "30", "-i",
                        os.path.join(hi, "%04d.png"), "-c:v", "libvpx-vp9", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-crf", "24",
                        "-b:v", "0", "-deadline", "good", "-cpu-used", "4", "-row-mt", "1", "-threads", "16",
                        "-tile-columns", "2", "-g", "60", "-f", "ivf", dst + ".tmp"], check=True)
        os.replace(dst + ".tmp", dst)
        if prime:
            os.replace(dst[:-4] + ".thm.tmp", dst[:-4] + ".thm")
        print(name, "done", flush=True)
        for d in (lo, hi):
            shutil.rmtree(d)
        os.remove(ivf)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(*sys.argv[1:6])
```

```py
"""Rename <data>/movie_hd/<subdir>/<name>_<hash>.ivf from the single-packet key to the two-packet key (camphd.py
first_packet_hash), so story movies with the same black first packet get their own 4K file (s95).

import os
import sys
import tempfile

here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, here)
import usm2ivf  # noqa: E402
from camphd import first_packet_hash  # noqa: E402


def main(usm_dir, hd_dir):
    usms = {f[:-4]: os.path.join(r, f) for r, _, fs in os.walk(usm_dir) for f in fs if f.endswith(".usm")}
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(hd_dir)):
        name, ext = f[:-21], f[-21:]
        if not f.endswith(".ivf") or len(f) < 22 or f[-21] != "_" or name not in usms:
            continue
        tmp = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "rekey.ivf")
        open(tmp, "wb").write(b"".join(usm2ivf.frames(open(usms[name], "rb").read())))
        old, new = first_packet_hash(tmp, 1), first_packet_hash(tmp, 2)
        os.remove(tmp)
        if int(ext[1:17], 16) == old:
            os.replace(os.path.join(hd_dir, f), os.path.join(hd_dir, "%s_%016x.ivf" % (name, new)))
            print(f, "->", "%s_%016x.ivf" % (name, new))

    main(*sys.argv[1:3])
```

`tools/camphd/usm2ivf.py`:

```py
"""CRI USM -> IVF (the VP9 video chunks), so ffmpeg can decode the camp movies. Usage: usm2ivf.py in.usm out.ivf"""
import struct
import sys


def frames(usm):
    pos = 0
    while pos + 8 <= len(usm):
        sig, size = usm[pos:pos + 4], struct.unpack_from(">I", usm, pos + 4)[0]
        if sig == b"@SFV":
            hdr, pad = usm[pos + 9], struct.unpack_from(">H", usm, pos + 10)[0]
            if usm[pos + 15] & 3 == 0:  # data chunk (1 = header, 2 = end, 3 = seek)
                yield usm[pos + 8 + hdr:pos + 8 + size - pad]
        pos += 8 + size


def main(src, dst):
    # the camp movies' video chunks already hold an IVF stream (DKIF header in the first chunk, then IVF frame records)
    fs = list(frames(open(src, "rb").read()))
    assert fs and fs[0][:4] == b"DKIF", "video chunks are not IVF"
    open(dst, "wb").write(b"".join(fs))
    print(src, len(fs) - 1, "frames")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(*sys.argv[1:3])
```

`tools/cpk.py`:

```py
"""CRI CPK archive reader: @UTF tables, TOC, CRILAYLA decompression.

Usage:
    python tools/cpk.py list <cpk> [--grep substr]
    python tools/cpk.py extract <cpk> <outdir> [--grep substr]
"""
import argparse
import os
import struct
import sys

# @UTF column storage (high nibble) and type (low nibble)
ST_ZERO, ST_CONST, ST_ROW = 0x10, 0x30, 0x50
TYPES = {0: ">B", 1: ">b", 2: ">H", 3: ">h", 4: ">I", 5: ">i", 6: ">Q", 7: ">q", 8: ">f", 9: ">d"}
T_STR, T_DATA = 0xA, 0xB


def read_utf(buf, pos=0):
    """Parse an @UTF table at buf[pos]; returns (table name, list of row dicts)."""
    if buf[pos:pos + 4] != b"@UTF":
        raise ValueError("not @UTF")
    base = pos + 8
    _ver, rows_off, str_off, data_off, name_off, ncols, row_len, nrows = struct.unpack_from(">HHIIIHHI", buf, base)
    rows_off += base
    str_off += base
    data_off += base

    def cstr(o):
        o += str_off
        return buf[o:buf.index(b"\0", o)].decode("utf-8", "replace")

    def value(t, p):
        if t == T_STR:
            return cstr(struct.unpack_from(">I", buf, p)[0]), 4
        if t == T_DATA:
            o, n = struct.unpack_from(">II", buf, p)
            return bytes(buf[data_off + o:data_off + o + n]), 8
        f = TYPES[t]
        return struct.unpack_from(f, buf, p)[0], struct.calcsize(f)

    cols = []
    p = base + 0x18
    for _ in range(ncols):
        flags = buf[p]
        name = cstr(struct.unpack_from(">I", buf, p + 1)[0])
        p += 5
        const = None
        if flags & 0xF0 == ST_CONST:
            const, n = value(flags & 0xF, p)
            p += n
        cols.append((name, flags & 0xF0, flags & 0xF, const))
    rows = []
    for r in range(nrows):
        p = rows_off + r * row_len
        row = {}
        for name, st, t, const in cols:
            if st == ST_ROW:
                row[name], n = value(t, p)
                p += n
            elif st == ST_CONST:
                row[name] = const
            else:
                row[name] = None
        rows.append(row)
    return cstr(name_off), rows


def crilayla(src):
    """Decompress a CRILAYLA block (LZ read backwards, 0x100-byte raw prefix stored at the end)."""
    if src[:8] != b"CRILAYLA":
        return src
    usize, csize = struct.unpack_from("<II", src, 8)
    out = bytearray(usize + 0x100)
    out[:0x100] = src[0x10 + csize:0x10 + csize + 0x100]
    inp = 0x10 + csize - 1
    pool = 0
    left = 0

    def bits(n):
        nonlocal inp, pool, left
        v = 0
        while n:
            if left == 0:
                pool = src[inp]
                inp -= 1
                left = 8
            take = min(left, n)
            v = (v << take) | ((pool >> (left - take)) & ((1 << take) - 1))
            left -= take
            n -= take
        return v

    o = len(out) - 1
    while o >= 0x100:
        if bits(1):
            off = bits(13) + 3
            length = 3
            for w in (2, 3, 5):
                n = bits(w)
                length += n
                if n != (1 << w) - 1:
                    break
            else:
                while True:
                    n = bits(8)
                    length += n
                    if n != 0xFF:
                        break
            for _ in range(length):
                out[o] = out[o + off]
                o -= 1
        else:
            out[o] = bits(8)
            o -= 1
    return bytes(out)


class Cpk:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.f = open(path, "rb")
        head = self.f.read(0x800)
        if head[:4] != b"CPK ":
            raise ValueError("not a CPK")
        _, rows = read_utf(head, 0x10)
        self.header = rows[0]
        toc_off, toc_size = self.header["TocOffset"], self.header["TocSize"]
        self.files = []
        if toc_off:
            self.f.seek(toc_off)
            toc = self.f.read(toc_size)
            _, self.files = read_utf(toc, 0x10)
            for r in self.files:
                r["_offset"] = r["FileOffset"] + 0x800  # measured: offsets count from the end of the 0x800 header, not TocOffset

    def path(self, r):
        d = r.get("DirName") or ""
        return f"{d}/{r['FileName']}" if d else r["FileName"]

    def read(self, r):
        self.f.seek(r["_offset"])
        data = self.f.read(r["FileSize"])
        if r["ExtractSize"] != r["FileSize"]:
            data = crilayla(data)
            if len(data) != r["ExtractSize"]:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.path(r)}: {len(data)} != {r['ExtractSize']}")
        return data


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=["list", "extract", "header"])
    ap.add_argument("cpk")
    ap.add_argument("outdir", nargs="?")
    ap.add_argument("--grep")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    c = Cpk(a.cpk)
    if a.cmd == "header":
        for k, v in c.header.items():
            print(k, v if not isinstance(v, bytes) else f"<{len(v)} bytes>")
        return
    for r in c.files:
        p = c.path(r)
        if a.grep and a.grep not in p:
            continue
        if a.cmd == "list":
            print(f"{r['FileSize']:>10} {r['ExtractSize']:>10} {p}")
        else:
            dst = os.path.join(a.outdir, p)
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst) or ".", exist_ok=True)
            with open(dst, "wb") as f:
                f.write(c.read(r))
    print(f"{len(c.files)} files", file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tools/drawlog_passes.py`:

```py
# drawlog_passes.py <log> [start line]: summarise an NX_LOG_DRAWS / NX_CONTROL drawlog frame as passes:
# consecutive draws into the same target, with the textures they sample (guest address, size, format) and shaders.
import re, sys

lines = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines()
start = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if "drawlog: frame" in l or "NX_LOG_DRAWS: frame" in l)
tex, passes, cur = [], [], None
for l in lines[start + 1:]:
    if "frames:" in l and "/s" in l: continue
    if "NX_CONTROL drawlog" in l or "replay finished" in l: break
    m = re.search(r"tex cbuf .* -> tex (\w+) (\d+x\d+) nvn fmt (0x\w+)", l)
    if m: tex.append(f"{m[1]}:{m[2]}:{m[3]}"); continue
    m = re.search(r"viewport (\S+ \S+ \S+ \S+) scissor .* target0 (\w+)", l)
    if m: vp, tgt = m[1], m[2]; continue
    m = re.search(r"draw op \d+ mode (\d+) args (\S+ \S+).*vs (\w+) fs (\w+)", l)
    if m:
        key = (tgt, vp)
        if not cur or cur["key"] != key:
            cur = {"key": key, "n": 0, "tex": set(), "sh": set()}
            passes.append(cur)
        cur["n"] += 1
        cur["tex"].update(tex)
        cur["sh"].add(m[3])
        tex = []
for i, p in enumerate(passes):
    print(f"{i:3} target {p['key'][0]} vp {p['key'][1]} draws {p['n']:4} vs {','.join(sorted(p['sh']))[:40]}")
    for t in sorted(p["tex"]): print("        samples", t)

```

`tools/drive.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Feed a scripted input sequence to a running tms.exe started with NX_CONTROL=control.txt (run from private/tms).
# Usage: sh ../../tools/drive.sh <script> [speed]   script lines: "<button|shot|...> [seconds to wait after]",
# or "<command with arguments> ; <seconds>" (e.g. "ls 0 32767 2000 ; 1"), "#" comments. With a speed (game started
# with NX_SPEED=n or sent "speed n"), waits are divided by it.
# Example scripts: tools/drive/*.txt
speed=${2:-1}
while IFS= read -r line; do
    case "$line" in ""|\#*) continue ;; esac
    case "$line" in
        *" ; "*) cmd=${line% ; *}; wait=${line##* ; } ;;
        *) cmd=${line%% *}; wait=${line#"$cmd"}; wait=${wait# } ;;
    esac
    [ "$cmd" = wait ] || echo "$cmd" >> control.txt
    sleep "$(awk "BEGIN { print ${wait:-2} / $speed }")"
done < "$1"

```

`tools/drive/goto.py`:

```py
"""Walk the player to map position x z (layout coordinates) with NX_CONTROL, using the "pos" command as feedback.
Run from private/tms while the game runs with NX_CONTROL=control.txt NX_LOG=live.log.  Other files: GOTO_CTL / GOTO_LOG env (rig instances).
python ../../tools/drive/goto.py X Z [--tol 6] [--step 400]
The stick is camera-relative and cameras cut between zones, so the stick->world rotation is re-learned from every
step's actual movement. Exits 0 when within tol, 1 when stuck (no movement for 3 steps)."""
import argparse, math, os, re, time
CTL, LOG = os.environ.get("GOTO_CTL", "control.txt"), os.environ.get("GOTO_LOG", "live.log")

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("x", type=float)
ap.add_argument("z", type=float)
ap.add_argument("--tol", type=float, default=6)
ap.add_argument("--step", type=int, default=400, help="game ms per stick hold")
ap.add_argument("--speed", type=float, default=2, help="NX_SPEED of the run (wall time = game time / speed)")
a = ap.parse_args()


def send(line):
    with open(CTL, "a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def pos():
    n = len(open(LOG, "rb").read())
    send("pos")
    for _ in range(40):
        time.sleep(0.1)
        tail = open(LOG, "rb").read()[n:].decode("latin1")
        m = re.findall(r"\[pos\] player (\S+) (\S+) (\S+)", tail)
        if m:
            return tuple(map(float, m[-1]))
        if "[pos] " in tail:
            return None
    return None


theta = 0.0  # world angle = stick angle + theta (stick (0,+1) = up on screen)
stuck = 0
for it in range(200):
    p = pos()
    if not p:
        print("no position"); time.sleep(1); continue
    dx, dz = a.x - p[0], a.z - p[2]
    dist = math.hypot(dx, dz)
    if dist < a.tol:
        print(f"arrived at {p[0]:.1f} {p[1]:.1f} {p[2]:.1f}"); raise SystemExit(0)
    want = math.atan2(-dz, dx)           # world angle of the target (north = -z = up, like the stick)
    s = want - theta                     # stick angle
    hold = a.step if dist > 25 else max(120, int(a.step * dist / 25))
    sx, sy = int(32767 * math.cos(s)), int(32767 * math.sin(s))
    send(f"ls {sx} {sy} {hold}")
    time.sleep(hold / 1000 / a.speed + 0.25)
    q = pos()
    if not q:
        continue
    mx, mz = q[0] - p[0], q[2] - p[2]
    moved = math.hypot(mx, mz)
    if moved > 1.5:
        theta = math.atan2(-mz, mx) - s
        stuck = 0
    else:
        stuck += 1
        if stuck >= 3:
            print(f"stuck at {q[0]:.1f} {q[1]:.1f} {q[2]:.1f}"); raise SystemExit(1)
    print(f"{q[0]:.1f} {q[1]:.1f} {q[2]:.1f}  dist {dist:.0f}  moved {moved:.1f}")
print("gave up"); raise SystemExit(1)

```

`tools/gdis.py`:

```py
"""Disassemble a guest function from the linked image with call targets named. python tools/dis.py <addr|symbol> [n]"""
import json, struct, sys
from capstone import CS_ARCH_ARM, CS_MODE_ARM, Cs

L = json.load(open("private/tms/link/layout.json"))
img = open("private/tms/link/image.bin", "rb").read()
B = L["image_base"]
names = {}
for m in L["modules"]:
    for k, v in m["exports"].items():
        names.setdefault(v, k)
for k, v in L["thunks"].items():
    names[v] = "thunk:" + k
inv = {v: k for k, v in names.items()}
arg = sys.argv[1]
a = int(arg, 16) if arg.startswith("0x") else inv[arg]
n = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 80
md = Cs(CS_ARCH_ARM, CS_MODE_ARM)


def plt(t):
    w0, w1, w2 = (struct.unpack_from("<I", img, t - B + 4 * k)[0] for k in range(3))
    if (w0 & 0xFFFFF000) == 0xE28FC000 and (w2 & 0xFFFFF000) == 0xE5BCF000:
        ror = lambda v, r: ((v >> r) | (v << (32 - r))) & 0xFFFFFFFF if r else v
        got = t + 8 + ror(w0 & 0xFF, ((w0 >> 8) & 15) * 2) + ror(w1 & 0xFF, ((w1 >> 8) & 15) * 2) + (w2 & 0xFFF)
        return struct.unpack_from("<I", img, got - B)[0]
    return t


print(f"{a:#x} {names.get(a, '')}")
for x in range(a, a + 4 * n, 4):
    i = next(md.disasm(img[x - B:x - B + 4], x), None)
    if i is None:
        print(f"  {x:#x} .word {struct.unpack_from('<I', img, x - B)[0]:#010x}")
        continue
    extra = ""
    if i.mnemonic.startswith("bl") or i.mnemonic.startswith("b"):
        if i.op_str.startswith("#"):
            t = plt(int(i.op_str[1:], 16))
            extra = "  ; " + names.get(t, hex(t))
    print(f"  {x:#x} {i.mnemonic:8s} {i.op_str}{extra}")

```

`tools/glsl_emu.py`:

```py
"""Run a translated vertex shader (GLSL from tools/shader_glsl.py) on the CPU: wraps it as C++ with the GLSL builtins it
uses and feeds it a `drawlog` skin dump (analysis/skin_<vbuf0>.bin: c4 0x200, c8 0x1c0, c9 0x3000, 8 vertices of stride 20).
Shortcut: c1 (BRX table) is hard-coded for vertex shader 7e942600, normals are (0,0,1); edit for other shaders.
    python tools/glsl_emu.py Vertex_X.glsl out.cpp  &&  clang++ -O0 -w -ffp-contract=off out.cpp -o emu.exe  &&  emu.exe skin.bin"""
import sys, re
src = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
body = src[src.index("void main()"):].replace("void main()", "void shade()").replace("precise ", "")
hdr = r'''
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>
typedef unsigned uint;
struct vec4 { float x, y, z, w; float& operator[](int i) { return (&x)[i]; } };
struct uvec4 { uint x, y, z, w; };
struct UB { vec4 data[4096]; };
static UB vp_c1, vp_c4, vp_c6, vp_c8, vp_c9;
static vec4 in_attr0, in_attr1, in_attr2, in_attr3, in_attr4, in_attr5, in_attr6, out_attr0, out_attr1, out_attr2, out_attr3, out_attr4, gl_Position;
static uvec4 in_attr7;
static float gl_PointSize;
static const int undef = 0;
static int floatBitsToInt(float f) { int i; memcpy(&i, &f, 4); return i; }
static float intBitsToFloat(int i) { float f; memcpy(&f, &i, 4); return f; }
static double min(double a, double b) { return a < b ? a : b; }
static double max(double a, double b) { return a > b ? a : b; }
static uint min(uint a, uint b) { return a < b ? a : b; }
static float inversesqrt(float x) { return 1.0f / sqrtf(x); }

'''
main = r'''
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    FILE* f = fopen(argv[1], "rb"); static unsigned char d[0x3c0 + 0x3000 + 160]; fread(d, 1, sizeof d, f); fclose(f);
    memcpy(vp_c4.data, d, 0x200); memcpy(vp_c8.data, d + 0x200, 0x1c0); memcpy(vp_c9.data, d + 0x3c0, 0x3000);
    uint c1[8] = {0x158, 0x170, 0x180, 0x198, 0x900, 0x918, 0x930, 0x940}; memcpy(vp_c1.data, c1, 32);
    for (int v = 0; v < 8; v++) {
        unsigned char* p = d + 0x33c0 + 20 * v;
        memcpy(&in_attr0, p, 12); in_attr0.w = 1;
        in_attr7 = {p[12], p[13], p[14], p[15]};
        in_attr1 = {p[16] / 255.f, p[17] / 255.f, p[18] / 255.f, p[19] / 255.f};
        in_attr2 = {0, 0, 1, 0}; in_attr3 = {1, 1, 1, 1}; in_attr4 = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        shade();
        printf("v%d pos %g %g %g idx %u %u %u w %.3f %.3f %.3f clip %g %g %g %g ndc %g %g\n", v, in_attr0.x, in_attr0.y, in_attr0.z,
               in_attr7.x, in_attr7.y, in_attr7.z, in_attr1.x, in_attr1.y, in_attr1.z, gl_Position.x, gl_Position.y, gl_Position.z, gl_Position.w,
               gl_Position.x / gl_Position.w, gl_Position.y / gl_Position.w);
    }
}
'''
open(sys.argv[2], "w").write(hdr + body + main)
```

`tools/lua/flagnames.py`:

```py
"""Dump global number constants (FLG_* = n) from compiled Lua 5.2 scripts (game flag definitions).
python tools/lua/flagnames.py <FlagXxx.lua>... > flags.txt   (prints "0x<hex> NAME", sorted by value)"""
import struct, sys


def parse(d):
    p = 18 + 4 + 4 + 3  # header, linedefined, lastlinedefined, numparams/is_vararg/maxstack

    def u32():
        nonlocal p
        v = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, p)[0]
        p += 4
        return v
    code = [u32() for _ in range(u32())]
    consts = []
    for _ in range(u32()):
        t = d[p]
        p += 1
        if t == 3:
            consts.append(struct.unpack_from("<d", d, p)[0])
            p += 8
        elif t == 4:
            n = u32()
            consts.append(d[p:p + n - 1].decode("latin1"))
            p += n
        elif t == 1:
            consts.append(bool(d[p]))
            p += 1
        else:
            consts.append(None)
    return code, consts


out = {}
for path in sys.argv[1:]:
    code, k = parse(open(path, "rb").read())
    regs = {}
    for ins in code:
        op, a = ins & 0x3F, (ins >> 6) & 0xFF
        c, b = (ins >> 14) & 0x1FF, (ins >> 23) & 0x1FF
        bx = ins >> 14
        rk = lambda x: k[x - 256] if x >= 256 else regs.get(x)
        if op == 1:  # LOADK
            regs[a] = k[bx]
        elif op == 8:  # SETTABUP _ENV[RK(B)] = RK(C)
            name, val = rk(b), rk(c)
            if isinstance(name, str) and isinstance(val, float):
                out[name] = int(val)
for name, v in sorted(out.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]):
    print(f"{v:#06x} {name}")

```

`tools/lua/luadis.py`:

```py
# Lua 5.2 bytecode disassembler (the game's compiled scripts), luac -l style with constants and upvalue names inline.
# usage: python tools/lua/luadis.py <file.lua> [function filter substring]
import struct, sys

OPS = ("MOVE LOADK LOADKX LOADBOOL LOADNIL GETUPVAL GETTABUP GETTABLE SETTABUP SETUPVAL SETTABLE NEWTABLE SELF ADD SUB "
       "MUL DIV MOD POW UNM NOT LEN CONCAT JMP EQ LT LE TEST TESTSET CALL TAILCALL RETURN FORLOOP FORPREP TFORCALL "
       "TFORLOOP SETLIST CLOSURE VARARG EXTRAARG").split()


class Reader:
    def __init__(self, d):
        self.d, self.p = d, 0

    def take(self, n):
        b = self.d[self.p:self.p + n]
        self.p += n
        return b

    def u8(self): return self.take(1)[0]
    def int(self): return struct.unpack(E + 'i', self.take(4))[0]
    def size(self): return struct.unpack(E + 'I', self.take(4))[0]  # size_t is 4 bytes on the 32-bit target (checked in header)

    def str(self):
        n = self.size()
        return self.take(n)[:-1].decode('utf-8', 'replace') if n else None


def function(r):
    f = {'line': r.int(), 'last': r.int(), 'params': r.u8(), 'vararg': r.u8(), 'stack': r.u8()}
    f['code'] = [struct.unpack(E + 'I', r.take(4))[0] for _ in range(r.int())]
    k = []
    for _ in range(r.int()):
        t = r.u8()
        k.append(None if t == 0 else bool(r.u8()) if t == 1 else struct.unpack(E + 'd', r.take(8))[0] if t == 3 else r.str())
    f['k'] = k
    f['protos'] = [function(r) for _ in range(r.int())]
    f['upvals'] = [(r.u8(), r.u8()) for _ in range(r.int())]
    f['source'] = r.str()
    f['lines'] = [r.int() for _ in range(r.int())]
    f['locals'] = [(r.str(), r.int(), r.int()) for _ in range(r.int())]
    f['upnames'] = [r.str() for _ in range(r.int())]
    return f


def kstr(v): return repr(v) if isinstance(v, str) else ('%g' % v if isinstance(v, float) else str(v))


def dump(f, path, flt):
    name = path
    if flt is None or flt in name or any(isinstance(v, str) and flt in v for v in f['k']):
        print('function %s (line %d-%d, %d params, %d stack)' % (name, f['line'], f['last'], f['params'], f['stack']))
        rk = lambda x: 'K' + kstr(f['k'][x - 256]) if x >= 256 else 'r%d' % x
        up = lambda i: f['upnames'][i] if i < len(f['upnames']) else 'U%d' % i
        for pc, ins in enumerate(f['code']):
            op, a, c, b, bx = ins & 63, (ins >> 6) & 255, (ins >> 14) & 511, ins >> 23, ins >> 14
            sbx = bx - 131071
            o = OPS[op] if op < len(OPS) else '?%d' % op
            if o in ('LOADK',): s = 'r%d = %s' % (a, kstr(f['k'][bx]))
            elif o == 'GETTABUP': s = 'r%d = %s[%s]' % (a, up(b), rk(c))
            elif o == 'SETTABUP': s = '%s[%s] = %s' % (up(a), rk(b), rk(c))
            elif o == 'GETTABLE': s = 'r%d = r%d[%s]' % (a, b, rk(c))
            elif o == 'SETTABLE': s = 'r%d[%s] = %s' % (a, rk(b), rk(c))
            elif o == 'SELF': s = 'r%d = r%d; r%d = r%d[%s]' % (a + 1, b, a, b, rk(c))
            elif o in ('ADD', 'SUB', 'MUL', 'DIV', 'MOD', 'POW'): s = 'r%d = %s %s %s' % (a, rk(b), '+-*/%^'['ADD SUB MUL DIV MOD POW'.split().index(o)], rk(c))
            elif o in ('EQ', 'LT', 'LE'): s = 'if (%s %s %s) ~= %d then skip' % (rk(b), {'EQ': '==', 'LT': '<', 'LE': '<='}[o], rk(c), a)
            elif o in ('JMP', 'FORLOOP', 'FORPREP', 'TFORLOOP'): s = 'r%d -> %d' % (a, pc + 1 + sbx)
            elif o == 'GETUPVAL': s = 'r%d = %s' % (a, up(b))
            elif o == 'SETUPVAL': s = '%s = r%d' % (up(b), a)
            elif o == 'CLOSURE': s = 'r%d = closure #%d' % (a, bx)
            elif o == 'CALL': s = 'r%d(%s) -> %s' % (a, '...' if b == 0 else b - 1, 'multi' if c == 0 else c - 1)
            else: s = 'A%d B%d C%d' % (a, b, c)
            line = f['lines'][pc] if pc < len(f['lines']) else 0
            print('  %4d [%4d] %-9s %s' % (pc, line, o, s))
    for i, p in enumerate(f['protos']):
        dump(p, '%s/%d' % (path, i), flt)


d = open(sys.argv[1], 'rb').read()
assert d[:5] == b'\x1bLuaR', 'not Lua 5.2 bytecode'
E = '<'  # little-endian data, although the header's endianness byte says 0
assert d[7] == 4 and d[8] == 4 and d[9] == 4 and d[10] == 8, 'unexpected int/size_t/instruction/number sizes'
r = Reader(d)
r.p = 18
dump(function(r), 'main', sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None)
```

`tools/lyts.py`:

```py
"""Dump the layout records (LYTS blocks: doors, triggers, objects) of a map model.apak.
python tools/lyts.py <model.apak>   (record: type, id, position xyz, size xyz, rot y, named strings)"""
import struct, sys

d = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()


def cstr(a):
    return d[a:d.index(b"\0", a)].decode("latin1") if 0 <= a < len(d) else "?"


pos = d.find(b"LYTS")
while pos >= 0:
    ver, n, hdr = struct.unpack_from("<3I", d, pos + 4)
    print(f"LYTS @{pos:#x} version {ver} records {n}")
    for i in range(n):
        r = pos + hdr + i * 0xa0
        if r + 0xa0 > len(d):
            break
        typ, flags, rid = struct.unpack_from("<3I", d, r)
        p = struct.unpack_from("<3f", d, r + 0xc)
        s = struct.unpack_from("<3f", d, r + 0x18)
        roty = struct.unpack_from("<f", d, r + 0x28)[0]
        ints = struct.unpack_from("<8i", d, r + 0x48)
        strs = [cstr(pos + x) for x in struct.unpack_from("<15I", d, r + 0x64) if x]
        names = [x for x in strs if x]
        print(f"  [{i}] type {typ:#x} f {flags} id {rid:#x} pos ({p[0]:.1f}, {p[1]:.1f}, {p[2]:.1f}) size ({s[0]:.0f}, {s[1]:.0f}, {s[2]:.0f}) roty {roty:.0f} ints {ints[:6]} {names}")
    pos = d.find(b"LYTS", pos + 4)
```

```ps1
# make_icon.ps1 <image> [out.ico]: any image (e.g. the game's own icon from your NSP's control NCA,
# icon_AmericanEnglish.dat, a 256x256 JPEG) -> a 256x256 PNG-in-ICO; default out private\tms\icon.ico.
# build.cmd embeds private\tms\icon.ico in tms.exe when it exists (re-run cmake: delete private\tms\build\build.ninja).
param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$image, [string]$out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\private\tms\icon.ico")
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$src = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile((Resolve-Path $image))
$bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap 256, 256
$g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
$g.InterpolationMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.InterpolationMode]::HighQualityBicubic
$g.DrawImage($src, 0, 0, 256, 256)
$ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
$bmp.Save($ms, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
$png = $ms.ToArray()
$f = New-Object System.IO.BinaryWriter([System.IO.File]::Create([System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($out)))
$f.Write([uint16]0); $f.Write([uint16]1); $f.Write([uint16]1)                # ICONDIR: reserved, type icon, 1 image
$f.Write([byte]0); $f.Write([byte]0); $f.Write([byte]0); $f.Write([byte]0)  # 256x256 (0 = 256), no palette
$f.Write([uint16]1); $f.Write([uint16]32); $f.Write([uint32]$png.Length); $f.Write([uint32]22)
$f.Write($png)
$f.Close(); $g.Dispose(); $bmp.Dispose(); $src.Dispose()
"wrote $out ($($png.Length + 22) bytes)"
```
