```txt
0x003d6e2c mob_mgr_update  # (crowd manager): town crowd (mob) walkers, run from field task 0x46b7f0; per call: removes finished walkers, spawns one, steers + places each walker (0x3d4b8c -> 0x3d53dc -> actor_set_pos): Switch steps it at 30 Hz
0x003c853c actor_set_pos  # (actor, vec3*): sets the actor position +0xc (cut scripts via Lua 0x41a894, crowd walkers via 0x3d53dc, cars via vehicle_update)
0x003c8734 actor_set_dir  # (actor, vec3* dir): yaw +0x1c = atan2(x, z); crowd walker step 0x3d64b0 calls it on its actor each crowd update
0x0049c420 scene_change  # (scene id): next game scene; 0x25 = game over -> title (battle task end 0x2909c8 after a loss), 0xe after RESULTS
0x002909c8 btl_task_end  # (battle task): end states +0x18: 0 wait for the battle, lost (R+8 == 2) -> fade 1 -> scene 0x25; else 3 -> result flow -> scene 0xe
0x00427644 lua_btlSetMapColorScale  # Lua C function (L): battle map colour scale (btl_game_over.lua dims to 0.3)
0x00427530 lua_btlSetMapLightScale  # Lua C function (L): battle map light scale
0x00429610 lua_btlPlaySpriteAnim  # Lua C function (L): battle 2D sprite anim (GAME OVER: gameover_0x.stsp, ends black over every window)
0x0020bc0c screen_fade  # (?, frames, colour ARGB, kind): full-screen fade (battle task end after a loss: 0, 0x1e, 0xff000000, 3)
0x0023d774 ui_draw_sprite  # (sprite id, float pos[2]*, alpha): 2D sprite; settings draw 0x33cb14 row backgrounds (lr 0x33cccc: 0x4e6a/0x4e6b table kind, 0x4e6c/0x4e6d selected slider/choice)
0x0023ce80 ui_draw_gauge  # (s0-s5 floats, part id, alpha): 2D gauge fill; settings draw 0x33cb14 slider bar (lr 0x33cd80, row in r9)
0x0023c8e4 ui_draw_part  # (s0 x, s1 y, part id, alpha): 2D layout part; settings draw 0x33cb14 slider knob (lr 0x33cda0, row in r9)
0x006dbc5c mana_frame_copy  # (dec, desc, src): CRI Mana copies one decoded MPV (MPEG-1 / Sofdec.Prime) frame into the app planes; desc = 3 x {ptr, w, h, pitch} Y / U / V (hle_movie.cpp 4K swap)

```

`tools/recomp/test_a32.py`:

```py
"""Differential test: random A32/VFP/NEON instructions, our C translation vs Unicorn.

    python tools/recomp/test_a32.py [--n 400] [--seed 1] [--only class]
    python tools/recomp/test_a32.py --only game --link private/tms/link [--n 100000]

Class "game": every distinct VFP/NEON encoding in the linked image's code (main + sdk), not random ones.

Builds one test exe with every case (clang), runs it, compares registers/flags/memory with Unicorn.
"""
import argparse
import os
import random
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import a32  # noqa: E402
import vfp  # noqa: E402
from unicorn import UC_ARCH_ARM, UC_MODE_ARM, Uc, UcError  # noqa: E402
from unicorn import arm_const as U  # noqa: E402

CLANG = r"C:\Program Files\LLVM\bin\clang.exe"
ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..")
CODE = 0x1000
MEM = 0x10000       # data window the base registers point into
MEMSZ = 0x10000
REGS = [getattr(U, f"UC_ARM_REG_R{i}") for i in range(13)] + [U.UC_ARM_REG_SP, U.UC_ARM_REG_LR]


def rnd_cond(r):
    return 14 if r.random() < 0.6 else r.randrange(14)


def gen(cls, r):
    """Random encodings for one class; PC/SP are kept out of operands where they would branch or trash the stack."""
    c = rnd_cond(r) << 28
    reg = lambda: r.randrange(13)
    if cls == "dp_imm":
        return c | 0x02000000 | r.randrange(16) << 21 | r.randrange(2) << 20 | reg() << 16 | reg() << 12 | r.randrange(4096)
    if cls == "dp_reg":
        return c | r.randrange(16) << 21 | r.randrange(2) << 20 | reg() << 16 | reg() << 12 | r.randrange(32) << 7 | r.randrange(4) << 5 | reg()
    if cls == "dp_rsr":
        return c | r.randrange(16) << 21 | r.randrange(2) << 20 | reg() << 16 | reg() << 12 | reg() << 8 | r.randrange(4) << 5 | 0x10 | reg()
    if cls == "mul":
        op = r.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 4])
        rd, ra = r.sample(range(13), 2)
        return c | op << 20 | rd << 16 | ra << 12 | reg() << 8 | 0x90 | reg()
    if cls == "ldst":
        # base r0..r3 (pointed into MEM), rt r4..r12 different from base; offsets small
        rn, rt = r.randrange(4), r.randrange(4, 13)
        p, u, b, w, l = r.randrange(2), r.randrange(2), r.randrange(2), r.randrange(2), r.randrange(2)
        if not p:
            w = 0
        if r.random() < 0.5:
            return c | 0x04000000 | p << 24 | u << 23 | b << 22 | w << 21 | l << 20 | rn << 16 | rt << 12 | r.randrange(256)
        return c | 0x06000000 | p << 24 | u << 23 | b << 22 | w << 21 | l << 20 | rn << 16 | rt << 12 | r.randrange(4) << 7 | r.randrange(2) << 5 | r.randrange(4, 6)
    if cls == "acqrel":  # LDA/LDAB/LDAH, STL/STLB/STLH; base r0..r3 (into MEM, word aligned)
        rn, rt = r.randrange(4), r.randrange(4, 13)
        sz = r.choice([(0x01900C9F, 0x0180FC90), (0x01D00C9F, 0x01C0FC90), (0x01F00C9F, 0x01E0FC90)])
        return c | sz[0] | rn << 16 | rt << 12 if r.randrange(2) else c | sz[1] | rn << 16 | rt
    if cls == "ldst_extra":
        rn, rt = r.randrange(4), r.choice([4, 6, 8, 10])
        p, u, w = r.randrange(2), r.randrange(2), r.randrange(2)
        if not p:
            w = 0
        op2 = r.choice([1, 2, 3])
        l = r.randrange(2)
        imm = r.randrange(256)
        return c | p << 24 | u << 23 | 1 << 22 | w << 21 | l << 20 | rn << 16 | rt << 12 | (imm >> 4) << 8 | 0x90 | op2 << 5 | (imm & 0xF)
    if cls == "ldm":
        rn = r.randrange(4)
        lst = r.randrange(1, 1 << 13) & ~(1 << rn) | 0x10
        return c | 0x08000000 | r.randrange(2) << 24 | r.randrange(2) << 23 | r.randrange(2) << 21 | r.randrange(2) << 20 | rn << 16 | lst
    if cls == "media":
        f = r.choice(["ubfx", "sbfx", "bfi", "bfc", "ext", "rev", "sel", "ssat", "usat", "pkh", "div", "par", "smmul", "smlad"])
        rd, rn, rm = reg(), reg(), reg()
        if f in ("ubfx", "sbfx"):
            lsb = r.randrange(32)
            wm1 = r.randrange(32 - lsb)
            return c | (0x07E00050 if f == "ubfx" else 0x07A00050) | wm1 << 16 | rd << 12 | lsb << 7 | rm
        if f in ("bfi", "bfc"):
            lsb = r.randrange(32)
            msb = r.randrange(lsb, 32)
            return c | 0x07C00010 | msb << 16 | rd << 12 | lsb << 7 | (15 if f == "bfc" else rm)
        if f == "ext":
            o1 = r.choice([0b000, 0b010, 0b011, 0b100, 0b110, 0b111])
            return c | 0x06800070 | o1 << 20 | r.choice([rn, 15]) << 16 | rd << 12 | r.randrange(4) << 10 | rm
        if f == "rev":
            return c | r.choice([0x06BF0F30, 0x06BF0FB0, 0x06FF0F30, 0x06FF0FB0]) | rd << 12 | rm
        if f == "sel":
            return c | 0x06800FB0 | rn << 16 | rd << 12 | rm
        if f in ("ssat", "usat"):
            return c | (0x06A00010 if f == "ssat" else 0x06E00010) | r.randrange(32) << 16 | rd << 12 | r.randrange(32) << 7 | r.randrange(2) << 6 | rm
        if f == "pkh":
            return c | 0x06800010 | rn << 16 | rd << 12 | r.randrange(32) << 7 | r.randrange(2) << 6 | rm
        if f == "div":
            return c | r.choice([0x0710F010, 0x0730F010]) | rd << 16 | rm << 8 | rn
        if f == "par":
            return c | 0x06000F10 | r.choice([1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7]) << 20 | rn << 16 | rd << 12 | r.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7]) << 5 | rm
        if f == "smmul":
            return c | 0x07500010 | rd << 16 | r.choice([15, reg()]) << 12 | rm << 8 | r.randrange(2) << 5 | rn
        return c | 0x07000010 | rd << 16 | r.choice([15, reg()]) << 12 | rm << 8 | r.randrange(4) << 5 | rn
    if cls == "misc":
        f = r.choice(["clz", "mrs", "msr", "movw", "movt", "hmul", "qadd", "crc"])
        rd, rm = reg(), reg()
        if f == "clz":
            return c | 0x016F0F10 | rd << 12 | rm
        if f == "mrs":
            return c | 0x010F0000 | rd << 12
        if f == "msr":
            return c | 0x0128F000 | rm  # APSR_nzcvq
        if f in ("movw", "movt"):
            return c | (0x03000000 if f == "movw" else 0x03400000) | r.randrange(16) << 16 | rd << 12 | r.randrange(4096)
        if f == "hmul":
            return c | 0x01000080 | r.randrange(4) << 21 | rd << 16 | reg() << 12 | reg() << 8 | r.randrange(4) << 5 | rm
        if f == "qadd":
            return c | 0x01000050 | r.randrange(4) << 21 | reg() << 16 | rd << 12 | rm
        return c | 0x01000040 | r.randrange(3) << 21 | reg() << 16 | rd << 12 | r.randrange(2) << 9 | rm
    if cls == "vfp":
        f = r.choice(["arith", "arith_d", "cmp", "cvt", "mov", "unary"])
        d, n, m = r.randrange(32), r.randrange(32), r.randrange(32)
        sd = lambda x: ((x & 1) << 22 | (x >> 1) << 12)
        sn = lambda x: ((x >> 1) << 16 | (x & 1) << 7)
        sm = lambda x: ((x >> 1) | (x & 1) << 5)
        dd = lambda x: ((x >> 4) << 22 | (x & 15) << 12)
        dn = lambda x: ((x & 15) << 16 | (x >> 4) << 7)
        dm = lambda x: ((x & 15) | (x >> 4) << 5)
        if f == "arith":
            op = r.choice([0x0E000A00, 0x0E000A40, 0x0E100A00, 0x0E100A40, 0x0E200A00, 0x0E200A40, 0x0E300A00,
                           0x0E300A40, 0x0E800A00, 0x0EA00A00, 0x0EA00A40])
            return c | op | sd(d) | sn(n) | sm(m)
        if f == "arith_d":
            op = r.choice([0x0E000B00, 0x0E300B00, 0x0E300B40, 0x0E200B00, 0x0E800B00, 0x0E000B40])
            return c | op | dd(d) | dn(n) | dm(m)
        if f == "cmp":
            return c | r.choice([0x0EB40A40, 0x0EB40AC0]) | sd(d) | sm(m)
        if f == "cvt":
            op = r.choice([0x0EB80AC0, 0x0EB80A40, 0x0EBD0AC0, 0x0EBC0AC0])  # s32->f32, u32->f32, f32->s32, f32->u32
            return c | op | sd(d) | sm(m)
        if f == "mov":
            return c | 0x0EB00A40 | sd(d) | sm(m)
        return c | r.choice([0x0EB10A40, 0x0EB00AC0, 0x0EB10AC0]) | sd(d) | sm(m)  # vneg, vabs, vsqrt
    if cls == "neon":
        q = r.randrange(2)
        d, n, m = (r.randrange(16) & ~q) , (r.randrange(16) & ~q), (r.randrange(16) & ~q)
        op = r.choice([0xF2000800, 0xF3000800, 0xF2000110, 0xF2200110, 0xF3000110, 0xF2000D00, 0xF3000D10,
                       0xF2000D10, 0xF3000E00, 0xF2000F00, 0xF3200E00, 0xF2000900 | 0x10])
        sz = r.randrange(3) << 20 if op in (0xF2000800, 0xF3000800, 0xF2000900 | 0x10) else 0
        return op | sz | q << 6 | (d & 15) << 12 | (n & 15) << 16 | (m & 15)
    raise ValueError(cls)


CLASSES = ["dp_imm", "dp_reg", "dp_rsr", "mul", "ldst", "ldst_extra", "ldm", "acqrel", "media", "misc", "vfp", "neon", "game"]


def game_words(link):
    """Distinct VFP/NEON words in the image's text: coprocessor 10/11 (cond != 0xF), NEON data processing (0xF2/0xF3),
    NEON element load/store (0xF4)."""
    import json
    lay = json.load(open(os.path.join(link, "layout.json")))
    img = open(os.path.join(link, "image.bin"), "rb").read()
    base = lay["image_base"]
    seen = set()
    for m in lay["modules"]:
        s, e = m["text"]
        for w in struct.unpack_from(f"<{(e - s) // 4}I", img, s - base):
            top = w >> 24
            vfp_ = (w >> 28) != 0xF and ((w >> 25) & 7) in (6, 7) and ((w >> 9) & 7) == 5
            if vfp_ or top in (0xF2, 0xF3, 0xF4):
                seen.add(w)
    return sorted(seen)


def rnd_state(r, cls):
    regs = [r.getrandbits(32) for _ in range(15)]
    if cls == "game":  # loads/stores: every core register points into MEM (16-byte aligned); post-index adds stay inside
        for i in range(13):
            regs[i] = MEM + 0x4000 + r.randrange(0x4000) & ~15
    if cls in ("ldst", "ldst_extra", "ldm", "acqrel"):
        for i in range(4):
            regs[i] = MEM + 0x4000 + r.randrange(0x4000) & ~3
        if cls != "ldm":
            for i in range(4, 13):
                regs[i] = r.getrandbits(32)
            # register offsets used by the reg-offset forms are r4/r5: keep them small
            regs[4] = r.randrange(64)
            regs[5] = r.randrange(64)
    if r.random() < 0.3:
        for i in range(13):
            regs[i] = r.choice([0, 1, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0xFFFFFFFF, r.randrange(64), regs[i]])
    flags = r.randrange(16)
    vregs = []
    for _ in range(32):
        k = r.random()
        if k < 0.5:
            vregs.append(struct.unpack("<Q", struct.pack("<ff", r.uniform(-1000, 1000), r.uniform(-4, 4)))[0])
        elif k < 0.7:
            vregs.append(struct.unpack("<Q", struct.pack("<d", r.uniform(-1e6, 1e6)))[0])
        else:
            vregs.append(r.getrandbits(64))
    mem = bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(MEMSZ))
    ge = r.randrange(16)
    return regs, flags, vregs, mem, ge


def run_unicorn(w, regs, flags, vregs, mem, ge):
    uc = Uc(UC_ARCH_ARM, UC_MODE_ARM)
    uc.mem_map(CODE, 0x1000)
    uc.mem_map(MEM, MEMSZ)
    uc.mem_write(CODE, struct.pack("<I", w))
    uc.mem_write(MEM, mem)
    uc.reg_write(U.UC_ARM_REG_C1_C0_2, uc.reg_read(U.UC_ARM_REG_C1_C0_2) | (0xF << 20))
    uc.reg_write(U.UC_ARM_REG_FPEXC, 0x40000000)
    cpsr = uc.reg_read(U.UC_ARM_REG_CPSR) & 0x0000FFFF & ~0x1F | 0x10
    uc.reg_write(U.UC_ARM_REG_CPSR, cpsr | flags << 28 | ge << 16)  # mode first: SP/LR are banked
    for i, rr in enumerate(REGS):
        uc.reg_write(rr, regs[i])
    for i in range(32):
        uc.reg_write(getattr(U, f"UC_ARM_REG_D{i}"), vregs[i])
    try:
        uc.emu_start(CODE, CODE + 4, count=1)
    except UcError as e:
        return None
    if uc.reg_read(U.UC_ARM_REG_PC) != CODE + 4:
        return None
    out = [uc.reg_read(rr) for rr in REGS]
    cp = uc.reg_read(U.UC_ARM_REG_CPSR)
    fp = uc.reg_read(U.UC_ARM_REG_FPSCR) >> 28
    vo = [uc.reg_read(getattr(U, f"UC_ARM_REG_D{i}")) for i in range(32)]
    return out, cp >> 28, (cp >> 16) & 0xF, fp, vo, bytes(uc.mem_read(MEM, MEMSZ))


def c_case(k, ins):
    body = a32.cond_c_lines(ins) if hasattr(a32, "cond_c_lines") else None
    lines = list(ins.lines)
    if ins.cond != 14:
        lines = [f"if ({a32.COND_C[ins.cond]}) {{"] + lines + ["}"]
    return f"static void T{k}(Cpu* c) {{\n  " + "\n  ".join(lines) + "\n}\n"


HARNESS = r"""
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "guest.h"
GuestFn g_hooks[1];
void dispatch(Cpu* c, uint32_t t) { (void)c; (void)t; }
void guest_trap(Cpu* c, uint32_t a, const char* w) { (void)c; (void)a; (void)w; }
void guest_unimpl(Cpu* c, uint32_t a, uint32_t w) { (void)c; (void)a; (void)w; }
void guest_bad_branch(Cpu* c, uint32_t f, uint32_t t) { (void)c; (void)f; (void)t; }
void guest_noreturn(Cpu* c, uint32_t a) { (void)c; (void)a; }
void guest_svc(Cpu* c, uint32_t i, uint32_t a) { (void)c; (void)i; (void)a; }
void guest_yield(Cpu* c) { (void)c; }
uint32_t cp15_read(Cpu* c, int a, int b, int d, int e) { return 0; }
void cp15_write(Cpu* c, int a, int b, int d, int e, uint32_t v) { }
%CASES%
typedef void (*T)(Cpu*);
static T tests[] = { %LIST% };
static const uint32_t words[] = { %WORDS% };
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (!VirtualAlloc((void*)(GUEST_BASE + 0x10000), 0x10000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE)) return 2;
    if (!VirtualAlloc((void*)(GUEST_BASE + 0x1000), 0x1000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE)) return 2;  // code page (pc-relative loads)
    FILE* in = fopen(argv[1], "rb"); FILE* out = fopen(argv[2], "wb");
    for (int k = 0; k < (int)(sizeof tests / sizeof tests[0]); k++) {
        Cpu c; memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
        uint32_t regs[15], flags, ge; uint64_t v[32];
        fread(regs, 4, 15, in); fread(&flags, 4, 1, in); fread(&ge, 4, 1, in); fread(v, 8, 32, in);
        fread(GPTR(0x10000), 1, 0x10000, in);
        memcpy(c.r, regs, sizeof regs);
        c.n = flags >> 3 & 1; c.z = flags >> 2 & 1; c.cf = flags >> 1 & 1; c.v = flags & 1; c.ge = ge;
        memcpy(c.vr.x, v, sizeof v);
        if (getenv("T_TRACE")) { fprintf(stderr, "case %d ", k); fflush(stderr); }
        memset(GPTR(0x1000), 0, 0x1000); memcpy(GPTR(0x1000), &words[k], 4);
        tests[k](&c);
        flags = c.n << 3 | c.z << 2 | c.cf << 1 | c.v;
        uint32_t fp = c.fn << 3 | c.fz << 2 | c.fc << 1 | c.fv;
        fwrite(c.r, 4, 15, out); fwrite(&flags, 4, 1, out); fwrite(&c.ge, 4, 1, out); fwrite(&fp, 4, 1, out);
        fwrite(c.vr.x, 8, 32, out); fwrite(GPTR(0x10000), 1, 0x10000, out);
    }
    fclose(out);
    return 0;
}
"""


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=300)
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--only")
    ap.add_argument("--link", help="linked image dir (image.bin + layout.json), for class game")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    r = random.Random(a.seed)
    ctx = a32.Ctx(None)
    cases = []
    if a.only == "game":
        words = game_words(a.link)
        print(f"{len(words)} distinct VFP/NEON words in the image")
        for w in words[:a.n]:
            ins = a32.decode(CODE, w, ctx, vfp.decode)
            if ins is None or ins.kind != a32.SEQ or not ins.lines:
                continue
            for _ in range(2):
                st = rnd_state(r, "game")
                ref = run_unicorn(w, *st)
                if ref is not None:
                    cases.append(("game", w, ins, st, ref))
                    break
    for cls in ([a.only] if a.only and a.only != "game" else CLASSES[:-1] if not a.only else []):  # game: --only only
        made = 0
        tries = 0
        while made < a.n and tries < a.n * 20:
            tries += 1
            w = gen(cls, r) & 0xFFFFFFFF
            ins = a32.decode(CODE, w, ctx, vfp.decode)
            if ins is None or ins.kind != a32.SEQ or not ins.lines:
                continue
            st = rnd_state(r, cls)
            ref = run_unicorn(w, *st)
            if ref is None:
                continue
            cases.append((cls, w, ins, st, ref))
            made += 1
    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=os.path.join(ROOT, "private"))
    src = os.path.join(tmp, "t.c")
    with open(src, "w") as f:
        f.write(HARNESS.replace("%CASES%", "\n".join(c_case(k, x[2]) for k, x in enumerate(cases)))
                .replace("%LIST%", ", ".join(f"T{k}" for k in range(len(cases))))
                .replace("%WORDS%", ", ".join(f"0x{x[1]:08x}u" for x in cases)))
    exe = os.path.join(tmp, "t.exe")
    subprocess.run([CLANG, "-O1", "-w", "-ffp-contract=off", "-fwrapv", "-fno-strict-aliasing",
                    "-I", os.path.join(ROOT, "runtime", "include"), src, "-o", exe], check=True)
    with open(os.path.join(tmp, "in.bin"), "wb") as f:
        for _, _, _, (regs, flags, vregs, mem, ge), _ in cases:
            f.write(struct.pack("<15I", *regs) + struct.pack("<II", flags, ge) + struct.pack("<32Q", *vregs) + mem)
    rc = subprocess.run([exe, os.path.join(tmp, "in.bin"), os.path.join(tmp, "out.bin")]).returncode
    if rc:  # a case crashed: rerun with tracing to name it
        tr = subprocess.run([exe, os.path.join(tmp, "in.bin"), os.path.join(tmp, "out.bin")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                            env={**os.environ, "T_TRACE": "1"})
        k = int(tr.stderr.strip().split()[-1])
        print(f"case {k} crashed: {cases[k][1]:08x} {cases[k][2].text}")
        print(f"  C: {' '.join(cases[k][2].lines)[:400]}")
        regs = cases[k][3][0]
        print("  regs", " ".join(f"{x:#x}" for x in regs))
        sys.exit(1)
    data = open(os.path.join(tmp, "out.bin"), "rb").read()
    rec = 15 * 4 + 12 + 256 + MEMSZ
    bad = {}
    for k, (cls, w, ins, st, ref) in enumerate(cases):
        o = data[k * rec:(k + 1) * rec]
        regs = list(struct.unpack_from("<15I", o, 0))
        flags, ge, fp = struct.unpack_from("<III", o, 60)
        v = list(struct.unpack_from("<32Q", o, 72))
        mem = o[72 + 256:]
        rregs, rflags, rge, rfp, rv, rmem = ref
        diffs = []
        if regs != rregs:
            diffs.append("regs " + ", ".join(f"r{i}={regs[i]:#x} want {rregs[i]:#x}" for i in range(15) if regs[i] != rregs[i]))
        if flags != rflags:
            diffs.append(f"nzcv {flags:04b} want {rflags:04b}")
        if cls == "media" and ge != rge:
            diffs.append(f"ge {ge:04b} want {rge:04b}")
        if cls in ("vfp", "game") and "vcmp" in (ins.text or "") and fp != rfp:
            diffs.append(f"fpscr nzcv {fp:04b} want {rfp:04b}")
        if v != rv:
            for i in range(32):
                if v[i] != rv[i]:
                    # NaN payload / sign of NaN differences are not interesting
                    a_, b_ = struct.unpack("<ff", struct.pack("<Q", v[i])), struct.unpack("<ff", struct.pack("<Q", rv[i]))
                    if all((x != x and y != y) or x == y for x, y in zip(a_, b_)):
                        continue
                    da, db = struct.unpack("<d", struct.pack("<Q", v[i]))[0], struct.unpack("<d", struct.pack("<Q", rv[i]))[0]
                    if da != da and db != db:
                        continue
                    diffs.append(f"d{i}={v[i]:#018x} want {rv[i]:#018x}")
        if mem != rmem:
            diffs.append("memory")
        if diffs:
            bad.setdefault(cls, []).append((w, ins, diffs))
    total = len(cases)
    print(f"{total} cases, {sum(len(x) for x in bad.values())} mismatches")
    for cls in CLASSES:
        n = sum(1 for x in cases if x[0] == cls)
        b = bad.get(cls, [])
        print(f"  {cls:10s} {n:4d} cases, {len(b)} bad")
        if cls == "game":  # one example per mnemonic
            import collections
            byk = collections.OrderedDict()
            for x in b:
                byk.setdefault((x[1].text or "").split()[0], []).append(x)
            for k, xs in byk.items():
                print(f"     {k}: {len(xs)} bad")
            b = [xs[0] for xs in byk.values()]
        for w, ins, d in b[:6 if cls != "game" else 60]:
            print(f"     {w:08x} {ins.text or ''} :: {'; '.join(d)[:300]}")
            print(f"        C: {' '.join(ins.lines)[:300]}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/recomp/vfp.py`:

```py
"""VFP / NEON / ARMv8-AArch32 FP instructions -> C.

Operands come from Capstone, except NEON element loads/stores (VLDn/VSTn), decoded from the encoding here.
Register file in C: c->v (union): .f[n]/.w[n] = Sn, .d[n]/.x[n] = Dn, Qn = D(2n), D(2n+1).
Unknown forms return None (the lifter emits guest_unimpl, reported at run time and in the stats).
"""
import collections

from capstone import CS_ARCH_ARM, CS_MODE_ARM, Cs
from capstone import arm as A

import a32

_md = Cs(CS_ARCH_ARM, CS_MODE_ARM)
_md.detail = True
UNHANDLED = collections.Counter()

CT = {"i8": "uint8_t", "u8": "uint8_t", "s8": "int8_t", "8": "uint8_t", "p8": "uint8_t",
      "i16": "uint16_t", "u16": "uint16_t", "s16": "int16_t", "16": "uint16_t",
      "i32": "uint32_t", "u32": "uint32_t", "s32": "int32_t", "32": "uint32_t", "f32": "float",
      "i64": "uint64_t", "u64": "uint64_t", "s64": "int64_t", "64": "uint64_t", "f64": "double"}
SIZE = {"uint8_t": 1, "int8_t": 1, "uint16_t": 2, "int16_t": 2, "uint32_t": 4, "int32_t": 4, "float": 4,
        "uint64_t": 8, "int64_t": 8, "double": 8}
WIDER = {"uint8_t": "uint16_t", "int8_t": "int16_t", "uint16_t": "uint32_t", "int16_t": "int32_t",
         "uint32_t": "uint64_t", "int32_t": "int64_t"}
NARROW = {v: k for k, v in WIDER.items()}
UNS = {"int8_t": "uint8_t", "int16_t": "uint16_t", "int32_t": "uint32_t", "int64_t": "uint64_t"}
SGN = {v: k for k, v in UNS.items()}
GPR = {"sb": 9, "sl": 10, "fp": 11, "ip": 12, "sp": 13, "lr": 14, "pc": 15}


class R:
    """A register operand: kind in s/d/q/r, index n (d index for q), lane or None."""

    def __init__(self, name, lane=None):
        self.k = name[0] if name[0] in "sdq" and name[1:].isdigit() else "r"
        if self.k == "r":
            self.n = GPR.get(name, int(name[1:]) if name[1:].isdigit() else -1)
        else:
            self.n = int(name[1:]) * (2 if name[0] == "q" else 1)
        self.lane = lane
        self.name = name

    @property
    def nbytes(self):
        return {"s": 4, "d": 8, "q": 16, "r": 4}[self.k]

    def f(self):  # scalar float view
        return f"c->vr.f[{self.n}]" if self.k == "s" else f"c->vr.d[{self.n}]"

    def bits(self):
        return f"c->vr.w[{self.n}]" if self.k == "s" else f"c->vr.x[{self.n}]"

    def g(self, pc_addr):
        return f"0x{pc_addr:08x}u" if self.n == 15 else f"c->r[{self.n}]"

    def lanes(self, t):
        return f"(({t}*)&c->vr.x[{self.n}])"


def ops_of(i):
    out = []
    for o in i.operands:
        if o.type == A.ARM_OP_REG:
            vi = o.vector_index if o.vector_index != -1 else None
            out.append(R(i.reg_name(o.reg), vi))
        elif o.type == A.ARM_OP_IMM:
            out.append(("imm", o.imm & 0xFFFFFFFF))
        elif o.type == A.ARM_OP_FP:
            out.append(("fp", o.fp))
        elif o.type == A.ARM_OP_MEM:
            out.append(("mem", i.reg_name(o.mem.base), o.mem.disp, o.subtracted))
        else:
            out.append(("other", o.type))
    return out


def decode(addr, w):
    if (w >> 24) == 0xF4:  # NEON element/structure load-store
        return neon_ldst(addr, w)
    i = next(_md.disasm(w.to_bytes(4, "little"), addr), None)
    if i is None:
        UNHANDLED["<capstone fail>"] += 1
        return None
    mn = i.mnemonic
    base = i.insn_name()
    dt = mn.split(".", 1)[1] if "." in mn else ""
    try:
        lines = emit(i, base, dt, ops_of(i), addr, w)
    except (KeyError, IndexError, ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError) as e:
        lines = None
    if lines is None:
        UNHANDLED[f"{base}.{dt}" if dt else base] += 1
        return None
    ins = a32.Insn(addr, w, text=f"{mn} {i.op_str}")
    ins.lines = lines
    return ins


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- scalar

def fbin(op):
    return lambda d, a, b: f"{d.f()} = {a.f()} {op} {b.f()};"


def is_dbl(dt):
    return dt.endswith("f64") or dt == "f64"


def emit(i, base, dt, o, addr, w):
    vec = any(isinstance(x, R) and x.k == "q" for x in o) or (
        any(isinstance(x, R) and x.k == "d" for x in o) and not dt.startswith("f64") and base not in SCALAR_D_OK)
    if base in ("vldr", "vstr"):
        r, (_, rb, disp, sub) = o[0], o[1]
        rbn = GPR.get(rb, int(rb[1:]) if rb[1:].isdigit() else 0)
        pc = (addr + 8) & ~3
        a = f"0x{(pc + (-disp if sub else disp)) & 0xFFFFFFFF:08x}u" if rbn == 15 else \
            (f"(c->r[{rbn}] {'-' if sub else '+'} {disp}u)" if disp else f"c->r[{rbn}]")
        sz = "32" if r.k == "s" else "64"
        if base == "vldr":
            return [f"{r.bits()} = ld{sz}({a});"]
        return [f"st{sz}({a}, {r.bits()});"]
    if base in ("vpush", "vpop", "vldmia", "vldmdb", "vstmia", "vstmdb"):
        return vldm(i, base, o, w)
    if base in ("fconsts", "fconstd"):  # vmov.f32/.f64 #imm: VFPExpandImm(imm8)
        import struct
        imm8 = ((w >> 16) & 0xF) << 4 | (w & 0xF)
        a, b, rest = imm8 >> 7, (imm8 >> 6) & 1, imm8 & 0x3F
        if base == "fconsts":
            bits32 = (a << 31) | ((b ^ 1) << 30) | ((0x1F if b else 0) << 25) | (rest << 19)
            v = struct.unpack("<f", struct.pack("<I", bits32))[0]
            return [f"{o[0].f()} = {v!r}f;"]
        bits64 = (a << 63) | ((b ^ 1) << 62) | ((0xFF if b else 0) << 54) | (rest << 48)
        v = struct.unpack("<d", struct.pack("<Q", bits64))[0]
        return [f"{o[0].f()} = {v!r};"]
    if base == "fmstat":
        return ["c->n = c->fn; c->z = c->fz; c->cf = c->fc; c->v = c->fv;"]
    # vmov.32 dN[x], rT / rT, dN[x]: the word comes from the encoding (bit 21); Capstone's fmdhr/fmdlr (and
    # fmrdh/fmrdl) names are unreliable (measured: vmov.32 d0[0], r0 = ee000b10 came back as fmdhr)
    if base in ("fmdhr", "fmdlr"):
        d, r = o[0], o[1]
        return [f"((uint32_t*)&c->vr.x[{d.n}])[{scalar_lane(w)}] = c->r[{r.n}];"]
    if base in ("fmrdh", "fmrdl"):
        r, d = o[0], o[1]
        return [f"c->r[{r.n}] = ((uint32_t*)&c->vr.x[{d.n}])[{scalar_lane(w)}];"]
    if base == "vmvn" and any(isinstance(x, tuple) and x[0] == "imm" for x in o):
        imm = next(x[1] for x in o if isinstance(x, tuple) and x[0] == "imm")
        return vec_imm(o[0], dt, ~imm)
    if base == "vmrs":
        if o[0].name == "apsr_nzcv":
            return ["c->n = c->fn; c->z = c->fz; c->cf = c->fc; c->v = c->fv;"]
        return [f"c->r[{o[0].n}] = get_fpscr(c);"]
    if base == "vmsr":
        return [f"set_fpscr(c, c->r[{o[1].n}]);"]
    if base in ("vcmp", "vcmpe"):
        a = o[0]
        b = "0.0" if len(o) < 2 or not isinstance(o[1], R) else o[1].f()
        fn = "vfp_cmp_d" if is_dbl(dt) else "vfp_cmp_f"
        return [f"{fn}(c, {a.f()}, {b});"]
    if base == "vsel" or base.startswith("vsel"):
        cc = {"vseleq": "c->z", "vselge": "(c->n == c->v)", "vselgt": "(!c->z && c->n == c->v)", "vselvs": "c->v"}[
            base if base != "vsel" else i.mnemonic.split(".")[0]]
        d, n, m = o
        return [f"{d.f()} = {cc} ? {n.f()} : {m.f()};"]
    if base in ("vmaxnm", "vminnm") and not vec:
        d, n, m = o
        fn = ("fmax" if base == "vmaxnm" else "fmin") + ("" if is_dbl(dt) else "f")
        return [f"{d.f()} = {fn}({n.f()}, {m.f()});"]
    if base.startswith("vrint") and not vec:
        d, m = o
        mode = base[5:] or "r"
        suf = "" if is_dbl(dt) else "f"
        fn = {"m": "floor", "p": "ceil", "a": "round", "z": "trunc", "n": "nearbyint_even", "r": "rint", "x": "rint"}[mode]
        if fn == "nearbyint_even":
            return [f"{d.f()} = round_even{suf}({m.f()});"]
        return [f"{d.f()} = {fn}{suf}({m.f()});"]
    if base == "vmov":
        return vmov(i, dt, o, vec)
    if base == "vcvt" or base in ("vcvta", "vcvtn", "vcvtp", "vcvtm", "vcvtr"):
        dregs = any(isinstance(x, R) and x.k in "dq" for x in o)
        return vcvt(base, dt, o, dregs and "f64" not in dt)
    if not vec:
        return scalar_arith(base, dt, o)
    return neon(i, base, dt, o, w)


SCALAR_D_OK = {"vldr", "vstr", "vmov", "vcmp", "vcmpe", "vcvt", "vpush", "vpop", "vldmia", "vldmdb", "vstmia",
               "vstmdb", "vmrs", "vmsr", "vsel", "vseleq", "vselge", "vselgt", "vselvs"}


def scalar_arith(base, dt, o):
    if base in ("vadd", "vsub", "vmul", "vdiv"):
        d, a, b = o
        return [fbin({"vadd": "+", "vsub": "-", "vmul": "*", "vdiv": "/"}[base])(d, a, b)]
    if base in ("vmla", "vmls", "vnmla", "vnmls", "vnmul"):
        d, a, b = o
        p = f"({a.f()} * {b.f()})"
        e = {"vmla": f"{d.f()} + {p}", "vmls": f"{d.f()} - {p}", "vnmla": f"-{d.f()} - {p}",
             "vnmls": f"-{d.f()} + {p}", "vnmul": f"-{p}"}[base]
        return [f"{d.f()} = {e};"]
    if base in ("vfma", "vfms", "vfnma", "vfnms"):
        d, a, b = o
        f = "fma" if is_dbl(dt) else "fmaf"
        e = {"vfma": f"{f}({a.f()}, {b.f()}, {d.f()})", "vfms": f"{f}(-{a.f()}, {b.f()}, {d.f()})",
             "vfnma": f"{f}(-{a.f()}, {b.f()}, -{d.f()})", "vfnms": f"{f}({a.f()}, {b.f()}, -{d.f()})"}[base]
        return [f"{d.f()} = {e};"]
    if base in ("vneg", "vabs", "vsqrt"):
        d, a = o
        suf = "" if is_dbl(dt) else "f"
        e = {"vneg": f"-{a.f()}", "vabs": f"fabs{suf}({a.f()})", "vsqrt": f"sqrt{suf}({a.f()})"}[base]
        return [f"{d.f()} = {e};"]
    return None


def vldm(i, base, o, w):
    regs = [x for x in o if isinstance(x, R) and x.k in "sd"]
    if base in ("vpush", "vpop"):
        rn, wb = 13, True
        db = base == "vpush"
        load = base == "vpop"
    else:
        rn = o[0].n
        wb = i.writeback
        db = base.endswith("db")
        load = base.startswith("vld")
    sz = regs[0].nbytes
    total = sz * len(regs)
    lines = [f"{{ uint32_t a = c->r[{rn}]{f' - {total}u' if db else ''};"]
    for k, r in enumerate(regs):
        b = "32" if sz == 4 else "64"
        if load:
            lines.append(f"{r.bits()} = ld{b}(a + {k * sz});")
        else:
            lines.append(f"st{b}(a + {k * sz}, {r.bits()});")
    if wb:
        lines.append(f"c->r[{rn}] {'-' if db else '+'}= {total}u;")
    lines.append("}")
    return lines


def scalar_lane(w):
    """Lane of VMOV core <-> scalar from the encoding (opc1 = bits 22:21, opc2 = bits 6:5). Measured: Capstone's
    vector_index is wrong for these (vmov.32 d0[0], r0 came back as lane 1)."""
    opc1, opc2 = (w >> 21) & 3, (w >> 5) & 3
    if opc1 & 2:
        return (opc1 & 1) << 2 | opc2  # 8-bit
    if opc2 & 1:
        return (opc1 & 1) << 1 | opc2 >> 1  # 16-bit
    return opc1 & 1  # 32-bit


def vmov(i, dt, o, vec):
    w = i.bytes
    enc = int.from_bytes(w, "little")
    if len(o) == 2:
        d, s = o
        if isinstance(s, tuple):  # immediate
            if s[0] == "fp":
                if d.k == "s":
                    return [f"{d.f()} = {float(s[1])!r}f;"]
                if d.k == "d" and dt in ("f64",):
                    return [f"{d.f()} = {float(s[1])!r};"]
                return vec_imm(d, dt, s[1])
            return vec_imm(d, dt, s[1])
        if d.k == "r" and s.k == "s":
            return [f"c->r[{d.n}] = {s.bits()};"]
        if d.k == "s" and s.k == "r":
            return [f"{d.bits()} = c->r[{s.n}];"]
        if d.k == "s" and s.k == "s":
            return [f"{d.bits()} = {s.bits()};"]
        if d.k == "d" and s.k == "d" and d.lane is None and s.lane is None:
            return [f"{d.bits()} = {s.bits()};"]
        if d.k == "q" and s.k == "q":
            return [f"c->vr.x[{d.n}] = c->vr.x[{s.n}]; c->vr.x[{d.n + 1}] = c->vr.x[{s.n + 1}];"]
        if d.k == "r" and s.k == "d" and s.lane is not None:  # vmov.32/u16/s8 rN, dM[x]
            t = CT[dt] if dt else "uint32_t"
            ln = scalar_lane(enc)
            return [f"c->r[{d.n}] = (uint32_t)(int32_t){s.lanes(t)}[{ln}];" if t.startswith("int") else
                    f"c->r[{d.n}] = (uint32_t){s.lanes(t)}[{ln}];"]
        if d.k == "d" and d.lane is not None and s.k == "r":  # vmov.32 dM[x], rN
            t = CT[dt] if dt else "uint32_t"
            return [f"{d.lanes(t)}[{scalar_lane(enc)}] = ({t})c->r[{s.n}];"]
        return None
    if len(o) == 3:
        a, b, cc = o
        if a.k == "r" and b.k == "r" and cc.k == "d":  # vmov rA, rB, dM
            return [f"c->r[{a.n}] = (uint32_t){cc.bits()}; c->r[{b.n}] = (uint32_t)({cc.bits()} >> 32);"]
        if a.k == "d" and b.k == "r" and cc.k == "r":
            return [f"{a.bits()} = ((uint64_t)c->r[{cc.n}] << 32) | c->r[{b.n}];"]
        return None
    if len(o) == 4:
        a, b, cc, d = o
        if a.k == "r" and b.k == "r":  # vmov rA, rB, sM, sM+1
            return [f"c->r[{a.n}] = {cc.bits()}; c->r[{b.n}] = {d.bits()};"]
        return [f"{a.bits()} = c->r[{cc.n}]; {b.bits()} = c->r[{d.n}];"]
    return None


def vec_imm(d, dt, imm):
    """vmov/vmvn immediate into a d/q register: Capstone gives the expanded element value."""
    t = CT.get(dt, "uint32_t")
    if dt == "f32":
        import struct
        imm = struct.unpack("<I", struct.pack("<f", float(imm)))[0] if isinstance(imm, float) else imm
        t = "uint32_t"
    n = d.nbytes // SIZE[t]
    v = f"({t})0x{int(imm) & ((1 << (8 * SIZE[t])) - 1):x}u"
    return [f"{{ {t}* p_ = {d.lanes(t)}; for (int k = 0; k < {n}; k++) p_[k] = {v}; }}"]


def vcvt(base, dt, o, vec):
    if vec:
        return neon_cvt(base, dt, o)
    to, frm = dt.split(".")
    d, s = o[0], o[1]
    fbits = o[2][1] if len(o) > 2 and isinstance(o[2], tuple) else None
    if fbits is not None:  # fixed point, same register
        if to in ("f32", "f64"):
            src = f"(int32_t){s.bits()}" if frm.startswith("s") else f"{s.bits()}"
            if frm.endswith("16"):
                src = f"(int16_t){s.bits()}" if frm.startswith("s") else f"(uint16_t){s.bits()}"
            return [f"{d.f()} = ({'double' if to == 'f64' else 'float'}){src} / {float(1 << fbits)!r};"]
        fn = f"cvt_{'d' if frm == 'f64' else 'f'}2{to[0]}32"
        return [f"{d.bits()} = (uint32_t){fn}({s.f()} * {float(1 << fbits)!r});"]
    if to in ("f32", "f64") and frm in ("s32", "u32"):
        src = f"(int32_t){s.bits()}" if frm == "s32" else s.bits()
        return [f"{d.f()} = ({'double' if to == 'f64' else 'float'}){src};"]
    if to == "f64" and frm == "f32":
        return [f"{d.f()} = (double){s.f()};"]
    if to == "f32" and frm == "f64":
        return [f"{d.f()} = (float){s.f()};"]
    if to in ("s32", "u32") and frm in ("f32", "f64"):
        k = "d" if frm == "f64" else "f"
        mode = {"vcvt": "", "vcvtr": "_r", "vcvta": "_a", "vcvtn": "_n", "vcvtp": "_p", "vcvtm": "_m"}[base]
        return [f"{d.bits()} = (uint32_t)vcvt_{k}2{to[0]}32{mode}(c, {s.f()});"]
    if to == "f32" and frm == "f16":
        return None
    return None


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- NEON

def vloop(d, t, n, expr_fn, srcs, out_t=None):
    """Generic lane loop: r_[k] = expr(k) for k < n, then copy to d. srcs: list of (name, R, type)."""
    out_t = out_t or t
    decl = " ".join(f"const {st}* {nm} = {r.lanes(st)};" for nm, r, st in srcs)
    return [f"{{ {out_t} r_[{n}]; {decl} for (int k = 0; k < {n}; k++) r_[k] = {expr_fn('k')}; "
            f"memcpy(&c->vr.x[{d.n}], r_, sizeof r_); }}"]


def lane_or_k(r, nm, k):
    return f"{nm}[{r.lane}]" if r.lane is not None else f"{nm}[{k}]"


def neon(i, base, dt, o, w):
    regs = [x for x in o if isinstance(x, R)]
    d = regs[0]
    t = CT.get(dt.split(".")[0], "uint32_t") if dt else "uint64_t"
    n = d.nbytes // SIZE[t]
    imm = next((x[1] for x in o if isinstance(x, tuple) and x[0] == "imm"), None)
    if base in ("vadd", "vsub", "vmul", "vand", "vorr", "veor", "vbic", "vorn", "vmax", "vmin", "vqadd", "vqsub",
                "vmla", "vmls", "vtst", "vceq", "vcge", "vcgt", "vcle", "vclt", "vrecps", "vrsqrts", "vabd", "vshl",
                "vrshl", "vhadd", "vrhadd") and len(regs) == 3:
        a, b = regs[1], regs[2]
        bt = t
        if base in ("vand", "vorr", "veor", "vbic", "vorn"):
            t = bt = "uint64_t"
            n = d.nbytes // 8
        A_, B_, D_ = lane_or_k(a, "a_", "k"), lane_or_k(b, "b_", "k"), "d_[k]"
        mt = "uint32_t" if t == "float" else UNS.get(t, t)
        e = {"vadd": f"({t})({A_} + {B_})", "vsub": f"({t})({A_} - {B_})", "vmul": f"({t})({A_} * {B_})",
             "vand": f"{A_} & {B_}", "vorr": f"{A_} | {B_}", "veor": f"{A_} ^ {B_}", "vbic": f"{A_} & ~{B_}",
             "vorn": f"{A_} | ~{B_}",
             "vmax": (f"fmaxf_arm({A_}, {B_})" if t == "float" else f"({A_} > {B_} ? {A_} : {B_})"),
             "vmin": (f"fminf_arm({A_}, {B_})" if t == "float" else f"({A_} < {B_} ? {A_} : {B_})"),
             "vqadd": f"sat_add_{t}({A_}, {B_})", "vqsub": f"sat_sub_{t}({A_}, {B_})",
             "vmla": f"({t})({D_} + {A_} * {B_})", "vmls": f"({t})({D_} - {A_} * {B_})",
             "vabd": (f"fabsf({A_} - {B_})" if t == "float" else f"({t})({A_} > {B_} ? {A_} - {B_} : {B_} - {A_})"),
             "vhadd": f"({t})(((int64_t){A_} + {B_}) >> 1)", "vrhadd": f"({t})(((int64_t){A_} + {B_} + 1) >> 1)",
             "vtst": f"({mt})(({mt}){A_} & ({mt}){B_} ? -1 : 0)",
             "vceq": f"({mt})({A_} == {B_} ? -1 : 0)", "vcge": f"({mt})({A_} >= {B_} ? -1 : 0)",
             "vcgt": f"({mt})({A_} > {B_} ? -1 : 0)", "vcle": f"({mt})({A_} <= {B_} ? -1 : 0)",
             "vclt": f"({mt})({A_} < {B_} ? -1 : 0)",
             "vrecps": f"(2.0f - {A_} * {B_})", "vrsqrts": f"((3.0f - {A_} * {B_}) * 0.5f)",
             "vshl": f"neon_shl_{t}({A_}, (int8_t){B_})", "vrshl": f"neon_rshl_{t}({A_}, (int8_t){B_})"}[base]
        if base in ("vceq", "vcge", "vcgt", "vcle", "vclt", "vtst"):
            out = mt
        else:
            out = t
        srcs = [("a_", a, t), ("b_", b, t)]
        if base in ("vmla", "vmls"):
            srcs.append(("d_", d, t))
        return vloop(d, t, n, lambda k: e, srcs, out)
    if base in ("vbsl", "vbit", "vbif"):
        a, b = regs[1], regs[2]
        n = d.nbytes // 8
        e = {"vbsl": "(d_[k] & a_[k]) | (~d_[k] & b_[k])", "vbit": "(a_[k] & b_[k]) | (d_[k] & ~b_[k])",
             "vbif": "(d_[k] & b_[k]) | (a_[k] & ~b_[k])"}[base]
        return vloop(d, "uint64_t", n, lambda k: e, [("a_", a, "uint64_t"), ("b_", b, "uint64_t"), ("d_", d, "uint64_t")])
    if base in ("vceq", "vcge", "vcgt", "vcle", "vclt") and len(regs) == 2:  # compare with #0
        a = regs[1]
        mt = UNS.get(t, t) if t != "float" else "uint32_t"
        op = {"vceq": "==", "vcge": ">=", "vcgt": ">", "vcle": "<=", "vclt": "<"}[base]
        return vloop(d, t, n, lambda k: f"({mt})(a_[k] {op} 0 ? -1 : 0)", [("a_", a, t)], mt)
    if base in ("vneg", "vabs", "vmvn", "vcnt", "vrecpe", "vrsqrte", "vqabs", "vqneg") and len(regs) == 2:
        a = regs[1]
        if base == "vmvn":
            t, n = "uint64_t", d.nbytes // 8
        e = {"vneg": f"({t})-a_[k]", "vabs": (f"fabsf(a_[k])" if t == "float" else f"({t})(a_[k] < 0 ? -a_[k] : a_[k])"),
             "vmvn": "~a_[k]", "vcnt": "(uint8_t)__builtin_popcount(a_[k])",
             "vrecpe": "recip_est(a_[k])", "vrsqrte": "rsqrt_est(a_[k])",
             "vqabs": f"sat_abs_{t}(a_[k])", "vqneg": f"sat_neg_{t}(a_[k])"}[base]
        return vloop(d, t, n, lambda k: e, [("a_", a, t)])
    if base == "vdup":
        s = regs[1]
        if s.k == "r":
            return vloop(d, t, n, lambda k: f"({t})c->r[{s.n}]", [])
        return [f"{{ {t} v_ = {s.lanes(t)}[{s.lane}]; {t}* p_ = {d.lanes(t)}; for (int k = 0; k < {n}; k++) p_[k] = v_; }}"]
    if base in ("vshl", "vshr", "vsra", "vrshr", "vrsra", "vsli", "vsri") and imm is not None:
        a = regs[1]
        bitsz = 8 * SIZE[t]
        if base == "vshl":
            e = f"({t})(a_[k] << {imm})" if imm < bitsz else "0"
        elif base in ("vshr", "vsra"):
            e = f"({t})(a_[k] >> {min(imm, bitsz - 1) if t.startswith('int') else imm})" if imm < bitsz or t.startswith('int') else "0"
            if base == "vsra":
                e = f"({t})(d_[k] + {e})"
        elif base in ("vrshr", "vrsra"):
            e = f"({t})(((int64_t)a_[k] + ((int64_t)1 << {imm - 1})) >> {imm})" if t.startswith("int") else \
                f"({t})(((uint64_t)a_[k] + ((uint64_t)1 << {imm - 1})) >> {imm})"
            if base == "vrsra":
                e = f"({t})(d_[k] + {e})"
        elif base == "vsli":
            m = ((1 << bitsz) - 1) << imm & ((1 << bitsz) - 1)
            e = f"({t})((a_[k] << {imm}) | (d_[k] & ~({t})0x{m:x}u))"
        else:
            m = ((1 << bitsz) - 1) >> imm
            e = f"({t})((a_[k] >> {imm}) | (d_[k] & ~({t})0x{m:x}u))"
        srcs = [("a_", a, t)] + ([("d_", d, t)] if base in ("vsra", "vrsra", "vsli", "vsri") else [])
        return vloop(d, t, n, lambda k: e, srcs)
    if base in ("vmovl", "vshll"):
        a = regs[1]
        wt = WIDER[t] if t in WIDER else None
        nn = 16 // SIZE[wt]
        sh = imm or 0
        return vloop(d, wt, nn, lambda k: f"({wt})((({wt})a_[k]) << {sh})", [("a_", a, t)])
    if base in ("vmovn", "vqmovn", "vqmovun", "vshrn", "vrshrn", "vqshrn", "vqrshrn", "vqshrun", "vqrshrun"):
        a = regs[1]
        # dt is the source element type (i16 -> result i8) for vmovn/vshrn; for vq* forms it is the source too
        st = t
        if st in ("uint8_t", "int8_t"):
            return None
        nt = NARROW[st]
        nn = 8 // SIZE[nt]
        sh = imm or 0
        if base.startswith("vr") or base.startswith("vqr"):
            src = f"(((int64_t)a_[k] + ((int64_t)1 << {sh - 1})) >> {sh})" if sh else "a_[k]"
        else:
            src = f"((int64_t)a_[k] >> {sh})" if sh else "a_[k]"
        if base.startswith("vq"):
            out = UNS[nt] if base.endswith("un") and nt in UNS else nt
            e = f"sat_narrow_{out}((int64_t){src})"
        else:
            out = UNS.get(nt, nt)
            e = f"({out}){src}"
        return vloop(d, out, nn, lambda k: e, [("a_", a, st)])
    if base in ("vmull", "vmlal", "vmlsl", "vqdmull"):
        a, b = regs[1], regs[2]
        wt = WIDER[t]
        nn = 16 // SIZE[wt]
        p = f"(({wt}){lane_or_k(a, 'a_', 'k')} * ({wt}){lane_or_k(b, 'b_', 'k')})"
        e = {"vmull": p, "vmlal": f"({wt})(d_[k] + {p})", "vmlsl": f"({wt})(d_[k] - {p})",
             "vqdmull": f"({wt})(2 * {p})"}[base]
        srcs = [("a_", a, t), ("b_", b, t)] + ([("d_", d, wt)] if base in ("vmlal", "vmlsl") else [])
        return vloop(d, wt, nn, lambda k: e, srcs)
    if base == "vpadd":
        a, b = regs[1], regs[2]
        half = n // 2 if d.k == "d" else n
        if d.k != "d":
            return None
        e = f"(k < {n // 2} ? ({t})(a_[2*k] + a_[2*k+1]) : ({t})(b_[2*(k-{n // 2})] + b_[2*(k-{n // 2})+1]))"
        return vloop(d, t, n, lambda k: e, [("a_", a, t), ("b_", b, t)])
    if base in ("vpmax", "vpmin"):
        a, b = regs[1], regs[2]
        op = ">" if base == "vpmax" else "<"
        h = n // 2

        def pm(x, y):
            return f"({x} {op} {y} ? {x} : {y})"
        e = f"(k < {h} ? {pm('a_[2*k]', 'a_[2*k+1]')} : {pm(f'b_[2*(k-{h})]', f'b_[2*(k-{h})+1]')})"
        return vloop(d, t, n, lambda k: e, [("a_", a, t), ("b_", b, t)])
    if base == "vext":
        a, b = regs[1], regs[2]
        nb = d.nbytes
        sh = imm * SIZE[t]
        return [f"{{ uint8_t t_[{2 * nb}]; memcpy(t_, &c->vr.x[{a.n}], {nb}); memcpy(t_ + {nb}, &c->vr.x[{b.n}], {nb}); "
                f"memcpy(&c->vr.x[{d.n}], t_ + {sh}, {nb}); }}"]
    if base in ("vzip", "vuzp", "vtrn"):
        a, b = regs[0], regs[1]
        return [f"neon_{base[1:]}(c, {a.n}, {b.n}, {a.nbytes}, {SIZE[t]});"]
    if base in ("vrev16", "vrev32", "vrev64"):
        a = regs[1]
        grp = int(base[4:]) // 8 // SIZE[t]
        return vloop(d, t, n, lambda k: f"a_[(k / {grp}) * {grp} + ({grp - 1} - k % {grp})]", [("a_", a, t)])
    if base in ("vtbl", "vtbx"):
        dst, idx = regs[0], regs[-1]
        tbl = regs[1:-1]
        return [f"neon_tbl(c, {dst.n}, {tbl[0].n}, {len(tbl)}, {idx.n}, {1 if base == 'vtbx' else 0});"]
    if base == "vswp":
        a, b = regs[0], regs[1]
        nd = a.nbytes // 8
        return [f"{{ uint64_t t_[{nd}]; memcpy(t_, &c->vr.x[{a.n}], {a.nbytes}); memcpy(&c->vr.x[{a.n}], &c->vr.x[{b.n}], {a.nbytes}); "
                f"memcpy(&c->vr.x[{b.n}], t_, {a.nbytes}); }}"]
    return None


def neon_cvt(base, dt, o):
    regs = [x for x in o if isinstance(x, R)]
    d, a = regs[0], regs[1]
    to, frm = dt.split(".")
    n = d.nbytes // 4
    fb = next((x[1] for x in o if isinstance(x, tuple) and x[0] == "imm"), 0)
    sc = f" * {float(1 << fb)!r}f" if fb else ""
    dv = f" / {float(1 << fb)!r}f" if fb else ""
    if to == "f32" and frm == "s32":
        return vloop(d, "float", n, lambda k: f"(float)a_[k]{dv}", [("a_", a, "int32_t")])
    if to == "f32" and frm == "u32":
        return vloop(d, "float", n, lambda k: f"(float)a_[k]{dv}", [("a_", a, "uint32_t")])
    if to == "s32" and frm == "f32":
        return vloop(d, "int32_t", n, lambda k: f"cvt_f2s32(a_[k]{sc})", [("a_", a, "float")])
    if to == "u32" and frm == "f32":
        return vloop(d, "uint32_t", n, lambda k: f"cvt_f2u32(a_[k]{sc})", [("a_", a, "float")])
    return None


def neon_ldst(addr, w):
    """VLD1-4 / VST1-4: multiple structures, single lane, all lanes. Encoding from the ARM ARM."""
    load = (w >> 21) & 1
    rn = (w >> 16) & 0xF
    rm = w & 0xF
    dd = ((w >> 22) & 1) << 4 | (w >> 12) & 0xF
    ins = a32.Insn(addr, w, text="vldst")
    if (w >> 23) & 1 == 0:  # multiple structures
        typ = (w >> 8) & 0xF
        size = (w >> 6) & 3
        table = {0b0111: (1, 1, 1), 0b1010: (1, 1, 2), 0b0110: (1, 1, 3), 0b0010: (1, 1, 4),
                 0b1000: (2, 1, 1), 0b1001: (2, 2, 1), 0b0011: (2, 2, 2),
                 0b0100: (3, 1, 1), 0b0101: (3, 2, 1), 0b0000: (4, 1, 1), 0b0001: (4, 2, 1)}
        if typ not in table:
            UNHANDLED["vldst bad type"] += 1
            return None
        nst, inc, regs = table[typ]
        esz = 1 << size
        total = 8 * nst * regs
        call = f"neon_ldst_multi(c, a_, {dd}, {nst}, {inc}, {regs}, {esz}, {load});"
    else:
        size = (w >> 10) & 3
        nst = ((w >> 8) & 3) + 1
        if size == 3:  # all lanes
            esz = 1 << ((w >> 6) & 3)
            t = (w >> 5) & 1
            if nst == 1:
                call = f"neon_ld_all(c, a_, {dd}, 1, 1, {esz}, {t + 1});"
            else:
                call = f"neon_ld_all(c, a_, {dd}, {nst}, {t + 1}, {esz}, 1);"
            total = nst * esz
            if not load:
                UNHANDLED["vst all lanes"] += 1
                return None
        else:
            esz = 1 << size
            ia = (w >> 4) & 0xF
            if size == 0:
                idx, inc = ia >> 1, 1
            elif size == 1:
                idx, inc = ia >> 2, 2 if ia & 2 else 1
            else:
                idx, inc = ia >> 3, 2 if ia & 4 else 1
            call = f"neon_ldst_lane(c, a_, {dd}, {nst}, {inc}, {esz}, {idx}, {load});"
            total = nst * esz
    wb = "" if rm == 15 else (f" c->r[{rn}] += {total}u;" if rm == 13 else f" c->r[{rn}] += c->r[{rm}];")
    ins.lines = [f"{{ uint32_t a_ = c->r[{rn}]; {call}{wb} }}"]
    return ins

```

`tools/setup/build_game.py`:

```py
"""Compile the lifted game code (lift.py output) into game.dll, next to tms.exe.

    python tools/setup/build_game.py --gen <lift.py out dir> --obj <obj dir> --out <game.dll>
        --include <dir with guest.h> --lib <tms.lib> --lib <crt_math.lib> --lib <vcruntime.lib> --def <game.def>
        [--clang clang.exe] [--lld lld-link.exe] [-j N]

Linux: the same with --out <game.so> and no --lib / --def. It needs clang and lld (ld.lld) and links against the libc /
libm that tms already loads; the runtime functions come from tms itself (built with -rdynamic).

One script, two callers: the dev build (CMakeLists.txt) and the player's first-run setup (setup.py), so both build
game.dll the same way. Needs only clang + lld-link: no C library headers or Windows SDK (guest.h NX_GAME_DLL). Objects
are rebuilt only when their .c, a header or this script is newer. Progress on stdout: "compile i/n name", "link".
"""
import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import os
import subprocess
import sys

# same code generation as the old static build (CMake RelWithDebInfo + NX_GEN_OPT): -O1, guest float semantics
LINUX = sys.platform.startswith("linux")
CFLAGS = ["--target=x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "-std=gnu11", "-O1", "-g", "-gcodeview", "-DNDEBUG", "-DNX_GAME_DLL",
          "-nostdinc", "-ffp-contract=off", "-fwrapv", "-fno-strict-aliasing", "-w"]
if LINUX:
    # a shared library: position independent, only table.c's tables exported (guest.h), unwind tables so the
    # runtime's C++ exceptions (thread exit) and longjmp pass through the generated frames
    CFLAGS = ["--target=x86_64-linux-gnu", "-std=gnu11", "-O1", "-DNDEBUG", "-DNX_GAME_DLL", "-nostdinc", "-fPIC",
              "-fvisibility=hidden", "-funwind-tables", "-ffp-contract=off", "-fwrapv", "-fno-strict-aliasing", "-w"]


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--gen", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--obj", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--include", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--lib", action="append", default=[])
    ap.add_argument("--def", dest="deffile", required=not LINUX)
    ap.add_argument("--clang", default="clang")
    ap.add_argument("--lld", default="ld.lld" if LINUX else "lld-link")
    ap.add_argument("-j", type=int, default=os.cpu_count() or 4)
    a = ap.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(a.obj, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(a.gen, "files.txt")) as f:
        sources = [os.path.join(a.gen, l.strip()) for l in f if l.strip()]
    if not LINUX:
        stub = os.path.join(a.obj, "fltused.c")  # the marker symbol the MSVC CRT normally defines for float code
        if not os.path.exists(stub):
            with open(stub, "w") as f:
                f.write("int _fltused = 0x9875;\n")
        sources.append(stub)
    deps = [os.path.join(a.include, "guest.h"), os.path.join(a.gen, "funcs.h"), os.path.abspath(__file__)]
    newest_dep = max(os.path.getmtime(d) for d in deps)

    def obj_of(src):
        return os.path.join(a.obj, os.path.basename(src) + (".o" if LINUX else ".obj"))

    def stale(src):
        o = obj_of(src)
        return not os.path.exists(o) or os.path.getmtime(o) < max(os.path.getmtime(src), newest_dep)

    todo = [s for s in sources if stale(s)]
    # biggest files first: the long ones start early, the pool stays full at the end
    todo.sort(key=os.path.getsize, reverse=True)

    def compile_one(src):
        o = obj_of(src)
        r = subprocess.run([a.clang, *CFLAGS, "-I", a.include, "-I", a.gen, "-c", src, "-o", o + ".part"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        if r.returncode:
            return src, r.stdout + r.stderr
        os.replace(o + ".part", o)  # a cancelled or failed compile never leaves a half object that looks current
        return src, None

    failed = []
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max(1, a.j)) as ex:
        for i, (src, err) in enumerate(ex.map(compile_one, todo), 1):
            print(f"compile {i}/{len(todo)} {os.path.basename(src)}", flush=True)
            if err:
                failed.append(src)
                print(err, flush=True)
    if failed:
        sys.exit(f"build_game: {len(failed)} file(s) failed to compile")

    objs = [obj_of(s) for s in sources]
    inputs = objs + a.lib + ([a.deffile] if a.deffile else [])
    if os.path.exists(a.out) and os.path.getmtime(a.out) >= max(os.path.getmtime(p) for p in inputs):
        print("game.dll up to date", flush=True)
        return
    print("link", flush=True)
    out_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(a.out))
    part = os.path.join(out_dir, "game.part.so" if LINUX else "game.part.dll")
    rsp = os.path.join(a.obj, "link.rsp")  # 40+ long paths: a response file keeps the command line short
    with open(rsp, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(f'"{p}"' for p in objs + a.lib) + "\n")
    if LINUX:
        # no libraries at all: the few C library functions (math, _setjmp) and the runtime's entry points bind when tms
        # loads game.so, to what tms itself uses, so game.so asks for no particular glibc version
        lld = a.lld if os.path.dirname(a.lld) else None
        cmd = [a.clang, "--target=x86_64-linux-gnu", "-shared", "-nostdlib", "-Wl,-O1", "-Wl,--gc-sections",
               "-Wl,-z,noexecstack", "-o", part, f"@{rsp}"]
        cmd.insert(1, f"--ld-path={lld}" if lld else "-fuse-ld=lld")
        if subprocess.run(cmd).returncode:
            sys.exit("build_game: link failed")
        os.replace(part, a.out)
        print(f"wrote {a.out}", flush=True)
        return
    r = subprocess.run([a.lld, "/nologo", "/DLL", "/NOENTRY", "/NODEFAULTLIB", "/MACHINE:X64", "/DEBUG",
                        f"/DEF:{a.deffile}", f"/OUT:{part}", f"/PDB:{os.path.splitext(a.out)[0]}.pdb",
                        f"/IMPLIB:{os.path.join(a.obj, 'game.lib')}", f"@{rsp}"])
    if r.returncode:
        sys.exit("build_game: link failed")
    os.replace(part, a.out)
    print(f"wrote {a.out}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/setup/nx_vcruntime.def`:

```def
; setjmp + memcpy/memset for the recompiled code (guest.h NX_GAME_DLL): VCRUNTIME140.dll names setjmp __intrinsic_setjmp
LIBRARY VCRUNTIME140.dll
EXPORTS
    _setjmp == __intrinsic_setjmp
    memcpy
    memset

```

`tools/setup/setup.py`:

```py
"""First-run setup: make the game data folder and game.dll from the player's OWN game files (plan phase 2).

    python setup.py --nsp <game.nsp> --keys <prod.keys> --data <new data folder> [--no-shaders]
    python setup.py --folder <folder with exefs\\ and romfs\\> [--no-shaders]
    python setup.py --dlss-only      (only the optional NVIDIA DLSS download; --dlss adds it to a full setup)

Linux: the same steps with tools from the system (clang + lld, nstool, dotnet or a self-contained NxShader): game.so
next to tms (--install, default as on Windows), nstool from --nstool, <setup>/nstool or PATH. No DLSS download.

Release layout (tools/package/package.ps1 -Setup): <install>\\tms.exe, <install>\\shaderc\\, and <install>\\setup\\ with
python\\, llvm\\ (clang.exe, lld-link.exe), nstool.exe, sdk\\ (guest.h, tms.lib, CRT import libs, game.def) and tools\\
(this folder's siblings, same layout as the repo's tools\\). Nothing of the game is shipped: every step runs here.

Steps: extract the program NCA (NSP only) -> check the game version -> link.py -> lift.py -> build_game.py (game.dll
next to tms.exe) -> shaderscan.py (all shaders into <data>\\cache\\shaders.bin). A finished step leaves a marker in
<data>\\setup\\, so a cancelled or failed run continues where it stopped. The launcher reads stdout:
"STEP i n text", "PROGRESS done total", "DATA <folder>", "ERROR text", "DONE".
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import urllib.request

LINUX = sys.platform.startswith("linux")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
TOOLS = os.path.dirname(HERE)
SETUP_ROOT = os.path.dirname(TOOLS)
INSTALL = os.path.dirname(SETUP_ROOT)

# The hooks use fixed addresses of this exact build: Tokyo Mirage Sessions #FE Encore, title 0100A9400C9C2000,
# base game (no update). Other builds need their own address tables.
SUPPORTED = {
    "main": "4f097186eb73edc5fdc9f804393a82c42d35e803f5c59fcddcac002bc77aa113",
    "sdk": "4fe101e041c3018dde03cd7efd31a4d53397ce7bb5745a359def874c90a546ce",
}
SUPPORTED_TEXT = "Tokyo Mirage Sessions #FE Encore, title 0100A9400C9C2000, base game without update"


# NVIDIA DLSS (optional, the player ticks it on the Setup page): the release holds nothing of NVIDIA, this downloads NVIDIA's
# own signed nvngx_dlss.dll from NVIDIA's DLSS repository to the player's PC, pinned and hash-checked. The driver's NGX loads
# it from the folder of tms.exe (runtime/src/vk_dlss.cpp). NVIDIA's licence applies to that file.
DLSS_DLL = "nvngx_dlss.dll"
DLSS_VERSION = "310.9.16"
DLSS_URL = f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/DLSS/v{DLSS_VERSION}/lib/Windows_x86_64/rel/{DLSS_DLL}"
DLSS_SIZE = 58956912
DLSS_SHA256 = "d00b5b0ab29c3ca101b70c3a5ecb3a01b7ef33766a3383a28a18623083e6123e"


def has_rtx():
    r = subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", "(Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController).Name"],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
    return any("NVIDIA" in n.upper() and "RTX" in n.upper() for n in r.stdout.splitlines())


def get_dlss(install):
    """Never fails the setup: the game runs without DLSS (FSR 3 then). A DLSS file the player put there is kept."""
    target = os.path.join(install, DLSS_DLL)
    if os.path.isfile(target):
        say("dlss: nvngx_dlss.dll is already there, kept")
        return
    if not has_rtx():
        say("dlss: no NVIDIA RTX GPU found, nothing downloaded")
        return
    part = target + ".part"
    try:
        say("dlss:", DLSS_URL)
        h, done = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(DLSS_URL, timeout=60) as r, open(part, "wb") as f:
            while block := r.read(1 << 20):
                f.write(block)
                h.update(block)
                done += len(block)
                say("PROGRESS", done, DLSS_SIZE)
        if done != DLSS_SIZE or h.hexdigest() != DLSS_SHA256:
            raise OSError(f"{done} bytes, sha256 {h.hexdigest()[:16]}: not the expected file")
        os.replace(part, target)
    except Exception as e:  # any network or file error: warn only
        if os.path.exists(part):
            os.remove(part)
        say("dlss: download failed:", str(e)[:300], "(the game runs without DLSS)")


def say(*parts):
    print(*parts, flush=True)


def fail(msg):
    say("ERROR", msg)
    sys.exit(1)


def run(cmd, what, progress=False):
    """Run a tool; pass its "compile i/n" lines on as PROGRESS, keep the rest for the error message."""
    p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, errors="replace")
    tail = []
    for line in p.stdout:
        line = line.rstrip()
        if progress and line.startswith("compile ") and "/" in line:
            i, n = line.split()[1].split("/")
            say("PROGRESS", i, n)
        tail = (tail + [line])[-20:]
    if p.wait():
        fail(f"{what} failed:\n" + "\n".join(tail))


def sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()


def dir_size(d):
    n = 0
    for root, _, files in os.walk(d):
        for f in files:
            try:
                n += os.path.getsize(os.path.join(root, f))
            except OSError:
                pass
    return n


def watch_size(paths, total, stop):
    """PROGRESS from the bytes written so far (nstool prints none)."""
    while not stop.wait(1.0):
        say("PROGRESS", sum(dir_size(p) if os.path.isdir(p) else os.path.getsize(p) if os.path.exists(p) else 0
                            for p in paths) >> 20, total >> 20)


def extract_nsp(nstool, keys, nsp, data):
    tmp = os.path.join(data, "setup", "nca")
    if not os.path.isdir(tmp):
        # the whole NSP (nstool's single-file -x fails on Windows paths); all NCAs but the program one are small.
        # Into nca.part first: a cancelled copy is never taken for a finished one.
        say("STEP", 1, 6, "Copying the game out of the NSP")
        part = tmp + ".part"
        shutil.rmtree(part, ignore_errors=True)
        stop = threading.Event()
        t = threading.Thread(target=watch_size, args=([part], os.path.getsize(nsp), stop))
        t.start()
        r = subprocess.run([nstool, "-k", keys, "-x", "/", part, nsp], capture_output=True, text=True, errors="replace")
        stop.set(), t.join()
        if not os.path.isdir(part) or not any(n.endswith(".nca") for n in os.listdir(part)):
            fail("nstool could not read the NSP (is it a Switch NSP?). nstool said:\n" + (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-1500:])
        os.replace(part, tmp)
    # the program NCA (code + romfs) is by far the biggest
    sizes = {n: os.path.getsize(os.path.join(tmp, n)) for n in os.listdir(tmp)
             if n.endswith(".nca") and not n.endswith(".cnmt.nca")}
    prog = os.path.join(tmp, max(sizes, key=sizes.get))
    # eShop-style NSPs: NCAs encrypted with a title key whose ticket (.tik) is in the NSP. nstool does not take it from
    # there by itself (title.keys it reads only next to prod.keys), so give it the ticket. No ticket: standard crypto.
    tik = sorted(n for n in os.listdir(tmp) if n.lower().endswith(".tik"))
    tik = ["--tik", os.path.join(tmp, tik[0])] if tik else []
    for part, sub in (("/0", "exefs"), ("/1", "romfs")):
        dst = os.path.join(data, sub)
        shutil.rmtree(dst, ignore_errors=True)
        say("STEP", 1, 6, f"Extracting {sub} (needs prod.keys)")
        stop = threading.Event()
        t = threading.Thread(target=watch_size, args=([dst], os.path.getsize(prog) if sub == "romfs" else 1 << 20, stop))
        t.start()
        r = subprocess.run([nstool, "-k", keys] + tik + ["-x", part, dst, prog], capture_output=True, text=True, errors="replace")
        stop.set(), t.join()
        if not os.path.isdir(dst) or not os.listdir(dst):
            fail(f"nstool could not extract {sub}: wrong or old prod.keys"
                 + ("" if tik else ", or the NSP needs a title key (no ticket inside: put title.keys next to prod.keys)")
                 + "? nstool said:\n" + (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-1500:])
    get_icon(nstool, keys, tmp, [n for n in sizes if os.path.join(tmp, n) != prog], data, tik)
    shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)


def get_icon(nstool, keys, tmp, ncas, data, tik=()):
    """The game's own icon from the control NCA -> <data>/icon.jpg (the launcher makes the window icons from it).
    Optional: any failure only means the default icon. An extracted folder has no control NCA: the launcher then crops
    one from the title screen picture the game saves on its first start."""
    try:
        for n in sorted(ncas, key=lambda n: os.path.getsize(os.path.join(tmp, n))):
            d = os.path.join(tmp, "control")
            shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
            subprocess.run([nstool, "-k", keys, *tik, "-x", "/", d, os.path.join(tmp, n)], capture_output=True, text=True,
                           errors="replace", timeout=120)
            for root, _, files in os.walk(d):
                icons = sorted(f for f in files if f.startswith("icon_") and f.endswith(".dat"))
                if icons:
                    pick = "icon_AmericanEnglish.dat" if "icon_AmericanEnglish.dat" in icons else icons[0]
                    shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(root, pick), os.path.join(data, "icon.jpg"))
                    say("icon: from", n, pick)
                    return
        say("icon: no control NCA with an icon")
    except Exception as e:
        say("icon: none (" + str(e)[:200] + ")")


# ---- launcher Guide page: optional extras, each into the data folder (never into romfs: the game files stay as dumped)
def install_mod(src, data):
    """A mod folder: .xdelta patches against the game's .cpk files (pack_000_map ... .xdelta, the usual Switch patch
    layout) -> <data>\\mods\\<folder name>\\romfs\\Pack\\<cpk>; or a folder that already holds romfs\\ -> copied."""
    name = os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(src))
    dst = os.path.join(data, "mods", name)
    if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(src, "romfs")):
        say("STEP", 1, 1, f"Copying mod {name}")
        shutil.copytree(os.path.join(src, "romfs"), os.path.join(dst, "romfs"), dirs_exist_ok=True)
        return
    pack = os.path.join(data, "romfs", "Pack")
    cpks = sorted((n[:-4] for n in os.listdir(pack) if n.endswith(".cpk")), key=len, reverse=True)
    patches = sorted(n for n in os.listdir(src) if n.lower().endswith(".xdelta"))
    if not patches:
        fail(f"{src} has no .xdelta files and no romfs folder: pick the folder you unpacked the patch into")
    plan = []
    for p in patches:
        cpk = next((c for c in cpks if p.lower().startswith(c.lower())), None)  # longest name first
        if not cpk:
            fail(f"{p}: no game archive matches its name (expected it to start with one of {', '.join(sorted(cpks))})")
        plan.append((p, cpk))
    if len({c for _, c in plan}) != len(plan):
        fail("two patches are for the same game archive: keep only one per archive in the folder")
    sys.path.insert(0, TOOLS)
    import vcdiff
    out_dir = os.path.join(dst, "romfs", "Pack")
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    for i, (p, cpk) in enumerate(plan, 1):
        say("STEP", i, len(plan), f"Patching {cpk}.cpk")
        out = os.path.join(out_dir, cpk + ".cpk")
        try:
            vcdiff.apply(os.path.join(pack, cpk + ".cpk"), os.path.join(src, p), out + ".part",
                         progress=lambda done, total: say("PROGRESS", done, total))
        except (ValueError, OSError) as e:
            if os.path.exists(out + ".part"):
                os.remove(out + ".part")
            fail(f"{p}: {e}")
        os.replace(out + ".part", out)
    # A newer version of a patch replaces the older one (user 11-24): other mods that are nothing but patched archives,
    # all of them archives this install just wrote, are deleted. Mods with anything else (textures, other files) stay.
    mine = {c.lower() + ".cpk" for _, c in plan}
    mods = os.path.join(data, "mods")
    for other in sorted(os.listdir(mods)):
        od = os.path.join(mods, other)
        if other == name or not os.path.isdir(od):
            continue
        files = [os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r, n), od).lower() for r, _, ns in os.walk(od) for n in ns]
        packed = {os.path.basename(f) for f in files if os.path.dirname(f) == os.path.join("romfs", "pack")}
        if files and len(packed) == len(files) and packed <= mine:
            say("STEP", 1, 1, f"Removing the older patch {other}")
            shutil.rmtree(od)


def install_zip(z, data):
    """A TMSRecomp extra ZIP (UHD textures: textures\\pack, 4K movies: movie_hd\\) unpacked into the data folder."""
    import zipfile
    with zipfile.ZipFile(z) as f:
        items = [i for i in f.infolist() if not i.is_dir() and not os.path.basename(i.filename).upper().startswith("README")]
        if not items or any(not i.filename.startswith(("textures/pack/", "movie_hd/")) or ".." in i.filename for i in items):
            fail(f"{os.path.basename(z)} is not a TMSRecomp UHD or MovieHD ZIP")
        total, done = sum(i.file_size for i in items), 0
        need = total - sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(data, i.filename)) for i in items if os.path.exists(os.path.join(data, i.filename)))
        if shutil.disk_usage(data).free < need + (1 << 30):
            fail(f"not enough disk space: {need >> 30} GB needed, {shutil.disk_usage(data).free >> 30} GB free")
        say("STEP", 1, 1, f"Unpacking {os.path.basename(z)}")
        import time
        for i in items:
            out = os.path.join(data, i.filename)
            stamp = time.mktime(i.date_time + (0, 0, -1))
            # a re-run continues: same size and the ZIP's own time = this file (size alone kept old files of a new pack)
            if not (os.path.exists(out) and os.path.getsize(out) == i.file_size and abs(os.path.getmtime(out) - stamp) < 3):
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
                with f.open(i) as s, open(out + ".part", "wb") as d:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(s, d, 1 << 22)
                os.replace(out + ".part", out)
                os.utime(out, (stamp, stamp))
            done += i.file_size
            say("PROGRESS", done >> 20, total >> 20)
        # a newer pack replaces the older one: its files the new ZIP no longer has are deleted (only in the folders it fills)
        keep = {os.path.normcase(os.path.join(data, i.filename)) for i in items}
        for top in {i.filename.split("/")[0] + "/" + i.filename.split("/")[1] for i in items if i.filename.count("/") >= 2}:
            for r, _, ns in os.walk(os.path.join(data, top)):
                for n in ns:
                    p = os.path.join(r, n)
                    if os.path.normcase(p) not in keep and not n.upper().startswith("README"):
                        os.remove(p)


def install_music(src, data):
    """Every .adx below the folder -> <data>\\music (custom battle music, ext_bgm.cpp)."""
    files = [os.path.join(r, n) for r, _, ns in os.walk(src) for n in ns if n.lower().endswith(".adx")]
    if not files:
        fail(f"{src} has no .adx files")
    dst = os.path.join(data, "music")
    os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
    say("STEP", 1, 1, f"Copying {len(files)} music files")
    for k, p in enumerate(files, 1):
        shutil.copy2(p, os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(p)))
        say("PROGRESS", k, len(files))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--nsp")
    ap.add_argument("--keys")
    ap.add_argument("--folder", help="already extracted game: becomes the data folder")
    ap.add_argument("--data", help="new data folder (NSP mode)")
    ap.add_argument("--install", default=INSTALL, help="folder with tms.exe (game.dll is written there)")
    ap.add_argument("--no-shaders", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--dlss", action="store_true", help="also download NVIDIA's nvngx_dlss.dll (RTX GPUs)")
    ap.add_argument("--dlss-only", action="store_true", help="only that download")
    ap.add_argument("--mod", help="extra: mod folder (.xdelta patches or romfs\\) -> <data>\\mods\\<folder name>")
    ap.add_argument("--zip", help="extra: TMSRecomp UHD / MovieHD ZIP -> unpacked into <data>")
    ap.add_argument("--music", help="extra: folder with .adx battle music -> <data>\\music")
    ap.add_argument("--nstool", help="nstool program (default: next to this setup, else on PATH)")
    ap.add_argument("--clang", help="Linux: clang (default: on PATH)")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if LINUX and (a.dlss or a.dlss_only):
        say("dlss: not available on Linux")
        a.dlss = False
        if a.dlss_only:
            say("DONE")
            return
    for arg, f in ((a.mod, install_mod), (a.zip, install_zip), (a.music, install_music)):
        if arg:
            if not (a.data and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(a.data, "romfs"))):
                fail("set up the game first (the extras go into its game files folder)")
            f(os.path.abspath(arg), os.path.abspath(a.data))
            say("DONE")
            return
    if a.dlss_only:
        say("STEP", 1, 1, "Downloading NVIDIA DLSS")
        get_dlss(a.install)
        say("DONE")
        return
    if a.nsp:
        if not (a.keys and a.data):
            fail("NSP mode needs --keys (your prod.keys) and --data (where the game files go)")
        data = a.data
    elif a.folder:
        data = a.folder
    else:
        fail("give --nsp + --keys + --data, or --folder")
    data = os.path.abspath(data)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(data, "setup"), exist_ok=True)
    py = sys.executable
    nstool = a.nstool or os.path.join(SETUP_ROOT, "nstool.exe")
    llvm = os.path.join(SETUP_ROOT, "llvm")
    sdk = os.path.join(SETUP_ROOT, "sdk")
    if LINUX:
        nstool = a.nstool or (os.path.join(SETUP_ROOT, "nstool") if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(SETUP_ROOT, "nstool"))
                              else shutil.which("nstool") or "nstool")
        if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(sdk, "guest.h")):  # a source checkout: the repo's own header
            sdk = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(TOOLS), "runtime", "include")
    shaderc = os.path.join(a.install, "shaderc", "NxShader.dll")
    if not os.path.exists(shaderc) and os.path.exists(os.path.join(data, "shaderc", "NxShader.dll")):
        shaderc = os.path.join(data, "shaderc", "NxShader.dll")  # a source build: <data>/shaderc, where tms also looks
    # a step is redone when its marker is missing or older than its tool (an update re-runs only what changed)
    def done(step, *deps):
        m = os.path.join(data, "setup", step + ".done")
        return os.path.exists(m) and all(os.path.getmtime(m) >= os.path.getmtime(d) for d in deps)
    def mark(step):
        with open(os.path.join(data, "setup", step + ".done"), "w") as f:
            f.write(time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\n"))
    t0 = time.time()

    if a.nsp and not done("extract"):
        for p, what in ((a.nsp, "NSP"), (a.keys, "prod.keys"), (nstool, "nstool.exe")):
            if not os.path.isfile(p):
                fail(f"{what} not found: {p}")
        free = shutil.disk_usage(data).free
        need = os.path.getsize(a.nsp) * 2 + (2 << 30)  # program NCA copy + romfs, removed again after
        if free < need:
            fail(f"not enough disk space on the data drive: {need >> 30} GB needed, {free >> 30} GB free")
        extract_nsp(nstool, a.keys, a.nsp, data)
        mark("extract")

    say("STEP", 2, 6, "Checking the game version")
    for m, want in SUPPORTED.items():
        p = os.path.join(data, "exefs", m)
        if not os.path.isfile(p):
            fail(f"{p} is missing: the folder needs exefs\\ and romfs\\ from your game (see Setup help)")
        if sha256(p) != want:
            fail(f"exefs\\{m} is from another build of the game. Supported: {SUPPORTED_TEXT}.")
    if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(data, "romfs", "Pack")):
        fail(f"{data}\\romfs\\Pack is missing: extract the romfs of your game there")

    if not done("link", os.path.join(TOOLS, "recomp", "link.py")):
        say("STEP", 3, 6, "Linking the game modules")
        run([py, os.path.join(TOOLS, "recomp", "link.py"), os.path.join(data, "exefs"), os.path.join(data, "link")], "link")
        mark("link")

    lifter = [os.path.join(TOOLS, "recomp", f) for f in ("lift.py", "a32.py", "vfp.py", "names.txt")]
    if not done("lift", os.path.join(data, "setup", "link.done"), *lifter):
        say("STEP", 4, 6, "Translating the game code to C")
        run([py, lifter[0], os.path.join(data, "link"), os.path.join(data, "gen")], "lift")
        mark("lift")

    if LINUX:
        say("STEP", 5, 6, "Compiling the game code (game.so)")
        clang = a.clang or shutil.which("clang")
        lld = shutil.which("ld.lld")
        if not clang or not lld:
            fail("clang and lld are needed to compile the game code (install them with your package manager)")
        run([py, os.path.join(HERE, "build_game.py"), "--gen", os.path.join(data, "gen"),
             "--obj", os.path.join(data, "setup", "obj"), "--out", os.path.join(a.install, "game.so"),
             "--include", sdk, "--clang", clang, "--lld", lld], "compile", True)
    else:
        say("STEP", 5, 6, "Compiling the game code (game.dll)")
        run([py, os.path.join(HERE, "build_game.py"), "--gen", os.path.join(data, "gen"),
             "--obj", os.path.join(data, "setup", "obj"), "--out", os.path.join(a.install, "game.dll"),
             "--include", sdk, "--lib", os.path.join(sdk, "tms.lib"), "--lib", os.path.join(sdk, "nx_crt_math.lib"),
             "--lib", os.path.join(sdk, "nx_vcruntime.lib"), "--def", os.path.join(sdk, "game.def"),
             "--clang", os.path.join(llvm, "clang.exe"), "--lld", os.path.join(llvm, "lld-link.exe")], "compile", True)

    if not a.no_shaders and not done("shaders", shaderc, os.path.join(TOOLS, "shaderscan", "shaderscan.py")):
        say("STEP", 6, 6, "Translating all shaders (no shader stutter later)")
        if not shutil.which("dotnet") and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(shaderc), "libhostfxr.so" if LINUX else "hostfxr.dll")):
            fail("the .NET runtime is not installed (needed for the shader translator, see README)")
        run([py, os.path.join(TOOLS, "shaderscan", "shaderscan.py"), data, "--dll", shaderc, "--set-aside"], "shader scan")
        mark("shaders")

    if a.dlss:
        say("STEP", 6, 6, "Downloading NVIDIA DLSS")
        get_dlss(a.install)

    say("DATA", data)
    say(f"setup finished in {time.time() - t0:.0f} s")
    say("DONE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/shader_glsl.py`:

```py
"""Translate a shader dumped by `drawlog` (analysis/code_<src>_<stage>_<consts off>_<consts size>.bin) to GLSL with the
shaderc sidecar, for reading. Usage (from private/tms):
    python ../../tools/shader_glsl.py analysis/code_XXXXXXXX_1_0_0.bin out_dir [attr types, e.g. 7=2,1=0]
Attribute types (vertex only): location=Ryujinx AttributeType (0 float, 1 sint, 2 uint)."""
import os
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

src, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
_, _, stage, coff, csize = os.path.basename(src)[:-4].split("_")
stage, coff, csize = int(stage), int(coff, 16), int(csize, 16)
code = open(src, "rb").read()
req = struct.pack("<III", 0x4853584E, stage, len(code))
if stage == 0:
    req += struct.pack("<III", 1, 1, 1)
req += struct.pack("<II", coff, csize)
if stage == 1:
    types = bytearray(32)
    for kv in (sys.argv[3].split(",") if len(sys.argv) > 3 else []):
        k, v = kv.split("=")
        types[int(k)] = int(v)
    req += bytes(types)
req += code
here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
dll = os.path.join(here, "..", "private", "tms", "shaderc", "NxShader.dll")
r = subprocess.run(["dotnet", dll], input=req, capture_output=True, env={**os.environ, "NXSHADER_DUMP_GLSL": out})
print("status", struct.unpack_from("<I", r.stdout)[0] if r.stdout else None, r.stderr.decode().strip())
```
