`tools/shaderc/Program.cs`:

```cs
// Maxwell shader -> SPIR-V for the TMSRecomp runtime, over stdin/stdout.
//
// Request : u32 'NXSH', u32 stage (Ryujinx ShaderStage: 0 compute, 1 vertex, 2 tess ctrl, 3 tess eval, 4 geometry,
//           5 fragment), u32 length, [compute only: u32 local size x, y, z], u32 constants offset in the code, u32
//           constants size (cbuf 1; 0 = none), [vertex only: u8 x 32 attribute types (Ryujinx AttributeType: 0 float,
//           1 sint, 2 uint) per input location], code (graphics: starts at the 0x50-byte program header).
// Response: u32 status (0 ok), u32 code size used, u32 spirv length, spirv, u32 resource count, resources
//           {u8 kind (0 uniform, 1 storage, 2 texture, 3 image), u8 set, u16 binding, i32 slot, i32 handle,
//            i32 sampler type, i32 array length}, u32 fragment output map.
// Bindings: set 0, base + {uniform 0.., storage 32.., texture 64.., image 192..}; base = stage * 256, compute 6 * 256
// (binding 0 is Ryujinx's support buffer: render scales, viewport; the runtime binds it for every program).
using System;
using System.IO;
using Ryujinx.Common.Memory;
using Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader;
using Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader.Translation;

sealed class Accessor : IGpuAccessor
{
    readonly ulong[] _code;
    readonly int _base;
    readonly int[] _local;
    readonly byte[] _bytes;
    readonly int _cOff, _cSize;
    readonly byte[] _attrTypes;
    int _tex, _img;

    public Accessor(byte[] code, ShaderStage stage, int[] local, int cOff, int cSize, byte[] attrTypes)
    {
        _attrTypes = attrTypes;
        _local = local;
        _bytes = code;
        _cOff = cOff;
        _cSize = cSize;
        _code = new ulong[(code.Length + 7) / 8 + 64];
        Buffer.BlockCopy(code, 0, _code, 0, code.Length);
        _base = stage == ShaderStage.Compute ? 6 * 256 : (int)stage * 256;
    }

    public int QueryComputeLocalSizeX() => _local[0];
    public int QueryComputeLocalSizeY() => _local[1];
    public int QueryComputeLocalSizeZ() => _local[2];

    // Maxwell cbuf 1 = the shader's constant data (inside the code block); indirect branch tables live there
    public uint ConstantBuffer1Read(int offset) =>
        offset >= 0 && offset + 4 <= _cSize && _cOff + offset + 4 <= _bytes.Length ? BitConverter.ToUInt32(_bytes, _cOff + offset) : 0;

    // integer vertex formats (bone indices) need integer inputs: a float input fed from a UINT format is undefined in Vulkan
    public GpuGraphicsState QueryGraphicsState()
    {
        var types = new Array32<AttributeType>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 32 && _attrTypes != null; i++) types[i] = (AttributeType)_attrTypes[i];
        return new GpuGraphicsState(false, InputTopology.Points, false, TessPatchType.Triangles, TessSpacing.EqualSpacing,
            false, false, false, false, false, 1f, AlphaTestOp.Always, 0f, types, true, default, false, false, false, false);
    }

    public void Log(string message) => Console.Error.WriteLine("[shaderc] " + message);

    public ReadOnlySpan<ulong> GetCode(ulong address, int minimumSize)
    {
        int i = (int)(address / 8);
        return i < _code.Length ? new ReadOnlySpan<ulong>(_code, i, _code.Length - i) : ReadOnlySpan<ulong>.Empty;
    }

    public SetBindingPair CreateConstantBufferBinding(int index) => new(0, _base + index);
    public SetBindingPair CreateStorageBufferBinding(int index) => new(0, _base + 32 + index);
    public SetBindingPair CreateTextureBinding(int count, bool isBuffer) { int b = _base + 64 + _tex; _tex += count; return new(0, b); }
    public SetBindingPair CreateImageBinding(int count, bool isBuffer) { int b = _base + 192 + _img; _img += count; return new(0, b); }

    public int QuerySamplerArrayLengthFromPool() => 1;
    public int QueryTextureArrayLengthFromBuffer(int slot) => 1;
    public int QueryTextureArrayLengthFromPool() => 1;
    public void RegisterTexture(int handle, int cbufSlot) { }
}

static class Program
{
    static int Main()
    {
        var stdin = new BinaryReader(Console.OpenStandardInput());
        var stdout = new BinaryWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput());
        for (;;)
        {
            uint magic;
            try { magic = stdin.ReadUInt32(); } catch (EndOfStreamException) { return 0; }
            if (magic != 0x4853584E) { Console.Error.WriteLine("[shaderc] bad magic"); return 1; }
            var stage = (ShaderStage)stdin.ReadUInt32();
            int len = stdin.ReadInt32();
            int[] local = stage == ShaderStage.Compute
                ? new[] { stdin.ReadInt32(), stdin.ReadInt32(), stdin.ReadInt32() }
                : new[] { 1, 1, 1 };
            int cOff = stdin.ReadInt32(), cSize = stdin.ReadInt32();
            byte[] attrTypes = stage == ShaderStage.Vertex ? stdin.ReadBytes(32) : null;
            byte[] code = stdin.ReadBytes(len);
            try
            {
                var acc = new Accessor(code, stage, local, cOff, cSize, attrTypes);
                var flags = stage == ShaderStage.Compute ? TranslationFlags.Compute : TranslationFlags.None;
                var ctx = Translator.CreateContext(0, acc, new TranslationOptions(TargetLanguage.Spirv, TargetApi.Vulkan, flags));
                ShaderProgram prog = ctx.Translate();
                string dumpDir = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("NXSHADER_DUMP_GLSL");
                if (dumpDir != null)
                {
                    // debug: the same shader as GLSL, readable (fresh context: a context translates once)
                    var gctx = Translator.CreateContext(0, new Accessor(code, stage, local, cOff, cSize, attrTypes), new TranslationOptions(TargetLanguage.Glsl, TargetApi.Vulkan, flags));
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(dumpDir);
                    string hash = Convert.ToHexString(System.Security.Cryptography.SHA1.HashData(code.AsSpan(0, Math.Min(code.Length, ctx.Size + 0x50)))).Substring(0, 12);
                    File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(dumpDir, $"{stage}_{hash}.glsl"), gctx.Translate().Code);
                }
                var info = prog.Info;
                stdout.Write(0u);
                stdout.Write((uint)ctx.Size);
                stdout.Write((uint)prog.BinaryCode.Length);
                stdout.Write(prog.BinaryCode);
                stdout.Write((uint)(info.CBuffers.Count + info.SBuffers.Count + info.Textures.Count + info.Images.Count));
                foreach (var b in info.CBuffers) WriteRes(stdout, 0, b.Set, b.Binding, b.Slot, 0, 0, 1);
                foreach (var b in info.SBuffers) WriteRes(stdout, 1, b.Set, b.Binding, b.Slot, b.SbCbSlot | (b.SbCbOffset << 8), 0, 1);
                foreach (var t in info.Textures) WriteRes(stdout, 2, t.Set, t.Binding, t.CbufSlot, t.HandleIndex, (int)t.Type, t.ArrayLength);
                foreach (var t in info.Images) WriteRes(stdout, 3, t.Set, t.Binding, t.CbufSlot, t.HandleIndex, (int)t.Type, t.ArrayLength);
                stdout.Write((uint)info.FragmentOutputMap);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"[shaderc] {stage} failed: {e.GetType().Name}: {e.Message}");
                stdout.Write(1u);
            }
            stdout.Flush();
        }
    }

    static void WriteRes(BinaryWriter w, byte kind, int set, int binding, int slot, int handle, int type, int count)
    {
        w.Write(kind);
        w.Write((byte)set);
        w.Write((ushort)binding);
        w.Write(slot);
        w.Write(handle);
        w.Write(type);
        w.Write(count);
    }
}
```

`tools/shaderscan/shaderscan.py`:

```py
"""Offline shader translation: every Maxwell shader in the game's CPK packs -> <data>/cache/shaders.bin, keyed exactly
as tms.exe does (vk_shader.cpp translate()), so the game does 0 shader translations in areas nobody has visited.
Same idea as tools/texextract. The release ships only this tool; the translations are made on the user's PC.

    python tools/shaderscan/shaderscan.py <data> [--packs pack_030_etc] [--dll PATH] [--cache FILE] [--check]

Shaders are BNSH blobs (Shaders/*.pso/.vso, APAK packs .pspk/.vspk/.cspk, inside other files such as effects, and in
the game executables <data>/link/image.bin):
every "BNSH" found in a file is scanned. A stage record in a BNSH is: control offset u64, code offset u64, then two
u32 sizes (offsets from the BNSH start). Graphics code starts with the 0x30-byte NVN header.

The translator is the same sidecar tms.exe runs (dotnet NxShader.dll); its file size + time stamp the cache, so use
the SAME dll as the game (default: <data>/build/shaderc, else <data>/shaderc, like tms.exe). Only appends: entries
already in the cache are skipped, an existing cache from another translator build is left alone (s30 rule).
Do not run while tms.exe runs (both append to the file).
Vertex shaders are translated with float inputs; integer-attribute variants (an attribute with a SINT / UINT format)
are keyed by the attribute types too. Every integer variant seen in play (s95: 12 of them, character / shading_effect /
stainless .vspk and image.bin) is attribute 7 = uint (skinning indices), so the vertex shaders of image.bin and
pack_030_etc (Shaders/*.vspk) also get that variant (~300 more translations).
--check: translate nothing, report how many entries of the existing cache this scan reproduces (key check).
"""
import argparse
import os
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "texextract"))
from cpk import Cpk  # noqa: E402
from texextract import read_entry  # noqa: E402

CODE_MAGIC, CTRL_MAGIC, LEN = 0x12345678, 0x98761234, 0x20000
ZERO32 = bytes(32)


def fnv(b, h=0xcbf29ce484222325):
    for x in b:
        h = ((h ^ x) * 0x100000001b3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    return h


def u32(b, o):
    return struct.unpack_from("<I", b, o)[0]


def bnsh_stages(buf, at):
    """(control bytes, code bytes) per stage record of the BNSH at buf[at]."""
    end = buf.find(b"BNSH", at + 4)
    end = len(buf) if end < 0 else end
    ctl = buf.find(struct.pack("<I", CTRL_MAGIC), at, end)
    while ctl >= 0:
        ref = buf.find(struct.pack("<Q", ctl - at), at, end)
        if ref >= 0 and ref + 24 <= end:
            # the game reads control +0x6fc..+0x750, past the stated sizes, and code until the translator stops:
            # slice both to the BNSH end, as they lie in guest memory (code_size from the translator bounds the hash)
            code_off = struct.unpack_from("<Q", buf, ref + 8)[0]
            if at + code_off < end:
                yield buf[ctl:end].ljust(0x800, bytes(1)), buf[at + code_off:end]
        ctl = buf.find(struct.pack("<I", CTRL_MAGIC), ctl + 4, end)


def shader_key(ctl, code):
    """Like vk_shader.cpp program_of(): (stage, local, consts_off, consts_size, code after the NVN header)."""
    header = u32(code, 0) == CODE_MAGIC
    sph = u32(code, 0x30) if header else 0
    sph_type, shader_type = sph & 0x1F, (sph >> 10) & 0xF
    stage = shader_type if sph_type == 1 and 1 <= shader_type <= 4 else 5 if sph_type == 2 else 0
    off = 0x30 if header else 0
    local = [1, 1, 1]
    if stage == 0 and u32(ctl, 0) == CTRL_MAGIC:
        local = [max(1, u32(ctl, 0x748 + 4 * k)) for k in range(3)]
    csize, coff = u32(ctl, 0x6FC), u32(ctl, 0x700)
    return stage, local, coff - off if csize else 0, csize, code[off:]


def keys(stage, local, coff, csize, code, types=ZERO32):
    # types: vertex attribute types (0 float, 1 sint, 2 uint per slot; all-float = the base module); others ignore it
    inp = struct.pack("<4I", stage, coff, csize, local[0] | local[1] << 10 | local[2] << 20 if stage == 0 else 0)
    prefix = fnv(code[:256], fnv(types, fnv(inp)))

    def full(size):
        h = fnv(code[:size])
        return fnv(code[coff:coff + csize], h) if csize and coff + csize <= LEN else h
    return prefix, full


class Sidecar:
    def __init__(self, dll):
        sc = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(dll), "hostfxr.dll")  # self-contained build (release ZIP): no .NET install
        cmd = [os.path.abspath(dll[:-4] + ".exe")] if os.path.exists(sc) else ["dotnet", dll]
        if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):  # self-contained linux-x64 publish: NxShader + libhostfxr.so
            sc = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(dll), "libhostfxr.so")
            cmd = [os.path.abspath(dll[:-4])] if os.path.exists(sc) else ["dotnet", dll]
        self.p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)

    def rd(self, n):
        b = self.p.stdout.read(n)
        if len(b) != n:
            raise RuntimeError("shader translator: read failed (did it crash?)")
        return b

    def translate(self, stage, local, coff, csize, code, types=ZERO32):
        """Same protocol as vk_shader.cpp translate_sidecar(); returns (code_size, spirv, res, frag_outputs) or None."""
        w = self.p.stdin
        w.write(struct.pack("<3I", 0x4853584E, stage, LEN))
        if stage == 0:
            w.write(struct.pack("<3I", *local))
        w.write(struct.pack("<2I", coff, csize))
        if stage == 1:
            w.write(types)
        w.write(code[:LEN].ljust(LEN, b"\0"))
        w.flush()
        if u32(self.rd(4), 0) != 0:
            return None
        code_size, n = struct.unpack("<2I", self.rd(8))
        spirv = self.rd(n)
        nres = u32(self.rd(4), 0)
        res = self.rd(20 * nres)  # Resource: u8 kind, u8 set, u16 binding, i32 slot, handle, type, count
        return code_size, spirv, nres, res, self.rd(4)


def read_cache(path):
    """(stamp, {prefix: [(full, code_size)]}) of an existing shaders.bin, or (None, {})."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None, {}
    b = open(path, "rb").read()
    stamp, have, o = struct.unpack_from("<3Q", b, 0), {}, 24
    while o + 24 <= len(b):
        prefix, full, code_size, n = struct.unpack_from("<QQII", b, o)
        o += 24 + 4 * n
        nres = u32(b, o)
        o += 4 + 20 * nres + 4
        have.setdefault(prefix, []).append((full, code_size))
    return stamp, have


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("data")
    ap.add_argument("--packs", help="comma separated pack names (default: all)")
    ap.add_argument("--dll", help="NxShader.dll (default: as tms.exe finds it)")
    ap.add_argument("--cache", help="default <data>/cache/shaders.bin")
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="only count existing cache entries this scan reproduces")
    ap.add_argument("--set-aside", action="store_true",
                    help="a cache from another translator build is renamed to shaders.bin.<time>.old (setup)")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    dll = a.dll or next((p for p in (os.path.join(a.data, "build", "shaderc", "NxShader.dll"),
                                     os.path.join(a.data, "shaderc", "NxShader.dll")) if os.path.exists(p)), None)
    if not dll:
        sys.exit("NxShader.dll not found (pass --dll)")
    st = os.stat(dll)
    stamp = (0x31435358, st.st_size, st.st_mtime_ns // 100 + 116444736000000000)
    cache = a.cache or os.path.join(a.data, "cache", "shaders.bin")
    old, have = read_cache(cache)
    if old and (old[0] != stamp[0] or old[1] != stamp[1] or old[2] // 10**7 != stamp[2] // 10**7) and a.set_aside:
        aside = f"{cache}.{int(time.time())}.old"  # kept, never deleted (the game would not use it anyway)
        os.replace(cache, aside)
        print(f"{cache} was made by another translator build: moved to {aside}")
        old, have = None, {}
    if old and (old[0] != stamp[0] or old[1] != stamp[1] or old[2] // 10**7 != stamp[2] // 10**7):
        sys.exit(f"{cache} was made by another translator build: left alone (use the game's own NxShader.dll)")
    print(f"translator {dll}; cache {cache}: {sum(map(len, have.values()))} entries")

    pack_dir = os.path.join(a.data, "romfs", "Pack")
    names = a.packs.split(",") if a.packs else sorted(n[:-4] for n in os.listdir(pack_dir) if n.endswith(".cpk"))
    seen, found, matched, new, failed, short = set(), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    uint7 = bytes(7) + b"\x02" + bytes(24)  # attribute 7 = uint
    sc, out = None, None

    def buffers():
        # the game executables embed shaders too (boot, movie, system UI: 169 BNSH in image.bin, missed by packs only)
        image = os.path.join(a.data, "link", "image.bin")
        if not a.packs and os.path.exists(image):
            with open(image, "rb") as f:
                yield "link/image.bin", [f.read()]
        for name in names:  # shaders are not modded (no mod replaces pack_030_etc); base packs only
            c = Cpk(os.path.join(pack_dir, name + ".cpk"))
            yield name, (read_entry(c, r) for r in c.files
                         if not c.path(r).endswith((".usm", ".acb", ".awb", ".lua", ".msbt", ".anm", ".lig", ".gtx")))

    for name, bufs in buffers():
        for buf in bufs:
            at = buf.find(b"BNSH")
            while at >= 0:
                for ctl, code in bnsh_stages(buf, at):
                    stage, local, coff, csize, body = shader_key(ctl, code)
                    if len(body) < 256:  # the prefix hash reads 256 bytes: the rest would be other guest memory
                        short += 1
                        continue
                    skinned = stage == 1 and name in ("link/image.bin", "pack_030_etc")
                    for types in (ZERO32, uint7) if skinned else (ZERO32,):
                        prefix, full = keys(stage, local, coff, csize, body, types)
                        if (prefix, fnv(body)) in seen:
                            continue
                        seen.add((prefix, fnv(body)))
                        found += 1
                        if any(s <= len(body) and full(s) == h for h, s in have.get(prefix, ())):  # as translate()
                            matched += 1
                            continue
                        if a.check:
                            continue
                        sc = sc or Sidecar(dll)
                        t = sc.translate(stage, local, coff, csize, body, types)
                        if not t or not t[0] or t[0] > len(body):
                            failed += 1
                            continue
                        code_size, spirv, nres, res, frag = t
                        if out is None:
                            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(cache), exist_ok=True)
                            out = open(cache, "ab")
                            if old is None:
                                out.write(struct.pack("<3Q", *stamp))
                        out.write(struct.pack("<QQII", prefix, full(code_size), code_size, len(spirv) // 4) + spirv +
                                  struct.pack("<I", nres) + res + frag)
                        out.flush()
                        have.setdefault(prefix, []).append((full(code_size), code_size))
                        new += 1
                at = buf.find(b"BNSH", at + 4)
        print(f"{name}: {found} shaders so far, {matched} already cached, {new} translated, {failed} failed")
    print(f"done: {found} shaders, {matched} already cached, {new} translated, {failed} failed, "
          f"{short} too short to key")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/spirv_dump.py`:

```py
"""Translate a shader dumped by `drawlog` with the shaderc sidecar and print the SPIR-V the runtime would get, one
instruction per line (opcode names from the Ryujinx source's Spv.Generator enum; operands as raw %ids / numbers).
Usage (from private/tms):
    python ../../tools/spirv_dump.py analysis/code_XXXXXXXX_1_ed0_20.bin out.txt [attr types, e.g. 7=2,1=0]"""
import os
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
src, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
_, _, stage, coff, csize = os.path.basename(src)[:-4].split("_")
stage, coff, csize = int(stage), int(coff, 16), int(csize, 16)
code = open(src, "rb").read()
req = struct.pack("<III", 0x4853584E, stage, len(code))
if stage == 0:
    req += struct.pack("<III", 1, 1, 1)
req += struct.pack("<II", coff, csize)
if stage == 1:
    types = bytearray(32)
    for kv in (sys.argv[3].split(",") if len(sys.argv) > 3 else []):
        k, v = kv.split("=")
        types[int(k)] = int(v)
    req += bytes(types)
req += code
dll = os.path.join(here, "..", "private", "tms", "shaderc", "NxShader.dll")
r = subprocess.run(["dotnet", dll], input=req, capture_output=True)
status, size, n = struct.unpack_from("<III", r.stdout)
assert status == 0, r.stderr.decode()
spv = struct.unpack_from(f"<{n // 4}I", r.stdout, 12)
open(out[:-4] + ".spv", "wb").write(r.stdout[12:12 + n])

enum = open(os.path.join(here, "..", "private", "third_party", "ryubing", "src", "Spv.Generator", "spirv.cs")).read()
body = enum[enum.index("public enum Op"):]
body = body[:body.index("}")]
names = {int(v): k for k, v in re.findall(r"(Op\w+) = (\d+),", body)}
# opcodes with a result type + result id (the common case); the rest print raw operands
no_result = {"OpStore", "OpBranch", "OpBranchConditional", "OpReturn", "OpReturnValue", "OpKill", "OpSelectionMerge",
             "OpLoopMerge", "OpDecorate", "OpMemberDecorate", "OpName", "OpMemberName", "OpEntryPoint", "OpExecutionMode",
             "OpCapability", "OpExtension", "OpMemoryModel", "OpSwitch", "OpFunctionEnd", "OpSource", "OpUnreachable"}
result_only = {"OpLabel", "OpTypeVoid", "OpTypeBool", "OpTypeInt", "OpTypeFloat", "OpTypeVector", "OpTypeMatrix",
               "OpTypeArray", "OpTypeRuntimeArray", "OpTypeStruct", "OpTypePointer", "OpTypeFunction", "OpExtInstImport",
               "OpTypeImage", "OpTypeSampler", "OpTypeSampledImage"}
lines = []
w = 5
while w < len(spv):
    wc, op = spv[w] >> 16, spv[w] & 0xFFFF
    args = list(spv[w + 1:w + wc])
    name = names.get(op, f"Op{op}")
    if name in ("OpName", "OpExtInstImport", "OpSourceExtension", "OpExtension"):
        raw = struct.pack(f"<{len(args)}I", *args)
        s = raw[(4 if name == "OpName" else 0):].split(b"\0")[0].decode(errors="replace")
        lines.append(f"{name} {'%' + str(args[0]) if name == 'OpName' else ''} \"{s}\"")
    elif name in result_only and args:
        lines.append(f"%{args[0]} = {name} " + " ".join(str(a) for a in args[1:]))
    elif name not in no_result and len(args) >= 2:
        lines.append(f"%{args[1]} = {name} %{args[0]} " + " ".join(f"%{a}" for a in args[2:]))
    else:
        lines.append(f"{name} " + " ".join(f"%{a}" for a in args))
    w += wc
open(out, "w").write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print(len(lines), "instructions ->", out)

```

`tools/spvgen/Motion.cs`:

```cs
// Camera motion vectors for the temporal upscaler (AMD FSR 3), built with Ryujinx's SPIR-V builder (Spv.Generator, MIT).
// Our own code. Per pixel: the scene depth d gives the pixel's point in NDC (NVN: +Y up = the top row, z = 2d - 1);
// M = previous view-projection x inverse(current view-projection) (computed on the CPU) takes it to the previous frame's
// NDC; the motion vector is previous pixel position - current pixel position (pixels, jitter removed), the FSR 3
// convention (motionVectorScale 1, 1). Moving characters get the camera motion only (no per-object motion yet).
// The depth is also copied to an R32 float image (the upscaler's depth input).
//   set 0: binding 0 sampled depth (combined image sampler, depth view), binding 1 storage image out mv (rg16f),
//          binding 2 storage image out depth (r32f)
//   push constants: float M[16] (row-major), int width, int height, float jitter x, float jitter y; local size 8 x 8
using Spv.Generator;
using static Spv.Specification;

static class Motion
{
    public static byte[] Build()
    {
        var m = new Module(0x00010300);
        m.AddCapability(Capability.Shader);
        m.AddCapability(Capability.StorageImageExtendedFormats);  // rg16f storage
        m.SetMemoryModel(AddressingModel.Logical, MemoryModel.GLSL450);

        var tVoid = m.TypeVoid();
        var tF = m.TypeFloat(32);
        var tI = m.TypeInt(32, 1);
        var tU = m.TypeInt(32, 0);
        var tB = m.TypeBool();
        var tV4 = m.TypeVector(tF, 4);
        var tI2 = m.TypeVector(tI, 2);
        var tU3 = m.TypeVector(tU, 3);
        var tSrc = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 1, ImageFormat.Unknown);
        var tMv = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 2, ImageFormat.Rg16f);
        var tDep = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 2, ImageFormat.R32f);
        var pSrc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tSrc);
        var pMv = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tMv);
        var pDep = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tDep);
        var members = new Instruction[20];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) members[i] = tF;
        members[16] = tI; members[17] = tI; members[18] = tF; members[19] = tF;
        var tPc = m.TypeStruct(true, members);
        var pPc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tPc);
        var pPcI = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tI);
        var pPcF = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tF);
        var pIn = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Input, tU3);

        var src = m.Variable(pSrc, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var mv = m.Variable(pMv, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var dep = m.Variable(pDep, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var pc = m.Variable(pPc, StorageClass.PushConstant);
        var gid = m.Variable(pIn, StorageClass.Input);
        m.Decorate(src, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(src, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(mv, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(mv, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)1);
        m.Decorate(mv, Decoration.NonReadable);
        m.Decorate(dep, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(dep, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)2);
        m.Decorate(dep, Decoration.NonReadable);
        m.Decorate(gid, Decoration.BuiltIn, (LiteralInteger)(int)BuiltIn.GlobalInvocationId);
        m.Decorate(tPc, Decoration.Block);
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) m.MemberDecorate(tPc, i, Decoration.Offset, (LiteralInteger)(4 * i));
        foreach (var v in new[] { src, mv, dep, pc, gid }) m.AddGlobalVariable(v);

        Instruction I(int v) => m.Constant(tI, v);
        Instruction F(float v) => m.Constant(tF, v);
        var f0 = F(0f);
        var f1 = F(1f);
        var f2 = F(2f);
        var fHalf = F(0.5f);

        var main = m.Function(tVoid, FunctionControlMask.MaskNone, m.TypeFunction(tVoid, false));
        m.AddFunction(main);
        m.AddLabel(m.Label());
        var w = m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, I(16)));
        var h = m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, I(17)));
        var jx = m.Load(tF, m.AccessChain(pPcF, pc, I(18)));
        var jy = m.Load(tF, m.AccessChain(pPcF, pc, I(19)));
        var id3 = m.Load(tU3, gid);
        var x = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 0));
        var y = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 1));
        var inside = m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.SLessThan(tB, x, w), m.SLessThan(tB, y, h));
        var body = m.Label();
        var end = m.Label();
        m.SelectionMerge(end, SelectionControlMask.MaskNone);
        m.BranchConditional(inside, body, end);
        m.AddLabel(body);
        var p = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, x, y);
        var d = m.CompositeExtract(tF, m.ImageFetch(tV4, m.Load(tSrc, src), p, ImageOperandsMask.Lod, I(0)), 0);
        var wf = m.ConvertSToF(tF, w);
        var hf = m.ConvertSToF(tF, h);
        // pixel centre without the jitter (the depth was drawn with it)
        var px = m.FSub(tF, m.FAdd(tF, m.ConvertSToF(tF, x), fHalf), jx);
        var py = m.FSub(tF, m.FAdd(tF, m.ConvertSToF(tF, y), fHalf), jy);
        var nx = m.FSub(tF, m.FMul(tF, m.FDiv(tF, px, wf), f2), f1);
        var ny = m.FSub(tF, f1, m.FMul(tF, m.FDiv(tF, py, hf), f2));
        var nz = m.FSub(tF, m.FMul(tF, d, f2), f1);
        Instruction M(int r, int c) => m.Load(tF, m.AccessChain(pPcF, pc, I(4 * r + c)));
        Instruction Row(int r) => m.FAdd(tF, m.FAdd(tF, m.FMul(tF, M(r, 0), nx), m.FMul(tF, M(r, 1), ny)),
                                         m.FAdd(tF, m.FMul(tF, M(r, 2), nz), M(r, 3)));
        var qx = Row(0);
        var qy = Row(1);
        var qw = Row(3);
        var ok = m.FOrdGreaterThan(tB, qw, F(1e-6f));
        var safeW = m.Select(tF, ok, qw, f1);
        var ppx = m.FMul(tF, m.FMul(tF, m.FAdd(tF, m.FDiv(tF, qx, safeW), f1), fHalf), wf);
        var ppy = m.FMul(tF, m.FMul(tF, m.FSub(tF, f1, m.FDiv(tF, qy, safeW)), fHalf), hf);
        var mx = m.Select(tF, ok, m.FSub(tF, ppx, px), f0);
        var my = m.Select(tF, ok, m.FSub(tF, ppy, py), f0);
        m.ImageWrite(m.Load(tMv, mv), p, m.CompositeConstruct(tV4, mx, my, f0, f0), ImageOperandsMask.MaskNone);
        m.ImageWrite(m.Load(tDep, dep), p, m.CompositeConstruct(tV4, d, f0, f0, f0), ImageOperandsMask.MaskNone);
        m.Branch(end);
        m.AddLabel(end);
        m.Return();
        m.FunctionEnd();
        m.AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModel.GLCompute, main, "main", gid);
        m.AddExecutionMode(main, ExecutionMode.LocalSize, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)1);
        return m.Generate();
    }
}

// Debug check of the motion vectors (NX_MV_CHECK=1): out = 4 x |current - previous frame at (pixel + mv)| (nearest
// texel; dark where the vectors are right), mode 2 = the same without the vectors (for comparison).
//   set 0: binding 0 current colour, binding 1 previous colour, binding 2 mv (combined image samplers, texel fetch),
//          binding 3 storage image out (r11g11b10 float)
//   push constants: int width, int height, int mode; local size 8 x 8
static class MvCheck
{
    public static byte[] Build()
    {
        var m = new Module(0x00010300);
        m.AddCapability(Capability.Shader);
        m.AddCapability(Capability.StorageImageExtendedFormats);
        m.SetMemoryModel(AddressingModel.Logical, MemoryModel.GLSL450);
        var tVoid = m.TypeVoid();
        var tF = m.TypeFloat(32);
        var tI = m.TypeInt(32, 1);
        var tU = m.TypeInt(32, 0);
        var tB = m.TypeBool();
        var tV4 = m.TypeVector(tF, 4);
        var tI2 = m.TypeVector(tI, 2);
        var tU3 = m.TypeVector(tU, 3);
        var tSrc = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 1, ImageFormat.Unknown);
        var tDst = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 2, ImageFormat.R11fG11fB10f);
        var pSrc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tSrc);
        var pDst = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tDst);
        var tPc = m.TypeStruct(true, tI, tI, tF);
        var pPc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tPc);
        var pPcI = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tI);
        var pPcF = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tF);
        var pIn = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Input, tU3);
        var cur = m.Variable(pSrc, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var prev = m.Variable(pSrc, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var mv = m.Variable(pSrc, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var dst = m.Variable(pDst, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var pc = m.Variable(pPc, StorageClass.PushConstant);
        var gid = m.Variable(pIn, StorageClass.Input);
        int bi = 0;
        foreach (var v in new[] { cur, prev, mv, dst })
        {
            m.Decorate(v, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
            m.Decorate(v, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)bi++);
        }
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.NonReadable);
        m.Decorate(gid, Decoration.BuiltIn, (LiteralInteger)(int)BuiltIn.GlobalInvocationId);
        m.Decorate(tPc, Decoration.Block);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) m.MemberDecorate(tPc, i, Decoration.Offset, (LiteralInteger)(4 * i));
        foreach (var v in new[] { cur, prev, mv, dst, pc, gid }) m.AddGlobalVariable(v);
        Instruction I(int v) => m.Constant(tI, v);
        Instruction F(float v) => m.Constant(tF, v);
        var main = m.Function(tVoid, FunctionControlMask.MaskNone, m.TypeFunction(tVoid, false));
        m.AddFunction(main);
        m.AddLabel(m.Label());
        var w = m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, I(0)));
        var h = m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, I(1)));
        var scale = m.Load(tF, m.AccessChain(pPcF, pc, I(2)));
        var id3 = m.Load(tU3, gid);
        var x = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 0));
        var y = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 1));
        var inside = m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.SLessThan(tB, x, w), m.SLessThan(tB, y, h));
        var body = m.Label();
        var end = m.Label();
        m.SelectionMerge(end, SelectionControlMask.MaskNone);
        m.BranchConditional(inside, body, end);
        m.AddLabel(body);
        var p = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, x, y);
        Instruction Fetch(Instruction img, Instruction q) => m.ImageFetch(tV4, m.Load(tSrc, img), q, ImageOperandsMask.Lod, I(0));
        var c = Fetch(cur, p);
        var v4 = Fetch(mv, p);
        var mx = m.FMul(tF, m.CompositeExtract(tF, v4, 0), scale);
        var my = m.FMul(tF, m.CompositeExtract(tF, v4, 1), scale);
        // bilinear from the previous frame at (pixel + mv)
        var fx = m.FAdd(tF, m.ConvertSToF(tF, x), mx);
        var fy = m.FAdd(tF, m.ConvertSToF(tF, y), my);
        var x0f = m.GlslFloor(tF, fx);
        var y0f = m.GlslFloor(tF, fy);
        var ax = m.FSub(tF, fx, x0f);
        var ay = m.FSub(tF, fy, y0f);
        var x0 = m.ConvertFToS(tI, x0f);
        var y0 = m.ConvertFToS(tI, y0f);
        var z2 = m.ConstantComposite(tI2, I(0), I(0));
        var max2 = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, m.ISub(tI, w, I(1)), m.ISub(tI, h, I(1)));
        Instruction At(Instruction qx, Instruction qy) => Fetch(prev, m.GlslSClamp(tI2, m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, qx, qy), z2, max2));
        var x1 = m.IAdd(tI, x0, I(1));
        var y1 = m.IAdd(tI, y0, I(1));
        var top = m.GlslFMix(tV4, At(x0, y0), At(x1, y0), m.CompositeConstruct(tV4, ax, ax, ax, ax));
        var bot = m.GlslFMix(tV4, At(x0, y1), At(x1, y1), m.CompositeConstruct(tV4, ax, ax, ax, ax));
        var o = m.GlslFMix(tV4, top, bot, m.CompositeConstruct(tV4, ay, ay, ay, ay));
        var f4 = F(4f);
        var d = m.VectorTimesScalar(tV4, m.GlslFAbs(tV4, m.FSub(tV4, c, o)), f4);
        m.ImageWrite(m.Load(tDst, dst), p, d, ImageOperandsMask.MaskNone);
        m.Branch(end);
        m.AddLabel(end);
        m.Return();
        m.FunctionEnd();
        m.AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModel.GLCompute, main, "main", gid);
        m.AddExecutionMode(main, ExecutionMode.LocalSize, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)1);
        return m.Generate();
    }
}
```

`tools/spvgen/MsExpand.cs`:

```cs
// MSAA expand shaders: draw a single-sample image into its multisampled twin (the runtime's MSAA, vk_replay.cpp
// MsTwin) with one full-screen triangle, so every sample of each pixel gets the pixel's colour. Built with Ryujinx's
// SPIR-V builder (Spv.Generator, MIT).
//   msxv (vertex): positions from gl_VertexIndex 0..2 = (-1,-1) (3,-1) (-1,3)
//   msxf (fragment): out0 = texelFetch(set 0 binding 0, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0)
using Spv.Generator;
using static Spv.Specification;

static class MsExpand
{
    public static byte[] Build(bool vertex)
    {
        var m = new Module(0x00010300);
        m.AddCapability(Capability.Shader);
        m.SetMemoryModel(AddressingModel.Logical, MemoryModel.GLSL450);
        var tVoid = m.TypeVoid();
        var tF = m.TypeFloat(32);
        var tI = m.TypeInt(32, 1);
        var tV2 = m.TypeVector(tF, 2);
        var tV4 = m.TypeVector(tF, 4);
        var tI2 = m.TypeVector(tI, 2);
        var main = m.Function(tVoid, FunctionControlMask.MaskNone, m.TypeFunction(tVoid, false));
        if (vertex)
        {
            var pInI = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Input, tI);
            var pOut = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Output, tV4);
            var vid = m.Variable(pInI, StorageClass.Input);
            var pos = m.Variable(pOut, StorageClass.Output);
            m.Decorate(vid, Decoration.BuiltIn, (LiteralInteger)(int)BuiltIn.VertexIndex);
            m.Decorate(pos, Decoration.BuiltIn, (LiteralInteger)(int)BuiltIn.Position);
            m.AddGlobalVariable(vid);
            m.AddGlobalVariable(pos);
            m.AddFunction(main);
            m.AddLabel(m.Label());
            var i = m.Load(tI, vid);
            // x = (i == 1) ? 3 : -1, y = (i == 2) ? 3 : -1
            var bT = m.TypeBool();
            var three = m.Constant(tF, 3f);
            var neg = m.Constant(tF, -1f);
            var x = m.Select(tF, m.IEqual(bT, i, m.Constant(tI, 1)), three, neg);
            var y = m.Select(tF, m.IEqual(bT, i, m.Constant(tI, 2)), three, neg);
            m.Store(pos, m.CompositeConstruct(tV4, x, y, m.Constant(tF, 0f), m.Constant(tF, 1f)));
            m.Return();
            m.FunctionEnd();
            m.AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModel.Vertex, main, "main", vid, pos);
        }
        else
        {
            var tSrc = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 1, ImageFormat.Unknown);
            var pSrc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tSrc);
            var pIn = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Input, tV4);
            var pOut = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Output, tV4);
            var src = m.Variable(pSrc, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
            var fc = m.Variable(pIn, StorageClass.Input);
            var o = m.Variable(pOut, StorageClass.Output);
            m.Decorate(src, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
            m.Decorate(src, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)0);
            m.Decorate(fc, Decoration.BuiltIn, (LiteralInteger)(int)BuiltIn.FragCoord);
            m.Decorate(o, Decoration.Location, (LiteralInteger)0);
            foreach (var v in new[] { src, fc, o }) m.AddGlobalVariable(v);
            m.AddFunction(main);
            m.AddLabel(m.Label());
            var f = m.Load(tV4, fc);
            var xy = m.ConvertFToS(tI2, m.VectorShuffle(tV2, f, f, 0, 1));
            m.Store(o, m.ImageFetch(tV4, m.Load(tSrc, src), xy, ImageOperandsMask.Lod, m.Constant(tI, 0)));
            m.Return();
            m.FunctionEnd();
            m.AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModel.Fragment, main, "main", fc, o);
            m.AddExecutionMode(main, ExecutionMode.OriginUpperLeft);
        }
        return m.Generate();
    }
}
```

`tools/spvgen/Overlay.cs`:

```cs
// Subtitle overlay compute shader for the runtime's present path (tools/spvgen, Ryujinx's Spv.Generator, MIT):
// blends a premultiplied RGBA8 bitmap from a storage buffer over a rectangle of the frame in place.
//   set 0 binding 0: storage buffer uint[] (bitmap rows, R in the low byte), binding 1: storage image (the frame,
//   R8G8B8A8_UNORM, read + write)
//   push constants: int x, int y (rectangle origin in the frame), int width, int height (bitmap size)
//   local size 8 x 8; out.rgb = o.rgb + d.rgb * (1 - o.a), alpha unchanged
using Spv.Generator;
using static Spv.Specification;

static class Overlay
{
    public static byte[] Build()
    {
        var m = new Module(0x00010300);
        m.AddCapability(Capability.Shader);
        m.SetMemoryModel(AddressingModel.Logical, MemoryModel.GLSL450);

        var tVoid = m.TypeVoid();
        var tF = m.TypeFloat(32);
        var tI = m.TypeInt(32, 1);
        var tU = m.TypeInt(32, 0);
        var tB = m.TypeBool();
        var tV4 = m.TypeVector(tF, 4);
        var tI2 = m.TypeVector(tI, 2);
        var tU3 = m.TypeVector(tU, 3);
        var tArr = m.TypeRuntimeArray(tU);
        var tBuf = m.TypeStruct(true, tArr);
        var pBuf = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.StorageBuffer, tBuf);
        var pBufU = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.StorageBuffer, tU);
        var tDst = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 2, ImageFormat.Rgba8);
        var pDst = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tDst);
        var tPc = m.TypeStruct(true, tI, tI, tI, tI);
        var pPc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tPc);
        var pPcI = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tI);
        var pIn = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Input, tU3);

        var buf = m.Variable(pBuf, StorageClass.StorageBuffer);
        var dst = m.Variable(pDst, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var pc = m.Variable(pPc, StorageClass.PushConstant);
        var gid = m.Variable(pIn, StorageClass.Input);
        m.Decorate(tArr, Decoration.ArrayStride, (LiteralInteger)4);
        m.Decorate(tBuf, Decoration.Block);
        m.MemberDecorate(tBuf, 0, Decoration.Offset, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(buf, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(buf, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(buf, Decoration.NonWritable);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)1);
        m.Decorate(gid, Decoration.BuiltIn, (LiteralInteger)(int)BuiltIn.GlobalInvocationId);
        m.Decorate(tPc, Decoration.Block);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) m.MemberDecorate(tPc, i, Decoration.Offset, (LiteralInteger)(4 * i));
        foreach (var v in new[] { buf, dst, pc, gid }) m.AddGlobalVariable(v);

        var i0 = m.Constant(tI, 0);
        var f1 = m.Constant(tF, 1f);

        var main = m.Function(tVoid, FunctionControlMask.MaskNone, m.TypeFunction(tVoid, false));
        m.AddFunction(main);
        m.AddLabel(m.Label());
        Instruction Pc(int i) => m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, m.Constant(tI, i)));
        var ox = Pc(0);
        var oy = Pc(1);
        var w = Pc(2);
        var h = Pc(3);
        var id3 = m.Load(tU3, gid);
        var x = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 0));
        var y = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 1));
        var inside = m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.SLessThan(tB, x, w), m.SLessThan(tB, y, h));
        var body = m.Label();
        var end = m.Label();
        m.SelectionMerge(end, SelectionControlMask.MaskNone);
        m.BranchConditional(inside, body, end);
        m.AddLabel(body);
        var word = m.Load(tU, m.AccessChain(pBufU, buf, i0, m.IAdd(tI, m.IMul(tI, y, w), x)));
        var o = m.GlslUnpackUnorm4x8(tV4, word);
        var a = m.CompositeExtract(tF, o, 3);
        var visible = m.FOrdGreaterThan(tB, a, m.Constant(tF, 0f));  // fully transparent texels leave the frame alone
        var blend = m.Label();
        var blendEnd = m.Label();
        m.SelectionMerge(blendEnd, SelectionControlMask.MaskNone);  // must come right before its branch
        m.BranchConditional(visible, blend, blendEnd);
        m.AddLabel(blend);
        var img = m.Load(tDst, dst);
        var p = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, m.IAdd(tI, ox, x), m.IAdd(tI, oy, y));
        var d = m.ImageRead(tV4, img, p, ImageOperandsMask.MaskNone);
        var res = m.FAdd(tV4, o, m.VectorTimesScalar(tV4, d, m.FSub(tF, f1, a)));
        var outv = m.CompositeInsert(tV4, m.CompositeExtract(tF, d, 3), res, 3);
        m.ImageWrite(img, p, outv, ImageOperandsMask.MaskNone);
        m.Branch(blendEnd);
        m.AddLabel(blendEnd);
        m.Branch(end);
        m.AddLabel(end);
        m.Return();
        m.FunctionEnd();
        m.AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModel.GLCompute, main, "main", gid);
        m.AddExecutionMode(main, ExecutionMode.LocalSize, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)1);
        return m.Generate();
    }
}
```

`tools/spvgen/Program.cs`:

```cs
// spvgen <shader> <out.h>: the runtime's own SPIR-V shaders as uint32_t arrays. Shaders: sharpen (Sharpen.cs ->
// runtime/src/sharpen_spv.h), overlay (Overlay.cs -> runtime/src/overlay_spv.h), smaa0/smaa1/smaa2 (Smaa.cs ->
// runtime/src/smaa0_spv.h ...), upscale (Upscale.cs ->
// runtime/src/upscale_spv.h), motion (Motion.cs -> runtime/src/motion_spv.h). One argument = sharpen (old usage).
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

static class Program
{
    static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        string name = args.Length > 1 ? args[0] : "sharpen", outPath = args[args.Length - 1];
        byte[] spv = name == "mvcheck" ? MvCheck.Build() : name == "motion" ? Motion.Build() : name == "overlay" ? Overlay.Build() : name == "upscale" ? Upscale.Build()
                   : name.StartsWith("smaa") ? Smaa.Build(name[4] - '0') : name.StartsWith("msx") ? MsExpand.Build(name == "msxv")
                   : Sharpen.Build();
        string what = name == "mvcheck" ? "Motion vector debug check compute shader, source tools/spvgen/Motion.cs." : name == "motion" ? "Camera motion vectors from depth (temporal upscaler input) compute shader, source tools/spvgen/Motion.cs."
                    : name.StartsWith("msx") ? $"MSAA expand (1x image -> multisampled twin) {(name == "msxv" ? "vertex" : "fragment")} shader, source tools/spvgen/MsExpand.cs."
                    : name.StartsWith("smaa") ? $"SMAA-style anti-aliasing pass {name[4]} compute shader, source tools/spvgen/Smaa.cs."
                    : name == "overlay" ? "Subtitle overlay blend compute shader, source tools/spvgen/Overlay.cs."
                    : name == "upscale" ? "Edge-adaptive (FSR 1 style) upscaling compute shader, source tools/spvgen/Upscale.cs."
                                        : "Contrast-adaptive sharpening compute shader, source tools/spvgen/Sharpen.cs.";
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"// Generated by tools/spvgen (dotnet run --project tools/spvgen -- {name} runtime/src/{name}_spv.h); do not edit.");
        sb.AppendLine("// " + what);
        sb.AppendLine("#pragma once");
        sb.AppendLine($"static const uint32_t k_{name}_spv[] = {{");
        for (int i = 0; i < spv.Length; i += 4)
        {
            sb.Append(i % 32 == 0 ? "    " : " ").Append("0x").Append(BitConverter.ToUInt32(spv, i).ToString("x8")).Append(',');
            if (i % 32 == 28 || i + 4 >= spv.Length) sb.AppendLine();
        }
        sb.AppendLine("};");
        File.WriteAllText(outPath, sb.ToString());
        Console.WriteLine($"{outPath}: {spv.Length} bytes of SPIR-V");
        return 0;
    }
}
```

`tools/spvgen/Sharpen.cs`:

```cs
// Contrast-adaptive sharpening compute shader for the runtime's present path, built here with Ryujinx's SPIR-V
// builder (Spv.Generator, MIT) because no GLSL/HLSL -> SPIR-V compiler is available. Our own formulation of the
// usual idea: per channel, the 4 cross neighbours pull the centre away from their mean by a weight that shrinks
// where the local range is already near 0 or 1 (no halos on hard edges).
//   set 0 binding 0: sampled image (the game's frame), binding 1: storage image (the output, R8G8B8A8_UNORM)
//   push constants: int width, int height, float peak (negative: -1/8 light .. -1/5 strong)
//   local size 8 x 8; out = (e + w * (b + d + f + h)) / (1 + 4w), w = peak * sqrt(clamp(min(mn, 1 - mx) / mx))
using Spv.Generator;
using static Spv.Specification;

static class Sharpen
{
    public static byte[] Build()
    {
        var m = new Module(0x00010300);
        m.AddCapability(Capability.Shader);
        m.SetMemoryModel(AddressingModel.Logical, MemoryModel.GLSL450);

        var tVoid = m.TypeVoid();
        var tF = m.TypeFloat(32);
        var tI = m.TypeInt(32, 1);
        var tU = m.TypeInt(32, 0);
        var tB = m.TypeBool();
        var tV4 = m.TypeVector(tF, 4);
        var tI2 = m.TypeVector(tI, 2);
        var tU3 = m.TypeVector(tU, 3);
        var tSrc = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 1, ImageFormat.Unknown);
        var tDst = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 2, ImageFormat.Rgba8);
        var pSrc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tSrc);
        var pDst = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tDst);
        var tPc = m.TypeStruct(true, tI, tI, tF);
        var pPc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tPc);
        var pPcI = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tI);
        var pPcF = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tF);
        var pIn = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Input, tU3);

        var src = m.Variable(pSrc, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var dst = m.Variable(pDst, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var pc = m.Variable(pPc, StorageClass.PushConstant);
        var gid = m.Variable(pIn, StorageClass.Input);
        m.Decorate(src, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(src, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)1);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.NonReadable);
        m.Decorate(gid, Decoration.BuiltIn, (LiteralInteger)(int)BuiltIn.GlobalInvocationId);
        m.Decorate(tPc, Decoration.Block);
        m.MemberDecorate(tPc, 0, Decoration.Offset, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.MemberDecorate(tPc, 1, Decoration.Offset, (LiteralInteger)4);
        m.MemberDecorate(tPc, 2, Decoration.Offset, (LiteralInteger)8);
        foreach (var v in new[] { src, dst, pc, gid }) m.AddGlobalVariable(v);

        var i0 = m.Constant(tI, 0);
        var i1 = m.Constant(tI, 1);
        var i2 = m.Constant(tI, 2);
        var f0 = m.Constant(tF, 0f);
        var f1 = m.Constant(tF, 1f);
        var f4 = m.Constant(tF, 4f);
        var fEps = m.Constant(tF, 1f / 1024);
        var v0 = m.ConstantComposite(tV4, f0, f0, f0, f0);
        var v1 = m.ConstantComposite(tV4, f1, f1, f1, f1);
        var vEps = m.ConstantComposite(tV4, fEps, fEps, fEps, fEps);
        var z2 = m.ConstantComposite(tI2, i0, i0);

        var main = m.Function(tVoid, FunctionControlMask.MaskNone, m.TypeFunction(tVoid, false));
        m.AddFunction(main);
        m.AddLabel(m.Label());
        var w = m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, i0));
        var h = m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, i1));
        var peak = m.Load(tF, m.AccessChain(pPcF, pc, i2));
        var id3 = m.Load(tU3, gid);
        var x = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 0));
        var y = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 1));
        var inside = m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.SLessThan(tB, x, w), m.SLessThan(tB, y, h));
        var body = m.Label();
        var end = m.Label();
        m.SelectionMerge(end, SelectionControlMask.MaskNone);
        m.BranchConditional(inside, body, end);
        m.AddLabel(body);
        var img = m.Load(tSrc, src);
        var max2 = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, m.ISub(tI, w, i1), m.ISub(tI, h, i1));
        var p = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, x, y);
        Instruction Tap(int dx, int dy)
        {
            var q = dx == 0 && dy == 0 ? p : m.GlslSClamp(tI2, m.IAdd(tI2, p, m.ConstantComposite(tI2, m.Constant(tI, dx), m.Constant(tI, dy))), z2, max2);
            return m.ImageFetch(tV4, img, q, ImageOperandsMask.Lod, i0);
        }
        var e = Tap(0, 0);
        var b = Tap(0, -1);
        var d = Tap(-1, 0);
        var f = Tap(1, 0);
        var hh = Tap(0, 1);
        var mn = m.GlslFMin(tV4, m.GlslFMin(tV4, m.GlslFMin(tV4, b, d), m.GlslFMin(tV4, f, hh)), e);
        var mx = m.GlslFMax(tV4, m.GlslFMax(tV4, m.GlslFMax(tV4, b, d), m.GlslFMax(tV4, f, hh)), e);
        var room = m.GlslFMin(tV4, mn, m.FSub(tV4, v1, mx));
        var amp = m.GlslSqrt(tV4, m.GlslFClamp(tV4, m.FDiv(tV4, room, m.FAdd(tV4, mx, vEps)), v0, v1));
        var wt = m.VectorTimesScalar(tV4, amp, peak);
        var sum = m.FAdd(tV4, m.FAdd(tV4, b, d), m.FAdd(tV4, f, hh));
        var num = m.FAdd(tV4, e, m.FMul(tV4, wt, sum));
        var den = m.FAdd(tV4, v1, m.VectorTimesScalar(tV4, wt, f4));
        var res = m.GlslFClamp(tV4, m.FDiv(tV4, num, den), v0, v1);
        var outv = m.CompositeInsert(tV4, m.CompositeExtract(tF, e, 3), res, 3);  // alpha unchanged
        m.ImageWrite(m.Load(tDst, dst), p, outv, ImageOperandsMask.MaskNone);
        m.Branch(end);
        m.AddLabel(end);
        m.Return();
        m.FunctionEnd();
        m.AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModel.GLCompute, main, "main", gid);
        m.AddExecutionMode(main, ExecutionMode.LocalSize, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)1);
        return m.Generate();
    }
}

```

`tools/spvgen/Smaa.cs`:

```cs
// SMAA-style morphological anti-aliasing, three compute passes, built with Ryujinx's SPIR-V builder (Spv.Generator,
// MIT). Our own formulation of the published idea (Reshetov's MLAA / Jimenez et al.'s SMAA): no area or search
// textures, the coverage is computed in the shader.
//   pass 0 edges:   A = colour.  out.r = edge on the pixel's left side, out.g = edge on its top side (luma delta over
//                   the threshold and at least half the largest delta around it: local contrast adaptation)
//   pass 1 weights: A = edges.   For a top edge: walk left/right along the row to the segment ends (max steps, stop at
//                   crossing edges); each end's crossing edge says the silhouette steps up (+1/2) or down (-1/2) there;
//                   the line runs from each end's half step to 0 at the segment centre (Z, U and L shapes alike). The
//                   pixel's share of the area between line and edge: line above the edge -> the pixel above takes
//                   this pixel's colour (out.g), below -> this pixel takes the colour above (out.r). Left edges the
//                   same along the column (out.b: this pixel takes the left colour, out.a: the left pixel takes ours).
//   pass 2 blend:   A = colour, B = weights. P += wt (T - P) + wb (Bm - P) + wl (L - P) + wr (R - P), weights from
//                   this pixel (r, b), the pixel below (g) and right (a), scaled down when they sum over 1. Alpha kept.
//   pass 3: pass 2 into an R11G11B10 float image
//   set 0: binding 0 sampled image A, binding 1 sampled image B, binding 2 storage image out (rgba8)
//   push constants: int width, int height, float threshold, int max steps; local size 8 x 8
using System;
using Spv.Generator;
using static Spv.Specification;

static class Smaa
{
    public static byte[] Build(int pass)
    {
        var m = new Module(0x00010300);
        m.AddCapability(Capability.Shader);
        m.SetMemoryModel(AddressingModel.Logical, MemoryModel.GLSL450);

        var tVoid = m.TypeVoid();
        var tF = m.TypeFloat(32);
        var tI = m.TypeInt(32, 1);
        var tU = m.TypeInt(32, 0);
        var tB = m.TypeBool();
        var tV3 = m.TypeVector(tF, 3);
        var tV4 = m.TypeVector(tF, 4);
        var tI2 = m.TypeVector(tI, 2);
        var tU3 = m.TypeVector(tU, 3);
        var tSrc = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 1, ImageFormat.Unknown);
        // pass 3 = pass 2 writing an R11G11B10 float image (the game's tone-mapped frame before FXAA is that format)
        var tDst = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 2, pass == 3 ? ImageFormat.R11fG11fB10f : ImageFormat.Rgba8);
        if (pass == 3) m.AddCapability(Capability.StorageImageExtendedFormats);
        var pSrc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tSrc);
        var pDst = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tDst);
        var tPc = m.TypeStruct(true, tI, tI, tF, tI);
        var pPc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tPc);
        var pPcI = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tI);
        var pPcF = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tF);
        var pIn = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Input, tU3);
        var pFnI = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Function, tI);
        var pFnV4 = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Function, tV4);

        var srcA = m.Variable(pSrc, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var srcB = m.Variable(pSrc, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var dst = m.Variable(pDst, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var pc = m.Variable(pPc, StorageClass.PushConstant);
        var gid = m.Variable(pIn, StorageClass.Input);
        m.Decorate(srcA, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(srcA, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(srcB, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(srcB, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)1);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)2);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.NonReadable);
        m.Decorate(gid, Decoration.BuiltIn, (LiteralInteger)(int)BuiltIn.GlobalInvocationId);
        m.Decorate(tPc, Decoration.Block);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) m.MemberDecorate(tPc, i, Decoration.Offset, (LiteralInteger)(4 * i));
        foreach (var v in new[] { srcA, srcB, dst, pc, gid }) m.AddGlobalVariable(v);

        Instruction I(int v) => m.Constant(tI, v);
        Instruction F(float v) => m.Constant(tF, v);
        var f0 = F(0f);
        var v0 = m.ConstantComposite(tV4, f0, f0, f0, f0);
        var z2 = m.ConstantComposite(tI2, I(0), I(0));
        var luma = m.ConstantComposite(tV3, F(0.2126f), F(0.7152f), F(0.0722f));

        var main = m.Function(tVoid, FunctionControlMask.MaskNone, m.TypeFunction(tVoid, false));
        m.AddFunction(main);
        m.AddLabel(m.Label());
        // function variables first (SPIR-V: in the first block)
        var vRes = m.Variable(pFnV4, StorageClass.Function);
        var vA = m.Variable(pFnI, StorageClass.Function);
        var vK = m.Variable(pFnI, StorageClass.Function);
        var vB = m.Variable(pFnI, StorageClass.Function);
        var vK2 = m.Variable(pFnI, StorageClass.Function);
        foreach (var v in new[] { vRes, vA, vK, vB, vK2 }) m.AddLocalVariable(v);

        var w = m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, I(0)));
        var h = m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, I(1)));
        var thr = m.Load(tF, m.AccessChain(pPcF, pc, I(2)));
        var steps = m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, I(3)));
        var id3 = m.Load(tU3, gid);
        var x = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 0));
        var y = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 1));
        var inside = m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.SLessThan(tB, x, w), m.SLessThan(tB, y, h));
        var body = m.Label();
        var end = m.Label();
        m.SelectionMerge(end, SelectionControlMask.MaskNone);
        m.BranchConditional(inside, body, end);
        m.AddLabel(body);
        var imgA = m.Load(tSrc, srcA);
        var max2 = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, m.ISub(tI, w, I(1)), m.ISub(tI, h, I(1)));
        var p = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, x, y);
        Instruction Fetch(Instruction img, Instruction qx, Instruction qy) =>
            m.ImageFetch(tV4, img, m.GlslSClamp(tI2, m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, qx, qy), z2, max2), ImageOperandsMask.Lod, I(0));
        Instruction Add(Instruction a, int d) => d == 0 ? a : m.IAdd(tI, a, I(d));
        Instruction Abs(Instruction a) => m.GlslFAbs(tF, a);
        Instruction Max(Instruction a, Instruction b) => m.GlslFMax(tF, a, b);
        void If(Instruction cond, Action then)
        {
            var t = m.Label();
            var e = m.Label();
            m.SelectionMerge(e, SelectionControlMask.MaskNone);
            m.BranchConditional(cond, t, e);
            m.AddLabel(t);
            then();
            m.Branch(e);
            m.AddLabel(e);
        }
        // while (cond()) step(): cond is straight-line code evaluated in the loop's check block
        void While(Func<Instruction> cond, Action step)
        {
            var header = m.Label();
            var check = m.Label();
            var loopBody = m.Label();
            var cont = m.Label();
            var merge = m.Label();
            m.Branch(header);
            m.AddLabel(header);
            m.LoopMerge(merge, cont, LoopControlMask.MaskNone);
            m.Branch(check);
            m.AddLabel(check);
            m.BranchConditional(cond(), loopBody, merge);
            m.AddLabel(loopBody);
            step();
            m.Branch(cont);
            m.AddLabel(cont);
            m.Branch(header);
            m.AddLabel(merge);
        }

        if (pass == 0)
        {
            Instruction L(int dx, int dy) { var f = Fetch(imgA, Add(x, dx), Add(y, dy)); return m.Dot(tF, m.VectorShuffle(tV3, f, f, 0, 1, 2), luma); }
            var c = L(0, 0);
            var l = L(-1, 0);
            var t = L(0, -1);
            var dl = m.Select(tF, m.SGreaterThan(tB, x, I(0)), Abs(m.FSub(tF, c, l)), f0);
            var dt = m.Select(tF, m.SGreaterThan(tB, y, I(0)), Abs(m.FSub(tF, c, t)), f0);
            var dr = Abs(m.FSub(tF, L(1, 0), c));
            var db = Abs(m.FSub(tF, L(0, 1), c));
            var dll = Abs(m.FSub(tF, l, L(-2, 0)));
            var dtt = Abs(m.FSub(tF, t, L(0, -2)));
            var mx = Max(Max(Max(dl, dt), Max(dr, db)), Max(dll, dtt));
            Instruction Edge(Instruction d) => m.Select(tF, m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.FOrdGreaterThan(tB, d, thr),
                                                                       m.FOrdGreaterThanEqual(tB, m.FMul(tF, d, F(2f)), mx)), F(1f), f0);
            m.Store(vRes, m.CompositeConstruct(tV4, Edge(dl), Edge(dt), f0, f0));
        }
        else if (pass == 1)
        {
            m.Store(vRes, v0);
            Instruction Top(Instruction qx, Instruction qy) => m.FOrdGreaterThan(tB, m.CompositeExtract(tF, Fetch(imgA, qx, qy), 1), F(0.5f));
            Instruction Left(Instruction qx, Instruction qy) => m.FOrdGreaterThan(tB, m.CompositeExtract(tF, Fetch(imgA, qx, qy), 0), F(0.5f));
            var e = Fetch(imgA, x, y);
            var half = F(0.5f);
            // one edge: run along axis u (the pixel's u = pu, other coordinate pv), 'has(u)' = edge continues at u,
            // 'crossNeg(u)' / 'crossPos(u)' = crossing edges at the boundary before u on the far / own side.
            // Writes the two weights (far side takes ours, we take the far side's) into res components ci_far, ci_own.
            void Segment(Instruction pu, Instruction limit, Func<Instruction, Instruction> has,
                         Func<Instruction, Instruction> crossFar, Func<Instruction, Instruction> crossOwn, int ciFar, int ciOwn)
            {
                // walk back
                m.Store(vA, pu);
                m.Store(vK, I(0));
                While(() =>
                {
                    var a = m.Load(tI, vA);
                    var ok = m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.SLessThan(tB, m.Load(tI, vK), steps), m.SGreaterThan(tB, a, I(0)));
                    var noCross = m.LogicalNot(tB, m.LogicalOr(tB, crossFar(a), crossOwn(a)));
                    return m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.LogicalAnd(tB, ok, noCross), has(m.ISub(tI, a, I(1))));
                }, () =>
                {
                    m.Store(vA, m.ISub(tI, m.Load(tI, vA), I(1)));
                    m.Store(vK, m.IAdd(tI, m.Load(tI, vK), I(1)));
                });
                // walk forward (b = last u with the edge; crossings at the boundary before b + 1)
                m.Store(vB, pu);
                m.Store(vK2, I(0));
                While(() =>
                {
                    var b = m.Load(tI, vB);
                    var b1 = m.IAdd(tI, b, I(1));
                    var ok = m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.SLessThan(tB, m.Load(tI, vK2), steps), m.SLessThan(tB, b, limit));
                    var noCross = m.LogicalNot(tB, m.LogicalOr(tB, crossFar(b1), crossOwn(b1)));
                    return m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.LogicalAnd(tB, ok, noCross), has(b1));
                }, () =>
                {
                    m.Store(vB, m.IAdd(tI, m.Load(tI, vB), I(1)));
                    m.Store(vK2, m.IAdd(tI, m.Load(tI, vK2), I(1)));
                });
                var a0 = m.Load(tI, vA);
                var b0 = m.Load(tI, vB);
                var bEnd = m.IAdd(tI, b0, I(1));
                // end heights: +1/2 toward the far side, -1/2 toward ours, 0 without a single crossing or at the step limit
                Instruction EndH(Instruction at, Instruction k)
                {
                    var far = crossFar(at);
                    var own = crossOwn(at);
                    var hv = m.Select(tF, m.LogicalAnd(tB, far, m.LogicalNot(tB, own)), half,
                                      m.Select(tF, m.LogicalAnd(tB, own, m.LogicalNot(tB, far)), F(-0.5f), f0));
                    return m.Select(tF, m.SLessThan(tB, k, steps), hv, f0);
                }
                var hA = EndH(a0, m.Load(tI, vK));
                var hB = EndH(bEnd, m.Load(tI, vK2));
                var fa = m.ConvertSToF(tF, a0);
                var fb = m.ConvertSToF(tF, bEnd);
                var len2 = m.FMul(tF, m.FSub(tF, fb, fa), half);  // half length
                var cen = m.FAdd(tF, fa, len2);
                var u0 = m.ConvertSToF(tF, pu);
                var u1 = m.FAdd(tF, u0, F(1f));
                // integral of a linear piece over [lo, hi] (0 when empty): (hi - lo) * (h(lo) + h(hi)) / 2
                Instruction Piece(Instruction lo, Instruction hi, Func<Instruction, Instruction> hAt)
                {
                    var len = m.GlslFMax(tF, m.FSub(tF, hi, lo), f0);
                    return m.FMul(tF, m.FMul(tF, len, half), m.FAdd(tF, hAt(lo), hAt(hi)));
                }
                var s1 = Piece(m.GlslFMax(tF, u0, fa), m.GlslFMin(tF, u1, cen), t => m.FDiv(tF, m.FMul(tF, hA, m.FSub(tF, cen, t)), len2));
                var s2 = Piece(m.GlslFMax(tF, u0, cen), m.GlslFMin(tF, u1, fb), t => m.FDiv(tF, m.FMul(tF, hB, m.FSub(tF, t, cen)), len2));
                var farW = m.FAdd(tF, Max(s1, f0), Max(s2, f0));
                var ownW = m.FAdd(tF, Max(m.FNegate(tF, s1), f0), Max(m.FNegate(tF, s2), f0));
                var r = m.Load(tV4, vRes);
                r = m.CompositeInsert(tV4, farW, r, ciFar);
                r = m.CompositeInsert(tV4, ownW, r, ciOwn);
                m.Store(vRes, r);
            }
            var ym1 = m.ISub(tI, y, I(1));
            var xm1 = m.ISub(tI, x, I(1));
            // top edge: along the row; far side = row y-1. crossing at boundary before u: left edges of (u, y-1) / (u, y)
            If(m.FOrdGreaterThan(tB, m.CompositeExtract(tF, e, 1), half), () =>
                Segment(x, m.ISub(tI, w, I(1)), u => Top(u, y), u => Left(u, ym1), u => Left(u, y), 1, 0));
            // left edge: along the column; far side = column x-1. crossing at boundary before v: top edges of (x-1, v) / (x, v)
            If(m.FOrdGreaterThan(tB, m.CompositeExtract(tF, e, 0), half), () =>
                Segment(y, m.ISub(tI, h, I(1)), v => Left(x, v), v => Top(xm1, v), v => Top(x, v), 3, 2));
        }
        else
        {
            var imgB = m.Load(tSrc, srcB);
            var P = Fetch(imgA, x, y);
            var wp = Fetch(imgB, x, y);
            var wt = m.CompositeExtract(tF, wp, 0);
            var wl = m.CompositeExtract(tF, wp, 2);
            var wb = m.Select(tF, m.SLessThan(tB, Add(y, 1), h), m.CompositeExtract(tF, Fetch(imgB, x, Add(y, 1)), 1), f0);
            var wr = m.Select(tF, m.SLessThan(tB, Add(x, 1), w), m.CompositeExtract(tF, Fetch(imgB, Add(x, 1), y), 3), f0);
            var sum = m.FAdd(tF, m.FAdd(tF, wt, wb), m.FAdd(tF, wl, wr));
            var sc = m.FDiv(tF, F(1f), Max(sum, F(1f)));
            Instruction Term(Instruction wgt, int dx, int dy) =>
                m.VectorTimesScalar(tV4, m.FSub(tV4, Fetch(imgA, Add(x, dx), Add(y, dy)), P), m.FMul(tF, wgt, sc));
            var o = m.FAdd(tV4, P, m.FAdd(tV4, m.FAdd(tV4, Term(wt, 0, -1), Term(wb, 0, 1)), m.FAdd(tV4, Term(wl, -1, 0), Term(wr, 1, 0))));
            m.Store(vRes, m.CompositeInsert(tV4, m.CompositeExtract(tF, P, 3), o, 3));  // alpha unchanged
        }
        m.ImageWrite(m.Load(tDst, dst), p, m.Load(tV4, vRes), ImageOperandsMask.MaskNone);
        m.Branch(end);
        m.AddLabel(end);
        m.Return();
        m.FunctionEnd();
        m.AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModel.GLCompute, main, "main", gid);
        m.AddExecutionMode(main, ExecutionMode.LocalSize, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)1);
        return m.Generate();
    }
}
```

`tools/spvgen/Upscale.cs`:

```cs
// Edge-adaptive upscaling compute shader (setting upscaler = FSR 1) for the runtime's present path, built with
// Ryujinx's SPIR-V builder (Spv.Generator, MIT) like Sharpen.cs. Our own code for the idea of AMD FidelityFX Super
// Resolution 1's EASU pass (MIT): a 12-tap Lanczos-like kernel whose footprint is rotated along the local edge and
// stretched with the edge strength, then clamped to the 4 nearest pixels (no ringing). RCAS = our Sharpen pass after.
//   set 0 binding 0: sampled image (the game's frame), binding 1: storage image (the output, R8G8B8A8_UNORM)
//   push constants: int src width, src height, dst width, dst height; local size 8 x 8
// Per output pixel: p = (x + 0.5) * src / dst - 0.5, f = floor(p), t = p - f. Taps: the 2x2 pixels around p and the
// cross around them (12). Luma gradient g and edge strength r (|central difference| / (sum of the two one-sided
// differences): 1 on a ramp, 0 on a peak) at the 4 inner pixels, mixed bilinearly with t -> direction d (unit),
// strength s. Kernel per tap v = tap - t: u = (dot(v, d) * (1 + (k - 1) s), cross(v, d) * (1 - s / 2)), k = 1 /
// max(|d.x|, |d.y|); q = min(|u|^2, 1 / lobe), lobe = 0.5 - 0.29 s; w = (1.5625 (0.4 q - 1)^2 - 0.5625) (lobe q - 1)^2.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Spv.Generator;
using static Spv.Specification;

static class Upscale
{
    public static byte[] Build()
    {
        var m = new Module(0x00010300);
        m.AddCapability(Capability.Shader);
        m.SetMemoryModel(AddressingModel.Logical, MemoryModel.GLSL450);

        var tVoid = m.TypeVoid();
        var tF = m.TypeFloat(32);
        var tI = m.TypeInt(32, 1);
        var tU = m.TypeInt(32, 0);
        var tB = m.TypeBool();
        var tV4 = m.TypeVector(tF, 4);
        var tI2 = m.TypeVector(tI, 2);
        var tU3 = m.TypeVector(tU, 3);
        var tSrc = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 1, ImageFormat.Unknown);
        var tDst = m.TypeImage(tF, Dim.Dim2D, 0, 0, 0, 2, ImageFormat.Rgba8);
        var pSrc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tSrc);
        var pDst = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.UniformConstant, tDst);
        var tPc = m.TypeStruct(true, tI, tI, tI, tI);
        var pPc = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tPc);
        var pPcI = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.PushConstant, tI);
        var pIn = m.TypePointer(StorageClass.Input, tU3);

        var src = m.Variable(pSrc, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var dst = m.Variable(pDst, StorageClass.UniformConstant);
        var pc = m.Variable(pPc, StorageClass.PushConstant);
        var gid = m.Variable(pIn, StorageClass.Input);
        m.Decorate(src, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(src, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.DescriptorSet, (LiteralInteger)0);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.Binding, (LiteralInteger)1);
        m.Decorate(dst, Decoration.NonReadable);
        m.Decorate(gid, Decoration.BuiltIn, (LiteralInteger)(int)BuiltIn.GlobalInvocationId);
        m.Decorate(tPc, Decoration.Block);
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) m.MemberDecorate(tPc, k, Decoration.Offset, (LiteralInteger)(4 * k));
        foreach (var v in new[] { src, dst, pc, gid }) m.AddGlobalVariable(v);

        var fc = new Dictionary<float, Instruction>();
        Instruction F(float x) => fc.TryGetValue(x, out var c) ? c : fc[x] = m.Constant(tF, x);
        var ic = new Dictionary<int, Instruction>();
        Instruction I(int x) => ic.TryGetValue(x, out var c) ? c : ic[x] = m.Constant(tI, x);
        Instruction Add(Instruction a, Instruction b) => m.FAdd(tF, a, b);
        Instruction Sub(Instruction a, Instruction b) => m.FSub(tF, a, b);
        Instruction Mul(Instruction a, Instruction b) => m.FMul(tF, a, b);
        Instruction Abs(Instruction a) => m.GlslFAbs(tF, a);
        var z2 = m.ConstantComposite(tI2, I(0), I(0));
        var lumaW = m.ConstantComposite(tV4, F(0.299f), F(0.587f), F(0.114f), F(0f));

        var main = m.Function(tVoid, FunctionControlMask.MaskNone, m.TypeFunction(tVoid, false));
        m.AddFunction(main);
        m.AddLabel(m.Label());
        Instruction Pc(int k) => m.Load(tI, m.AccessChain(pPcI, pc, I(k)));
        var sw = Pc(0); var sh = Pc(1); var dw = Pc(2); var dh = Pc(3);
        var id3 = m.Load(tU3, gid);
        var x = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 0));
        var y = m.Bitcast(tI, m.CompositeExtract(tU, id3, 1));
        var inside = m.LogicalAnd(tB, m.SLessThan(tB, x, dw), m.SLessThan(tB, y, dh));
        var body = m.Label();
        var end = m.Label();
        m.SelectionMerge(end, SelectionControlMask.MaskNone);
        m.BranchConditional(inside, body, end);
        m.AddLabel(body);

        Instruction ToF(Instruction i) => m.ConvertSToF(tF, i);
        var posx = Sub(Mul(Add(ToF(x), F(0.5f)), m.FDiv(tF, ToF(sw), ToF(dw))), F(0.5f));
        var posy = Sub(Mul(Add(ToF(y), F(0.5f)), m.FDiv(tF, ToF(sh), ToF(dh))), F(0.5f));
        var flx = m.GlslFloor(tF, posx);
        var fly = m.GlslFloor(tF, posy);
        var tx = Sub(posx, flx);
        var ty = Sub(posy, fly);
        var base2 = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, m.ConvertFToS(tI, flx), m.ConvertFToS(tI, fly));
        var max2 = m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, m.ISub(tI, sw, I(1)), m.ISub(tI, sh, I(1)));
        var img = m.Load(tSrc, src);

        // the 12 taps, by offset from the top-left inner pixel
        var taps = new (int dx, int dy)[] { (0, -1), (1, -1), (-1, 0), (0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (-1, 1), (0, 1), (1, 1), (2, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2) };
        var col = new Dictionary<(int, int), Instruction>();
        var lum = new Dictionary<(int, int), Instruction>();
        foreach (var (dx, dy) in taps)
        {
            var q = m.GlslSClamp(tI2, m.IAdd(tI2, base2, m.ConstantComposite(tI2, I(dx), I(dy))), z2, max2);
            var c = m.ImageFetch(tV4, img, q, ImageOperandsMask.Lod, I(0));
            col[(dx, dy)] = c;
            lum[(dx, dy)] = m.Dot(tF, c, lumaW);
        }

        // direction + edge strength at the 4 inner pixels, mixed bilinearly
        Instruction Ratio(Instruction lo, Instruction mid, Instruction hi) =>
            m.FDiv(tF, Abs(Sub(hi, lo)), Add(Add(Abs(Sub(hi, mid)), Abs(Sub(mid, lo))), F(1f / 4096)));
        Instruction dirx = null, diry = null, len = null;
        foreach (var (a, b) in new[] { (0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1) })
        {
            var wx = a == 0 ? Sub(F(1f), tx) : tx;
            var wy = b == 0 ? Sub(F(1f), ty) : ty;
            var w = Mul(wx, wy);
            var l = lum[(a, b)];
            var gx = Sub(lum[(a + 1, b)], lum[(a - 1, b)]);
            var gy = Sub(lum[(a, b + 1)], lum[(a, b - 1)]);
            var rx = Ratio(lum[(a - 1, b)], l, lum[(a + 1, b)]);
            var ry = Ratio(lum[(a, b - 1)], l, lum[(a, b + 1)]);
            var s = Mul(Add(Mul(rx, rx), Mul(ry, ry)), F(0.5f));
            dirx = dirx == null ? Mul(w, gx) : Add(dirx, Mul(w, gx));
            diry = diry == null ? Mul(w, gy) : Add(diry, Mul(w, gy));
            len = len == null ? Mul(w, s) : Add(len, Mul(w, s));
        }
        var d2 = Add(Mul(dirx, dirx), Mul(diry, diry));
        var flat = m.FOrdLessThan(tB, d2, F(1f / 32768));
        dirx = m.Select(tF, flat, F(1f), dirx);
        diry = m.Select(tF, flat, F(0f), diry);
        var inv = m.GlslInverseSqrt(tF, m.Select(tF, flat, F(1f), d2));
        dirx = Mul(dirx, inv);
        diry = Mul(diry, inv);
        var stretch = m.FDiv(tF, F(1f), m.GlslFMax(tF, Abs(dirx), Abs(diry)));
        var lx = Add(F(1f), Mul(Sub(stretch, F(1f)), len));
        var ly = Sub(F(1f), Mul(F(0.5f), len));
        var lobe = Sub(F(0.5f), Mul(F(0.29f), len));
        var clip = m.FDiv(tF, F(1f), lobe);

        Instruction acc = null, wsum = null;
        foreach (var (dx, dy) in taps)
        {
            var vx = Sub(F(dx), tx);
            var vy = Sub(F(dy), ty);
            var ux = Mul(Add(Mul(vx, dirx), Mul(vy, diry)), lx);
            var uy = Mul(Sub(Mul(vy, dirx), Mul(vx, diry)), ly);
            var q = m.GlslFMin(tF, Add(Mul(ux, ux), Mul(uy, uy)), clip);
            var wb = Sub(Mul(F(0.4f), q), F(1f));
            var wa = Sub(Mul(lobe, q), F(1f));
            var w = Mul(Sub(Mul(F(1.5625f), Mul(wb, wb)), F(0.5625f)), Mul(wa, wa));
            var cw = m.VectorTimesScalar(tV4, col[(dx, dy)], w);
            acc = acc == null ? cw : m.FAdd(tV4, acc, cw);
            wsum = wsum == null ? w : Add(wsum, w);
        }
        var res = m.VectorTimesScalar(tV4, acc, m.FDiv(tF, F(1f), wsum));
        var c00 = col[(0, 0)]; var c10 = col[(1, 0)]; var c01 = col[(0, 1)]; var c11 = col[(1, 1)];
        var mn = m.GlslFMin(tV4, m.GlslFMin(tV4, c00, c10), m.GlslFMin(tV4, c01, c11));
        var mx = m.GlslFMax(tV4, m.GlslFMax(tV4, c00, c10), m.GlslFMax(tV4, c01, c11));
        res = m.GlslFClamp(tV4, res, mn, mx);
        var outv = m.CompositeInsert(tV4, F(1f), res, 3);
        m.ImageWrite(m.Load(tDst, dst), m.CompositeConstruct(tI2, x, y), outv, ImageOperandsMask.MaskNone);
        m.Branch(end);
        m.AddLabel(end);
        m.Return();
        m.FunctionEnd();
        m.AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModel.GLCompute, main, "main", gid);
        m.AddExecutionMode(main, ExecutionMode.LocalSize, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)8, (LiteralInteger)1);
        return m.Generate();
    }
}
```
